Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于食物识别领域的 VLM 应用。仅 LoRA 微调方法论有间接借鉴价值，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：细粒度食物识别（fine-grained food recognition）与食物推理；应用场景：基于图像的膳食评估（image-based dietary assessment）；传感器类型：普通可见光图像（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：216 种地中海/欧洲菜肴类别，以及食材成分识别。

Model architecture: 基于 PaliGemma-2-3B 开源权重架构，采用 LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）进行参数高效微调（PEFT）。对比基线包括 CNN 模型（DenseNet-121）以及闭源前沿模型（Gemini Flash 3/3.5、GPT-5.4 Mini、Claude Haiku 4.6）。

Lightweight method: 采用 LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）进行参数高效微调（PEFT），这是对预训练大模型进行轻量级适配的方法，避免全量微调的开销。但论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS 或推理加速等传统模型压缩手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。虽然模型基于 3B 参数的小型 VLM，但未讨论边缘/星上部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：来自三个欧洲研究项目数据集（MedGR、ODIN、VIPPSTAR）的 17,340 张图像，统一为 216 个菜肴类别词汇表，配 102,642 条指令式问答对。评价指标：Top-1 准确率（92.96% ± 0.91%）、Top-3/Top-5 准确率、Exact-Set（食材识别，90.79% ± 1.3%）。实验设置：3 折交叉验证（3-fold cross-validation）。

Experiments: OliveGemma 在 Top-1 准确率上达到 92.96%，超过最强 CNN 基线 DenseNet-121 达 7.31%；在零样本闭源模型对比中，超过 Gemini Flash 3/3.5 达 8%、GPT-5.4 Mini 达 46%、Claude Haiku 4.6 达 64%。在 Top-3/Top-5 上排名第二，仅次于 DenseNet-121。食材识别 Exact-Set 达 90.79%。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关，属于食物识别领域；2. 未涉及任何模型压缩或推理加速技术；3. 未提供部署相关指标（参数量、FLOPs、延迟等）；4. 未讨论小目标检测、旋转框检测等遥感目标检测核心问题；5. 模型基于 3B 参数 VLM，即使有 LoRA 微调，推理开销仍可能较大，不适合星上部署。

Ideas for my research: 1. LoRA/PEFT 微调思路可借鉴：在遥感目标检测中，可考虑对预训练检测模型（如 DETR 系列、YOLO 系列）采用 LoRA 等参数高效微调，减少在轨模型更新时的训练开销；2. 小模型超越大模型的经验：论文证明小型 VLM 通过领域数据微调可超越大参数闭源模型，这支持"在轨用小模型+领域微调"的轻量化路线；3. 指令式问答数据构造方式可借鉴到遥感场景理解任务中，但需注意遥感目标检测更关注定位精度而非语义推理。

Abstract: Image based dietary assessment offers a scalable alternative to self reported food diaries, yet fine-grained food recognition remains challenging due to high intra-class variability and visually similar dishes. This study presents OliveGemma, a vision language model for recognising and reasoning about Mediterranean and European cuisine. Built on the open-weight PaliGemma-2-3B architecture, OliveGemma is fine-tuned with LoRA on a unified corpus of 17,340 images from three European research project datasets (MedGR, ODIN, and VIPPSTAR), reconciled into a vocabulary of 216 composed dish categories and paired with 102,642 instruction style question-answer items covering dish recognition, likely and visible ingredients, class boundary discrimination, visual evidence and overall visual food understanding. Under a 3-fold cross-validation scheme, OliveGemma achieves a top-1 accuracy of 92.96% +/- 0.91%, exceeding the strongest CNN baseline (DenseNet-121) by 7.31% and outperforming zero-shot frontier models with exact instructions and bounded classes including Gemini Flash 3 and 3.5, GPT-5.4 Mini, and Claude Haiku 4.6 by 8%, 46%, and 64% respectively. Furthermore, OliveGemma demonstrates competitive performance on Top-3 and Top-5 accuracy, being second best across CNNs and frontier models, surpassed only by DenseNet-121. In addition, OliveGemma achieves 90.79% +/- 1.3% Exact-Set on the likely ingredients of the food categories. These results demonstrate that PEFT adaptation of a small VLM can surpass substantially larger proprietary models on specialised food recognition. The model is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/JamesZar/OliveGemma-3B and the experiments and results can be found at https://github.com/tsiokris/OliveGemma.

</details>


### [77] [Dual-domain U-Nets with embedded back projection operators for motion-resolved 4D CBCT reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03430)
*Ivo Herzig,Pascal Paysan,Daniel Barco,Marc André Stadelmann,Frank-Peter Schilling,Igor Peterlik,Michal Walczak,Lijin Aryananda,Woo Sang Ahn,Rudolf Marcel Füchslin,Lukas Lichtensteiger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于CNN的4D锥形束CT（4D CBCT）运动分辨重建方法，从自由呼吸扫描中直接预测静态体积和十个位移矢量场（DVFs），无需呼吸信号或投影分箱，用于胸部肿瘤图像引导放疗。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文属于医学影像领域（4D CBCT重建），面向图像引导放疗（image-guided radiation therapy），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱数据，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及轻量化/在轨部署。相关性评分为1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于医学影像4D CBCT重建领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：4D CBCT运动分辨重建（motion-resolved 4D CBCT reconstruction）；应用场景：胸部肿瘤图像引导放疗；传感器类型：锥形束CT（cone beam CT）；目标类别：肿瘤（tumor）和食管（esophagus）的可见性评估。不涉及遥感场景或目标检测。

Model architecture: 基于U-Net扩展的CNN：编码器作用于滤波投影堆栈（filtered projection stacks），解码器作用于体积域（volume domain），skip connections被替换为多分辨率下不可训练的反投影函数（non-trainable back-projection functions）以跨域传递特征。网络输入为自由呼吸3D CBCT投影，输出为最大吸气静态体积加十个覆盖呼吸周期的位移矢量场（DVFs）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS或轻量网络设计等模型压缩/加速方法，也未涉及实时推理或边缘/星上部署。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。该工作面向医学影像离线重建场景，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：模拟CBCT扫描训练，11个未见模拟患者和13个临床自由呼吸扫描评估；另有两个额外模型（60秒和6秒扫描）由临床专家在3个和2个扫描上评估。指标：RMSE（-1.19 HU）、PSNR（+0.09 dB）、SSIM（-0.009），以及临床专家对肿瘤和食管可见性的偏好评估（tumor visibility 59% vs 36% no preference, 5% reference；esophagus visibility 47% vs 42%, 11%）。

Experiments: 在模拟数据上图像质量与SART-TV相当（mean RMSE: -1.19 HU, PSNR: +0.09 dB, SSIM: -0.009），同时实现4D重建；在临床扫描上，方法显示出更清晰的动态结构（如膈肌）和更少的运动条纹伪影。临床专家评估中，本方法在肿瘤可见性（59% vs 36%无偏好，5%参考）和食管可见性（47% vs 42%，11%）上均被偏好。

Limitations: 与本研究方向弱相关，主要局限包括：1）面向医学影像而非遥感场景，数据模态（CBCT投影）与遥感图像完全不同；2）不涉及目标检测任务；3）不涉及任何轻量化/压缩/部署方法；4）未报告计算开销和推理效率；5）训练依赖模拟数据，泛化到真实临床场景仍需验证。

Ideas for my research: 尽管整体方向不相关，但可借鉴的点有限：1）U-Net中skip connections替换为不可训练的反投影函数实现跨域特征传递的思想，在遥感多传感器（如SAR与光学）特征融合中可能有启发；2）从单次扫描预测运动模型（DVFs）的思路，与遥感视频/多时相序列中运动目标建模有一定类比性；3）模拟数据训练+临床验证的范式可迁移到遥感仿真数据训练。但这些均为间接借鉴，价值有限。

Abstract: Four-dimensional cone beam CT (4D CBCT) is important for image-guided radiation therapy of thoracic cancers, but its use is limited by long scan times, causing high patient dose and motion/sparse-sampling artifacts.
  We propose a deep learning method for motion-resolved 4D CBCT reconstruction from conventional free-breathing scans, without a respiratory signal or explicit projection binning. Our CNN takes free-breathing 3D CBCT projections as input and predicts a static volume at maximum inhalation plus ten displacement vector fields (DVFs) spanning a breathing cycle.
  The network extends U-Net: the encoder acts on filtered projection stacks, the decoder acts in the volume domain, and skip connections are replaced with non-trainable back-projection functions at multiple resolutions to transfer features between domains. The model is trained on simulated CBCT scans and evaluated on 11 unseen simulated patients and 13 clinical free-breathing scans. Two additional models (60 s and 6 s scans) were evaluated by clinical experts on three and two scans, comparing single phases of our 4D reconstruction to reference 3D SART-TV images for tumor and esophagus visibility.
  Experts preferred our method for tumor visibility (59% vs. 36% no preference, 5% reference) and esophagus visibility (47% vs. 42%, 11%). On simulated data, image quality matched SART-TV (mean RMSE: -1.19 HU, PSNR: +0.09 dB, SSIM: -0.009) while enabling 4D reconstruction. On clinical scans, our method showed sharper dynamic structures (e.g., diaphragm) and fewer motion streak artifacts than traditional reconstruction.
  This non-patient-specific CNN predicts static volumes and full 4D respiratory motion models from a single free-breathing scan, without a respiratory surrogate or projection binning, reducing motion artifacts while adding motion-modeling capability.

</details>


### [78] [Hi-Token: Hierarchical Coordinate Tokenization for Generative Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03471)
*Xiuyuan Zhu,Ke Lu,Kun Dong,Siwen Jiao,Hao Wu,Zijin Du,Shun Mao,Dongming Zhang,Jian Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Hi-Token和Hi-GAR两种方法，通过将边界框坐标编码为轴特定的数字token（百位/十位/个位）并引入基于几何的GRPO奖励，改进生成式视觉语言模型（VLM）在visual grounding任务中的定位精度。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于泛视觉/泛机器学习方法，聚焦于生成式视觉语言模型（VLM）的visual grounding坐标表示与强化学习奖励设计，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测的轻量化、剪枝、量化、蒸馏或边缘/星上部署。其坐标编码和几何奖励方法理论上可能对遥感旋转框检测的坐标回归有间接借鉴，但论文本身与本研究方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 2分。与本研究方向弱相关，不建议优先精读。仅当对坐标表示学习或几何奖励设计感兴趣时，可选择性阅读其方法部分，借鉴坐标编码和奖励设计思路到遥感旋转框检测中，但整体参考价值有限。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：visual grounding（视觉定位/指代定位），属于生成式VLM的定位任务。应用场景：通用视觉理解，非遥感场景。传感器类型：摘要未说明（推测为自然图像）。目标类别：摘要未说明（使用RefCOCO系列数据集，涉及自然图像中的指代目标）。

Model architecture: 基于生成式VLM架构（未改动主干结构）。核心创新模块：(1) Hi-Token——将边界框坐标的每个数字位（百位、十位、个位）编码为轴特定的token，引入coarse-to-fine结构并增加token复用；(2) Hi-GAR——基于几何的GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）奖励，结合box overlap和多尺度坐标精度。实验在三个VLM backbone上进行。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计或任何模型压缩/加速方法。Hi-Token的token复用机制在某种程度上可减少token数量，但这属于序列生成效率优化，并非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。且该方法是面向生成式VLM的，VLM本身计算开销大，与星上/边缘部署的轻量化需求方向相反。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：RefCOCO系列（RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg等）。评价指标：IoU（intersection over union），包括不同IoU阈值下的定位精度、低重叠预测比例、token频率、数字边界、目标尺度、IoU分布等分析指标。实验设置：在三个VLM backbone上做受控对比实验。

Experiments: 主要结果：(1) Hi-Token在评估的IoU范围内一致提升定位精度；(2) Hi-GAR进一步减少低重叠预测，且仅在训练阶段使用；(3) 在三个VLM backbone和RefCOCO系列上均取得一致增益；(4) Hi-R1在大多数报告指标上超过强专家基线。消融/分析实验包括token频率、数字边界、目标尺度和IoU分布分析。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/在轨部署完全无关，属于通用视觉grounding任务；(2) 摘要未说明模型参数量、推理速度等部署指标；(3) 未涉及遥感目标检测中的小目标、旋转框、密集排列等挑战；(4) 基于VLM的方法计算开销大，与轻量化方向相悖；(5) 摘要未说明在遥感图像上的泛化能力。

Ideas for my research: (1) Hi-Token的轴特定数字位编码思想可借鉴到遥感旋转框检测的坐标回归头设计中——将旋转框的(x, y, w, h, θ)各分量按数字位分解编码，可能提升小目标定位精度；(2) Hi-GAR的几何奖励（box overlap + 多尺度坐标精度）思想可迁移到遥感检测的损失函数设计中，尤其对IoU-based损失（如GIoU、CIoU）在旋转框场景下的改进有启发；(3) 其coarse-to-fine坐标表示思路与遥感小目标检测中的多尺度特征融合有概念上的相似性，可思考如何结合；(4) 但需注意：该方法面向生成式VLM，若要在遥感轻量化检测中借鉴，需将其思想适配到CNN/Transformer检测头中，并评估计算开销。

Abstract: Generative Vision-Language Models (VLMs) commonly treat bounding-box coordinates as independent output symbols, leaving numerical order and axis semantics implicit. We identify this representation as an important source of error in visual grounding. Hi-Token encodes each coordinate with axis-specific tokens for the hundreds, tens, and ones digits, which adds coarse-to-fine structure and increases token reuse while retaining the existing VLM architecture. Hi-GAR complements this representation with a geometry-based reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using box overlap and coordinate accuracy at multiple scales. Controlled comparisons under matched training conditions show that Hi-Token improves localization throughout the evaluated IoU range. Hi-GAR further reduces low-overlap predictions and is used only during training. Experiments on three VLM backbones and the RefCOCO family show consistent gains across models and benchmarks. Hi-R1 achieves higher values than strong specialist baselines on most reported metrics. Analyses of token frequency, digit boundaries, object scale, and IoU distributions explain the effects of coordinate representation and reward training. The results show that structured coordinate generation provides an effective approach to generative visual grounding.

</details>


### [79] [MT-Web2Code: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Multi-Turn Regional Reconstruction and Localized Modification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03474)
*Qiming Li,Shujie Hu,Haohan Liu,Xiaocheng Feng,Songxiang Liu,Guanglu Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MT-Web2Code，首个面向多轮网页UI代码生成的多模态编码基准，通过逆向损坏轨迹引擎构建确定性修复轨迹，并设计双轴评估协议衡量区域重建保真度与未受影响内容保持度。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于网页UI代码生成（web UI generation）与前端工程中的多轮代码修复任务，属于多模态大语言模型（LVLMs）与代码生成交叉领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能等任何遥感相关场景，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化/部署。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为网页UI代码生成基准，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，无直接可借鉴的轻量化方法或遥感检测技术，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多轮网页UI代码生成与修复（multi-turn web UI coding），包括Macro-Level区域重建与Micro-Level局部修改。应用场景：前端工程开发（frontend engineering）。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：网页界面元素（非遥感目标）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。论文主要贡献是构建基准数据集MT-Web2Code和评估协议，而非提出新的模型架构。评估对象为13个前沿coding agents（LVLM-based coding agents）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要中未提及任何剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计、实时推理或边缘/星上部署等模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署，未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：MT-Web2Code，包含102个任务，覆盖16个垂直领域（vertical domains），是首个多模态多轮网页UI编码基准。构建方法：Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine（逆向损坏轨迹引擎），通过迭代注入结构性和风格性缺陷到golden pages来生成确定性修复轨迹。评估指标：双轴评估协议（dual-axis evaluation protocol），包括目标区域保真度（target-region fidelity）和未受影响内容保持度（preservation of unaffected content）；区域重建用5维VLM-based rubric评估，局部修改用确定性像素级对齐（deterministic pixel-grounded alignment）评估。

Experiments: 在13个前沿coding agents上进行了实验。主要发现：1）现有agents难以在重建目标区域的同时保持未受影响内容；2）缺乏细粒度的视觉-代码对齐能力以完成局部编辑；3）在多轮交互中存在错误雪球效应（error snowballing）。

Limitations: 1）与遥感在轨目标检测完全无关，无任何可迁移的遥感或轻量化方法；2）摘要未说明基准中任务的具体难度分布、各agents的量化性能对比数据；3）评估依赖VLM-based rubric，存在主观性风险（尽管局部修改用确定性像素对齐）；4）摘要未说明代码和数据的具体发布时间与许可；5）未讨论该基准对真实前端工程效率提升的实际验证。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但仍有少量方法论层面的间接借鉴可能：1）Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine的"逆向损坏-修复轨迹"思想，可类比用于遥感目标检测中构建数据增强或对抗性样本生成策略（如对遥感图像注入噪声/遮挡后训练模型修复或检测）；2）双轴评估协议中"目标区域保真度+未受影响内容保持度"的评估思路，可类比为遥感检测中"检测精度+背景误检率"的联合评估；3）多轮错误雪球效应（error snowballing）的发现，对遥感在轨多帧连续检测中误差累积问题有一定启发。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in web UI generation. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on single-turn full-page generation from scratch, overlooking the iterative workflow of real-world frontend engineering, where developers repeatedly reconstruct missing regions and modify localized elements within existing codebases. To bridge this gap, we introduce MT-Web2Code, the first multimodal coding benchmark for multi-turn Macro-Level Regional Reconstruction and Micro-Level Localized Modification, which contains 102 tasks spanning 16 vertical domains. To construct deterministic repair trajectories without costly turn-level human annotation, we develop a scalable Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine that iteratively injects structural and stylistic defects into golden pages. We further propose a dual-axis evaluation protocol that measures target-region fidelity and the preservation of unaffected content, where regional reconstruction is assessed by a 5-dimensional VLM-based rubric and localized modification by deterministic pixel-grounded alignment. Experiments on 13 frontier coding agents reveal that current agents struggle to faithfully reconstruct target regions while preserving unaffected content, lack fine-grained visual-code alignment for localized edits, and suffer from error snowballing over multiple turns. Beyond benchmarking, our deterministic evaluation metrics provide fine-grained feedback signals that may facilitate future research on training iterative UI coding agents. Our evaluation code and data will soon be released.

</details>

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS或轻量网络设计等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。作为病理基础模型，其规模较大，不具备星上部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 预训练数据：624M patches、2.4M regions、36K WSIs。下游评估：34个多样化数据集。评价指标：摘要未明确列出具体指标名称，涉及癌症亚型分类、组织表型分析、VQA任务。

Experiments: 在34个数据集上与近期基础模型（foundation models）和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进行对比，MRPT在癌症亚型分类、组织表型分析和WSI视觉问答任务上均取得更优性能。摘要未提供具体数值结果和消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关，属于医学影像领域。2. 未提供任何轻量化或部署相关信息。3. 模型规模大（基于624M patches预训练），计算开销高，不适合资源受限场景。4. 摘要未给出具体性能数值、模型参数量或推理速度。5. 未涉及目标检测任务，仅涉及分类、表型分析和VQA。

Ideas for my research: 1. 多分辨率金字塔结构（Multi-Resolution Pyramid）思想可借鉴：遥感图像同样存在多尺度目标（小目标舰船/飞机 vs 大场景），层级化多分辨率特征聚合思路可迁移到遥感目标检测中。2. Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) 的跨尺度交互机制，对遥感小目标检测中跨层特征融合有参考价值。3. 多分辨率语义一致性对齐（embedding alignment across resolutions）思想可用于遥感多传感器（光学+SAR）或多分辨率影像的特征对齐。4. 但需注意：该方法是重型基础模型，直接迁移到在轨场景需配合轻量化手段（剪枝、蒸馏等），论文本身未提供此类方案。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) and their hierarchical variants have achieved strong performance in Computational Pathology (CPath). However, most are pre-trained on single-resolution Whole Slide Images (WSIs), limiting their generalization across arbitrary resolutions. Gigapixel WSIs inherently contain diagnostic patterns at multiple scales, including cellular morphologies, tissue architectures, and global context, mirroring how expert pathologists examine WSIs. We introduce Multi-Resolution Pyramid Transformer (MRPT), a model that hierarchically aggregates multi-resolution information from cellular to tissue and WSI levels. MRPT employs a biologically meaningful Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) mechanism to capture scale-independent interactions and enforces multi-resolution semantic consistency by aligning embeddings across resolutions, yielding robust and generalizable WSI representations. Pre-trained in a multi-resolution self-supervised manner on 624M patches, 2.4M regions, and 36K WSIs, MRPT learns rich coarse-to-fine histopathology features. Extensive experiments on 34 diverse datasets show that MRPT surpasses recent foundation models and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in cancer subtype classification, tissue phenotyping, and Visual Question Answering (VQA) for WSI understanding.

</details>


### [81] [How Many Labels Are Enough? ALDA: Active Learning Deployment Advisor for Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03511)
*Julia Machnio,Mads Nielsen,Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi*

TL;DR: 提出ALDA框架，用于在临床性能约束下为医学影像主动学习（Active Learning）方法选择部署策略，通过拟合学习曲线预测达到临床目标所需的标注数量，并引入部署窗口量化阈值不确定性，从而在试点阶段（15-30%预算）选出部署最优的采样策略。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于医学影像主动学习方法选择框架。仅其"部署导向决策"和"风险感知选择"的方法论思想对轻量化方案选择策略有间接借鉴意义，但无直接技术相关性，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：主动学习（Active Learning）方法选择与部署决策；应用场景：医学影像分类（medical imaging classification）；传感器类型：医学影像（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：临床标注目标（非遥感目标）。

Model architecture: ALDA框架包含：参数化学习曲线模型（parametric learning-curve model）用于拟合每个候选采样策略的性能增长趋势；部署窗口（deployment window）用于量化临床阈值不确定性对标注成本估计的敏感性；风险感知决策规则（risk-aware rule）在近最优成本的策略中优先选择部署窗口最窄、对阈值修订最鲁棒的策略。摘要未说明底层分类模型的具体架构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。该论文的"轻量化"体现在数据标注成本层面（减少所需标注数量），而非模型计算复杂度层面。ALDA通过预测达到临床性能目标所需的最少标注数来降低标注成本，最多可减少82%的标注成本。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。该论文的"部署"指临床场景下的方法选择部署，而非星上/边缘硬件部署。不涉及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等硬件加速。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：四个医学影像分类领域（four medical imaging classification domains），摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标：达到临床性能目标所需的专家标注数量（annotation cost）、部署窗口宽度（deployment window）、标注成本降低比例（最高82%）。实验设置：从预期预算的15-30%作为试点阶段（pilot phase）进行方法选择。

Experiments: 主要实验结论：ALDA能从15-30%预算的试点阶段准确预测部署最优的主动学习方法；与较差的策略选择相比，标注成本最多可降低82%。摘要未提供与具体基线方法的详细对比表或消融实验细节。

Ideas for my research: 1. 方法论借鉴：ALDA的"部署导向决策框架"思想可迁移到遥感轻量化方法选择中——在有限的验证预算下，通过拟合性能-资源曲线（如mAP vs FLOPs/延迟），预测不同轻量化策略（剪枝、量化、蒸馏）达到目标精度所需的计算资源，从而在试点阶段选出部署最优方案。2. 部署窗口概念可类比为"资源预算窗口"，量化硬件资源约束（如星上算力）不确定性对轻量化方案选择的影响。3. 风险感知决策规则可应用于在轨场景：在近最优精度的多个轻量化模型中选择对硬件波动最鲁棒的方案。4. 该论文本身不涉及遥感或轻量化，仅作为方法论参考，阅读优先级较低。

Abstract: Active learning (AL) promises to reduce the cost of medical imaging projects by lowering the number of clinical labels required. However, practical deployment requires committing to a sampling strategy before the full annotation budget is spent, and choosing the wrong strategy can increase rather than decrease costs. We propose Active-Learning Deployment Advisor (ALDA), a deployment-oriented framework for AL method selection under clinical performance constraints. Given a short pilot phase, ALDA fits a parametric learning-curve model to each candidate strategy, estimates whether that strategy is expected to reach a required clinical performance target, and predicts the number of expert annotations needed to do so. In addition to absolute annotation cost, ALDA introduces a deployment window that quantifies the sensitivity of this cost estimate to uncertainty in the clinical threshold. The final recommendation follows a risk-aware rule: among strategies with near-optimal predicted cost, ALDA prefers the strategy with the narrowest deployment window, the most robust to threshold revisions. Experiments on four medical imaging classification domains show that ALDA predicts the deployment-optimal method from a pilot of 15-30% of the intended budget and reduces annotation costs by up to 82% compared with a poor strategy choice. Rather than introducing a new sampling heuristic, ALDA provides a practical decision layer that answers a deployment-critical question: how many labels are enough?

</details>

Abstract: One common approach to pose estimation involves predicting object keypoints in an image, followed by using Perspective-n-Point algorithms to compute the object's rotation and translation relative to the camera. While rotations preserve object shapes, this property is often neglected in keypoint-based pose estimation methods, where keypoints are typically predicted independently from each other. As imprecise keypoint predictions negatively affects pose estimation accuracy, it also limits its reliability in downstream tasks. In this work, we explore whether such inaccurate pose estimates can be identified by simply examining spatial locations between 2D keypoints. We propose a set of hand-crafted geometric features that capture the self-consistency of keypoint predictions, including pairwise distances, reprojection consistency, as well as render and mask consistency. Despite its simplicity, a logistic regression classifier trained on these features reliably detects pose estimation failures, outperforming confidence-based approaches like conformal keypoint predictions that rely solely on keypoint uncertainty.

</details>

Abstract: Score-based diffusion models are typically formulated using continuous-time stochastic differential equations and measure-theoretic stochastic calculus. In this paper, we develop a hyperfinite formulation of score-based generative modeling within the framework of Nonstandard Analysis. Starting from an internal diffusion process on a hyperfinite grid, we derive the associated infinitesimal generator and establish its correspondence with the classical Fokker--Planck equation. We then obtain a hyperfinite backward-mean identity that yields the reverse-time drift and provides a constructive derivation of the reverse-time SDE. Building on these results, we show that minimization of an internal score-matching objective recovers the score function required by the reverse-time dynamics, thereby connecting score estimation with generative sampling directly at the hyperfinite level. Under suitable assumptions, we further derive a hyperfinite Girsanov formula and establish a relationship between likelihood optimization and Fisher-divergence objectives. Finally, we analyze the second-order consistency of the hyperfinite dynamics and show that the leading correction term depends explicitly on the fourth moment of the increment distribution, with the Gaussian value $κ=3$ eliminating the leading dispersion contribution. Taken together, these results provide a unified hyperfinite framework for diffusion-based generative modeling--while laying foundations for further extensions--that links discrete grid dynamics, reverse-time diffusion, score matching, and likelihood-based formulations within a common nonstandard setting.

</details>

Abstract: We develop a class of diffusion-based stochastic particle optimisation methods for loss functions with intractable gradients. Specifically, we consider problems in which the loss gradient is an integral with respect to a parameter-dependent distribution, a structure that includes training generative models, fine-tuning, and learning latent-variable models. We introduce mean-field dynamics and its interacting-particle approximations, which contain several existing algorithms as special cases and provides a route to constructing new methods. Under well-posedness and joint contractivity assumptions, we prove exponential convergence and show that the continuous-time particle system admits a non-asymptotic error bound. We illustrate it by developing momentum and higher-order Langevin variants and evaluating them on maximum marginal-likelihood estimation and energy-based-model training.

Abstract: Causal inference has traditionally centered on scalar outcomes: whether a patient recovers, how much a worker earns, or how many visits a website receives. Modern studies increasingly ask causal questions about outcomes with richer form, such as clinical notes, open-ended survey responses, and images. A hospital may want to know how an AI documentation tool changes the notes physicians write, or how a nurse training program alters what patients say in survey responses. For such outcomes, the usual average treatment effect is ill-defined: one cannot meaningfully subtract one text or image from another. To this end, we propose a causal query for unstructured outcomes. The key idea is to learn what features of the outcome are most causally affected by the treatment, which we call the maximally contrasting feature (MCF). To estimate the MCF, we learn a feature-scoring function that maps each outcome to a scalar and exposes the sharpest contrast between treated and control potential outcomes. We develop identification conditions and estimation algorithms for this query, and extend it to heterogeneous effects by allowing the feature-scoring function to depend on observed covariates. We also handle settings where both the treatment and the outcome are unstructured. Empirical studies on text and images show that the algorithm recovers salient aspects of an outcome changed by a treatment.

Abstract: Non-intrusive reduced-order models (NIROMs) have become a standard tool for approximating parametric partial differential equations from computer design of experiments while significantly reducing computational costs. However, assessing the reliability of their predictions remains a major challenge, particularly in extrapolation regimes or under limited training data. In this work, we introduce a framework for quantifying model-form uncertainty in NIROMs by combining a perturbative stochastic representation of reduced bases with distribution-free conformal-type methods. Starting from a deterministic reduced basis constructed from snapshot matrices, we model uncertainty through random perturbations defined on the Stiefel manifold, directed along the discarded modes, yielding stochastic reduced-order approximations whose induced variance reflects the basis-truncation error. A transport approximation gives a closed-form posterior variance that sepa- rates basis-induced from regression-induced uncertainty, without re-training the underlying Gaussian processes. We include this posterior variance within a conformal risk control calibration framework, that provides prediction sets with coordinate miscoverage guarantees. The calibration factor produced by this framework is itself an interpretable, scalar diagnostic of the quality of the uncertainty estimate. The methodology is evaluated on parametric PDE benchmarks and an industrial tire-manufacturing calendering process. Numerical experiments demonstrate reliable, locally informative uncertainty quantification that goes beyond the Gaussian predictive variance.

Abstract: We study score learning for reflected diffusion on bounded domains. Reflection keeps trajectories feasible but does not ensure that the learned score satisfies the boundary behavior implied by the forward process. With implicit score matching, integration by parts leaves a boundary term, and we show that it depends on one scalar at each boundary point: the diffusion- weighted normal component of the score, or conormal trace. The no-flux condition fixes this value while leaving the re- maining boundary components unrestricted; under anisotropic diffusion it generally differs from the ordinary normal score component. On hyperrectangles, our parametrization enforces the required trace without additional trainable parameters or a stochastic boundary estimator and, under regularity assump- tions, can represent the true score, whereas fixing an incorrect value creates an error that more data cannot remove. We ex- tend the construction to simplices and polygonal domains and identify reflection masking: hard reflection can keep samples feasible even when the learned trace is wrong, so post-reflection metrics may hide the error. Experiments show the clearest separation with less frequent reflection, anisotropic diffusion, and mass near intersections of constraints; under full reflection, final sample placement improves inconsistently, illustrating how hard repair can mask boundary-score errors and decouple score accuracy from downstream generation quality.

Abstract: The drift diffusion model (DDM) is a cornerstone of cognitive decision-making research. Although numerous estimation methods exist, researchers continue to seek inference approaches that are both fast and flexible across diverse study designs. Amortized Bayesian inference (ABI) can provide nearly instantaneous inference for complex stochastic models like the DDM, but neural networks trained for one study design cannot generalize to others. In this paper, we propose a divide-and-conquer framework that address this limitation. The core idea is that the DDM's independence assumption allows the full dataset to be decomposed into pairwise shards, each sharing a common structure that a single neural network can learn. Inference is performed on each shard separately and the resulting posteriors are combined via consensus MCMC to approximate the full posterior. Using simulated datasets, we evaluate the accuracy and uncertainty of this method. Our results show that the proposed divide-and-conquer approach achieves accuracy and uncertainty comparable to MCMC while reducing computational cost by several orders of magnitude. This work not only advances DDM estimation but also demonstrates a general strategy for improving the scalability and generalizability of ABI methods across diverse applications.

Abstract: Tensor cross-concentrated sampling (t-CCS) bridges entrywise sampling and t-CUR slice-wise sampling by observing entries only within selected horizontal and lateral slices. Existing t-CCS completion methods, however, assume that the observations are free of gross corruption. In this work, we study robust recovery of a third-order low-tubal-rank tensor from partial t-CCS observations contaminated by sparse, arbitrarily large outliers. We propose Robust Iterative t-CUR (R-ItCUR), a tensor-native algorithm that partitions the sampled tensor cross into two exterior blocks and an intersection block, applies adaptive blockwise Welsch correction for outlier suppression, and updates the low-rank component through projected blockwise gradient descent. By operating directly on the sampled cross, R-ItCUR avoids reconstructing the full tensor throughout the iterations, resulting in substantial memory and computational savings. Experiments on synthetic tensors, cardiac MRI data, and three-dimensional seismic data demonstrate accurate recovery and strong robustness to sparse gross corruptions. The results further highlight the importance of explicitly exploiting the cross-concentrated sampling structure in robust tensor completion.

</details>

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have emerged as a flexible framework for amortised inference over discrete and mixed discrete-continuous objects, requiring only an unnormalised target density specified through a reward. In this work, we formulate forward-policy training in GFlowNets through the information geometry of the induced trajectory sampler. Treating the forward policy as an induced trajectory sampler, we show that its intrinsic first-order geometry is given by the Fisher-Rao metric of the trajectory family, and that the associated natural gradient provides the canonical local update whenever the corresponding Fisher information is computable or accurately approximable. We derive an exact decomposition of the trajectory Fisher into per-step conditional second moments, which clarifies when temporal score interactions vanish and when dense couplings remain under shared parameterisation. This leads to three computational regimes: settings with tractable exact Fisher information, settings where Monte Carlo estimators of the expected Fisher are sufficient, and structure-exploitable settings in which target locality or factorisation yields accurate approximations of the Fisher expectation. In the latter case, graphical-model tools such as exact marginalisation, separator methods, and belief propagation provide principled surrogates for natural-gradient updates. The resulting framework turns target structure into optimisation geometry and yields a tractable route to structure-aware forward-policy training in GFlowNets. We illustrate the framework empirically through examples comparing convergence and exploration behaviour under Riemannian and Euclidean optimisation.

</details>

Abstract: Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) is widely adopted in frequency-selective channels for its ability to simplify equalization, yet it also causes large signal peaks, out-of-band (OOB) emissions, and spectral leakage. We study downlink precoding/combining for multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO)--OFDM systems by minimizing the sum of the users' mean-squared errors (MSEs) under per-subcarrier transmit-power limits, per-antenna OOB spectral-mask constraints, and per-antenna peak-amplitude (clipping) constraints, which confine the emitted spectrum and limit waveform peaks to reduce power-amplifier saturation, nonlinear distortion, and spectral regrowth. The resulting nonconvex problem is handled by a minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) based block coordinate descent (BCD), with a closed-form combiner update and an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm with closed-form updates for the precoder subproblem. Simulations show clear gains over well-known benchmark schemes.

Abstract: This paper proposes a geometry-based joint cross-modal token selection framework for latency-constrained multimodal token communications. To capture cross-modal token dependencies, we leverage the cross-attention mechanism to project modality-specific tokens into a shared query-key space, where the modality with the fewest tokens serves as the anchor modality and the others as non-anchor modalities. Inspired by germ-grain models, we define an angular-distance metric and construct semantic grain regions around anchor queries. Based on this geometric representation, we identify cross-modal evidence shared across multiple anchor queries in this space and develop an intersection-based token selection (IBS) strategy that prioritizes non-anchor tokens whose key are covered by multiple grain regions. We further develop an erasure-aware extension, termed robust-IBS (R-IBS), for token-wise erasure channels using an expected angular-distance formulation. In both IBS and R-IBS, the grain regions are optimized for individual queries under a latency constraint, using block coordinate descent and a low-complexity greedy algorithm. Simulations corroborate the effectiveness of IBS and R-IBS under latency-constrained and token-wise erasure channels, achieving up to 31.6% and 29.2% task accuracy gains on visual question answering (VQA) and audio-visual question answering (AVQA) tasks, respectively, over existing token selection baselines.

</details>

Abstract: This paper investigates energy efficiency (EE) maximization for the downlink of cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output systems under quality-of-service and per-access point power constraints. We first derive closed-form gradient expressions of the objective function with respect to the power allocation coefficients, and then propose an accelerated projected gradient (APG) approach to solve this problem. To reduce the computational complexity and runtime of APG, we propose a deep-unfolded APG framework that maps iterative APG updates onto a finite number of neural network layers, where parameters such as step sizes and penalty coefficients are learned from data. The proposed approach produces power allocation solutions through a fixed number of gradient-based updates without the need for line search or manual parameter tuning. Numerical results show that the method achieves EE performance comparable to the iterative APG approach while requiring significantly lower computational cost, with up to a 30-fold reduction in floating-point operations under the considered system settings.

Abstract: Orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation has emerged as a promising solution to mitigate the severe Doppler shift in low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite communications. However, the frequency-dependent Doppler shift induced by the high mobility of LEO satellites leads to the Doppler squint effect (DSE). This effect compromises the channel sparsity in the delay-Doppler (DD) domain, rendering existing channel estimation methods ineffective. To overcome this challenge, this paper proposes a DSE-resilient transmission scheme for cyclic prefix OTFS (CP-OTFS)-based LEO satellite systems. Specifically, we analyze the input-output relationship of the CPOTFS- based LEO satellite communication system and derive a DSE-aware representation of the satellite-terrestrial channel in the DD domain. To efficiently capture DSE-aware channel characteristics, we propose a novel OTFS frame structure that allows the energy distribution of the received signal to serve as prior information for channel estimation. Meanwhile, this frame structure strategically allocates pilot symbols to achieve uniform energy distribution and reduce the peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), while imposing a time-domain waveform continuity constraint to suppress out-of-band emission (OOBE) caused by rectangular pulses. Based on the frame structure, we propose a prior-aided iterative channel reconstruction (PAICR) algorithm to mitigate the severe power leakage induced by DSE. The proposed algorithm iteratively extracts and removes dominant channel components using Doppler-domain received signal energy observations, with a convergence criterion ensuring reliable termination. Furthermore, a Cramer-Rao lower bound is derived to provide a theoretical benchmark for evaluating the algorithm's performance.

### [97] [Task-Oriented Candidate-Latent Feedback for Coarse-to-Fine Sensing in Distributed OFDM-ISAC Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03319)
*Shiv Shankar,Radha Krishna Ganti,J Klutto Milleth*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种面向ISAC（集成感知与通信）架构的粗到细学习式感知流水线，通过轻量卷积评分器生成delay-Doppler候选图，并用学习式编码器构造紧凑的候选潜在表示（candidate-latent），经后训练均匀量化后在SE-SF接口传输，实现单目标四参数估计，压缩比达1.2-9.2×10⁴。

Reading priority: 2分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测方向弱相关，核心场景是ISAC无线通信。但其"任务导向压缩+后训练量化+有限预算约束"的框架思想对星地链路反馈压缩和模型量化有一定启发，可作为方法借鉴的泛读材料，不建议作为核心参考文献。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：单目标估计（single-target estimation），包括检测与四参数（delay-Doppler-azimuth-elevation）联合估计。场景：ISAC（集成感知与通信）架构下的SE-SF接口反馈压缩。传感器：基于pilot的OFDM信道估计（无线通信信号），非遥感光学/SAR/高光谱传感器。目标类别：无线信道中的单目标（未说明具体目标类型，如车辆/行人等）。

Lightweight method: 轻量化手段包括：(1) 轻量卷积评分器（lightweight convolutional scorer）用于候选生成；(2) 学习式编码器将高维DDAE张量压缩为K个C维候选token（candidate-latent feedback）；(3) 后训练均匀量化（post-training uniform quantization）到b bits；(4) 有限反馈预算B_fb = bKC + 18K + 16 bits约束下的压缩传输。压缩比达1.2-9.2×10⁴（相对8-bit DDAE magnitude tensor）。未涉及剪枝（pruning）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）或NAS。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等具体部署指标。仅给出接口传输速率：从multi-Gbit/s降至sub-Mbit/s，每相干处理间隔（CPI）107-806 bytes。该指标针对SE-SF通信接口而非星上计算资源，与遥感卫星在轨部署（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等）无直接对应关系。

Experiments: 在(K, C, b)设计空间中选取三个工作点，实现96.33-98.88%检测率、107-806 bytes/CPI、1.2-9.2×10⁴压缩比。跨场景评估（campus-scale）无需重训练即达98.79-99.50%检测率且角精度持平或更优，说明学习到的表示捕获了跨场景可迁移的目标相关结构。未提供与现有方法的对比实验或消融实验细节。

Limitations: (1) 仅针对单目标（single-target）估计，未扩展到多目标检测场景；(2) 场景为无线通信ISAC，非遥感卫星/光学/SAR图像，目标类型和特征完全不同；(3) 摘要未说明模型参数量、FLOPs、推理延迟等计算开销；(4) 未涉及剪枝、蒸馏、NAS等主流轻量化技术；(5) 跨场景泛化仅验证了clutter密度相当或更低的环境，未验证更高clutter密度场景；(6) 未说明量化对精度损失的具体影响（仅给出压缩比）。

Abstract: Future integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) architectures separate the sensing entity (SE) that acquires measurements from the sensing function (SF) that performs inference, creating a need for compact, task-oriented feedback on the SE-SF interface. Forwarding the raw channel frequency response or full per-link delay-Doppler-azimuth-elevation (DDAE) tensor is prohibitively expensive, while peak-only reporting discards target-discriminative structure under clutter. We propose a learning-based coarse-to-fine sensing pipeline with candidate-latent feedback for single-target estimation. At the SE, a lightweight convolutional scorer produces a dense delay-Doppler proposal map from pilot-based OFDM channel estimates, and a learned encoder constructs K compact C-dimensional candidate tokens by fusing per-candidate azimuth-elevation patches, normalized position, and confidence cues. The latents are uniformly quantized post-training to b bits and transmitted under a finite budget B_fb = bKC + 18K + 16 bits to the SF, which performs cross-candidate refinement, reranking, and joint four-parameter estimation. On a ray-traced urban scene with static and dynamic clutter, three operating points in the (K, C, b) design space achieve 96.33-98.88% detection at 107-806 bytes per coherent processing interval, compression ratios of 1.2-9.2 x 10^4 over the 8-bit DDAE magnitude tensor, reducing the SE-SF interface from multi-Gbit/s to sub-Mbit/s rates. Cross-scene evaluation on an independent campus-scale environment achieves 98.79-99.50% detection and at-or-better angular accuracy without retraining, indicating that the learned representation captures target-relevant structure that transports across scenes of comparable or lower clutter density.

</details>

Abstract: Artificial intelligence-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) are envisioned to consist of multiple AI-based modules, potentially developed independently by different vendors. In this work, we study AI-RAN-enabled cell-free MIMO systems, with a particular focus on the system implications of modern AI models. Specifically, we focus on the phenomenon of test-time scalability popularized by large language models (LLMs), under which model performance improves as additional computational resources are allocated at testing time. By noting that the optimal amount of additional computational resources for each AI module should in general depend on its interaction with the other modules as well as with the underlying wireless channels, we propose a generic framework that enables optimal resource allocation for each test-time scalable module in cell-free MIMO systems. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in fully exploiting the potential of test-time scalable AI-RANs in cell-free MIMO systems.

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署指标，也未涉及星上部署、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等硬件平台。其"训练开销"概念是通信层面的导频开销，与计算部署开销无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标为beamforming gain（波束成形增益）和training overhead（训练开销），通过numerical results（数值仿真）验证，未使用任何遥感或视觉数据集。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明"numerical results validate the superiority of our proposed scheme in terms of both beamforming gain and training overhead"，即通过数值仿真验证了所提方案在波束成形增益和训练开销两方面的优越性。未给出具体对比方法、消融实验或详细数值结果。

Abstract: Near-field beam training is essential for harvesting the high-gain potential of extremely large-scale multiple input multiple output systems. To reduce training overhead, existing works have mostly leveraged the beam squint effect by utilizing time-delay (TD) beamforming with polar-domain codebook, which enables the simultaneous sweeping of multiple angles at a specific distance. However, such methods still suffer from high overhead due to the exhaustive distance searching. To address this challenge, we propose a pattern zooming based near-field wideband beam training with wavenumber-domain codebook. Specifically, we first establish a refined wideband Fourier planewave channel representation, based on which we reveal a pattern zooming effect, where the wavenumber-domain patterns across different subcarriers exhibit frequency-dependent scaling relative to the center frequency. Exploiting this property, we develop a TD-assisted beam sweeping strategy that simultaneously probes multiple wavenumber directions to rapidly acquire the complete wavenumber-domain pattern. Based on the acquired pattern, we further derive exact, approximation-free closed-form expressions that establish a rigorous mapping between the receiver coordinates and the wavenumber-domain pattern, enabling accurate user localization with only a few pilots. Finally, numerical results validate the superiority of our proposed scheme in terms of both beamforming gain and training overhead.

</details>


### [100] [New Mid-Band (FR3, 6-24 GHz) XL-MIMO for 6G: Channel Modeling, Algorithm Evaluation, and Field Trials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03783)

Abstract: The new mid-band (FR3, 6-24 GHz) spectrum is expected to play an important role in future 6G networks by providing a favorable balance among coverage, capacity, and deployment feasibility. Meanwhile, extremely large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (XL-MIMO) has emerged as a key enabling technology to exploit the propagation and spatial multiplexing potential of these frequency bands. Firstly, this paper provides a systematic review of spectrum allocation and standardization activities for new mid-band spectrum, together with the 6G spectrum planning strategies of countries and regions. Secondly, the wideband massive MIMO channel sounder is also introduced, which is specially developed for channel measurements of new mid-band with over a thousand elements. Thirdly, propagation characteristics and channel modeling approaches of four representative XL-MIMO architectures, including co-located, cell-free, and intelligent XL-MIMO, are comprehensively reviewed and analyzed, with particular emphasis on near-field propagation, spatial non-stationarity, and capacity performance. Then, recent advances in channel estimation, beamforming, and artificial-intelligence-assisted signal processing are summarized. In addition, the performance of new mid-band XL-MIMO systems equipped with 1536 and 768 antenna elements is comparatively evaluated. Finally, real communication environment prototype system field trials conducted in the Upper 6 GHz (U6GHz) band are used to investigate practical system performance under realistic deployment conditions. The results indicate that the target signal-to-noise ratio is a critical factor affecting XL-MIMO performance in the U6GHz band.

</details>

Ideas for my research: 可借鉴点非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：文中"用closed-form度量避免重复优化、排除劣质候选"的思路，在轻量化模型搜索（如NAS或剪枝候选评估）中可类比为"用低成本代理指标快速筛选候选结构，再对少量候选做精细评估"。但这属于泛化思想，与遥感在轨检测无直接关联。

Abstract: This letter investigates transmit-power minimization for multiuser pinching-antenna system (PAS) from a coupled-mode-theory (CMT)-aware perspective. Existing CMT-based pinching antenna (PA) studies reveal coupling-induced power exchange and radiation behavior, but these effects have not been fully embedded into system-level multi-PA channel modeling and beamforming design. We therefore develop a directional and loss-aware channel model that captures coupling-length-dependent power extraction and the downstream guided-power reduction caused by in-waveguide attenuation and upstream extraction. The model shows that PA design should account for both directional radiation and guided-power evolution, rather than only propagation distance or maximum coupling considered in most existing works. Based on this channel model, we formulate a quality-of-service (QoS)-constrained power minimization problem for continuous PA positioning and finite-codebook activation. For each candidate coupling length, the element-wise positioning and BPSO-based activation use a closed-form zero-forcing (ZF) power metric for low-complexity configuration ranking, thereby avoiding repeated beamforming optimization while excluding rank-deficient candidates and ordering the remaining ones. The selected configuration for each coupling length is then evaluated by optimal fixed-configuration QoS beamforming. Simulation results demonstrate that CMT-aware modeling fundamentally reshapes the preferred PA configuration, maximum coupling is not always power-efficient due to suppressed downstream PA contributions, and finite-codebook activation combined with ZF-based ranking provides a balance between transmit-power performance and deployment complexity.

</details>

### [102] [GeoID-PINN: Identifiability-Aware Regional Epidemic Inference with Geographic Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02633)
*Weixiong Hua,Fan Bu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GeoID-PINN，一种用于区域传染病SIRD动力学的物理信息神经网络，通过行随机源组成矩阵建模区域间空间依赖，并利用距离、邻接、通勤等先验进行正则化，在COVID-19路易斯安那州数据上验证了轨迹拟合与区域依赖结构恢复之间的差异。

Research relevance: 1分（基本无关）。该论文研究的是区域传染病传播动力学建模（SIRD模型），属于流行病学/时空预测领域，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关；不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测等任何遥感视觉任务；也不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署等任何轻量化或部署技术。唯一可能的弱关联是"physics-informed neural network (PINN)"和"spatial prior"这类时空建模思想，但与本课题方向无实质交集。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于流行病学时空建模领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及任何遥感数据、目标检测任务或模型压缩部署技术，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：区域传染病传播动力学建模（SIRD dynamics），属于时空预测/流行病学建模。应用场景：区域疫情监测与传播溯源（regional surveillance）。传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器，仅使用区域级统计报告数据（如COVID-19病例数）。目标类别：不涉及目标检测，建模对象为感染/易感/康复/死亡四类人群状态。

Model architecture: GeoID-PINN：基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的SIRD动力学模型。核心设计包括：(1) 行随机源组成矩阵（row-stochastic source-composition matrix），每行分配非负且和为1的源权重，用于表示区域间空间依赖；(2) 对该矩阵施加正则化，使其逼近由距离（distance）、邻接（adjacency）、通勤（commuting）或领先-滞后（lead-lag）信息构造的空间先验。属于时空图/矩阵建模架构，非CNN/Transformer等视觉网络。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：(1) 四区域模拟数据（four-region simulation with known truth）；(2) 美国路易斯安那州64个县的COVID-19回顾性数据；(3) 15县对照实验（controlled 15-county comparison）。评价指标：source-composition error（源组成误差）、MSE（mean squared error）、MAE（mean absolute error）、NLL（negative log likelihood）、MSE/MAE百分比降幅。

Experiments: 主要结果：(1) 四区域模拟中，兼容距离先验给出source-composition error 0.099，无正则化时升至0.159，强错误先验下升至0.577，但轨迹拟合和传播规模估计保持相似——说明准确轨迹不保证恢复区域依赖结构；(2) 64县COVID-19数据上，Forecast-Trained Geo-PINN相对自回归负二项基线将MSE从32,957降至11,468，MAE从70.60降至57.73，但基线NLL更低（5.158 vs 5.346），即基线分布拟合更好但点预测精度更差；(3) 15县对照中，县邻接先验使MSE降低6.85%、MAE降低3.1%；(4) 不同合理先验下性能相近，支持结构化正则化但无法唯一恢复边结构。

Limitations: 摘要未说明模型参数量、计算复杂度、推理速度等部署指标。论文本身存在以下局限：(1) 作者明确指出需要prior-sensitivity和observation-model检查后才能解释结果；(2) 不同先验下性能相近，无法唯一恢复区域依赖边结构；(3) 基线在NLL上更优，说明点精度提升可能以分布拟合为代价。与本课题相关的局限是：该工作与遥感目标检测和轻量化完全无关，无可借鉴的部署或压缩信息。

Ideas for my research: 对本课题（遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化）的可借鉴点非常有限，但可抽象出以下思路：(1) "行随机源组成矩阵 + 空间先验正则化"的建模思想，若未来涉及多源遥感数据融合或跨区域特征关联建模，可参考用结构化先验约束特征依赖矩阵；(2) "轨迹拟合好不等于结构恢复正确"这一结论提醒我们：在模型压缩/蒸馏中，仅关注最终指标（如mAP）可能掩盖中间特征或结构信息的丢失，评估轻量化模型时应同时检查特征分布保持情况；(3) 先验敏感性分析（prior-sensitivity）的思想可迁移到轻量化方法中，即验证压缩后的模型在不同输入分布/场景下的鲁棒性。总体而言，该论文对本课题的借鉴价值很低。

Abstract: Regional surveillance data reflect local transmission, reporting, seeding, and external infection pressure, which are difficult to identify separately. We introduce GeoID-PINN, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for susceptible-infectious-recovered-deceased (SIRD) dynamics. The model represents spatial dependence with a row-stochastic source-composition matrix whose rows assign nonnegative source weights that sum to one. We regularize this matrix toward a spatial prior constructed from distance, adjacency, commuting, or lead-lag information. In a four-region simulation with known truth, a compatible distance prior gives source-composition error 0.099. The error rises to 0.159 without regularization and 0.577 under a strongly misspecified prior, while trajectory fit and transmission-scale estimates remain similar. Accurate trajectories therefore do not guarantee recovery of the regional dependence structure. We also evaluate GeoID-PINN retrospectively using COVID-19 data from 64 Louisiana counties. Relative to an autoregressive negative-binomial baseline, Forecast-Trained Geo-PINN reduces mean squared error (MSE) from 32,957 to 11,468 and mean absolute error (MAE) from 70.60 to 57.73. The baseline has lower negative log likelihood (NLL), 5.158 versus 5.346, indicating better distributional fit but worse point accuracy. In a controlled 15-county comparison, county adjacency reduces MSE by 6.85 percent and MAE by 3.1 percent. Similar performance across plausible priors supports structured regularization but not unique edge recovery. These results require prior-sensitivity and observation-model checks before interpretation.

</details>

Model architecture: 摘要提到实验覆盖三种架构（具体架构名称未说明）和三个数据集（具体数据集名称未说明）。核心方法为arm-specific covariate adjustment，即利用每个模型自身多次运行的训练日志统计量作为协变量进行回归调整，以降低模型比较的不确定性。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要提到三个架构和三个数据集（具体名称未说明），评价指标为模型性能差异及其不确定性（uncertainty reduction）。摘要未说明具体数据集名称和指标名称。

Experiments: 在视觉任务上跨三个架构和三个数据集进行实验，发现基于早期训练日志的简单协变量调整通常能降低模型比较的不确定性。主要局限是协变量选择——广泛搜索日志池中最相关的统计量往往引入更多噪声而非减少噪声。

Limitations: 主要局限为协变量选择问题：广泛搜索训练日志池中最相关的统计量会引入选择噪声（selection noise），即使事后看存在有用的统计量。此外，摘要未说明具体架构、数据集、实验细节和统计方法的具体实现。

Ideas for my research: 对遥感在轨目标检测轻量化课题的直接借鉴意义有限。但有一个间接启发：在评估轻量化模型（如剪枝/量化后的模型）与原始模型的性能差异时，如果采用多次随机训练取均值比较的方式，本文提出的利用训练日志进行协变量调整以降低比较不确定性的思路，可用于更严谨地验证轻量化方法是否真正带来性能损失或提升。不过该思路属于统计评估层面的辅助工具，并非核心研究方向。

Abstract: Comparing stochastically trained models requires estimating both a performance difference and its uncertainty from repeated runs. We study whether training logs from those same runs can make such comparisons more precise. Because training-log covariates are produced during training rather than measured before it, we use arm-specific covariate adjustment: each model is adjusted only with statistics from its own runs, and the raw mean difference remains the reported effect. In a vision study spanning three architectures and three datasets, simple adjustments based on early training logs often reduce uncertainty in model comparisons. The main limitation is covariate selection. Broadly searching the log pool for the most correlated statistic often adds more noise than it removes, even when useful statistics exist in hindsight. Training logs therefore appear useful for more precise model comparisons, but only when the adjustment avoids large selection noise.

</details>

Model architecture: 采用图信号处理（graph signal processing, GSP）视角：将attention机制建模为token上的加权图，token hidden states作为图节点上的信号。使用图谱诊断（graph-spectral diagnostics）和token图可视化（token-graph visualizations）进行分析。涉及多个模型家族（model families）的对比验证。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法，如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络设计等均未提及。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标为图谱诊断指标（graph-spectral diagnostics），包括全局连通性（global connectivity）、谱集中度（spectral concentration）、高频能量（high-frequency energy）等，以及定性token图可视化。这些指标属于表征分析范畴，非目标检测评价指标（如mAP、IoU等）。

Experiments: 主要发现：1）随着context length增加，表征按输入动态复杂度（dynamical complexity）更清晰地区分；2）简单输入产生全局连通性更强、隐藏状态信号更平滑且谱更集中的token图；3）复杂输入产生更局部化的图、谱支撑更宽、高频能量更高的隐藏状态信号；4）这些内部签名在不同模型家族间保持一致（conserved across model families）。

Limitations: 1）与遥感目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，属于LLM可解释性研究；2）仅关注数值推理的ICL内部表征，不涉及任何视觉/遥感任务；3）摘要未说明具体模型规模、数据集、计算开销等；4）未提供任何部署或工程化信息。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发：论文提出的"图信号处理视角分析注意力内部表征"方法，理论上可迁移到分析遥感目标检测模型（如DETR类transformer检测器）中attention结构对目标特征的表征组织方式，帮助理解检测器内部特征如何随输入复杂度变化，从而为轻量化剪枝提供理论依据——即识别哪些attention连接对简单/复杂场景贡献不同，指导结构化剪枝。但这一迁移需要大量额外工作，且论文本身未提供任何可直接复用的检测或轻量化方法。

Abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which attention induces a weighted graph over tokens, while token hidden states define signals on its nodes. Quantitative graph-spectral diagnostics and qualitative token-graph visualizations reveal that representations become more clearly differentiated by input dynamical complexity as context length increases. Simpler inputs produce attention-induced token graphs with stronger global connectivity and smoother, spectrally concentrated hidden-state signals, whereas more complex inputs produce more localized graphs and hidden-state signals with broader spectral support and greater high-frequency energy. Together, these findings point to systematic, context-dependent internal signatures associated with numerical ICL that are conserved across model families.

</details>

Abstract: The standard check for contamination in LLM backtests is simple: compare scores before and after the training cutoff. We show this check is uninformative. Four flagship models fail it on questions they cannot have memorized: every scored question resolved after their cutoffs. The reason is structural. Models legitimately know more about times near their cutoff, so recency mimics leakage, and we prove no passive backtest can separate the two from genuine skill. Measurement, not just detection, requires information from outside the backtest. We supply it in two forms. A known cutoff identifies leakage at the boundary; a matched clean control identifies it globally and yields a leakage-adjusted score. We also derive where leakage hides: it concentrates on outcomes that surprised the crowd and were well covered in training, and partial memorization is disproportionately rewarded. We validate the estimators against ground truth by planting leakage in twin models, where they recover the injected dose and return null on clean questions. Deployed on frontier models, they detect one cutoff-localized signature and, at the audit's power floor, clear five models whose apparent advantages were recency alone. Backtests need not be discarded; they need one defensible reference.

</details>

Experiments: 在 20 个基准数据集上，q-Hermite 核取得了与经典核及其他正交多项式核相当的竞争性性能，并在数值稳定性和计算简洁性方面具有优势。具体对比结果数值摘要未说明。

Abstract: The performance of Support Vector Machines (SVMs) critically depends on the kernel function choice, which enables implicit mapping of data into high-dimensional feature spaces. While classical kernels like Radial Basis Function (RBF) remain popular, orthogonal polynomial kernels offer mathematically interpretable alternatives that can incorporate structured prior knowledge. This work extends the orthogonal polynomial kernel paradigm by introducing a novel family based on discrete $q$-Hermite I polynomials, a class of $q$-orthogonal polynomials that generalize classical Hermite polynomials through a deformation parameter $q$. We formally define the q-Hermite kernel and establish its validity under Mercer's theorem. The kernel's inherent boundedness properties naturally prevent annihilation and explosion effects without requiring explicit scaling mechanisms. Extensive experiments across 20 benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed kernel achieves competitive performance compared to both classical kernels and other orthogonal polynomial kernels, while offering advantages in numerical stability and computational simplicity. Our results confirm that $q$-orthogonal polynomials constitute a promising direction for kernel design, bridging mathematical elegance with practical machine learning applications, that provides conceptual and algorithmic resources that may be further extended to emerging quantum computing paradigms. To facilitate full reproducibility, we provide the complete implementation and experimental pipeline in an open-access GitHub repository at https://github.com/Kokechacho/SVMs-QSVMs.

</details>

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) is the task of discovering underlying patterns from data and representing them using mathematical expressions. Current machine learning approaches to SR often lack a profound understanding of the intrinsic mathematical and physical principles governing these expressions. While the pioneering AI Feynman method leverages the mathematical properties underlying the data, its expression simplification mechanism suffers from a narrow scope of applicability and is prone to failure on complex equations. Furthermore, its underlying mechanisms rely heavily on brute-force searches for sub-expressions, severely limiting its practical utility. Through rigorous mathematical deduction and proofs, we propose our method, Deep Divide and Reduce in Symbolic Regression (DDRSR). DDRSR fundamentally broadens the applicability of expression decomposition and reduction, circumvents the need for brute-force sub-structure searches, and ensures both wider versatility and strict theoretical correctness. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that these theoretical principles yield significant advantages in both expression decomposition and numerical regression tasks. Finally, we discuss the applicable scenarios and inherent limitations of this paradigm, alongside promising directions for future research.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：CO2地质封存操作的多模态代理建模（multimodal auto-regressive transformer surrogate）；应用场景：地质碳封存（geological carbon storage）；传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 多模态自回归Transformer代理模型：三个独立编码器分别处理3D地质模型（geomodel）、相对渗透率标量参数、控制变量（stage durations和well injection rates），通过transformer encoder中的self-attention进行特征融合，temporal decoder通过encoder-decoder cross-attention自回归生成预测。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等均未提及）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。该模型用于离线地质模拟与数据同化（MCMC），非实时在轨部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：修改后的SEAM CO2地质模型（含断层系统和三个叠置含水层），使用4000次GEOS流动模拟生成训练数据；评价指标：饱和度MAE（中位数0.028）、其他目标量的中位数相对误差0.2-5%；还使用层次化马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（hierarchical MCMC）进行数据同化验证。

Experiments: 在随机采样的地质模型和控制变量测试集上，代理模型实现了中位数饱和度MAE为0.028，其他目标量中位数相对误差为0.2-5%。模型能够捕捉从速率控制到底部孔压控制的切换。在三种操作策略下用于层次化MCMC数据同化，显著降低了关键元参数（特别是断层渗透率）的不确定性，后验预测与真实模型结果一致。

Limitations: 与遥感在轨目标检测方向完全无关。摘要未涉及任何遥感数据、目标检测任务、轻量化技术或边缘/星上部署内容。该论文属于地下流体模拟与不确定性量化领域，对遥感目标检测轻量化课题没有直接参考价值。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的技术启发是：其多模态Transformer编码器-解码器架构中的self-attention特征融合和cross-attention自回归解码设计，在理论上可作为遥感多模态数据（如光学+SAR）融合的参考思路，但该论文本身并未涉及遥感场景，且未讨论任何轻量化策略，因此对本课题的直接可借鉴点极少。

Abstract: The use of variable well perforation and injection strategies can improve the efficiency of geological carbon storage operations. We develop a new multimodal auto-regressive transformer surrogate to model these operations under geological uncertainty. A modified SEAM CO2 geomodel, which involves a faulted system with three stacked aquifers, is considered. The two injection wells are perforated in stages, from bottom to top, with the stage durations and individual well injection rates treated as control variables. The surrogate model processes three input modalities - the 3D geomodel, scalar parameters characterizing relative permeability functions, and control variables - through separate encoders. These are fused via self-attention in a transformer encoder, and a temporal decoder generates predictions auto-regressively through encoder-decoder cross-attention. The surrogate is trained, using 4000 GEOS flow simulations, to predict saturation and pressure at monitoring locations, total injected and mobile CO2 mass, and saturation footprints. For a new test set, involving randomly sampled geomodels and control variables, the surrogate achieves a median saturation MAE of 0.028 and median relative errors of 0.2-5% for the other quantities of interest. Importantly, it captures the switch from rate to bottom-hole-pressure control. The surrogate model is used within a hierarchical Markov chain Monte Carlo data assimilation procedure for a synthetic true model under three operational strategies. Substantial uncertainty reduction is achieved for key metaparameters, particularly the fault permeabilities. Posterior predictions for saturation footprints and total injected and mobile CO2 mass are also shown to be generally consistent with true model results.

</details>


### [109] [Trajectory inference via Acceleration Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03916)
*Bartolo Dazzini,Giovanni Conforti,Alain Durmus,Aram-Alexandre Pooladian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种名为 Acceleration Matching (AM) 的轨迹推断算法，通过将插值问题提升到相空间并回归显式条件加速度场来生成平滑随机轨迹，避免昂贵的预处理和模拟训练。

Research relevance: 1 分，基本无关。该论文研究的是 trajectory inference（轨迹推断），属于科学计算/生成模型领域，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无任何关联。

Reading priority: 1 分。论文主题为 trajectory inference，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：trajectory inference（轨迹推断），即从离散时间点的未配对观测快照中生成平滑轨迹。应用场景为一般科学领域（如生物、物理等），非遥感场景。传感器类型、目标类别均不适用。

Model architecture: 核心方法为 Acceleration Matching (AM)：将原始插值问题提升到 phase space（相空间），然后回归到一个显式的 conditional acceleration field（条件加速度场），从而诱导出随机、平滑且与给定边际分布一致的轨迹。训练仅需位置数据。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（如 pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS 等）。其"轻量"仅体现在训练过程中避免了 trajectory simulation 和昂贵的预处理子程序，属于算法效率优化而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等任何部署相关信息，也未讨论星上或边缘部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。仅在多个 benchmark problems（基准问题）上提供了数值实验证据，表明 AM 与现有算法相比具有竞争力或更优。具体数据集和评价指标未在摘要中列出。

Experiments: 摘要仅提到在现有文献中的多个 benchmark problems 上进行了数值实验，结果显示 AM 与已有算法相当或更优。未给出具体对比方法名称、消融实验或详细结果数据。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：该方法面向一般科学领域的轨迹推断问题，与遥感图像/卫星数据无关；未涉及目标检测任务；未讨论模型压缩或边缘部署；缺乏真实遥感场景验证。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的思想启发是：其"避免昂贵预处理和模拟训练"的算法设计理念，在遥感在轨目标检测模型训练中，若涉及数据生成或轨迹类任务（如目标运动轨迹预测），可考虑类似的免模拟训练策略。但整体上与本课题（遥感在轨目标检测与轻量化）无直接可借鉴点。

Abstract: Trajectory inference is a fundamental problem in many scientific domains: given a collection of unpaired snapshots of observations at discrete time points, the goal is to generate smooth trajectories that best resemble and interpolate the data. Existing algorithms exhibit computational challenges: they either rely on preprocessing subroutines to enforce smoothness or on simulation-based training objectives, both of which can be expensive. In order to overcome these limitations, we propose a new algorithm called Acceleration Matching (\texttt{AM}). Our approach consists of lifting the original interpolation problem to phase space and then regressing onto an explicit conditional acceleration field that induces random, smooth trajectories that agree with the prescribed marginals. Importantly, our resulting training algorithm only requires positional data, avoids trajectory simulation during training, and is devoid of expensive preprocessing. We provide ample numerical evidence suggesting that \texttt{AM} is competitive with or superior to existing algorithms on several benchmark problems from the existing literature.

</details>


### [110] [LLMs Can Annotate Attribution Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02632)
*Ameen Patel,Max Zhang,Nathan Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种自动化流水线，用语言模型将特征或MLP神经元自动分组为supernode，从而自动化circuit tracing中原本需要人工的步骤，并验证其可解释性与有效性。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。论文研究的是大语言模型（LLM）内部机制的可解释性（circuit tracing / interpretability），与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测、模型轻量化均无直接关系。既非遥感场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及剪枝/量化/蒸馏等轻量化方法。仅从"自动化流水线"和"用LLM辅助分析"的角度，对泛机器学习方法有极弱的借鉴意义。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于NLP可解释性领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。仅当对"LLM辅助自动化标注/分析"这一泛化思路感兴趣时，可作泛读参考。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。核心是提出一个自动化pipeline：将特征/MLP神经元的描述直接输入给一个语言模型（LLM），由其将特征分组为supernode。涉及LLM作为分组器（grouping model）和LLM judge作为图质量评估器。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未提及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络、实时推理、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署，未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：two-hop Capitals任务（100个prompt）、Wikipedia prompt completions（1000个attribution graphs）。评价指标：自动化可解释性指标（automated interpretability metrics）、supernode恢复率（97/100）、LLM judge标记值得人工审查的图。

Experiments: 主要实验：1) 在two-hop Capitals任务上，pipeline生成的supernode与人工标注的supernode在自动化可解释性指标上相当；2) 在97/100个prompt中成功恢复对应中间hop的supernode；3) 概念验证：自动标注1000个来自Wikipedia的attribution graphs，并用LLM judge标记值得人工审查的图。未提供与基线方法的详细对比或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于NLP可解释性领域；2) 摘要未说明pipeline在不同规模模型上的泛化能力；3) 未讨论自动化分组可能引入的偏差或错误累积问题；4) 未报告计算开销、运行时间等工程指标；5) 仅验证了two-hop Capitals和Wikipedia两个场景，泛化性有限。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但可考虑：1) "用LLM自动化分组/标注"的思路，可迁移到遥感目标检测中自动生成/整理训练样本的标注或难例挖掘（hard example mining）流程；2) "LLM judge自动筛选值得关注的图/样本"的思路，可用于遥感数据中自动筛选有价值的训练样本或异常目标；3) 若未来研究涉及"可解释性"维度（如解释轻量化模型为何在遥感小目标上性能下降），该自动化分析思路有一定参考价值。但整体上对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接帮助很小。

Abstract: Circuit tracing is an exciting technique for revealing the internal computation of language models, but it requires a time-intensive manual step of grouping individual features or MLP neurons into supernodes. We present a simple pipeline for automating this step: directly presenting feature descriptions to a language model that groups them into supernodes. Using automated interpretability metrics, we confirm that supernodes generated by our pipeline are as interpretable as those generated by human annotators. On a two-hop Capitals task, our pipeline recovers a supernode corresponding to the intermediate hop in 97 of 100 prompts. Finally, we present a simple proof of concept using our pipeline for open-ended exploration, where we automatically annotate 1000 attribution graphs from Wikipedia prompt completions and then use an LLM judge to flag interesting graphs worth human review. We hope this work demonstrates that even simple automation can produce meaningful attribution graph annotations, motivating further work on automated circuit tracing.

</details>


### [111] [Verifier-Guided Model Discovery for Physical Dynamical Systems with Pretrained Symbolic Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02662)
*Farbod Faraji,Francesco Belardinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种验证器引导（verifier-guided, VG）的神经到符号（neural-to-symbolic）工作流，以ODEFormer为符号骨干，将预训练transformer从合成ODE轨迹迁移到高维物理数据，用于非线性物理系统的可解释预测。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于非线性物理系统（Van der Pol振荡器、涡脱落）的符号方程发现与可解释预测，属于科学机器学习（scientific ML）领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱/多光谱数据，也不涉及目标检测或模型轻量化/部署。唯一间接关联是"涡脱落"现象出现在大气和等离子体系统中，但并非遥感图像处理任务。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于科学机器学习/符号回归领域。除非对"验证器引导筛选"或"特征分布兼容性"这类方法论思想有跨领域兴趣，否则无需优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：非线性物理系统的可解释预测与符号方程发现（symbolic regression / neural-to-symbolic forecasting）。应用场景：科学发现与工程决策，具体包括Van der Pol振荡器、涡脱落（vortex shedding，出现在大气和等离子体系统中）。传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器。目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: 以ODEFormer为符号骨干（symbolic backbone），采用预训练transformer将合成ODE轨迹映射为方程。围绕该骨干构建验证器引导（verifier-guided, VG）工作流，利用动力学和物理可容许性（dynamical and physical-admissibility）准则从多轨迹候选方程池中筛选方程。对高维数据采用坐标约简（coordinate reduction）后进行符号发现。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计等模型压缩或加速方法。其核心关注点是模型的可解释性与物理可审计性，而非计算效率或部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。其目标场景是科学预测而非边缘/星上部署，因此不具备在轨部署可行性分析。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：合成ODE轨迹（用于预训练ODEFormer）、Van der Pol振荡器（held-out初始条件）、涡脱落数据（固定和变化的Reynolds数）。评价指标：重建保真度（reconstruction fidelity）、符号可发现性（symbolic discoverability）、跨参数泛化能力（cross-parameter generalization）。

Experiments: 主要实验：1) 在Van der Pol振荡器上，VG工作流在held-out初始条件下优于原始ODEFormer工作流；2) 在涡脱落问题上，通过坐标约简和符号发现，在固定和变化Reynolds数下恢复基本脱落振荡器及高次谐波，无需wake-specific候选库或预设Navier-Stokes结构；3) 跨参数模型可泛化到保留的regime。关键发现：重建保真度本身不能决定符号可发现性，潜在动力学与骨干预训练分布之间的兼容性更为重要。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可迁移的检测或压缩技术；2) 摘要未说明计算开销、推理效率或部署可行性；3) 方法针对低维符号方程发现，对高维遥感图像数据（如SAR、多光谱）的适用性未讨论；4) 验证器引导工作流依赖物理准则，遥感目标检测任务缺乏此类先验。

Ideas for my research: 尽管整体弱相关，但有两个方法论层面的间接借鉴点：1) "验证器引导的候选筛选"思想——在模型压缩/蒸馏中，可以用验证器（如精度、FLOPs、延迟约束）从多个轻量化候选方案中筛选最优，而非仅依赖单一指标；2) "潜在动力学与预训练分布兼容性"的洞察——在知识蒸馏中，教师与学生之间的特征分布兼容性可能比单纯的重建保真度更重要，这提示蒸馏时应关注中间层特征对齐而非仅输出对齐。但这些借鉴较为间接，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Reliable forecasting of nonlinear physical systems underpins scientific discovery and engineering decision-making. Yet high-fidelity simulations are prohibitively costly, and machine-learning surrogates can be opaque and encode assumptions about system dynamics, limiting generalizability. Pretrained transformers mapping synthetic ODE trajectories to equations offer interpretable alternatives, promising transfer without system-specific equation knowledge. Transferring them reliably to high-dimensional physical data, however, remains an open challenge. We develop a verifier-guided (VG) workflow around ODEFormer as a symbolic backbone, using dynamical and physical-admissibility criteria to select from a multi-trajectory candidate equation pool, enabling transfer. On canonical Van der Pol oscillators, VG outperforms the original ODEFormer workflow across held-out initial conditions. We then address vortex shedding, a phenomenon occurring in atmospheric and plasma systems of societal relevance, through coordinate reduction and symbolic discovery at fixed and varying Reynolds numbers. VG discovers fixed-parameter reduced-order equations that recover the fundamental shedding oscillator and higher harmonics without a wake-specific candidate library or prescribed Navier-Stokes structure, while the cross-parameter model generalizes to withheld regimes. Reconstruction fidelity alone did not determine symbolic discoverability, highlighting the importance of compatibility between latent dynamics and the backbone's pretraining distribution. This work establishes a verifier-guided neural-to-symbolic methodology for interpretable and physically auditable forecasting in the natural sciences.

</details>


### [112] [CT-HEG: A Bidirectional, Timestamp-Attributed Event Graph for ICU In-Hospital Mortality Prediction - An Architectural Ablation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02663)
*Mohammad Nasir Uddin,Rahnuma Tabassum Orpita,Asaduzzaman Anik,Eklachur Rahman Bhuiyan,Marjahan Risalat,SM Wali Ullah,Asif Ahamed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CT-HEG连续时间异构电子健康记录图模型（CHIRP-Net），用于ICU死亡风险预测，在MIMIC-IV上达到AUROC 0.8449。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。该论文聚焦医疗健康领域（ICU死亡预测、电子健康记录EHR），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、地球观测、目标检测或模型轻量化部署。虽然使用了图神经网络（GATv2Conv）和异构时序建模，但属于泛机器学习/医疗AI方法，与遥感在轨目标检测及轻量化方向无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文为医疗AI方向，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化完全无关，不建议投入时间精读。仅当对异构图建模或"参数压缩反而提升性能"这一反直觉现象感兴趣时，可作泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：ICU死亡风险预测（mortality prediction）。场景：医疗重症监护（ICU），非遥感场景。传感器类型：医疗监护设备（vital signs, lab events），非遥感传感器。目标类别：患者死亡风险二分类，非遥感目标检测。

Model architecture: CHIRP-Net：四层异构GATv2Conv网络，基于CT-HEG图结构。图包含三种节点类型（visit, vital, lab_event）和2D边属性（t_hours/48, value_norm），编码时间与数值信息且无需插值（imputation-free）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明明确的轻量化方法（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS）。仅提及一个消融实验：将异构边类型合并为单一关系后参数量减少7倍（7x fewer parameters），且在该设置下性能优于完整模型——这暗示了参数压缩的潜在方向，但并非论文核心贡献。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理能力。该模型面向医疗场景，无星上/边缘部署考虑。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：MIMIC-IV v3.1（31,142个ICU住院记录，LOS>=48h，13.4%死亡率）。评价指标：AUROC（5-seed均值0.8449±0.0071）、AUPRC（0.4958±0.0209）、集成AUROC 0.8618（95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745）、校准误差ECE 0.0307。对比方法：logistic regression, mTAND, Transformer, GRU-D。含消融实验和bootstrap置信区间。

Experiments: 主要结果：CHIRP-Net 5-seed平均AUROC 0.8449±0.0071，AUPRC 0.4958±0.0209；集成模型AUROC 0.8618。关键消融：移除反向边导致AUROC下降0.1968±0.0073（双向连接对模型利用输入至关重要）；时间注意力边特征贡献0.0247±0.0093 AUROC；将异构边类型合并为单一关系（参数量减少7倍）在所有seed上优于完整模型。温度缩放后校准良好（ECE 0.0307）。

Limitations: 摘要未说明外部验证、预指定的时间评估和人口统计学公平性审计，作者明确表示在这些完成前不能声称模型鲁棒性。时间与人口统计子组分析未在本文报告。此外，该论文与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景无关，但有以下可借鉴的通用方法论：(1) 异构图建模（heterogeneous graph）处理多类型节点与边属性的思路，可类比遥感多传感器/多模态数据（光学+SAR+高光谱）的联合建模；(2) "合并异构边类型减少7倍参数反而性能更优"的发现提示：在轻量化设计中，过度复杂的结构设计未必必要，参数压缩可能带来正则化收益；(3) 时间注意力边特征（time-attentive edge features）可类比遥感时序影像中的时间建模；(4) 双向连接对信息流动的必要性，可类比遥感检测网络中特征金字塔的top-down/bottom-up双向传播。但这些均为间接借鉴，整体参考价值有限。

Abstract: Accurate ICU mortality prediction requires modeling irregular clinical observations across heterogeneous entity types. Existing sequence models handle irregular sampling but ignore typed relational structure; existing graph models assume fixed-interval inputs. We introduce the Continuous-Time Heterogeneous EHR Graph (CT-HEG) schema and evaluate which architectural choices drive predictive performance. CT-HEG encodes each ICU stay as a typed, timestamped graph with three node types (visit, vital, lab_event) and 2D edge attributes (t_hours/48, value_norm) encoding timing and value without imputation. We instantiate CT-HEG as CHIRP-Net, a four-layer heterogeneous GATv2Conv network, evaluated on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (31,142 ICU stays, LOS>=48h, 13.4% mortality) with five seeds and bootstrapped confidence intervals, against logistic regression, mTAND, a Transformer, and GRU-D, plus an ablation study. CHIRP-Net achieved 5-seed mean AUROC 0.8449+/-0.0071 (AUPRC 0.4958+/-0.0209); the ensemble achieved AUROC 0.8618 (95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745). Removing reverse edges disconnected observation nodes from the visit readout, cutting AUROC by 0.1968+/-0.0073. Time-attentive edge features contributed 0.0247+/-0.0093 AUROC. Collapsing heterogeneous edge types into one relation (7x fewer parameters) outperformed the full model on all seeds. Post-calibration ECE was 0.0307. Temporal and demographic subgroup analyses were explored but not reported here, pending follow-up work. Bidirectional connectivity was necessary for the model to use its inputs at all, and CT-HEG was reasonably well calibrated after validation-fitted temperature scaling. These results support CT-HEG for irregular EHR data, while external validation, a pre-specified temporal evaluation, and a demographic fairness audit remain necessary before any claim of robustness. Code: https://github.com/nasiruddinstudents-ctrl/chirp-net-mimic-iv.

</details>


### [113] [Sphere Retraction Normalizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02668)
*Jie Zhang,Cheng-Fang Su,Yi-Jui Huang,Min-Te Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于黎曼流形上retraction映射族的归一化方法（p-SpheretNorm），将欧氏残差连接与GeoNorm统一到同一框架，在nanoGPT上验证了球形残差流中指数映射并非最优retraction。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛深度学习/神经网络训练稳定性方法，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。其"lightweight deep connection schemes"中的"lightweight"指轻量级连接方案（网络结构层面的连接设计），并非模型压缩/加速意义上的轻量化（pruning/quantization/distillation等）。

Reading priority: 2分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于泛深度学习训练方法。仅当对残差连接/归一化设计有理论兴趣时可略读，对在轨部署课题的直接借鉴价值有限。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：神经网络训练稳定性/归一化方法设计。场景：通用深度学习（在nanoGPT语言模型上验证）。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明遥感或目标检测相关任务。

Model architecture: 提出p-SpheretNorm，一个单参数族的角retraction方法，将残差流约束在超球面上。Proj-SpheretNorm（p=1，metric projection retraction）和Cay-SpheretNorm（p=2，Cayley retraction）是其中两个特例，仅需代数运算且精确保范。GeoNorm和identity map分别是该族两端的极限。在nanoGPT（小型GPT）上验证。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及传统模型压缩/加速方法（pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、TensorRT等）。文中"lightweight deep connection schemes"指轻量级残差连接方案（网络结构层面的设计），与部署轻量化含义不同。但该方法仅需代数运算（无需指数映射等复杂操作），在计算开销上相对GeoNorm更轻，可视为一种计算友好的归一化设计。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅在nanoGPT上报告validation loss，未涉及实时推理或边缘/星上部署。由于方法仅需代数运算，理论上计算开销较低，但缺乏具体部署数据支撑。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：摘要未明确说明具体数据集（仅在nanoGPT模型上训练，未给出语料名称）。评价指标：validation loss（验证损失）。实验设置：对比现有lightweight deep connection schemes，验证在有限p处取得最优validation loss。

Experiments: 在nanoGPT上，三种方法（Proj-SpheretNorm、Cay-SpheretNorm及族内其他p值）均优于现有lightweight deep connection schemes；最优validation loss在有限p处取得，说明指数映射（GeoNorm）并非球形残差流的最优retraction，而只是谱系的一端。摘要未给出具体数值对比和消融细节。

Limitations: 1. 仅在nanoGPT（语言模型）上验证，未在视觉/遥感任务上测试；2. 摘要未提供计算开销、参数量、训练速度等量化对比；3. 未涉及目标检测或遥感场景；4. 方法对深层CNN/检测backbone的适用性未知；5. 摘要未说明与模型压缩/加速（pruning/quantization等）的结合方式。

Ideas for my research: 1. 该方法的"仅需代数运算、精确保范"特性，理论上计算开销低，可考虑将其引入轻量化检测backbone（如MobileNet、EfficientNet类）的残差连接设计中，提升训练稳定性同时保持低计算成本；2. 其"retraction族统一框架"思想可启发对轻量化网络连接结构的系统化设计；3. 但需注意：该方法面向训练稳定性而非推理加速，对在轨部署的直接贡献有限，需自行验证其在遥感目标检测任务上的效果与开销。
