Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测无直接关系，但存在以下间接借鉴点：1) 联邦学习（Federated Learning）框架中"数据分散、通信受限"的设定与多星协同在轨推理/训练场景有概念相似性，可参考其FedAvg/FedAvgM在通信轮次效率上的分析思路；2) "跨站点性能损失（cross-site penalty）"的评估框架可类比为遥感模型在不同传感器/不同轨道/不同光照条件下的泛化性能评估；3) 论文强调"学习可迁移表征"是核心挑战，这与遥感目标检测模型在不同卫星平台间迁移时的域适应问题有相通之处。但整体借鉴价值有限，建议仅作为方法论层面的参考。

Abstract: Electronic health record foundation models are limited by institutionally siloed data and substantial performance degradation under cross-site transfer. We evaluated federated training of tokenized generative event models (GEMs) across 122,251 intensive care hospitalizations from three independent health systems harmonized to the Common Longitudinal ICU Data Format. Models were assessed on 12 post-24-hour clinical prediction tasks using within-site, cross-site, centralized, and federated training configurations. GEMs achieved the highest mean within-site and cross-site ROC-AUC and were substantially more transportable than conventional supervised models: their average cross-site penalties were 0.025 ROC-AUC and 0.027 PR-AUC, compared with 0.079 and 0.089 for LightGBM. Federated Learning (FedAvg and FedAvgM) approached the performance of centralized GEM training, with most gains obtained within 5-10 communication rounds. However, centralized multi-site training provided only modest improvements over complete local training. Multi-site models were most useful when local training data were limited, with their advantage narrowing as institutional data accumulated. These findings show that federated GEM training is technically feasible and preserves most centralized performance, but that the main open challenge is learning transportable representations to translate larger, but heterogeneous data from multiple health systems into a reliable target-site benefit.

</details>


### [137] [Sedentary Behavior Classification for Wearable Sensors with a CNN-BiLSTM Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02946)
*Yuliang Chen,Weiwei Shi,Jingjing Zou,Rong Zablocki,Animesh Kumar,Jordan A. Carlson,Sheri J. Hartman,Mikael Anne Greenwood-Hickman,Paul R. Hibbing,Marta Jankowska,Jay Yang,Arun Kumar,Loki Natarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究基于髋部佩戴加速度计数据训练的CNN-BiLSTM模型（CHAP）能否迁移到腕部佩戴场景进行久坐行为检测，并评估微调策略的效果。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于泛可穿戴传感器/人体行为识别领域，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关。虽然涉及"迁移学习/微调"这一与模型轻量化有一定方法论关联的技术，但既非遥感场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及任何模型压缩或部署优化。其核心是传感器佩戴位置变化（domain shift）下的行为分类迁移问题。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关——既非遥感场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及任何模型压缩或部署优化。仅迁移学习/微调的方法论思路有极弱的间接参考价值，不建议作为重点阅读对象。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：久坐行为二分类（sitting vs non-sitting classification）；应用场景：可穿戴传感器健康监测；传感器类型：accelerometer（加速度计），分别佩戴于hip（髋部）和wrist（腕部）；目标类别：sitting / non-sitting。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: CHAP模型：CNN-BiLSTM（卷积神经网络+双向长短期记忆网络）混合架构，最初为髋部加速度计数据设计。对比对象为从零训练的transformer模型。摘要未说明具体网络层数、卷积核大小、参数量等细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等经典轻量化方法。唯一与"轻量化"沾边的是迁移学习/微调（finetuning）策略——即利用髋部预训练模型作为起点，用少量腕部标注数据微调以适应新传感器位置，这属于减少训练成本/数据需求的思路，而非模型压缩或推理加速。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。仅提及"zero-shot performance"和"finetuning with varying amounts of labeled data"，关注的是数据效率和迁移能力，而非边缘/星上部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：iWatch dataset，ground-truth posture labels由wearable cameras（可穿戴相机）提供。评价指标：accuracy（准确率）。实验设置：髋部训练模型在髋部数据上的zero-shot评估、在腕部数据上的zero-shot评估、以及用不同量腕部标注数据微调后的评估。

Experiments: 主要结果：(1) 髋部训练的模型在髋部数据上无需重训即表现良好；(2) 迁移到腕部数据时accuracy下降，原因是sensor placement shift（传感器佩戴位置偏移导致的域差异）；(3) 微调CHAP相比从零训练的transformer模型具有一致优势。摘要未提供具体数值结果。

Limitations: 摘要未说明：模型参数量与计算开销、微调所需数据量的具体阈值、腕部数据高信号变异性的处理策略细节、模型在真实场景中的泛化能力。此外，该研究面向可穿戴健康监测，与遥感在轨目标检测在数据模态、任务目标、部署约束（功耗/算力/实时性）上均无交集。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景无关，但"预训练模型跨域迁移+少量目标域数据微调"的范式对遥感在轨目标检测有一定方法论启发：(1) 可借鉴"源域预训练→目标域微调"思路，例如用地面/机载遥感数据预训练检测模型，再迁移到星上影像域（不同传感器、不同分辨率、不同光照条件）进行少量数据微调；(2) "zero-shot性能下降→需要域适配"的结论提示，在轨模型部署时需考虑传感器/成像条件变化带来的domain shift，可探索domain adaptation或test-time adaptation；(3) 微调相比从零训练更高效，说明在算力受限的星上场景中，预训练+轻量微调可能是比全量训练更可行的方案。但这些借鉴仅停留在方法论层面，论文本身与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化均无直接关系。

Abstract: Accurate detection of sedentary behavior is important for studying health risks related to prolonged sitting, but posture-based classification remains challenging with wearable sensors, especially at the wrist. We study whether a deep learning model trained on hip-worn accelerometer data can transfer to wrist-worn accelerometer data for sitting versus non-sitting classification. We use CHAP, a CNN-BiLSTM model originally developed for hip accelerometers, and evaluate its zero-shot performance on wrist data as well as its adaptation through finetuning with varying amounts of labeled wrist data. Experiments are conducted on the iWatch dataset with ground-truth posture labels derived from wearable cameras. The hip-trained model performs strongly on hip data without retraining, but accuracy drops on wrist data due to sensor placement shift. Finetuning CHAP provides consistent advantages over transformer models trained from scratch. These findings suggest that hip-based pretraining provides a useful starting point for wrist deployment, while highlighting the need for wrist-specific adaptation to handle higher signal variability.

</details>


### [138] [ATFlash: Per-RoPE-Wavelength Attention Windows for Compute/Memory-Efficient LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02947)
*Shun-ichiro Hayashi,Daichi Mukunoki,Tetsuya Hoshino,Takahiro Katagiri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于RoPE波长结构的距离窗口剪枝方法，按波长比例剪除query-key内积项，实现与输入无关的token级稀疏注意力，在保持长上下文精度的同时提升推理速度。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文是泛NLP/大语言模型领域的注意力机制加速方法，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测完全无关。虽然涉及"pruning"（剪枝）和推理加速，但属于token级注意力稀疏化，并非面向遥感目标检测的模型轻量化。其轻量化思路（注意力稀疏剪枝）对遥感大模型或Transformer-based检测器的注意力计算优化有一定间接借鉴意义，但整体与本研究方向弱相关。

Reading priority: 2分（低优先级）。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于NLP长上下文注意力加速研究。仅当本人课题涉及Transformer-based遥感检测器且关注注意力计算优化时，可参考其结构感知剪枝和硬件移植思路，但整体借鉴价值有限。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：长上下文大语言模型（LLM）的注意力机制加速与稀疏化。应用场景：长文本推理（LongBench-v2、RULER等长上下文基准）。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 基于RoPE（rotary position embeddings）的Transformer注意力机制。核心思想：RoPE的注意力分数可分解为2D旋转频率对的求和，每个频率对的波长限制了其位置判别距离。据此提出per-RoPE-wavelength distance window，按波长比例剪除query-key内积项。实现为query-key收缩轴上的切片（slice），不改变online-softmax递推结构，可移植到FlashAttention-4 prefill和FlashInfer decode。

Lightweight method: 注意力稀疏化/剪枝方法：1) token级剪枝——按RoPE波长比例的距离窗口剪除超出波长比例距离的query-key内积项；2) 与频率级剪枝正交，可叠加使用；3) 剪枝率与输入无关，具有关于序列长度N的对数形式的闭式解（区别于MInference等动态稀疏方法）；4) 实现为query-key收缩轴的切片，保持online-softmax递推不变，便于移植到FlashAttention/FlashInfer。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅报告了推理加速：在RTX PRO 6000上，Llama模型两个移植版本均超过stock实现，加速比随上下文长度增长，128K时达1.29×；端到端在Qwen2.5-7B-1M上，剪除57%内积项后，1M token上下文加速比达1.31×。该加速面向GPU（RTX PRO 6000），未涉及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等边缘或星上部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 模型：Qwen2.5-0.5B、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B-1M。数据集：LongBench-v2（用于KL散度和top-1匹配率评估）、RULER、OpenAI-MRCR、LongCodeQA、∞Bench（用于长上下文基准绝对分数评估）。指标：top-1 match rate（96-98%）、mean output-distribution KL（10^-3 nat量级）、剪枝率（37-48%内积项）、加速比（1.29×@128K、1.31×@1M）。

Experiments: 在Qwen2.5-0.5B和Llama-3.2-3B上，窗口在各自原生上下文长度内剪除37-48%的query-key内积项；相对full attention，top-1匹配率保持96-98%，输出分布KL在10^-3 nat量级。在RULER、OpenAI-MRCR、LongCodeQA、∞Bench等长上下文基准上绝对分数基本保持。在RTX PRO 6000上，FlashAttention-4 prefill和FlashInfer decode两个移植版本均超过stock实现，加速比随上下文长度增长，128K达1.29×；Qwen2.5-7B-1M端到端在1M token上下文下剪除57%内积项，加速1.31×。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于NLP长上下文注意力加速；2) 摘要未说明在视觉/遥感图像任务上的适用性；3) 加速比相对有限（1.29-1.31×），且仅在GPU上验证，未涉及边缘/星上硬件；4) 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、能耗等部署关键指标；5) 未讨论与CNN-based检测器或轻量目标检测模型的结合方式。

Ideas for my research: 1) 该方法的"结构感知剪枝"思想可借鉴：如果遥感目标检测模型使用Transformer/注意力机制（如DETR系列、ViT-based检测器），可考虑基于位置编码结构（如RoPE或2D位置编码）设计距离窗口剪枝，减少注意力计算量；2) "剪枝率与输入无关、闭式解"的设计理念值得借鉴——在星上部署中，输入无关的确定性计算模式更利于硬件资源规划和功耗预估；3) 保持online-softmax递推不变、以切片方式实现剪枝的思路，说明轻量化改造应尽量不破坏原有计算结构，便于硬件移植；4) 该方法与动态稀疏方法正交、可叠加的特性提示：多种轻量化手段（剪枝+量化+蒸馏）可组合使用以获得更大压缩收益。

Abstract: The attention score with rotary position embeddings (RoPE) decomposes exactly into a sum over its 2D-rotation frequency pairs, and each pair's wavelength limits how far it can discriminate position. Aligned with this structure, we propose the per-RoPE-wavelength distance window: it prunes the query--key inner-product terms beyond a wavelength-proportional distance. Unlike a sliding window, every key remains reachable, at least through the low-frequency pairs. The reduction rate is input-independent, with a closed form logarithmic in the sequence length $N$, in contrast to dynamic-sparse methods like MInference. Such token-level selection is orthogonal to our frequency-level pruning. The window can therefore be applied on top of those methods. On Qwen2.5-0.5B and Llama-3.2-3B, the window prunes 37--48\% of the query--key inner-product terms within each model's native context length. Relative to full attention, the top-1 match rate stays at 96--98\% and the mean output-distribution KL at the $10^{-3}$-nat level on LongBench-v2 contexts. We examine absolute scores on long-context benchmarks such as RULER, OpenAI-MRCR, LongCodeQA, and $\infty$Bench: they are broadly preserved. We implement the window as a slice of the query--key contraction axis, leaving the online-softmax recurrences untouched, and port it with minimal diffs into the released FlashAttention-4 prefill and FlashInfer decode. On RTX PRO 6000 with Llama, both ports outpace stock with gains growing with context length, up to $1.29\times$ at 128K. End to end on Qwen2.5-7B-1M, with 57\% of the inner-product terms pruned, the speedup reaches $1.31\times$ at a 1M-token context.

</details>


### [139] [Rubrics as Privileged Information for Open-Ended Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02948)
*Deepika Bablani,Ajay Gupta,Wanming Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出将on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)扩展到开放式生成任务，使用rubric（评分准则）作为软privileged information (PI)进行知识蒸馏，相比硬参考答案PI和rubric-as-reward RL在健康问答和科学问答基准上取得更优效果。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文是自然语言处理/大语言模型领域的知识蒸馏方法研究，聚焦于开放式文本生成（health response、science QA），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或任何视觉任务。虽然涉及knowledge distillation这一轻量化技术，但蒸馏对象是LLM的文本生成能力，而非遥感目标检测模型，方法本身（rubric-based soft PI）也难以直接迁移到视觉检测任务。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文是LLM文本生成领域的蒸馏研究，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及任何视觉检测、遥感场景或部署优化内容。除非对"蒸馏信号设计"这一通用方法论有浓厚兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：开放式文本生成（open-ended generation）中的知识蒸馏；应用场景：健康问答（HealthBench）和科学问答（ResearchQA）；传感器类型：不适用（纯NLP任务）；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 基于Qwen和Llama模型家族的大语言模型，采用on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)框架，同一模型在不同context下同时充当student和teacher。使用rubric作为soft privileged information (PI)提供dense token-level supervision。

Lightweight method: 涉及knowledge distillation（知识蒸馏），但这是LLM蒸馏而非检测模型压缩。核心创新在于蒸馏信号的设计：用rubric（评分准则）作为soft PI替代hard reference completion PI，为student提供更丰富的训练信号。不涉及剪枝、量化、NAS等传统轻量化手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及任何部署相关指标（参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等），且LLM蒸馏与星上部署场景无直接关联。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：HealthBench（健康问答基准，基于医生创建的rubric评分）、RubricHub Science corpus + ResearchQA（科学问答）；评价指标：absolute score（绝对分数），RuPI比RaR RL提升最高+0.10，比reference-PI提升+0.034至+0.079；ResearchQA上66.6% vs 64.2%（reference-PI）和57.6%（RaR RL）。

Experiments: 在Qwen和Llama多个模型上验证rubric作为PI的有效性；对比rubric-as-reward (RaR) RL方法和reference-PI蒸馏方法；在HealthBench和ResearchQA两个基准上均显示soft rubric PI优于hard reference PI和RaR RL。

Limitations: 1. 完全面向NLP/LLM任务，与遥感视觉检测无任何交集；2. 摘要未说明计算开销、推理效率等部署指标；3. rubric-based soft PI的设计依赖人工编写的评分准则，在遥感检测任务中难以直接定义类似rubric；4. 未涉及任何视觉特征、空间结构或小目标检测问题。

Ideas for my research: 1. 蒸馏信号设计的思路可借鉴：在遥感目标检测的知识蒸馏中，传统做法是蒸馏teacher的feature map或logits，可思考是否能用"soft rubric"式的结构化偏好信号（如检测框质量评分、IoU分布偏好）替代单一hard label，为student提供更丰富的监督；2. on-policy self-distillation（同一模型自蒸馏）的思想可迁移到检测模型轻量化，减少对大型teacher的依赖；3. 但整体而言，该论文与遥感在轨检测轻量化方向关联度很低，仅作为蒸馏信号设计方法的泛化参考。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a single model acts as both student and teacher with different contexts, has shown promise in verifiable domains like math, where hard privileged information (PI) in the form of ground-truth answers structurally constrains valid continuations. We extend OPSD to open-ended generation using soft PI in the form of rubrics that guide preferences but admit many valid responses. Rubrics have served as scalar rewards for reinforcement learning (RL); we show that they provide substantially richer signal as dense PI for distillation, and contrary to intuition, soft rubric PI provides a larger and more effective training signal on student roll-outs than hard reference completion PI in this regime. A reference completion is one point in a set of valid responses, so distilling towards it over-constrains the student, while rubrics specify the preference structure shared across the set of valid responses. We show the effectiveness of using rubrics as PI for open-ended generation across Qwen and Llama model families and show that it outperforms rubric-as-reward (RaR) RL using HealthBench, a benchmark that grades open-ended health responses against physician-created rubrics, providing dense token-level supervision for open-ended tasks; RuPI beats RaR RL by up to +0.10 absolute score and, under matched recipe and KL direction, beats reference-PI by +0.034 to +0.079 absolute score across three models. We further show that these findings generalize to training on the RubricHub Science corpus and evaluating on ResearchQA: soft rubric PI outperforms both reference-PI distillation and RaR RL (66.6% vs. 64.2% and 57.6%).

</details>


### [140] [Schedule-Informed Temporal Fusion Forecasting of Hourly Airport Security-Checkpoint Throughput](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02950)
*Yinxiao Zhang,Sen Wang,Yi Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将航班时刻表转换为安检吞吐量预测信号的框架，使用截断泊松核将座位容量分配到起飞前时段，并结合Temporal Fusion Transformer进行6小时至96小时的安检吞吐量预测，服务于机场安检人员排班规划。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于机场安检吞吐量预测/时间序列预测领域，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关；也不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测、舰船/飞机/车辆检测等遥感目标检测任务；更不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署等轻量化方法。唯一可借鉴的是其时间序列预测框架（Temporal Fusion Transformer）和将离散事件（航班时刻）转化为连续信号（安检需求强度）的建模思路，属于泛机器学习/时序预测方法，与本研究方向弱相关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于机场安检吞吐量预测领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感数据、目标检测任务或任何模型压缩/加速方法。除非对Temporal Fusion Transformer在时序预测中的应用有额外兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机场安检吞吐量（hourly checkpoint throughput）时间序列预测；应用场景：机场安检人员排班（checkpoint staffing）、通道开放规划、多日安检规划；传感器类型：不适用（使用TSA吞吐量数据和Cirium Diio航班时刻表）；目标类别：不适用（预测对象为每小时安检吞吐量）。

Model architecture: 核心模型为Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT），用于融合三类输入信号：(1) 由航班时刻表经截断泊松核（truncated Poisson kernels）转换得到的到达强度信号（schedule-derived arrival-intensity signals）；(2) 历史吞吐量（historical throughput）；(3) 计划活动与时间变量（scheduled activity and temporal variables）。对比基线为RNN和LSTM。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法，如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络设计等均未提及。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理能力等部署相关信息。该任务为离线/近实时机场运营预测，与星上部署、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等硬件加速场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：2023-2024年美国运输安全管理局（TSA）吞吐量数据，以及Cirium Diio航班时刻表数据，针对Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport（亚特兰大机场）。训练方式：按时间顺序训练（chronologically trained），2024年7-12月作为测试集。评价指标：加权平均绝对百分比误差（weighted mean absolute percentage error, wMAPE）。对比模型：RNN和LSTM，使用5个随机种子（five random seeds）进行评估。

Experiments: 主要实验结果：(1) 直接6小时预测（direct six-hour forecasts）：提出模型wMAPE为9.33%，优于RNN的12.16%和LSTM的11.37%，且在高峰时段误差最低；(2) 6小时递归更新（six-hour recursive updates）：在24-96小时预测范围内误差保持在10.60%-11.04%之间，但更长预测时域内有效预测起点较少。摘要未说明消融实验细节。

Limitations: 局限性：(1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于机场运营预测领域；(2) 观测吞吐量反映的是实际处理量而非无约束到达量，预测需结合本地人员配置、容量、排队和等待时间信息解读；(3) 仅针对单一机场（亚特兰大机场）验证，泛化性未说明；(4) 摘要未说明模型复杂度、推理效率等部署指标；(5) 更长预测时域（>96小时）的有效预测起点减少，长时域可靠性受限。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但仍有以下可借鉴点：(1) 将离散事件（航班时刻）转化为连续信号（安检需求强度）的"事件-信号转换"建模思路，可类比于将卫星轨道/过境时间等离散事件转化为在轨观测需求强度信号，用于在轨任务调度或目标检测触发策略；(2) Temporal Fusion Transformer的时序特征融合框架，可用于遥感时序数据（如多时相变化检测、视频目标检测）的特征建模；(3) 按时间顺序划分训练/测试集（chronological split）的评估策略，对遥感时序数据集的评估划分有参考价值；(4) 加权误差指标（wMAPE）在峰值时段更敏感的评估思路，可类比于遥感小目标检测中对小目标/难样本的加权评估。但整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Checkpoint staffing requires accurate forecasts of when screening demand will occur, yet flight schedules record departure times rather than passenger arrival times at security checkpoints. This study develops a framework that converts known flight schedules into temporally aligned signals for forecasting hourly checkpoint throughput. Using 2023-2024 Transportation Security Administration throughput data and Cirium Diio flight schedules for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, domestic and international seat capacity was distributed across pre-departure hours using truncated Poisson kernels. A Temporal Fusion Transformer then combined these schedule-derived arrival-intensity signals with historical throughput, scheduled activity, and temporal variables. Models were trained chronologically, with July-December 2024 reserved for testing, and evaluated against recurrent neural network and long short-term memory models across five random seeds. For direct six-hour forecasts, the proposed model achieved a weighted mean absolute percentage error of 9.33%, compared with 12.16% for the recurrent neural network and 11.37% for long short-term memory, while also producing the lowest errors during peak periods. With six-hour recursive updates, errors remained between 10.60% and 11.04% across 24-96 hour horizons, although longer horizons contained fewer valid forecast origins. By transforming scheduled departures into interpretable pre-departure screening-load signals without requiring passenger-flight matching, the framework supports advance staffing, lane-opening, and multiday checkpoint planning. Because observed throughput reflects realized processing rather than unconstrained arrivals, the forecasts should be interpreted together with local staffing, capacity, queue, and wait-time information.

</details>


### [141] [SP3O: Reinforcement Learning from Segment Preferences without Reward Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02951)
*Evan Assmus,Qining Zhang,Lei Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于分段偏好反馈的无奖励模型、无评论家、基于梯度的偏好强化学习算法 SP3O，用于一般随机 MDP 的偏好强化学习。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文属于强化学习/RLHF 领域，聚焦于偏好反馈下的策略优化算法设计，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩/加速等任何相关主题。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于强化学习/RLHF 领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：偏好强化学习（Preference-based Reinforcement Learning, PbRL）与 RLHF。应用场景：机器人控制（robotic control）和大语言模型微调（LLM finetuning）。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: SP3O 算法框架：无奖励模型（reward-model-free）、无评论家（critic-free）、基于梯度（gradient-based）的 PPO 类型策略优化。核心模块包括：利用 off-policy importance sampling 构建策略价值差估计器（policy value difference estimator），并通过 PPO-type loss 计算策略梯度。摘要未说明具体网络结构（如 actor 网络的具体设计）。

Lightweight method: 不涉及任何模型轻量化方法。摘要未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT 等任何模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署，未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 实验设置：机器人控制（robotic control）和大语言模型微调（LLM finetuning）场景。摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标细节。

Experiments: 与现有 PbRL/RLHF 算法（如 DPO、P3O 等）进行对比实验，结果显示 SP3O 在长时程任务（long-horizon tasks）中表现更优。摘要未提供具体数值结果。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1) 该算法面向一般随机 MDP 的偏好学习，与视觉目标检测任务无直接关联；2) 摘要未报告计算开销、收敛速度的具体量化数据；3) 未涉及任何视觉/遥感数据处理。

Ideas for my research: 与本人课题（遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化）基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：如果未来在轨目标检测模型需要结合人类偏好反馈进行在线自适应调优（例如根据地面站偏好调整检测策略），SP3O 的 segment-level 偏好反馈和 off-policy importance sampling 思想或许可作为参考，但这属于非常间接的关联，且当前阶段不具直接可操作性。

Abstract: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) for general stochastic MDPs often requires training a reward model. Existing reward-model-free methods are either restricted to bandits or deterministic MDPs, such as DPO or P3O, or use zeroth-order, gradient-free optimization, which in general exhibits a slower convergence rate than gradient-based algorithms. Furthermore, existing reward-model-free preference-based RL algorithms almost exclusively use trajectory-level feedback, which can require significant effort from a human evaluator when trajectories are long. On the other hand, segments are much shorter, so they are easier to compare and evaluate. In this paper, we introduce a novel reward-model-free, critic-free, and gradient-based PbRL algorithm compatible with segment preferences named Segment Pairwise Proximal Policy Optimization (SP3O). SP3O utilizes segment-level preference feedback to construct an accurate policy value difference estimator via off-policy importance sampling, and then uses the estimator to compute the policy gradient via a PPO-type loss function. We provide a theoretical basis for the algorithm and analyze the tradeoff in choosing the segment length. We also evaluate it experimentally against other PbRL/RLHF algorithms in robotic control and LLM finetuning settings to show its improved performance, especially in long-horizon tasks.

</details>


### [142] [Inverted Detection and Control in Steering Vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02957)
*Max Torop,Aria Masoomi,Jennifer Dy*

Main category: cs.LG

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）中的steering vectors概念控制机制，属于自然语言处理/可解释性领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩部署。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评估在Gemma 3 12B、Qwen 2.5 14B、Olmo 3 7B三个模型上进行，覆盖5个概念，实验结果为27/30个实验有提升，提升幅度从+0.9%到+138%。

Experiments: 在27/30个实验中，所提出的ISV识别与符号翻转方法相比基线ITI pipeline有提升，提升范围+0.9%至+138%。评估模型包括Gemma 3 12B、Qwen 2.5 14B、Olmo 3 7B，覆盖5个概念。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：该方法仅针对LLM文本概念控制，与视觉目标检测、遥感图像处理完全无关；未涉及任何部署或轻量化考量。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：steering vectors中"检测-控制反转"现象提示在模型内部表征层面可能存在反直觉的线性判别结构，这或许对理解轻量化模型（如蒸馏后的小模型）中特征表征的保真度有一定启发，但关联非常间接。不建议作为主要参考。

Abstract: Steering vectors (SVs) are widely used to influence the expression of concepts (e.g., truthfulness) in large language model outputs. A key assumption underpinning SVs is that they are linearly discriminative with respect to the concept: representations of texts that exhibit the concept are more aligned with the SV than those that do not, motivating shifts along the positive or negative SV direction to respectively promote or suppress the concept. In this work, we identify an inverted detection-control phenomenon in which some highly discriminative SVs that are aligned with positive representations can consistently promote the opposite behavior. We refer to such vectors as inverted-steering vectors (ISVs). We provide a geometric characterization of ISVs' effects, finding that steering along these directions systematically pushes representations in discriminative downstream heads as if the concept were absent, even prior to decoding. Motivated by this analysis, we propose an approach for distinguishing ISVs without requiring generation or associated response scoring. This enables targeted sign flips, which we use to improve a foundational detection-based steering pipeline via Inference Time Intervention (ITI). Our approach improves results in 27/30 experiments, ranging from +0.9% to +138%. We evaluate our findings on Gemma 3 12B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Olmo 3 7B across 5 concepts.

</details>


### [143] [Scaling an Autoregressive Transformer for Single-Cell Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02961)
*Aleksandr Sharipov,Yusif Mukhtarov,Igor Molybog*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究单细胞基因表达向量的自监督生成任务，提出因果transformer配合量化VAE tokenizer的架构，并首次拟合了单细胞基础模型的双指数scaling law和compute-optimal frontier。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关（1分）。论文主题是单细胞基因表达（single-cell gene expression）的生成建模，属于生物信息学/计算生物学领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及object detection、目标检测或任何视觉任务。虽然文中使用了quantized VAE tokenizer和scaling law等概念，但这些是通用生成模型/基础模型技术，与遥感目标检测轻量化没有直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于计算生物学/单细胞基因组学领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：单细胞基因表达向量的自监督生成（self-supervised generation）。应用场景：计算生物学/单细胞基因组学。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：细胞类型（cell type），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: 因果transformer（causal transformer）配合学习得到的量化VAE tokenizer（learned quantized VAE tokenizer），使用cross-entropy loss训练。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明明确的轻量化方法。文中涉及quantized VAE tokenizer（量化VAE分词器），但这里的"quantized"是指对基因表达向量进行离散化编码，而非模型压缩中的weight quantization。文中研究了scaling behavior（通过改变参数量和训练数据量），但这属于scaling law研究，不是模型轻量化/压缩/加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标包括：生成基因表达向量的生物学保真度（biological fidelity）、预训练损失的scaling behavior、生成分布与真实分布的比较。摘要未说明具体指标名称（如FID、KL散度等）。

Experiments: 主要实验：1）在held-out基因表达向量上条件生成，比较生成分布与ground truth分布；2）通过改变参数量和训练数据量研究scaling properties；3）首次联合拟合双指数scaling law并计算compute-optimal frontier。摘要未说明对比方法或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1）与遥感目标检测轻量化方向完全无关，缺乏任何可迁移的遥感/视觉/部署信息；2）摘要未说明模型参数量、推理速度等部署指标；3）摘要未说明具体数据集和定量评价指标；4）摘要未说明轻量化方法（量化、剪枝、蒸馏等）。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能间接相关的点是：1）quantized VAE tokenizer的离散化编码思想，在遥感目标检测中可类比为对特征图/中间表征做离散化以降低存储和计算开销，但这与主流轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏）差异较大；2）scaling law研究思路（参数量vs数据量的权衡）在遥感轻量化模型设计中可参考，但需要重新在遥感场景下拟合。总体而言，本文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接可借鉴点极少。

Abstract: We study a self-supervised generation task for single-cell gene expression vectors: given a set of vectors from a cell type, we aim to generate additional gene expression vectors of that cell type. For this task we characterize both the biological fidelity of the generated gene expression vectors and the scaling behavior of the pretraining loss. The model is a causal transformer paired with a learned quantized VAE tokenizer, trained with a cross-entropy loss. To evaluate the model, we condition it on held-out gene expression vectors of a cell type and generate vectors of gene expression, comparing the resulting distribution over gene expression vectors to the ground truth distribution of that cell type. We study the scaling properties of the proposed architecture by varying the number of trained parameters and the amount of training data. To our knowledge, we find the first jointly-fit two-exponent scaling law and compute-optimal frontier for a single-cell foundation model. Finally, we discuss how this pretrained model could be finetuned for perturbation response prediction.

</details>


### [144] [A Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator for Transient Magnetization Prediction in Power Magnetics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02965)
*Yachao Zhu,Qiujie Huang,Sinan Li,Yang Li,Gang Lei,Jianguo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理信息混合神经算子（PI-HNO），用于高频高功率密度变换器中磁性元件的瞬态磁化预测，通过B-H能量一致性正则化实现紧凑的磁滞建模。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于电力电子领域磁性元件的瞬态磁化预测（core-loss modeling），属于电磁/材料物理建模问题，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩部署。虽然模型参数量小（4777参数）体现了一定的轻量化思想，但应用场景和任务类型与本研究方向完全不同，属于弱相关（1-2分）。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于电力电子磁性元件建模领域。虽然其参数高效模型设计和物理信息正则化思想有一定借鉴价值，但整体相关性极低，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：瞬态磁化预测（transient magnetization prediction）/磁芯损耗建模（core-loss modeling）；应用场景：高频高功率密度变换器（high-frequency, high-power-density converters）中的磁性元件；传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: PI-HNO（Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator）包含两个分支：1）局部循环分支（local recurrent branch），用于边界状态表示和速率依赖响应演化；2）Preisach启发的全局分支（global branch），提取波形级磁滞上下文。模型输入为B(t)-H(t)历史、预测区间内的B(t)序列及运行条件信息，输出H(t)序列及重构的B-H轨迹。采用B-H能量一致性正则化（B-H energy-consistency regularization）。

Lightweight method: 模型本身设计紧凑，每个材料特定模型仅4777个可训练参数（trainable parameters），体现了参数高效（parameter-efficient）的设计理念。但摘要未说明是否采用剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）或NAS等标准模型压缩方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明部署相关信息。虽然模型参数量小（4777参数），但未提及FLOPs、延迟（latency）、显存（memory）、能耗（energy consumption）或实时推理（real-time inference）能力，也未涉及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等边缘或星上部署平台。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：MagNetX transient database，使用14种铁氧体材料（ferrite materials）的材料特定模型。评价指标：序列精度（sequence accuracy）和B(t)-H(t)能量一致性误差（energy consistency error），平均误差1.92%，95百分位误差7.60%。

Experiments: 在MagNetX数据库上对14种铁氧体材料进行材料特定模型评估，PI-HNO在序列精度与B-H能量一致性之间取得紧凑权衡。消融实验（ablation studies）表明局部分支、全局分支和能量感知正则化组件对瞬态磁化预测均有独立贡献。

Limitations: 1）应用领域与遥感/目标检测完全无关，属于电力电子磁芯损耗建模；2）摘要未说明模型推理速度、计算复杂度（FLOPs）等部署指标；3）未涉及目标检测任务，无检测精度（mAP等）或推理延迟信息；4）模型针对特定材料训练，泛化到其他材料或场景的能力未说明。

Ideas for my research: 尽管应用场景不同，但有以下可借鉴思路：1）物理信息正则化（physics-informed regularization）的思想可迁移到遥感目标检测中，例如利用遥感几何先验（如旋转框的物理约束）作为正则化项；2）混合架构设计（局部+全局分支）可类比于遥感小目标检测中局部特征与全局上下文融合的设计；3）参数高效模型（4777参数）的设计理念对星上部署的轻量化模型有参考价值，但需结合具体检测任务重新设计。

Abstract: Magnetic components in high-frequency, high-power-density converters are increasingly driven by non-sinusoidal flux-density waveforms with fast transitions, minor-loop operation, dc bias, and temperature variation. Under these conditions, steady-state core-loss formulas and single-valued material curves cannot fully capture transient magnetization responses. This work proposes the Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator (PI-HNO), a compact material-specific neural model with B-H energy-consistency regularization for core-loss-oriented transient magnetization prediction. Given the measured B(t)-H(t) history, the input B(t) series over the prediction interval and operating-condition information, PI-HNO predicts the H(t) series and the corresponding reconstructed B-H trajectory. The model integrates a local recurrent branch for boundary-state representation and rate-dependent response evolution with a Preisach-inspired global branch that extracts waveform-level hysteresis context. Evaluation on the MagNetX transient database using material-specific models for 14 ferrite materials demonstrates that PI-HNO achieves a compact trade-off between sequence accuracy and B(t)-H(t) energy consistency, with the mean and 95th percentile B(t)-H(t) energy consistency errors of 1.92% and 7.60%, respectively, using only 4777 trainable parameters per model. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the local, global, and energy-aware regularized components provide distinct contributions to transient magnetization prediction.

</details>


### [145] [AcceptMoE: Commitment-Weighted Self-Sizing Verifier Expert Sets for Efficient MoE Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02989)
*Shuang Liang,Hao,Chen,Zhiwen Mo,Qianzhou Wang,Guoyu Li,Lingxiao Ma,Wayne Luk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AcceptMoE 是一种面向 MoE（Mixture-of-Experts）大语言模型的验证端专家选择器，通过结合目标路由器分数与离线估计的提交概率，自动调整每个验证块可用的专家数量，并在卸载场景下依据缓存驻留情况决定专家资格，从而在不显著损失精度的前提下大幅提升推理吞吐并降低主机到设备的数据传输量。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于泛机器学习/大语言模型推理加速方向，核心对象是 MoE 大语言模型的 speculative decoding 加速，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化均无直接关联。虽然其"专家选择/稀疏激活/推理加速"思想在方法论层面对轻量化推理有一定借鉴意义，但并非遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向弱相关，属于 LLM 推理加速领域。其"动态稀疏激活/选择性计算"思想在方法论层面有一定启发，但缺乏遥感场景、目标检测任务和传统轻量化手段（剪枝/量化/蒸馏）的直接关联，建议仅作为方法论参考快速浏览，不投入深度阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：大语言模型（LLM）推理加速，具体为 MoE 模型的 speculative decoding（投机解码）验证阶段优化。应用场景：通用 LLM 服务（SGLang serving），非遥感/卫星场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用（文本生成任务）。

Model architecture: 面向 MoE（Mixture-of-Experts）目标模型。核心组件是 AcceptMoE——一个 verifier-side（验证端）专家选择器，它结合 target-router scores（目标路由器分数）与 offline-estimated commitment probabilities（离线估计的提交概率），自动调整每个 verification block 的 eligible experts（合格专家）数量，无需用户指定专家预算。在 offloading（卸载）场景下，依据 cache residency（缓存驻留情况）决定专家资格，而非预测自然路由并预取对应专家权重。

Lightweight method: 该论文并非传统意义上的模型轻量化（剪枝/量化/蒸馏/NAS），而是推理阶段的稀疏激活与专家选择优化。核心思想是：在 MoE 的 speculative decoding 中，并行验证会激活所有树节点所选专家的并集，但只有少数节点到达被接受的输出。AcceptMoE 通过限制验证阶段可用的专家数量（expert eligibility），减少激活专家并集大小和 expert-weight traffic（专家权重传输量），从而降低计算与 I/O 开销。这属于"推理时稀疏化/选择性激活"范畴，与轻量化中的"动态稀疏推理"思想相关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明星上/边缘部署。但提供了服务端推理性能数据：在 SGLang 服务、batch size=1 条件下，相比 EAGLE-3 基线，全 GPU 内存场景下吞吐提升 1.290 倍；物理专家卸载（physical expert offloading）场景下吞吐提升 2.06 倍；host-to-device 传输量降低 73.6%~77.1%。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等具体指标。

Datasets and metrics: 覆盖 12 个 model-task pairs，涉及 3 个 MoE 目标模型和 4 个 benchmark。评价指标：平均精度（mean accuracy）和吞吐量（throughput）。相比 EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with natural routing，AcceptMoE 的平均精度仅低 0.27 个百分点。

Experiments: 主要对比基线为 EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with natural routing。实验结果表明：约束 target-expert eligibility 会改变模型分布，但精度损失很小（平均仅 0.27 个百分点）；在吞吐方面，全内存场景提升 1.290 倍，卸载场景提升 2.06 倍，同时 host-to-device 流量降低 73.6%~77.1%。摘要未说明消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于 LLM 推理加速领域；2. 摘要未说明模型参数量、FLOPs、延迟、能耗等部署关键指标；3. 约束专家资格会改变模型分布，存在精度-效率权衡，摘要未讨论精度损失的边界条件；4. 实验仅在 LLM 文本生成 benchmark 上验证，未涉及视觉/遥感任务；5. 摘要未说明该方法对非 MoE 架构或小模型的适用性。

Ideas for my research: 1. "稀疏激活/选择性计算"思想可迁移：在遥感目标检测模型中，可借鉴"动态选择关键计算路径"的思路，例如对背景区域跳过部分计算、对候选目标区域动态分配更多计算资源，实现推理时动态稀疏化；2. "离线估计提交概率 + 在线路由分数结合"的决策机制，可类比为目标检测中的"离线统计目标先验 + 在线特征响应"来动态决定哪些层/通道参与计算；3. "依据缓存驻留/资源可用性决定计算范围"的思想，对星上资源受限场景有启发——可根据片上存储/算力余量动态调整模型计算规模；4. 其"减少数据传输量"的优化目标与星地链路带宽受限问题类似，可借鉴其降低 host-to-device 流量（类似星上-地面数据传输）的思路。

Abstract: Speculative decoding verifies a tree of draft tokens in one target-model forward pass. For a mixture-of-experts (MoE) target, however, parallel verification can activate the union of the experts selected by all tree nodes, even though only a small subset of those nodes reaches the accepted output. Token count, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic are therefore distinct cost measures: reducing the token workload need not shrink the expert union proportionally, and under offloading, transfer traffic also depends on cache residency. We introduce AcceptMoE, a verifier-side expert selector that combines target-router scores with offline-estimated commitment probabilities and automatically adjusts the number of eligible experts for each verification block, eliminating the need for a user-specified expert budget. Under offloading, AcceptMoE conditions expert eligibility on cache residency instead of predicting natural routes and prefetching the corresponding expert weights. Although constraining target-expert eligibility changes the model distribution, across 12 model-task pairs spanning three MoE targets and four benchmarks, AcceptMoE's mean accuracy is 0.27 percentage points lower than that of EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with natural routing. Served with SGLang at batch size one, it reaches 1.290 times the throughput of this baseline with all expert weights in GPU memory, and 2.06 times under physical expert offloading, while reducing host-to-device traffic by 73.6 percent to 77.1 percent.

</details>


### [146] [Joint Affine Spectral Shaping: Coupling Weight and Bias Updates Beyond Weight-Only Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02991)
*Gongyue Zhang,Honghai Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出联合正则化逆谱映射（JRI）方法，将仿射层的权重和偏置作为联合动量矩阵进行谱优化，在BERT-mini/IMDb上相比仅权重逆整形提升了测试准确率与损失。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于泛机器学习/优化方法研究，聚焦于神经网络优化器（Muon谱优化器）中权重与偏置的联合谱分配问题，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或在轨智能等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及任何轻量化/压缩/部署方法。其唯一可能的借鉴价值在于优化器层面的通用改进，与遥感目标检测模型轻量化方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文是NLP优化器研究，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测任务或任何轻量化/部署技术，仅可作为优化器层面的边缘参考，阅读优先级极低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：神经网络优化器设计（optimizer design），具体为谱优化器（spectral optimizer）中权重与偏置的联合更新。应用场景：自然语言处理（NLP），在四层BERT-mini上从零训练并用于IMDb情感分类。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 四层BERT-mini（4-layer BERT-mini）作为测试模型。优化器层面：将每个仿射层（affine layer）的权重和偏置构造为联合动量矩阵 A=[M_W, αm_b]，并对其施加带上限的正则化逆谱映射（capped regularized-inverse spectral map），同时产生权重更新和物理偏置更新。对比了exact-SVD Muon、weight-only inverse shaping、affine-probe inverse shaping和proposed joint regularized inverse (JRI)四种变体。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。该论文不包含剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计、实时推理或边缘/星上部署等任何模型压缩或加速方法。它属于优化器层面的算法改进，而非模型轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息。且其研究对象为NLP优化器，与星上/边缘部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：IMDb（情感分类），在四层BERT-mini上从零训练。评价指标：验证损失选择的测试准确率（validation-loss-selected test accuracy）和测试损失（test loss）。实验设置：严格五种子消融（strict five-seed ablation），另有一次独立的22种子复现（22-seed replication）。

Experiments: 主要结果：weight-only inverse shaping将测试准确率从84.903±0.242%提升到85.562±0.308%，测试损失从0.3479降至0.3345；允许偏置影响联合SVD但保留独立Adam偏置更新不优于weight-only；JRI联合变换偏置将测试准确率提升至85.738±0.180%，测试损失降至0.3291，五个种子均优于probe基线。峰值性能窗口内，JRI将偏置更新范数从0.02095降至0.00301，边界函数占比从86.58%降至78.97%，权重诱导边界运动与显式偏置的余弦从+0.030变为-0.137。22种子复现得到85.743±0.203%准确率。

Limitations: 局限性：1) 仅在单一NLP任务（IMDb/BERT-mini）上验证，未在视觉/遥感任务上测试；2) 模型规模极小（四层BERT-mini），结论在大型模型上的泛化性未知；3) 摘要未说明计算开销（谱分解本身可能昂贵）；4) 与遥感目标检测、轻量化部署完全无关，无直接可迁移性。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值有限，但可考虑：1) 若在遥感目标检测模型训练中采用Muon类谱优化器，可参考其"权重与偏置联合谱分配"思想，但需注意谱分解的计算开销在星上训练场景下可能不可接受；2) 该论文展示的严格多种子消融与统计显著性报告方式（均值±标准差、多种子复现）可作为实验严谨性的参考范式；3) 其"减少偏置更新范数、降低边界函数占比"的分析思路，可用于理解轻量化后模型训练动态的变化，但整体上对本课题借鉴意义较弱。

Abstract: Matrix spectral optimizers reshape weight-update spectra but usually delegate vector-valued biases to a separate optimizer. We study whether this separation is neutral. We formulate each affine layer as a joint momentum matrix $A=[M_W,αm_b]$ and apply a capped regularized-inverse spectral map to the complete matrix, producing both the weight and physical bias updates. A strict five-seed ablation on a four-layer BERT-mini trained from scratch on IMDb compares exact-SVD Muon, weight-only inverse shaping, affine-probe inverse shaping, and the proposed joint regularized inverse (JRI). Weight-only inverse shaping raises validation-loss-selected test accuracy from $84.903\pm0.242\%$ to $85.562\pm0.308\%$ and lowers selected test loss from $0.3479$ to $0.3345$. Allowing bias to alter the joint SVD while retaining an independent Adam bias update does not improve over weight-only inverse shaping. Using the transformed bias jointly raises selected test accuracy to $85.738\pm0.180\%$ and lowers test loss to $0.3291$, with all five seeds improving relative to the probe baseline. During the peak-performance window, JRI preserves the eligible weight-update norm while reducing the bias-update norm from $0.02095$ to $0.00301$, lowers boundary-function share from $86.58\%$ to $78.97\%$, and changes the cosine between weight-induced boundary motion and explicit bias from $+0.030$ to $-0.137$. An independent 22-seed replication yields $85.743\pm0.203\%$ selected test accuracy. These results identify joint affine spectral allocation as a small but consistent extension to weight-only spectral optimization.

</details>

*Misaki Matsuura,Mohammadreza Nemati,Dulat Bekbolsynov,Stanislaw Stepkowski,Kevin S. Xu*

Abstract: There has been significant interest in using machine learning algorithms to predict kidney transplant outcomes, such as the number of years until a graft inevitably fails. These prediction algorithms could possibly be used for pre-transplant donor-recipient matching to identify more compatible donors and recipients and thus improve post-transplant outcomes. In this study, we explore the use of survival prediction models trained on deceased donor kidney transplant data from the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR). We propose a novel paired recipient-based evaluation framework that compares graft outcomes between two recipients who received kidneys from the same deceased donor, allowing us to evaluate the counterfactual benefit of changing the recipient for a certain donor. We find that five different survival prediction models, ranging in complexity from linear to deep learning-based models, all result in ~60% paired recipient-based accuracy. We further translate this accuracy into an interpretable quantity of post-transplant years gained. We also highlight major limitations of the commonly used concordance index (C-index) metric for evaluating survival prediction accuracy in this setting and demonstrate that our proposed paired recipient-based accuracy metric is more clinically relevant and better reflects real-world allocation settings.

</details>


### [148] [PLAN: Parallel Liquid-Inspired Approximation Network for Efficient Representation Learning in Flexible Job Shop Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03041)
*Dhivya Dharshini Kannan,Wei Zhang,Jieyi Bi,Yingpeng Du,Tianjun Wei,Jie Zhang,Zuming Liu,Anupam Trivedi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PLAN（Parallel Liquid-inspired Approximation Network），一种将液态神经网络（LNN）的连续动态状态演化重构为离散化、可并行化形式的轻量级表示学习框架，用于柔性作业车间调度（FJSP），在降低参数量和推理延迟的同时提升调度性能。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于泛机器学习/组合优化领域，核心任务是柔性作业车间调度（FJSP），与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测完全无关。但其"轻量化网络设计"思路——将连续动态系统离散化并行化以降低推理延迟和参数量的方法——对轻量化模型设计有一定方法学借鉴意义，因此评为2分（泛机器学习方法，弱相关）。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向相关性很弱，属于组合优化/调度领域。虽然其轻量化网络设计思路（LNN离散化并行化）有一定方法学参考价值，但缺乏视觉任务验证，且不涉及遥感场景，建议仅作为轻量化方法论泛读参考，优先级低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：柔性作业车间调度（Flexible Job Shop Scheduling, FJSP），属于组合优化/调度问题，非视觉任务。应用场景：工业调度、生产排程。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉任务）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: PLAN框架将液态神经网络（LNN）的连续液态状态动力学重构为离散化、可并行化的形式。结构上解耦了"状态演化"与"上下文聚合"：liquid-inspired updates负责主演化状态表示，轻量级上下文聚合模块提供互补的全局上下文。PLAN作为即插即用的backbone，可搭配紧凑随机模块处理随机FJSP，替代异构图Transformer处理多面动态FJSP。

Lightweight method: 核心轻量化思路：将LNN固有的顺序动态（sequential dynamics）瓶颈通过离散化+并行化（parallelizable formulation）消除，从而在保持参数效率的同时提升计算效率。通过结构解耦（状态演化与上下文聚合分离）实现轻量级设计。相比基线，仅使用22%-47%的参数。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明星上/边缘部署相关信息。仅报告了推理延迟降低（平均降低13.2%、31.7%、26.9%，最大降低69.2%）和参数量减少（仅用基线22%-47%的参数），但未报告FLOPs、显存、能耗、具体硬件平台（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT）等部署指标。且该任务为调度问题，不涉及视觉推理，与在轨部署场景无直接关联。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：确定性（deterministic）、随机（stochastic）、多面动态（multi-faceted dynamic）三类FJSP基准。评价指标：makespan（完工时间/调度时长）和推理延迟（inference latency）。

Experiments: 在确定性、随机、多面动态三类FJSP基准上，PLAN相比对应SOTA基线分别平均降低makespan 1.2%、1.4%、2.3%，其中某个基准设置下提升达10.2%。推理延迟平均降低13.2%、31.7%、26.9%，在最大规模实例上最大降低69.2%。参数量仅为基线的22%-47%。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于调度优化领域。2. 摘要未说明具体网络参数量数值、FLOPs、硬件平台、能耗等部署细节。3. 未涉及视觉特征提取、图像处理等与遥感目标检测相关的技术。4. 轻量化方法（LNN离散化并行化）是否可迁移到CNN/Transformer类视觉检测骨干网络尚不明确。

Ideas for my research: 1. "将连续动态系统离散化+并行化"的思路可借鉴：在遥感目标检测的轻量化设计中，若采用类RNN/状态空间模型（如Mamba、LNN）作为骨干，可考虑将其顺序动态重构为并行可计算形式以降低推理延迟，这对星上实时推理有参考价值。2. "结构解耦"思想（状态演化与上下文聚合分离）可用于设计轻量检测头或特征融合模块，减少冗余计算。3. 其"即插即用backbone"设计理念可借鉴到遥感检测框架中，便于替换不同骨干网络。4. 但需注意：该方法的验证场景是调度问题而非视觉任务，迁移到遥感目标检测需要重新验证。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches for flexible job shop scheduling (FJSP) heavily rely on attention-centric architectures to achieve state-of-the-art performance. However, these models suffer from excessive parameter counts and prohibitive inference latency as problem scales expand. While liquid neural networks (LNNs) offer a parameter-efficient alternative for modeling adaptive state evolution, their inherently sequential dynamics bottleneck computational efficiency. To resolve this trade-off, we propose PLAN (Parallel Liquid-inspired Approximation Network), a lightweight representation learning framework that reformulates continuous liquid-state dynamics into a discretized and parallelizable formulation. PLAN structurally decouples state evolution from context aggregation, where liquid-inspired updates handle the primary evolving state representation, and a lightweight context aggregation module provides complementary global context. Furthermore, PLAN acts as a versatile, plug-and-play backbone that generalizes to complex FJSP variants, pairing with a compact stochastic module for stochastic FJSP and replacing heavy heterogeneous graph transformers in multi-faceted dynamic FJSP. Extensive evaluations across deterministic, stochastic, and multi-faceted dynamic FJSP benchmarks show that PLAN reduces the average makespan by 1.2%, 1.4%, and 2.3%, respectively, compared with the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines, with the improvement reaching 10.2% in one benchmark setting. PLAN also reduces average inference latency by 13.2%, 31.7%, and 26.9%, respectively, with a maximum reduction of 69.2% on the largest instances, while using only 22$-$47% of the baseline parameters.

</details>


### [149] [Exploiting Separability in Multi-Scale Grey-Box Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03045)
*Joshua E. Hammond,Tyler A. Soderstrom,Brian A. Korgel,Michael Baldea*

Task and scene: 任务类型：灰盒优化问题求解（grey-box optimization）。应用场景：通用优化问题，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 双层优化框架：外层为Bayesian optimization（BO），使用Gaussian process（GP）作为surrogate model优化标量目标函数（仅关于黑盒变量）；内层通过global optimization求解白盒子问题。白盒约束通过内层优化器收敛到可行点时精确满足，无需penalty functions、chance constraints或moment approximations。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等）。论文关注的是优化算法效率（减少迭代次数和wall clock time），而非神经网络模型轻量化。

Datasets and metrics: 使用13个benchmark problems进行实验评估。评价指标为regret（累积regret）、迭代次数（iterations）和wall clock time。摘要未说明具体benchmark名称和详细实验设置。

Experiments: 在13个基准问题上，bilevel BO相比基线方法实现了更低的regret，且所需迭代次数和wall clock time更少。该优势对initialization set size、exploration parameters和inner-solver choice具有鲁棒性。摘要未说明具体对比的基线方法名称。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1）该方法仅适用于决策变量可自然划分为黑盒/白盒子集的特定问题结构，泛化性有限；2）内层全局优化的收敛性假设较强；3）未涉及任何深度学习或计算机视觉任务；4）未提供与遥感/目标检测相关的任何实验验证。

Ideas for my research: 与本人课题（遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化）基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接联系是：若未来需要做超参数自动搜索（如NAS搜索轻量网络结构），BO方法可能作为搜索策略参考，但本文聚焦于灰盒优化而非网络结构搜索，借鉴价值极低。

Abstract: We consider grey-box optimization problems where the decision variables naturally partition into black-box variables (as arguments to an expensive black-box function) and white-box variables, governed by a set of explicit, closed-form equations that also depend on the output of the black-box function. We exploit this separability through a bilevel reformulation: an outer Bayesian optimization (BO) to optimize the scalar objective as a function of black-box variables alone, while an inner problem solves the white-box subproblem via global optimization. The Gaussian process surrogate used in BO is therefore defined rather than and white-box constraints are satisfied exactly whenever the inner optimizer converges to a feasible point---without penalty functions, chance constraints, or moment approximations. On a suite of 13 benchmark problems, bilevel BO achieves lower regret, with fewer iterations and wall clock time. This advantage is robust to initialization set size, exploration parameters, and inner-solver choice.

</details>

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息，也未涉及星上/边缘部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 实验环境：classical control tasks、real-world vector-based environments、Atari benchmarks。评价指标：training stability（训练稳定性），与强DQN变体（strong DQN variants）对比。摘要未给出具体数据集名称和量化指标数值。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明SADQ在classical control tasks、real-world vector-based environments和Atari benchmarks上相比strong DQN variants一致地提升了训练稳定性。提供了理论分析证明SADQ在pointwise层面减少了bootstrap-induced overestimation。未给出具体对比数值和消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于强化学习算法研究。2. 摘要未说明引入dynamics model带来的额外计算开销，也未讨论在资源受限场景下的可行性。3. 摘要未说明该方法在视觉感知任务（如图像目标检测）上的适用性。4. 摘要未给出具体性能数值和部署指标。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：如果未来在轨遥感目标检测中引入强化学习（如自适应推理、动态网络裁剪、推理时资源调度等），SADQ中"用模型预测来正则化决策聚合"的思想或许可类比为"用轻量预测器来引导动态推理路径选择"，但这属于非常间接的类比，且论文本身未涉及任何视觉/遥感任务。总体而言，对本课题的直接可借鉴点很少。

Abstract: Deep Q-Networks (DQNs) learn value functions through bootstrapped temporal-difference updates, where future returns are approximated using a greedy maximization over next-state action values. While effective, this aggregation rule is inherently sensitive to estimation noise: when Q-values are uncertain, the maximization operator deterministically favors the largest estimate, regardless of its reliability, leading to amplified errors through bootstrapping. In this work, we propose the \textbf{S}uccessor Rollout \textbf{A}ggregation \textbf{D}eep \textbf{Q}-Network (SADQ), a simple modification to Q-learning that regularizes how the TD target is formed. SADQ uses one-step rollout predictions from a learned dynamics model to guide the comparison among candidate next-state actions, introducing additional structure into the aggregation step without altering the underlying learning framework. The resulting mixed Bellman update attenuates unreliable maxima while preserving the standard fixed point under diminishing model error. We provide theoretical analysis showing that SADQ reduces bootstrap-induced overestimation in a pointwise manner. Empirically, SADQ consistently improves training stability across classical control tasks, real-world vector-based environments, and Atari benchmarks when compared to strong DQN variants.

</details>


### [151] [SynEnergy: Anomaly Semantic-Guided Diffusion for Synthetic Energy Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03087)
*Lin Jiang,Dahai Yu,Ravikumar Gelli,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SynEnergy，一个两阶段扩散框架，用于保留异常事件的合成能源数据生成，通过异构图异常语义学习和异常语义引导扩散实现。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于能源消费数据的合成生成（synthetic energy data generation），属于时间序列生成/扩散模型领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为能源数据生成，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：合成能源数据生成（synthetic energy data generation）；应用场景：需求预测、需求响应规划、电网可靠性评估；传感器类型：不适用（能源消费数据）；目标类别：异常事件（极端天气、基础设施故障、行为变化）。

Model architecture: 两阶段扩散框架SynEnergy：(1) 第一阶段HG-ASL（Heterogeneous Graph-based Anomaly Semantic Learning），基于异构图建模城市区域间的空间和属性依赖，从稀疏残差结构中提取区域特定异常语义；(2) 第二阶段AS-Diff（Anomaly Semantic-guided Diffusion），将学习到的异常语义注入去噪过程，生成保留异常模式的消费序列。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 四个真实世界能源消费数据集；对比11个通用和能源特定生成基线；评价指标包括异常保留保真度（anomaly preservation fidelity，平均提升12.21%）、下游质量（downstream quality，提升2.96%）以及整体生成保真度（overall generation fidelity）。

Experiments: 在四个真实能源数据集上对比11个基线方法，SynEnergy在异常保留保真度上平均提升12.21%，下游质量提升2.96%，同时保持与基线相当的总体生成保真度。

Limitations: 摘要未说明具体局限性。与本研究方向的缺口：完全不涉及遥感影像、目标检测、模型轻量化或边缘/星上部署，属于能源领域时间序列生成任务，方法论（扩散模型+异构图）与遥感目标检测轻量化无直接关联。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。可能的间接启发：(1) 扩散模型在异常/小目标语义保持上的思路，若未来涉及遥感数据增强或异常场景合成可参考；(2) 异构图建模空间依赖的思想，与遥感场景中地理空间关系建模有一定概念相通性，但与本课题（在轨目标检测轻量化）关联较弱。

Abstract: Fine-grained energy consumption data are essential for applications such as demand forecasting, demand response planning, and grid reliability assessment. However, access to such data is often restricted by privacy concerns and data-sharing constraints, motivating growing interest in synthetic energy data generation. Although existing methods can reproduce overall consumption distributions and recurring temporal patterns, they often smooth out or underrepresent anomalous events caused by extreme weather, infrastructure failures, and behavioral shifts. Preserving these events is challenging because they are sparse, localized in time and space, and shaped by heterogeneous dependencies across geographical proximity and regional attributes. To address these challenges, we propose SynEnergy, a two-stage diffusion-based framework for anomaly-preserving energy consumption data generation. The first stage, Heterogeneous Graph-based Anomaly Semantic Learning (HG-ASL), extracts region-specific anomaly semantics from sparse residual structures by jointly modeling spatial and attribute dependencies across urban regions. The second stage, Anomaly Semantic-guided Diffusion (AS-Diff), injects the learned anomaly semantics into the denoising process to generate realistic consumption sequences while preserving anomalous patterns. This design enables controllable generation for individual regions and scales naturally to city-wide settings. We evaluate SynEnergy on four real-world energy consumption datasets against 11 general-purpose and energy-specific generation baselines. Experimental results show that SynEnergy improves anomaly preservation fidelity by an average of 12.21% and downstream quality by 2.96%, while maintaining competitive overall generation fidelity compared to baselines.

</details>


### [152] [SMOPD: Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning via Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03092)
*Wen Wang,Jiahua Bao,Tu Yongsiqi,Yihao Liu,Haotian Zhou,Haoxuan Ma,Mengyu Zhou,Wenkui Fan,Junwei He,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SMOPD（Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation），一种两阶段多奖励强化学习训练方法，通过先训练奖励专用教师再在线策略蒸馏合并到单一学生策略，解决GDPO在稠密+稀疏奖励粒度不平衡时优化信号不足的问题。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛机器学习/强化学习领域，聚焦多奖励强化学习训练中的奖励信号平衡问题，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。唯一可借鉴点是其中使用了online policy distillation（在线策略蒸馏）技术，这与轻量化中的knowledge distillation有一定方法学上的交集，但应用场景完全不同（这里是LLM策略蒸馏而非视觉模型压缩）。

Reading priority: 2分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM强化学习对齐领域。仅"Specialize-and-Merge"两阶段蒸馏思想对多教师蒸馏设计有间接启发，但整体借鉴价值有限，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多奖励强化学习（multi-reward reinforcement learning）训练优化。应用场景：大语言模型（LLM）对齐训练，具体包括tool-calling（工具调用）和helpful/harmless（有益/无害）对齐。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明遥感、卫星、目标检测相关场景。

Model architecture: 两阶段框架SMOPD：Stage1-Specialize阶段训练多个reward-specialized teachers（奖励专用教师模型），每个教师针对单一奖励信号进行优化；Stage2-Merge阶段通过online policy distillation（在线策略蒸馏）将多个教师的能力合并到单一student policy（学生策略）。基座模型为1.5B、3B、7B规模的LLM backbone。

Lightweight method: 涉及online policy distillation（在线策略蒸馏），属于知识蒸馏范畴，但此处蒸馏目的是"合并多奖励能力"而非"模型压缩/轻量化"。摘要未说明任何剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、NAS、FLOPs、参数量压缩等轻量化手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、实时推理、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。虽然蒸馏后的单一student policy在推理时比多个教师更高效（只需部署一个模型），但论文未从部署角度量化这一优势。

Datasets and metrics: 实验设置：两个多奖励场景——complementary rewards（互补奖励：tool-calling准确率和格式）与conflicting rewards（冲突奖励：helpful和harmless）。基座规模：1.5B、3B、7B。对比方法：GDPO（Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization）。评价指标：摘要未明确列出具体指标名称，仅说明SMOPD在三个backbone规模上均优于GDPO。

Experiments: 主要结果：SMOPD在1.5B、3B、7B三个backbone上均优于GDPO。摘要未提供具体数值、消融实验细节或更多对比方法。

Limitations: 1. 摘要未说明方法在视觉/遥感任务上的适用性；2. 未提供计算开销、训练成本等效率指标；3. 未说明蒸馏过程中的性能损失或收敛稳定性；4. 实验仅覆盖LLM对齐场景，泛化性未知；5. 摘要未说明与遥感目标检测的任何关联。

Ideas for my research: 1. 方法学借鉴：SMOPD的"Specialize-and-Merge"两阶段思想可类比到遥感目标检测的轻量化蒸馏中——先训练多个针对不同目标类别（舰船/飞机/车辆）或不同传感器（光学/SAR）的专用教师，再通过在线蒸馏合并为单一轻量学生模型，可能比单一教师蒸馏效果更好；2. 奖励粒度平衡问题与遥感检测中多任务损失平衡（如分类损失与回归损失、大目标与小目标损失权重）有相似性，可借鉴其"reward-priority配置"思想来设计多任务损失权重调度策略；3. 在线策略蒸馏（online policy distillation）在遥感检测蒸馏中可作为teacher-student同步训练的参考方案。

Abstract: We aim to improve model performance in multi-reward reinforcement learning training process. Existing Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO) has mitigated the issue of reward signals masking one another during direct scalarization by normalizing each reward dimension separately before aggregation. However, our experiments show that GDPO still struggles to balance reward signals with different granularities. Specifically, in some particular training tasks, the model may receive a dense reward that assigns fine-grained scores ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, together with a sparse reward that provides only binary feedback of either 0 or 1. In such cases, we find that the sparse reward may provide an insufficient optimization signal, preventing its corresponding capability from being effectively reinforced. Therefore, how can we strengthen the optimization signal from the sparse reward without sacrificing the capability already learned from the fine-grained reward? To overcome this limitation, we propose Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation (SMOPD), a two-stage training method for multi-reward optimization. Stage1-Specialize: SMOPD first employs reward-priority configurations to train multiple reward-specialized teachers, allowing each reward to be learned under conditions where its signal can effectively drive optimization. Stage2-Merge: SMOPD then utilizes online policy distillation to combine the reward-specialized capabilities of these teachers into a single student policy, while maintaining balanced task-level optimization. To validate our method, we conduct experiments on two multi-reward settings: complementary rewards(tool-calling accuracy and format) and conflicting rewards (helpful and harmless rewards). Based on above settings, SMOPD outperforms GDPO across 1.5B, 3B and 7B backbones.

</details>


### [153] [Convex-Hull-Neighborhood Smooth Dual Generalization: Controlling Local Correction Propagation in Offline RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03108)
*Yi Yang,Zhennan Chen,Mingfeng Lv,Hanlei Li,Zhengsen Ruan,Lvqing Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种离线强化学习算法CSDG，通过凸包邻域平滑双泛化机制显式分离并控制OOD动作对Bellman备份的贡献。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文属于离线强化学习（offline RL）领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩/轻量化任何一方面。属于泛机器学习方法，与本课题弱相关（1分）。
