<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：离线强化学习（offline reinforcement learning）；应用场景：Gym-MuJoCo和AntMaze等标准RL基准环境；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体网络结构。算法层面提出Convex Hull Neighborhood Smooth Dual Generalization (CSDG)，将Bellman backup表达为in-sample value target加上CHN-local correction，通过在不同扰动半径下采样in-sample-oriented和OOD-oriented候选进行平滑，并用mixture coefficient lambda控制贡献。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计或边缘/星上部署等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未讨论参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息，且其面向的是RL训练算法而非推理模型部署。

Datasets and metrics: 实验数据集：Gym-MuJoCo和AntMaze基准环境；评价指标：摘要仅提及"strong aggregate performance and stable value estimation"，具体指标（如return、成功率等）未说明。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明在Gym-MuJoCo和AntMaze上取得较强综合性能和稳定的价值估计，未给出具体数值对比或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但作为RL方法，其与遥感目标检测/轻量化方向无直接关联，且未涉及任何部署相关考量。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：其"显式分离in-sample与OOD贡献"的思想在概念上类似于知识蒸馏中"教师-学生"分离监督信号的做法，但关联非常间接。不建议作为本课题的核心参考。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (offline RL) can benefit from nearby out-of-distribution (OOD) actions, but estimation errors at these actions may be amplified by bootstrapping. Existing regularization and local-generalization methods control either the admissible OOD region or the influence of generalized targets, often through separate mechanisms. We propose Convex Hull Neighborhood Smooth Dual Generalization (CSDG), which expresses the Bellman backup as an in-sample value target plus a CHN-local correction. This formulation makes the generalized contribution explicit and separates it from the in-sample reference path. The correction is obtained by smoothing in-sample-oriented and OOD-oriented candidates sampled at different perturbation radii. A mixture coefficient lambda scales its contribution to each backup, while the recursive discount remains gamma. Under boundedness and fixed perturbation kernels, we derive an exact one-step correction identity, a time-varying iterate bound, and a fixed-point bound that depends only on the branch discrepancy at the fixed point. We further characterize the implicit policies induced by the idealized operators and give a conditional non-degradation criterion. The practical algorithm approximates these quantities using asymmetric bounded noise and expectile regression, without exact support classification or an additional pessimistic OOD penalty. Experiments on Gym-MuJoCo and AntMaze show strong aggregate performance and stable value estimation. Code is available at: https://github.com/YOUNG-fnxm/CSDG

</details>


### [154] [Double Descent in Gradient Boosting Decision Trees via Split-Candidate Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03111)
*Ryuichi Kanoh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将"分裂候选数"（split candidates）作为梯度提升决策树（GBDT）的容量参数，通过实证树核诊断分析双下降（double descent）现象，并验证了XGBoost、LightGBM和CatBoost在中间分裂候选预算下出现测试误差峰值。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。本文是纯机器学习理论/方法研究，聚焦GBDT的容量参数与double descent现象，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。属于泛机器学习方法，对遥感在轨目标检测的借鉴意义非常有限。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于纯机器学习理论论文，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：GBDT容量分析与double descent理论研究。应用场景：通用机器学习理论分析，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 研究对象为梯度提升决策树（GBDT），具体涵盖XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost三种主流实现，以及随机森林（random forest）作为对照。核心概念是"分裂候选数"（split-candidate budget）作为容量参数，以及用于诊断的实证树核（empirical tree-kernel）方法。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。虽然"分裂候选数"可视为一种控制模型复杂度的超参数，但并非面向部署的轻量化手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。GBDT本身在星上部署场景中并非主流选择（遥感在轨目标检测主要依赖CNN/Transformer等深度学习模型）。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。实验在XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost上进行，以随机森林作为对照。评价指标为测试误差（test error），并观察double descent曲线中的误差峰值。

Experiments: 实验验证了三个理论预测：(1) 更深的树在更少分裂候选数下达到峰值区间；(2) 更大的训练集需要更细的量化网格；(3) 标签噪声使峰值更明显。结果显示XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost在中间分裂候选预算下出现测试误差峰值，而随机森林在同一扫描下单调改善。

Limitations: 与本研究方向基本无关。局限包括：仅针对GBDT类模型，不涉及深度学习目标检测网络；无遥感数据实验；无部署相关指标；理论分析框架（double descent）对CNN目标检测模型的轻量化设计参考价值有限。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但可提取两点方法论启示：(1) double descent现象提示在模型容量（如网络宽度、深度）与泛化性能之间存在非单调关系，这提醒我们在轻量化遥感目标检测模型时，不能盲目追求最小容量，需在容量-精度-速度之间寻找平衡点；(2) 文中"容量参数扫描+误差曲线诊断"的分析范式，可类比用于评估轻量化剪枝/量化比例对遥感目标检测精度的影响曲线。

Abstract: Double descent is commonly studied by scaling an explicit capacity parameter, such as neural-network width. For gradient boosting decision trees (GBDTs), however, an analogous single-axis capacity parameter has not been established. We propose the number of split candidates as an operational capacity parameter for GBDTs. Holding other training controls fixed, increasing the split-candidate budget refines the feature-quantization grid and expands the dictionary of root-to-leaf paths from which boosting selects its updates. To analyze this expansion, we construct an empirical tree-kernel diagnostic that summarizes how candidate-induced paths group the training examples. A regime in which the empirical kernel rank grows toward the sample size and very small positive eigenvalues emerge exposes noise-sensitive directions; in this regime, test error peaks before decreasing again at larger split-candidate budgets. This perspective predicts that deeper trees should reach the regime with fewer split candidates, larger training sets should require finer grids, and label noise should make the peak more pronounced. Experiments support these predictions and show test-error peaks at intermediate split-candidate budgets across XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost, whereas a random-forest control improves monotonically under the same split-candidate sweep. Taken together, our analysis and experiments support split-candidate scaling as a single-axis capacity intervention for studying GBDTs and suggest that the observed double descent arises from an interaction between candidate-induced geometry and boosting dynamics.

</details>


### [155] [Simulation-free and finite-time diffusion model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03117)
*Kentaro Kaba,Masayuki Ohzeki,Yuki Sughiyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种设计扩散模型参考扩散过程的通用框架，同时实现免模拟训练与有限时间生成，并揭示score matching和conditional flow matching在该框架下的理论关系。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。该论文是纯生成式扩散模型的理论方法论文，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测等目标检测任务，更不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等轻量化或星上部署方法。它属于泛机器学习/生成模型理论方向，与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"课题基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文为生成式扩散模型的理论方法研究，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。除非后续课题涉及扩散模型用于遥感数据生成/增强，否则可忽略。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：生成式扩散模型（generative diffusion models）的理论设计。应用场景：通用生成建模，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 提出一个设计reference diffusion process的通用框架：先指定可处理的时变条件分布（tractable time-dependent conditional distributions），再构造以这些分布为边缘分布的reference process。框架揭示了score matching并非扩散模型训练的本质，而是通过reference process的reversal自然涌现的；conditional flow matching是该框架的小噪声极限（small-noise limit）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络等均未提及）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息，也未涉及星上/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。论文未提及任何数据集或评价指标，属于纯理论推导性质的工作。

Experiments: 摘要未说明。论文未提及实验设置、对比方法或消融实验，核心贡献为理论框架的构建与推导。

Limitations: 摘要未说明。但可推断：该工作为纯理论贡献，缺乏实验验证；且其面向通用生成建模，与遥感目标检测及轻量化部署无直接关联。摘要中未说明该框架在计算效率、采样速度、生成质量上的实际收益。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。可能的间接启发包括：(1) 若未来研究方向涉及基于扩散模型的遥感图像生成/数据增强（如SAR图像仿真、遥感场景合成），该框架关于reference process设计的理论思路可用于改进生成效率；(2) 论文中"同时实现免模拟训练与有限时间生成"的目标，在思路上与在轨推理对实时性的追求有类比性，但技术路径完全不同。总体而言，与本课题（遥感在轨目标检测+轻量化）的直接可借鉴点很少。

Abstract: The performance of generative diffusion models is determined by the choice of the reference diffusion process connecting the empirical and prior distributions. Conventional approaches typically trade off simulation-free training against finite-time generation. We propose a framework for designing the reference process that achieves both simultaneously. The key idea is to prescribe tractable time-dependent conditional distributions and then construct the reference process realizing them as its marginals. This framework reveals that score matching is not fundamental to diffusion-model training but instead emerges naturally through reversal of the reference process. We further show that conditional flow matching arises as the small-noise limit of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [156] [Trajectory-Guided Forget-Recover Network for Continual LLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03123)
*Zezheng Wu,Xinghe Cheng,Qinggang Zhang,Haoran Luo,Jiapu Wang,Qing Yang,Jingwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轨迹引导的遗忘-恢复网络（TFR-Net），通过通道级风险追踪和休眠通道再激活，解决连续机器遗忘请求中知识重现与模型容量下降的问题。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛机器学习领域的 machine unlearning（机器遗忘）研究，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。虽然涉及通道级（channel-level）操作和模型容量管理，但目标不是模型压缩或加速，而是数据遗忘与保留效用的权衡，与在轨遥感目标检测轻量化方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。论文聚焦 machine unlearning，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，仅在通道级操作思想上有一点点间接借鉴，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：machine unlearning（机器遗忘），即在连续遗忘请求下消除敏感数据对模型的影响。应用场景为通用机器学习/隐私合规场景，非遥感或卫星场景。传感器类型、目标类别均不适用，摘要未说明。

Model architecture: TFR-Net（Trajectory-guided Forget-Recover Network）：通过通道级风险追踪（channel-level risk tracking）区分持久目标相关通道（persistent target-related channels）与瞬时热点（transient hotspots），仅抑制持久通道；同时通过再激活休眠通道（reactivating dormant channels）恢复模型容量。恢复仅在保留效用退化在预设容差内时才被接受。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等传统轻量化方法。虽然涉及通道级操作和模型容量管理，但目的是遗忘而非压缩/加速，与轻量化部署无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息，且论文场景与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 在四个数据集上进行实验（摘要未说明具体数据集名称）。评价指标为 unlearning effectiveness（遗忘有效性）与 retained utility（保留效用）之间的权衡（trade-off），与目标检测的 mAP、速度等指标无关。

Experiments: 在四个数据集上与代表性基线方法（representative baselines）对比，TFR-Net 在遗忘有效性与保留效用之间取得更优的权衡。摘要未说明具体基线名称和详细数值。

Limitations: 摘要未说明具体局限性。主要缺口包括：未给出数据集名称、基线方法、具体实验数值；未讨论计算开销；未涉及遥感/目标检测场景；未说明通道级操作对模型推理效率的影响。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值有限，但有两个概念可参考：(1) 通道级（channel-level）重要性/风险评估的思路，与结构化剪枝中通道重要性判定的思想有相通之处，可迁移到遥感目标检测模型的通道剪枝策略设计中；(2) 动态通道激活/抑制的机制，与动态推理（dynamic inference）或条件计算（conditional computation）有相似性，可启发在轨场景下根据输入复杂度动态调整计算量的思路。但整体上该论文与课题方向关联较弱。

Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to eliminate the influence of sensitive data on a model. In the real world, unlearning requests arrive continually, which gives rise to two challenges. First, an unlearning intervention may redistribute target-related computation across remaining pathways, allowing previously forgotten knowledge to re-emerge. Second, repeated unlearning interventions may progressively reduce the model capacity needed to preserve retained utility. To address these challenges, we propose the Trajectory-guided Forget-Recover Network (TFR-Net). TFR-Net tracks channel-level risk across requests. It separates persistent target-related channels from transient hotspots and suppresses only the persistent ones. TFR-Net also recovers model capacity by reactivating dormant channels. These channels make strong contributions to retained utility and show low current and historical forget risk. The recovery is accepted only when retained-utility degradation remains within a predefined tolerance. Experiments on four datasets show that TFR-Net consistently achieves a more favorable trade-off between unlearning effectiveness and retained utility than representative baselines.

</details>


### [157] [Lightweight Chunk Selection for Mobile Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03148)
*Sicong Chang,Yidan Shen,Wen Yu,Jiefu Chen,Xin Fu,Renjie Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种面向移动/边缘设备RAG（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）的轻量级证据块选择器，通过融合LLM查询隐状态、MoE路由专家信号和检索块嵌入，用紧凑MLP映射到证据原型空间，以余弦相似度选出最支持答案的检索块，在移动端预算下提升rank-1证据选择准确率约2.5%。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于泛NLP/泛机器学习方向，聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的检索增强生成（RAG）在移动端/边缘设备的轻量化部署，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测完全无关。虽然涉及"轻量化"和"边缘部署"概念，但对象是RAG chunk selection而非遥感目标检测模型，且不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏等传统模型压缩技术，仅通过特征融合与紧凑MLP实现参数效率优化。对遥感在轨目标检测轻量化课题的借鉴价值有限。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于NLP/RAG领域。虽然涉及移动端轻量化部署概念，但技术对象、任务类型、评价体系均与遥感目标检测差异巨大，借鉴价值有限。仅当对"多源特征融合+紧凑映射"的通用轻量设计范式感兴趣时可作泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：RAG（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）中的证据块选择（chunk selection），属于NLP信息检索与生成任务。应用场景：移动端/边缘设备上的LLM部署。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 选择器（selector）由三部分特征来源组成：(1) question hidden states（LLM侧查询意图表示）；(2) MoE routing-derived expert signals（生成器内部路由结构）；(3) retrieved chunk embeddings（候选侧证据几何）。一个紧凑MLP（multilayer perceptron）将这些特征映射到chunk embedding空间中的evidence prototype，通过cosine similarity选择与原型最对齐的候选块。可选的任务感知特征选择策略（task-aware feature selection）用于进一步降低输入维度以适应更严格的部署预算。

Lightweight method: 轻量化手段为：(1) 仅保留一个检索块（retain only one retrieved chunk）以减少计算和内存；(2) 使用紧凑MLP作为选择器，避免引入额外的LLM或压缩器（compressor）；(3) 可选的任务感知特征选择策略（task-aware feature selection）降低selector输入维度。未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）或NAS等传统模型压缩技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存或能耗数据。仅定性说明该方法在"strict mobile budget"下可行，通过避免额外LLM/压缩器来降低计算成本，并通过特征选择进一步适配更严格的部署预算。未涉及星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等硬件加速细节。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标为rank-1 evidence selection准确率，实验显示相比mobile-applicable baselines平均提升2.5%。构建了基于evidence sufficiency（证据充分性）而非answer-string containment的语义chunk-correctness标签用于监督评估。

Experiments: 摘要仅报告了主要结果：所提出的选择器在rank-1 evidence selection上比移动端适用的基线方法平均提升2.5%。未提供详细的对比方法列表、消融实验或不同部署预算下的性能曲线。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于NLP领域；(2) 摘要未提供任何量化部署指标（参数量、FLOPs、延迟等），无法评估其实际轻量化程度；(3) 仅关注RAG chunk selection这一子任务，未涉及目标检测模型压缩；(4) 提升幅度有限（2.5%），且未说明在不同检索质量下的鲁棒性；(5) 依赖MoE路由信号，限制了其仅适用于MoE架构的LLM。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与遥感目标检测轻量化弱相关，但有以下可借鉴思路：(1) "特征融合+紧凑映射器"的轻量设计范式——将多源异构特征（类似遥感中的多光谱/多传感器特征）通过紧凑MLP融合并映射到统一嵌入空间，可类比用于遥感多模态特征融合的轻量检测头设计；(2) "证据充分性"标签构建思想——在遥感目标检测中可类比为"检测置信度与定位质量解耦"的标签设计；(3) 任务感知特征选择（task-aware feature selection）思路可迁移到遥感检测中，用于在资源受限时动态裁剪冗余特征通道；(4) 避免引入额外重模型、仅用轻量模块实现性能提升的设计哲学，与星上部署的算力约束理念一致。

Abstract: RAG improves the factual grounding of LLM by incorporating external knowledge, but deploying RAG on mobile and edge devices remains challenging because retrieved context increases computation and memory. A direct way to reduce this cost is to retain only one retrieved chunk before generation, but the top-ranked retrieved chunk is not always the most evidence-supporting one, since retrieval similarity does not necessarily imply evidential sufficiency. Existing context-reduction methods can improve context quality, but often require additional LLMs or compressors that are costly under a strict mobile budget. In this paper, we study lightweight RAG chunk selection as an evidence-alignment problem. Our selector combines three complementary feature sources: question hidden states that represent LLM-side query intent, MoE routing-derived expert signals that capture the generator's internal routing structure, and retrieved chunk embeddings that preserve candidate-side evidence geometry. A compact multilayer perceptron maps these features to an evidence prototype in the chunk embedding space, and the candidate most aligned with this prototype is selected by cosine similarity. For stricter deployment budgets, we further introduce an optional task-aware feature selection strategy to reduce the selector input dimension. To support supervised evaluation, we construct semantic chunk-correctness labels based on evidence sufficiency rather than answer-string containment. Experiments show that the proposed selector consistently improves rank-1 evidence selection over mobile-applicable baselines by an average of 2.5%. These results suggest that using LLM-side query representations and MoE routing information and aligning them with retrieval-side candidate embedding is an effective and parameter-efficient strategy for mobile-applicable RAG chunk selection.

</details>


### [158] [On the Implicit Flatness Bias of Sharpness-Aware Minimization: A Linear Stability Analysis with Quantitative Hyperparameter Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03197)
*Jiaxin Deng,Junbiao Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从线性稳定性角度理论分析了Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM)的隐式平坦偏好机制，推导出最大Hessian特征值的定量上界，并提出TLC-SAM方法根据Taylor近似误差自适应调整扰动半径ρ。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。本文是泛机器学习/优化理论方向的研究，聚焦SAM优化器的平坦极小值机制分析，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。虽然SAM作为一种优化器可应用于任何深度学习任务（包括遥感目标检测），但本文不涉及遥感场景、目标检测任务或任何模型压缩/加速方法，属于泛视觉/泛机器学习方法。

Reading priority: 1分。本文是优化器理论分析论文，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测和模型轻量化方向基本无关。仅当需要优化训练策略（如引入SAM提升泛化）时可作为背景参考，但优先级很低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：优化器理论分析（SAM优化器的平坦极小值机制）。应用场景：通用图像分类（CIFAR-100）。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：CIFAR-100的100类通用物体，非遥感目标。摘要未说明遥感相关场景。

Model architecture: 使用ResNet-18和VGG-19作为验证实验的骨干网络。核心研究对象是SAM优化器本身，而非检测模型架构。提出TLC-SAM (Taylor-Locality Controlled SAM)变体，通过观测Taylor近似误差来动态调整扰动半径ρ。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等经典轻量化方法。本文的轻量化关联仅在于：SAM优化器通过寻找平坦极小值可能改善模型泛化，从而在相同精度下可能允许更小的模型，但这并非本文直接研究内容。摘要未说明任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。理论分析聚焦于优化收敛性质，与部署硬件无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：CIFAR-100（900个模型的受控实验）。骨干网络：ResNet-18和VGG-19。评价指标：最大Hessian特征值λ_max（用于衡量平坦性）、泛化性能。摘要未说明准确率等具体数值。

Experiments: 在CIFAR-100上对900个模型进行受控实验，验证了理论预测：在固定其他量时，增大ρ与更小的最大Hessian特征值一致相关（跨batch size和学习率设置）。TLC-SAM相比固定半径SAM进一步降低了top Hessian特征值。摘要未提供与SOTA方法的定量对比。

Limitations: 1. 理论分析基于局部线性化和梯度噪声对齐假设，实际训练中这些假设可能不完全成立。2. 仅在CIFAR-100图像分类上验证，未在遥感、目标检测等更复杂任务上测试。3. 摘要未说明TLC-SAM在最终测试精度上的提升幅度，仅报告了Hessian特征值的降低。4. 与遥感在轨目标检测、轻量化部署完全无关。

Ideas for my research: 1. 尽管本文与遥感轻量化无直接关系，但SAM优化器可作为一种"免费"的泛化增强手段，在遥感小样本目标检测训练中引入SAM或TLC-SAM，可能提升小目标检测的泛化能力，尤其在训练数据有限的遥感场景下。2. 平坦极小值（flat minima）与模型压缩存在潜在联系：平坦的损失景观可能使剪枝/量化后的模型精度损失更小，可探索"先SAM训练、后压缩"的流程。3. 本文的稳定性-局部性权衡视角可迁移到知识蒸馏中teacher-student的优化稳定性分析。4. 但整体借鉴价值有限，建议仅作为训练技巧的补充参考。

Abstract: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) improves generalization by seeking parameters whose loss is robust to local adversarial perturbations, but the quantitative mechanism underlying its implicit bias toward flat minima remains unclear. In particular, the perturbation radius $ρ$ is typically treated as an isolated tuning parameter, despite defining the neighborhood in which SAM measures sharpness. We analyze mini-batch SAM near an interpolating minimum through linear stability. Under local linearization and gradient-noise alignment assumptions, we prove that every linearly stable minimum satisfies $λ_{\max}\leq\sqrt[3]{bΓ/(2ρη^2)}$, where $λ_{\max}$ is the largest Hessian eigenvalue, $b$ is the batch size, $η$ is the learning rate, and $Γ$ bounds the gradient norm. The bound quantitatively characterizes SAM's implicit flatness bias: holding the other quantities fixed, a smaller batch size, a larger learning rate, or a larger radius restricts linearly stable SAM to flatter minima. It also exposes a necessary trade-off: $ρ$ should be large enough to promote flatness, yet remain local enough to preserve the approximation and stable training. We validate this prediction in a controlled study of 900 models on CIFAR-100 with ResNet-18 and VGG-19, where increasing $ρ$ is consistently associated with a smaller largest Hessian eigenvalue across batch-size and learning-rate settings. Finally, we instantiate the analysis in Taylor-Locality Controlled SAM (TLC-SAM), which adjusts $ρ$ using the observed Taylor-approximation error and further reduces the top Hessian eigenvalue relative to fixed-radius SAM. Our results provide quantitative hyperparameter bounds and a stability--locality perspective for analyzing and designing SAM variants.

</details>


### [159] [Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03223)
*Ranxu Zhang,Guinan Chen,Chenshaodong,Jinghao Lin,Xiaozhou Xu,Sunzhe,Yanyong Zhang,Chao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ADRS框架，通过自蒸馏奖励塑形为多轮语言智能体构建与回报关联的token级信用分配，提升长程交互任务的强化学习性能。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。该论文聚焦于LLM智能体的强化学习奖励塑形（reward shaping）与信用分配（credit assignment），属于自然语言处理/强化学习领域，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。唯一的间接联系在于其"自蒸馏"（self-distillation）思想与知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）有概念上的相似性，但应用场景和机制完全不同。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，属于LLM强化学习领域。除非对"自蒸馏+门控"的奖励塑形机制有跨领域兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多轮语言智能体的强化学习（multi-turn language agent RL）；应用场景：交互式基准测试（interactive benchmarks）；传感器类型：不适用（纯文本/语言交互）；目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明具体基准测试名称。

Model architecture: 基于LLM agent的强化学习框架，核心组件包括：1) 特权技能（privileged skills）作为教师信号；2) Teacher Value Advantage (TVA) gate，基于组内置信度-回报关联调制教师信号；3) 将门控token信号整合进原生RL信用构建路径。整体架构围绕"教师偏好-回报相关性-原生RL信用路径"三层设计展开。

Lightweight method: 摘要中提到的"self-distilled"（自蒸馏）并非传统意义上的模型压缩知识蒸馏，而是指利用同一冻结策略快照（frozen policy snapshot）对固定token进行重新评分以生成稠密监督信号。不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、NAS、轻量网络设计、边缘部署等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文完全不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。且其研究对象为LLM语言智能体，与在轨遥感目标检测的部署约束（如FPGA/NPU/TensorRT）无任何关联。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要提到在三个交互式基准测试（three interactive benchmarks）上进行实验，但未给出具体数据集名称。评价指标为长程任务（long-horizon tasks）上的性能提升，具体指标名称摘要未说明。实验还考察了跨RL骨干网络（RL backbones）、数据缩减（reduced-data）、未见任务（unseen tasks）和延长训练（extended training）等场景下的泛化性。

Experiments: 主要实验结论：ADRS在三个交互式基准上持续提升长程任务性能，增益在跨RL骨干、数据缩减、未见任务和延长训练等条件下均保持。摘要未提供与具体基线方法的数值对比、消融实验细节或可视化分析。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于NLP+RL领域；2) 摘要未说明具体基准数据集、指标数值、计算开销；3) 未讨论该方法在视觉或多模态场景下的适用性；4) 未涉及任何部署约束或效率考量；5) 摘要未说明方法在真实世界（非仿真交互环境）中的表现。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值有限，但有两个概念层面的启发：1) "self-distilled reward shaping"中利用冻结教师模型（frozen teacher）提供稠密监督的思想，在遥感目标检测的知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）中可类比为：用冻结的大模型教师为轻量学生模型提供逐像素/逐token的稠密soft label，而非仅稀疏的检测框级监督；2) "return-associated gating"（回报关联门控）思想可类比为：在蒸馏过程中根据样本难度或类别置信度动态调节蒸馏损失权重，避免教师噪声信号干扰学生训练。但这些仅是方法论层面的类比，需自行迁移到视觉检测蒸馏场景。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to learn through interaction, but sparse trajectory-level rewards reveal success without identifying which intermediate decisions deserve credit. Training-only privileged skills can provide denser supervision by allowing the same frozen policy snapshot to rescore fixed tokens from skill-free trajectories while conditioned on task-matched procedural skills. Existing methods, however, do not jointly calibrate teacher scores across interaction steps, relate teacher confidence to realized returns, and integrate the resulting signal into native reward-to-advantage construction. We introduce Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping (ADRS), a framework for constructing return-associated token-level credit for multi-turn language agents. ADRS centers and normalizes privileged token scores within each step, modulates them with a return-associated Teacher Value Advantage (TVA) gate based on within-group confidence--return association, and incorporates the gated token signal into native RL credit construction. Together, these components determine what the teacher prefers, when that preference is return-relevant, and how it enters the native reinforcement-learning credit path, while keeping rollouts and inference skill-free. Finally, experiments across three interactive benchmarks show that ADRS consistently improves performance on long-horizon tasks, with gains persisting across RL backbones, reduced-data settings, unseen tasks, and extended training. For anonymous review, our code is available at the following the link: https://github.com/gitrxh/ADRS-arxiv

</details>


### [160] [SAKI: Score-Aware Low-Rank Key Indexing for Long-Context KV Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03228)
*Lin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAKI，一种无需训练的KV cache压缩索引方法，通过协方差加权低秩目标直接保留注意力分数而非键重建质量，在多个LLM上优于key PCA。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）推理中的KV cache压缩与索引，属于泛机器学习/泛视觉方法范畴，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。虽然涉及低秩压缩（low rank compression）和推理效率优化，但应用场景是LLM的KV cache，而非遥感目标检测模型。其低秩分解思想可能对模型压缩有间接借鉴意义，但整体与本研究方向弱相关。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向弱相关，属于LLM KV cache压缩领域。虽然低秩分解和"直接优化任务相关目标而非重建质量"的思想有一定借鉴价值，但整体应用场景差异大，优先级较低。若后续研究涉及Transformer骨干的轻量化压缩，可选择性阅读其方法论部分。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM推理阶段的KV cache压缩与索引（KV cache compression and indexing）。应用场景：大语言模型长上下文推理加速。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: SAKI（Score-Aware KV cache Index），一种训练无关（training free）的KV cache索引方法。核心思想：从SVD（奇异值分解）推导协方差加权query-key算子的闭式非对称分解，直接优化注意力分数（attention score）的期望失真，而非键重建质量。涉及低秩分解、协方差加权目标、top-k召回优化。

Lightweight method: 低秩压缩（low rank compression）：对KV cache进行rank r的键压缩，通过协方差加权低秩目标最小化注意力分数失真。属于模型推理阶段的存储/计算压缩方法，与剪枝、量化、蒸馏等传统轻量化手段不同，但同属模型压缩与加速范畴。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及在LLaMA 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 7B、Mistral 7B v0.1、Llama 3.2 3B等LLM上的推理效率改进，但未给出具体速度或资源占用数据。

Datasets and metrics: 模型：LLaMA 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 7B、Mistral 7B v0.1、Llama 3.2 3B。指标：top-64 recall、注意力分数MSE（mean squared error）、Pearson相关系数（0.997）、每模型改进的注意力头比例（68%-89%）。数据集：摘要未说明具体评测数据集。

Experiments: 在rank 32时，SAKI相比key PCA移除了PCA剩余top-64召回误差的13%-30%。具体改进：LLaMA 3.1 8B上从0.748提升到0.799，Qwen 2.5 7B上从0.786提升到0.850。每模型68%-89%的注意力头获得改进，深层（deeper layers）改进最大。预测分数MSE与实际测量高度吻合（Pearson相关系数0.997）。消融实验确认增益来自优化注意力分数目标而非仅协方差加权。分析还解释了weight-only、invariant subspace、key reconstruction方法的次优性。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于LLM推理优化领域。2. 摘要未说明实际推理速度、内存节省、能耗等部署指标。3. 未涉及遥感图像特征（如小目标、旋转框、复杂背景）的适配。4. 方法针对KV cache，不直接适用于CNN或视觉Transformer的目标检测骨干网络。5. 未说明在视觉任务上的泛化能力。

Ideas for my research: 1. 低秩分解思想可迁移：SAKI的"直接优化注意力分数而非重建质量"的思想，可类比到遥感目标检测中轻量化Transformer的注意力模块压缩——与其追求特征重建保真度，不如直接优化检测损失相关的注意力分布。2. 协方差加权低秩目标可用于遥感检测骨干网络的通道/头剪枝，指导哪些注意力头或通道对检测性能更重要。3. 训练无关（training free）的压缩思路对星上部署有吸引力——在轨场景难以进行重训练，训练无关的压缩方法（如无需微调的剪枝/低秩分解）更实用。4. 闭式SVD分解的低秩方案计算开销低，适合边缘/星上算力受限环境。

Abstract: Existing low rank KV cache methods preserve either model weights or key variance, neither of which directly reflects the attention scores used during inference. We derive the expected attention score distortion caused by rank r key compression and show that it yields a covariance weighted low rank objective. Under a margin condition, controlling this distortion also improves top k recall. The optimal rank r solution has a closed form asymmetric factorization obtained from the SVD of the covariance weighted query key operator. This motivates SAKI, a training free KV cache index that directly preserves attention scores rather than key reconstruction quality.
  Across LLaMA 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Mistral 7B v0.1, and Llama 3.2 3B, SAKI outperforms key PCA at every tested rank. At rank 32, it removes 13 to 30 percent of PCA's remaining top 64 recall error, including improvements from 0.748 to 0.799 on LLaMA 3.1 8B and from 0.786 to 0.850 on Qwen 2.5 7B. It improves 68 to 89 percent of attention heads per model, with the largest gains in deeper layers. Predicted score MSE reductions closely match empirical measurements, with a Pearson correlation of 0.997, while ablation studies confirm that the gains arise from optimizing the attention score objective rather than covariance weighting alone. Analysis of the scoring operator further explains why weight only, invariant subspace, and key reconstruction methods can be suboptimal.

</details>


### [161] [FinVerse: Financial Time-Series Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03259)
*Jaehoon Lee,Jun Seo,Seunghan Lee,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Minjae Kim,Sungdong Yoo,Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Soonyoung Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FinVerse，一个面向金融领域的时间序列预测基准，包含 116,897 条金融时间序列和 78 个评估指标，强调领域感知的评估方式比统一误差指标更能反映真实决策价值。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦金融时间序列预测（time-series forecasting）的基准评估，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或任何模型压缩/加速方法。属于泛机器学习/时序建模领域，与本课题相关性极弱。

Reading priority: 1 分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于金融时间序列预测领域。除非对"领域感知评估"方法论感兴趣，否则无需优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：时间序列预测（time-series forecasting）基准构建与评估。应用场景：金融领域（股票价格涨跌预测等）。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。论文主要评估了 43 个公开的时间序列预测基础模型（time-series forecasting foundation models），但未给出这些模型的具体结构细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS 或任何模型压缩/轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：FinVerse，包含 116,897 条金融时间序列（171.1M 观测值），其中 60,232 条序列（17.4M 观测值）被选为评估目标。评估指标：定义 11 个指标族（metric families）共 78 个评估指标，根据每条时间序列的经济含义分配最合适的评估指标。对比分析：评估了 43 个公开时间序列预测基础模型。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：在通用预测标准下表现优异的模型，其预测能力并不一定能转化为有用的金融预测。这一发现强调了需要领域感知（domain-aware）的基准来评估模型在更接近真实决策目标下的表现。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：论文仅聚焦金融领域，未涉及遥感场景；评估的是预测任务而非检测任务；未讨论模型效率、部署或轻量化问题。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但有一个方法论层面的间接借鉴点：论文强调"统一误差指标不能反映真实决策价值"，这可以类比到遥感在轨目标检测中——在轨部署时，检测精度（如 mAP）并非唯一考量，还需考虑推理延迟、能耗、星上资源约束等"决策级"指标。可借鉴其"领域感知评估"思想，为在轨检测模型设计更贴近星上实际部署约束的评估体系（如精度-延迟-能耗联合评估）。

Abstract: As time-series foundation models have emerged, the need for benchmarks that can evaluate their forecasting ability in meaningful ways has become increasingly important. Existing time-series forecasting benchmarks provide useful standardized comparisons, but they often evaluate heterogeneous series with uniform error-based metrics. Strong performance under such metrics does not necessarily imply that a model's forecasts will support the best real-world decisions across domains. For example, in stock forecasting, correctly predicting whether a price will rise or fall can be more directly relevant to realized returns than minimizing point-wise forecast error alone. To this end, we introduce FinVerse, a finance-domain time-series forecasting benchmark that takes a first step toward more realistic evaluation. The released FinVerse data artifact contains 116,897 financial time series with 171.1M observations, of which 60,232 series with 17.4M observations are selected as evaluated targets based on their economic relevance to financial decisions. Unlike generic forecasting benchmarks that primarily emphasize uniform point-forecast or probabilistic accuracy, FinVerse defines 11 metric families comprising 78 evaluation metrics and assigns the most appropriate evaluation metrics to each individual time series based on its underlying economic meaning. Our analysis of 43 public time-series forecasting foundation models shows that strong performance under generic forecasting criteria does not necessarily translate into useful financial forecasts. This finding highlights the need for domain-aware benchmarks that evaluate models under objectives closer to real-world decision making.

</details>


### [162] [ED-DiT: Physics-Guided Diffusion Pretraining for Transferable Molecular Representations from Electron Density](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03260)
*Liang Shuang,Haocheng Wang,Jiayi Song,Shuquan Ye,Ben Fei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ED-DiT，一种基于物理引导的Diffusion Transformer，用于电子密度点云的自监督预训练，学习可迁移的分子表征，在多个电子结构相关任务上优于从头训练。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于分子电子密度（electron density）的机器学习预训练，属于计算化学/材料科学领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、地球观测、目标检测或模型轻量化。既无遥感图像处理，也无目标检测任务，更无任何模型压缩或部署相关内容。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于计算化学/分子机器学习领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：分子电子密度自监督预训练、属性预测、开/闭壳层分类、分子-电子密度检索、分子条件电子密度预测。应用场景：计算化学、材料科学、分子表征学习。传感器类型：不适用（输入为电子密度点云）。目标类别：分子/电子结构相关。

Model architecture: ED-DiT：基于Diffusion Transformer（DiT）架构，在电子密度点云上进行自监督预训练。通过在不同扩散噪声水平下重建被破坏和部分掩蔽的log-density场来学习可复用表征，并引入电子数一致性约束（electron-number consistency constraint）以保持总电子质量。预训练编码器可适配多种下游任务。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关信息，且该任务本身与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：EDBench（包含六个子任务）。评价指标：RMSE（均方根误差）。实验设置：包括全监督和仅10%标签的低监督场景。

Experiments: 在EDBench六个任务上，ED-DiT一致优于同架构从头训练（from scratch）。分子条件电子密度预测任务中，RMSE从2.2474降至1.3753，超过现有baseline；仅用10%标签时，轨道能量预测RMSE从0.0293降至0.0138。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1）该方法针对分子电子密度这一特定数据模态，泛化到其他领域（如遥感图像）的可行性未知；2）Diffusion Transformer通常计算开销较大，与轻量化/在轨部署方向相悖；3）未提供模型规模、推理效率等工程指标。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与遥感目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但可借鉴的间接思路包括：1）自监督预训练（self-supervised pretraining）在有限标注下提升下游任务性能的思想——遥感目标检测同样面临标注稀缺问题，可探索在遥感图像上做掩码重建/扩散式预训练；2）物理约束（physics-guided）与领域知识注入模型的思路，类比于在遥感检测中引入几何/物理先验（如目标尺寸、传感器成像模型）；3）低监督（limited supervision）场景下的表征学习策略对遥感小样本检测有参考价值。但这些均为方法论层面的间接启发，非直接相关。

Abstract: Pretraining has shown strong potential for learning transferable representations, yet it remains underexplored for electron-density-based molecular learning. Electron density provides a continuous three-dimensional description of molecular electronic structure, capturing both local spatial patterns and global physical quantities. This raises a key question: can electron-density fields be used for self-supervised pretraining to learn a shared representation that transfers across diverse electronic-structure-related tasks? We propose ED-DiT, a physics-guided Diffusion Transformer for self-supervised pretraining on electron-density point clouds. ED-DiT learns reusable representations by reconstructing corrupted and partially masked log-density fields across diffusion noise levels. An electron-number consistency constraint is further introduced to preserve the total electronic mass. The pretrained encoder can be adapted to property prediction, open-/closed-shell classification, molecule-electron-density retrieval, and molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction. Experiments on six EDBench tasks show that ED-DiT consistently outperforms the same architecture trained from scratch, especially under limited supervision. For molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction, it reduces RMSE from 2.2474 to 1.3753 and surpasses the available baseline. With only 10% labels, it improves orbital energy prediction RMSE from 0.0293 to 0.0138. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-guided electron-density pretraining for learning transferable molecular representations.

</details>


### [163] [The Ignition Is Real, and It Lives at the Readout: Latent composition, difficulty-clocked ignition, and the interface-constituted commit in a recurrent-depth reasoner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03263)
*Simon Lam-Muir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"组合点火"（compositional ignition）现象在latent-reasoning模型中的真实性，通过从零复现一个30M参数的recurrent-depth推理模型，验证该现象是真实计算还是训练数据或仪器伪影。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关；不涉及任何目标检测任务；不涉及任何模型轻量化方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等）。它属于认知科学/机器学习可解释性领域，研究latent-reasoning模型内部的"组合点火"现象是否真实存在，与本研究方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，属于latent-reasoning模型可解释性研究，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测或任何模型压缩/加速方法。除非对pre-registered实验设计方法论感兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：latent-reasoning模型内部机制的可解释性分析（验证"compositional ignition"现象真实性）。应用场景：非遥感、非视觉任务，属于语言/推理模型内部动力学研究。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 30M参数的recurrent-depth reasoner（循环深度推理模型），从零复现（same recipe and seed）。模型包含vocabulary readout和hidden state两个通道，使用decoder的LayerNorm坐标进行分析。涉及tied readout（绑定读出层）机制。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS, 轻量网络设计等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量优化、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。虽然模型规模为30M参数，但论文关注的是其内部推理机制而非部署效率。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。评价指标包括：decision margin（决策边际，5.8-8.0 logits）、hidden-state direction的angular steps（52.9到1.2度）、squared-norm的radial displacement（0.961）、radial logit effect（<=5.7e-6）、relay（0.00）。采用pre-registered whole-signature gate和pre-registered normalization controls作为验证方法。

Experiments: 主要实验：从零复现30M参数recurrent-depth reasoner（same recipe and seed），通过pre-registered gate验证"compositional ignition"现象。关键发现：ignition真实存在于readout通道；arrival time随problem depth规律上升；decision margin在单次迭代中跳升5.8-8.0 logits；hidden-state方向在raw geometry中snap但decoder-coordinate claim未确认；velocity-trough claim被撤回（coordinate-dependent）。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可迁移的技术方法。2. 摘要未说明数据集、训练数据来源、具体任务类型。3. 部分结论（decoder-coordinate claim、velocity-trough claim）未被确认或被撤回，说明结果对坐标选择敏感，稳健性存疑。4. 模型规模仅30M，与遥感在轨检测模型的视觉backbone架构差异巨大。

Ideas for my research: 可借鉴点非常有限，但有两个方法论层面的启发：1) pre-registered实验设计和"whole-signature gate"验证思路——在遥感模型轻量化研究中，可以预先注册评估协议（如特定数据集上的精度-速度权衡阈值），避免过拟合和选择性报告；2) 对模型内部状态（如hidden state）进行几何/动力学分析的方法，可用于理解轻量化（如剪枝、蒸馏）后模型内部表征的变化，但需要将分析对象从语言推理模型迁移到视觉检测模型，迁移难度大。

Abstract: We test whether the "compositional ignition" reported in latent-reasoning models is real computation, an instrument artifact, or inherited from verbal training data. We grow an independent realization of a published 30M-parameter recurrent-depth reasoner from scratch (same recipe and seed), film its development, certify fidelity through a pre-registered whole-signature gate, and measure resolution in two channels at once: the vocabulary readout and the hidden state. The ignition is real and lives at the readout: arrival time rises lawfully with problem depth, resolution is sharp and holds, and the signature reproduces across two same-seed realizations with divergent training trajectories. At commitment the decision margin jumps 5.8-8.0 logits in one iteration, exceeding the 90th percentile of near-threshold non-event steps in 96% of cases; the signed margin's zero-crossing there is definitional and carries no evidential weight, so the evidence is that conditioned magnitude. The hidden-state direction snaps in raw geometry, meeting its pre-registered criterion (in the decoder's LayerNorm coordinates it attenuates just below our bar, so the composite decoder-coordinate claim is not confirmed), and then freezes in both (descriptively so in decoder coordinates; angular steps 52.9 to 1.2 degrees over eight iterations), while subsequent displacement is predominantly radial (0.961 of squared-norm) and readout-null to a measured bound (radial logit effect <=5.7e-6). An earlier velocity-trough claim is withdrawn: pre-registered normalization controls showed it coordinate-dependent. Intermediates were never recoverable through the tied readout (relay 0.00). All criteria were frozen before their data; the predictions ledger, including this paper's own withdrawn headline, ships in the companion repository.

</details>


### [164] [Noise-Aware Shrinkage for Differentially Private Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03277)
*Lele Zheng,Weifeng Kong,Xinyi Zhang,Ke Cheng,Tao Zhang,Yulong Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAGE，一种噪声感知的自适应收缩方法，用于差分隐私零阶优化（DP-ZO）中根据信号质量自适应衰减私有化梯度估计，提升大语言模型隐私微调的效果。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的差分隐私（differential privacy）零阶优化（zeroth-order optimization）微调，属于自然语言处理与隐私保护机器学习领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩/轻量化部署。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于差分隐私+大语言模型微调领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：差分隐私下的大语言模型（LLM）高效微调（private fine-tuning）。场景：隐私保护机器学习，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 基于DP-ZO（differentially private zeroth-order optimization）框架，提出SAGE模块作为后处理（post-processing）组件，通过估计信号能量、时间跟踪稳定估计、与warm-up参考比较信噪比来推导有界收缩因子。模型主体为RoBERTa-large、OPT-1.3B、OPT-6.7B等大语言模型。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明传统意义上的模型轻量化方法（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS）。但DP-ZO本身具有memory-efficient特性（仅需前向评估，无需存储梯度），这与内存效率相关，但并非面向推理部署的轻量化。SAGE仅引入常数级额外状态，不增加隐私预算和模型查询次数。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明星上/边缘部署相关信息。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署指标。论文关注的是训练阶段的memory efficiency（内存效率），而非推理阶段的部署效率。

Datasets and metrics: 实验模型：RoBERTa-large、OPT-1.3B、OPT-6.7B。评价指标：在相同隐私预算（privacy budgets）下的模型效用（utility）对比。摘要未说明具体数据集名称。

Experiments: 在RoBERTa-large、OPT-1.3B、OPT-6.7B上验证SAGE在大多数设置下优于现有baseline，同时保持DP-ZO的前向-only内存效率。理论分析表明收缩能比线性下降项更快地降低二次更新风险项。

Limitations: 与遥感目标检测和轻量化方向完全无关。摘要未涉及任何遥感数据、目标检测任务、模型压缩或边缘/星上部署内容。此外，摘要未说明具体数据集、隐私预算的具体数值、以及SAGE在不同任务上的泛化表现。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。但有两个间接可参考的点：(1) SAGE中"根据信号质量自适应调整更新权重"的思想，可类比迁移到知识蒸馏或剪枝中根据层/通道重要性自适应调整压缩强度；(2) DP-ZO的memory-efficient前向-only优化思路，在星上资源受限场景下训练/微调轻量检测模型时可能有参考价值，但需大幅改造。

Abstract: Differentially private zeroth-order optimization (DP-ZO) enables memory-efficient private fine-tuning of large language models using only forward evaluations. Existing aggregation-based DP-ZO methods reconstruct model updates at a fixed scale, ignoring that the strength of useful signals varies throughout training. Consequently, noise-dominated updates may receive excessive weight and degrade model utility. To address this issue, we propose SAGE, a noise-aware shrinkage method that adaptively attenuates privatized estimates according to their estimated signal quality. SAGE subtracts the known Gaussian noise variance from the observed second moment to estimate the underlying signal energy, stabilizes this estimate through temporal tracking, and compares its current signal-to-noise level with a warm-up reference to derive a bounded shrinkage factor. As pure post-processing, SAGE requires neither additional privacy budget nor model queries and introduces only constant additional state. Our theoretical analysis shows that shrinkage reduces the quadratic update-risk term faster than the linear descent term, preserving useful descent while limiting the influence of noise-dominated updates. Experiments on RoBERTa-large, OPT-1.3B, and OPT-6.7B demonstrate that SAGE outperforms existing baselines in most settings under the same privacy budgets while preserving the forward-only memory efficiency of DP-ZO.

</details>


### [165] [The Tell-Tale Trace: Detecting Reasoning Failures in LLMs Using Chain-of-Thought Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03291)
*Shashwat Sourav,Aishwarya Balwani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在布尔可满足性问题（SAT/UNSAT）上的链式推理（Chain-of-thought, CoT）动态特征，通过分析推理轨迹的结构变化来诊断和纠正推理失败，而非依赖语义忠实性假设。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于大语言模型的推理过程分析与纠错，属于自然语言处理/可解释AI领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩/加速。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM推理分析领域，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM推理正确性诊断与纠错；应用场景：布尔可满足性问题（SAT/UNSAT）求解；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 研究对象为多种LLM（包括Llama3-70B等），通过给CoT句子打上推理功能标签（reasoning function tagging）来分析推理轨迹的结构动态，并设计proof-search prompt干预策略。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及任何模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：可验证的布尔可满足性任务（Boolean satisfiability tasks），具有可变复杂度；评价指标：推理正确率（accuracy），例如Llama3-70B从13.3%提升至85%，纠正了84.6%的错误。

Experiments: 在多种LLM上对SAT/UNSAT问题进行研究。关键发现：错误推理轨迹更早进入子句检查阶段、重复相似操作、更早结束（premature verification collapse）；在UNSAT问题上模型会过早转向错误的SAT结论。通过proof-search prompt干预，Llama3-70B准确率从13.3%提升至85%。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化完全无关；2. 研究对象是LLM推理而非视觉模型；3. 不涉及任何部署或资源约束考量；4. 方法依赖可验证的逻辑任务（SAT），难以直接迁移到视觉目标检测场景。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与课题方向弱相关，但"通过分析推理轨迹的结构动态来诊断模型失败"这一思路在概念上可类比于：在轻量化目标检测模型中，通过分析中间特征图或注意力分布的变化来诊断量化/剪枝后模型性能退化原因，从而指导更有针对性的压缩策略。但这种借鉴非常间接，实际可操作性有限。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large language model (LLM) performance while also providing an observable interface to the model's reasoning process. Existing approaches that leverage verbalized CoTs to monitor reasoning correctness, however, largely evaluate the semantic correctness or consistency of individual intermediate steps, rather than how the reasoning process evolves across the trace. As a result, failures distributed across the reasoning trajectory, rather than those localized to a single incorrect step, remain comparatively underexplored. Furthermore, verbalized CoTs need not faithfully reflect the model's internal reasoning, motivating analyses that do not treat individual statements as literal accounts of internal computation. In this work, we therefore ask whether the dynamics of visible CoT can be leveraged to systematically distinguish successful from failed reasoning without assuming such semantic faithfulness. We study a range of LLMs on verifiable Boolean satisfiability tasks with variable complexity, enabling controlled comparisons near each model's capability frontier. Tagging CoT sentences by reasoning function reveals premature verification collapse on SAT problems: incorrect traces enter clause checking earlier, repeat similar operations, and finalize sooner. On UNSAT problems, models presumptuously move towards incorrect SAT conclusions, checking candidate assignments rather than deriving contradictions across constructed cases. Subsequently, a targeted proof-search prompt intervention raises Llama3-70B accuracy from 13.3% to 85%, correcting 84.6% of these errors. These results show that capability failures can manifest as distributed, task-dependent changes in the structure of visible reasoning, and that CoT dynamics agnostic to whether the verbalized trace reflects the model's internal computations can help diagnose and correct failures.

</details>


### [166] [Provably Learning Multi-Head Attention with Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03294)
*Sunyeop Kim,Insung Kim,Jian Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究从黑盒输入输出访问中学习多头softmax注意力参数的理论问题，提出一种无需子空间正交假设即可恢复多头注意力canonical表示（W_h, v_h）的算法，并扩展到单层Transformer。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。本文是纯理论性的机器学习/深度学习可学习性（learnability）研究，聚焦于从黑盒查询中恢复Transformer多头注意力参数，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或模型轻量化/部署。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，仅因研究对象是Transformer注意力机制，可能对理解注意力结构有间接理论参考价值。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于纯理论机器学习可学习性研究，无遥感场景、无目标检测任务、无轻量化/部署方法。除非对Transformer注意力参数可辨识性的理论感兴趣，否则不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：理论可学习性分析（learning multi-head softmax attention from black-box queries）。应用场景：非遥感、非视觉任务，属于理论机器学习/深度学习理论。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 研究对象为多头softmax注意力（multi-head softmax attention），参数为(W_h, v_h)，h∈[H]。扩展模型为单层Transformer，包含多头注意力后接无偏置ReLU前馈网络（bias-free ReLU feed-forward network）。算法通过合并具有相同W_h的head、对v_h求和、当和为零时丢弃合并head来恢复canonical表示。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。唯一与"轻量化"沾边的概念是"合并相同W_h的head并丢弃零和head"，但这属于理论上的参数可辨识性/冗余消除，而非面向部署的模型压缩。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署指标。本文是纯理论复杂度分析（value query次数为O(Hd²)），与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。无实验数据集、无评价指标、无实验设置。本文为纯理论证明，仅给出查询复杂度（4Hd²-2H+1次value queries，最大序列长度2H+1）和误差界（参数误差为输出误差的常数倍）等理论保证。

Experiments: 摘要未说明。无实验对比、无消融实验。本文以理论证明为主：在精确oracle输出下，随机选择查询向量可概率1恢复canonical pairs（至置换）；在近似oracle输出下给出参数误差界；并扩展到单层Transformer（含ReLU FFN）的功能等价恢复。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关，属于纯理论可学习性研究。2. 假设条件较强：需要精确或近似oracle输出、已知H或H的上界H0、随机查询向量等。3. 仅处理单层Transformer，未涉及多层、多head间复杂交互、位置编码等实际模型要素。4. 无任何实验验证，实用性存疑。5. 摘要未说明该算法对实际深度学习训练/推理的指导意义。

Ideas for my research: 1. 本文的"合并相同W_h的head、丢弃零和head"思想，理论上提示多头注意力中存在参数冗余，可启发在遥感目标检测Transformer中做head-level剪枝（head pruning）的轻量化思路。2. 本文对注意力参数可辨识性的理论分析，可作为理解注意力机制结构冗余的参考，但需自行将其转化为实际压缩方法。3. 总体而言，对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值很低，仅可作为理论背景阅读。

Abstract: We study the problem of learning multi-head softmax attention from black-box input-output access. The learner may query arbitrary real-valued token sequences and observe only the scalar output at the final token. Recent work gives an algorithm using $O(d^2)$ value queries to recover the single-head parameters $(W,v)$. For multiple heads, the same work establishes identifiability under the assumption that the heads occupy pairwise orthogonal subspaces. Applying the single-head recovery algorithm separately to the heads additionally requires bases for these subspaces to be known. We recover a canonical representation by merging heads with the same $W_h$, summing their corresponding $v_h$, and discarding a merged head when this sum is zero, without these subspace assumptions. By varying the number of copies of a token, our algorithm obtains samples of a rational function whose interpolation separates the canonical heads. Additional queries formed by adding selected token vectors then match the same head across different queries. When the oracle outputs and all subsequent computations are exact, the learner chooses its query vectors at random and recovers the canonical pairs $\{(W_h,v_h):h\in[H]\}$ up to permutation with probability one. When $H$ is known, it uses exactly $4Hd^2-2H+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H+1$. If only a known upper bound $H_0$ is available, the algorithm uses $4H_0d^2-2H_0+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H_0+1$. For approximate oracle outputs, we give conditions under which the parameter error is at most a model- and query-dependent constant multiple of the output error. Finally, we extend our result to a one-layer Transformer with multi-head attention followed by a bias-free ReLU feed-forward network. Under additional conditions, we recover a functionally equivalent Transformer without relying on a separate algorithm for learning the feed-forward network.

</details>


### [167] [Any-OPD: Heterogeneous On-Policy Distillation for Flow-Matching Models via Representation-Space Bridging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03316)
*Siming Fu,Zheming Fu,Ruizhe He,Hualiang Wang,Jie Huang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Mingchen Zhong,Weihu Huang,Xiaoxuan He,Haojun Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Any-OPD，首个支持任意异构latent flow-matching生成模型之间on-policy蒸馏的框架，通过模型无关的视觉表征连接教师与学生，实现跨模型家族的蒸馏。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文是生成式AI/扩散模型领域的知识蒸馏方法，属于泛机器学习方法。虽然涉及knowledge distillation这一轻量化核心技术，但完全不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或任何视觉检测任务，属于泛视觉/泛机器学习方法。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文是生成式模型蒸馏的前沿工作，其"异构模型间蒸馏"和"模型无关表征对齐"的思想对知识蒸馏方法本身有启发，但与遥感目标检测、在轨部署、轻量化检测模型等核心研究方向关联度很低，仅作为蒸馏方法论层面的泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：生成式模型（latent flow-matching generators）的on-policy知识蒸馏。应用场景：文本到图像生成（text-to-image generation）。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用（生成图像而非检测目标）。

Model architecture: 教师模型为FLUX.1-dev（12B参数），学生模型为SD3.5-Medium（2.5B参数）。框架核心：将教师视为黑盒采样器，通过一个冻结的、模型无关的视觉表征（frozen model-agnostic vision representation）连接教师与学生，比较两者独立解码的输出。通过匹配连续噪声水平（continuous noise levels）而非时间步索引来恢复轨迹对应关系，并引入anchoring phase将教师样本通过学生自己的VAE重新编码。

Lightweight method: 知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）——具体为on-policy distillation。核心创新在于打破了传统蒸馏对"相同VAE latent、匹配架构、共同时间步网格"的假设，支持异构模型家族之间的蒸馏。这是模型压缩/轻量化的一种方法，但面向生成式模型而非检测模型。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量压缩比、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及学生模型为教师的约1/5大小（12B→2.5B），但这是生成模型规模，与遥感在轨检测的轻量化需求差异很大。

Datasets and metrics: 评价指标：PickScore（从0.846提升至0.884）和HPSv3（从9.12提升至10.97）。摘要未说明具体训练数据集。

Experiments: 将12B的FLUX.1-dev蒸馏到2.5B的SD3.5-Medium，学生模型的PickScore从0.846提升至0.884，HPSv3从9.12提升至10.97，达到教师水平的约1/5规模。对比方法：直接latent回归（direct latent regression）完全无法训练。

Limitations: 1. 面向生成式模型（text-to-image），与遥感目标检测任务无直接关联；2. 摘要未说明推理速度、参数量压缩比、FLOPs等部署指标；3. 未涉及检测任务、遥感场景或任何视觉检测数据集；4. 蒸馏框架依赖生成模型的VAE和噪声调度，难以直接迁移到检测模型。

Ideas for my research: 1. "模型无关表征连接"的思想可借鉴：在遥感检测模型蒸馏中，若教师与学生架构差异大（如不同backbone、不同neck），可考虑用冻结的通用视觉表征（如CLIP特征）作为对齐空间，而非逐层特征对齐；2. "连续噪声水平匹配替代离散时间步索引"的思路，类比到检测蒸馏中可理解为用连续尺度/连续特征层级匹配替代离散层索引；3. on-policy蒸馏思想（教师纠正学生自己生成的样本）在检测蒸馏中可类比为教师对学生的预测结果进行纠正，而非仅对固定样本蒸馏；4. 但整体而言，该论文与遥感在轨检测轻量化方向关联度低，借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: On-policy distillation, in which a teacher corrects samples that the student itself generates, presupposes that the two models speak the same language: identical VAE latents, matching architectures, and a common timestep grid. We ask what happens when none of this holds, as when the strongest teacher available and the student one wishes to deploy come from different model families, and find that the standard recipes have no answer: teacher latents cannot serve as targets in a foreign coordinate system, per-pixel losses against a teacher that stochastically re-draws local detail degenerate into blur or divergence, and timestep indices lose their meaning across mismatched schedules. We present Any-OPD, to our knowledge the first framework for on-policy distillation between arbitrary pairs of latent flow-matching generators. Any-OPD treats the teacher purely as a black-box sampler and connects the two models at exactly one point: a frozen, model-agnostic vision representation in which their independently decoded outputs are compared, sidestepping every assumption about latents, features, or architecture. Trajectory correspondence is recovered by matching continuous noise levels instead of step indices, and a brief anchoring phase, in which teacher samples are re-encoded through the student's own VAE, ensures the on-policy gradient measures sample quality rather than domain mismatch. Distilling the 12B FLUX.1-dev into the 2.5B SD3.5-Medium, Any-OPD lifts the student's PickScore from 0.846 to 0.884 and HPSv3 from 9.12 to 10.97, rivaling the teacher at a fifth of its size, where direct latent regression fails to train at all.

</details>


### [168] [AS-FedBridge: Pseudo-Spike Bridge Distillation for Heterogeneous ANN-SNN Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03324)
*Shengyang Li,Yiting Dong,Liuyang Song,Ximing Wang,Luyuan Xie,Cong Li,Qingni Shen,Zhaofei Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AS-FedBridge，一个面向混合ANN-SNN客户端的联邦学习框架，通过Pseudo-Spike Interface桥接连续激活与离散脉冲之间的语义鸿沟，在资源受限边缘设备上实现高效协同训练。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文聚焦联邦学习（Federated Learning）与脉冲神经网络（SNN）在边缘设备上的协同训练，涉及边缘部署和资源效率，但完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务。其轻量化思路（SNN稀疏计算、ANN-SNN对齐）对边缘部署有间接借鉴意义，但并非遥感场景下的目标检测。

Reading priority: 2分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测方向弱相关，核心贡献在联邦学习+SNN领域，不涉及遥感场景和目标检测任务。但其SNN轻量化思路和ANN-SNN对齐方法对边缘/星上部署有一定间接借鉴价值，可作为轻量化技术储备性阅读，优先级较低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：联邦学习下的混合ANN-SNN协同训练（heterogeneous FL）。应用场景：分布式边缘设备上的协作模型训练，强调数据隐私保护。传感器类型：摘要未说明（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：摘要未说明（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: AS-FedBridge框架包含一个轻量级Bridge模块，配备Pseudo-Spike Interface，将连续实值激活信号投影到脉冲兼容空间，实现ANN与SNN之间的表征对齐。框架支持混合ANN-SNN客户端（mixed ANN-SNN clients），应对极端规模、架构和客户端异构性挑战。

Lightweight method: 核心轻量化手段是采用SNN（Spiking Neural Networks）作为ANN的替代方案，利用其稀疏计算机制（sparse computing mechanisms）和高能效特性（high energy efficiency）。此外，Bridge模块本身被设计为轻量级（lightweight），且整体框架仅引入边际计算开销（marginal computational overhead）。但摘要未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）或NAS等经典压缩方法。

Onboard deployability: 面向资源受限边缘设备（resource-constrained edge devices）部署，强调SNN的高能效与稀疏计算优势。框架支持模型性能与资源效率之间的可控权衡（controllable trade-off between model performance and resource efficiency）。但摘要未说明具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等量化指标，也未提及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等硬件部署细节。

Datasets and metrics: 在四个数据集上进行评估（摘要未说明具体数据集名称）。评价指标为准确率（accuracy），并与多种先进的异构联邦学习方法（advanced heterogeneous FL methods）进行对比。摘要未说明具体指标数值。

Experiments: 建立了首个混合ANN-SNN联邦学习基准（comprehensive benchmark），与多种异构FL方法对比。实验表明：ANN-SNN对齐程度与协作FL性能呈正相关；AS-FedBridge在四个数据集上持续取得更优准确率，同时缓解了极端规模、架构和客户端异构性挑战；仅引入边际计算开销。

Limitations: 1. 摘要未涉及遥感场景，未在遥感数据集上验证；2. 未涉及目标检测任务，仅讨论分类/协同训练；3. 未给出具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、能耗等部署量化指标；4. 未说明SNN在真实边缘硬件（FPGA/NPU）上的实测性能；5. 未讨论在轨/星上部署场景的约束（如辐射环境、功耗预算、通信带宽）。

Ideas for my research: 1. SNN的稀疏计算与高能效特性可借鉴到星上遥感目标检测的轻量化设计中，探索ANN-SNN混合架构在遥感小目标检测上的可行性；2. Pseudo-Spike Interface的连续-离散信号对齐思路，可类比用于遥感检测中连续特征图与二值/低比特量化特征之间的对齐；3. 联邦学习框架对多客户端异构性的处理，可借鉴到多颗卫星协同训练/增量学习的场景；4. 性能与资源效率的可控权衡机制，可迁移到星上检测模型在精度与功耗之间的动态调节。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across distributed edge devices while strictly preserving data privacy. To facilitate practical deployment on resource-constrained edge devices, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as a promising alternative to traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) due to their sparse computing mechanisms and high energy efficiency. However, jointly training ANNs and SNNs exposes a challenge of representational misalignment, which is intrinsically caused by differences in information representation, specifically the semantic gap between continuous real-valued activations in ANNs and discrete spatio-temporal spikes in SNNs. To overcome this barrier, we propose AS-FedBridge, a novel federated learning framework tailored for mixed ANN-SNN clients. AS-FedBridge features a lightweight Bridge equipped with a Pseudo-Spike Interface, which effectively projects continuous signals into a spike-compatible space to facilitate ANN-SNN alignment. Given the absence of existing mixed ANN-SNN federated frameworks, we establish a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate against multiple advanced heterogeneous FL methods. Our empirical analysis demonstrates a positive correlation between the degree of ANN-SNN alignment and the collaborative FL performance. Across four datasets, AS-FedBridge consistently demonstrates advanced accuracy while mitigating extreme scale, architecture, and client heterogeneity challenge. Furthermore, our framework enables a highly controllable trade-off between model performance and resource efficiency. AS-FedBridge accomplishes these robust performance gains while introducing only marginal computational overhead, establishing a robust and practical foundation for mixed ANN-SNN federated learning systems.

</details>


### [169] [Tight Worst-Case Bounds for the Smallest Eigenvalue of ReLU NTK Gram Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03368)
*Zhao Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究连续ReLU导数Gram矩阵H的最小特征值下界，证明其与投影分离度Δ±/√log n成正比，并构造达到匹配上界的极值族，证明该速率在通用常数意义下紧致。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。这是一篇纯数学理论论文，研究ReLU激活函数导数Gram矩阵的谱性质，属于泛机器学习/深度学习理论范畴。虽然ReLU是神经网络常用激活函数，但论文完全不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化，属于泛机器学习理论方法。

Reading priority: 1分。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，属于纯数学理论论文，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：数学理论分析（矩阵谱理论）。应用场景：深度学习理论，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 研究连续ReLU导数Gram矩阵H，其元素通过对标准高斯方向上的成对门控内积求平均得到。涉及n个单位向量x1,...,xn ∈ R^d的投影分离度Δ±。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等均未提及）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。不涉及任何数据集或实验评价指标，纯理论证明（下界与上界匹配）。

Experiments: 摘要未说明。无实验对比或消融实验，仅提供理论证明：证明λ_min(H) = Ω(Δ±/√log n)的通用无维度下界，并构造达到匹配上界λ_min(H) = O(Δ±/√log n)的最坏情况族。

Limitations: 本文是纯理论数学论文，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测和模型轻量化方向基本无关。摘要未涉及任何工程应用、实验验证或部署考量。ReLU导数Gram矩阵的谱性质虽与神经网络理论相关，但对轻量化目标检测的实际指导意义有限。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的间接联系是：ReLU导数Gram矩阵的最小特征值下界与神经网络的表达能力/泛化性理论相关，可能对理解轻量化网络（如剪枝后网络）的表达能力保持有理论参考价值，但这一联系非常间接，需要大量额外推导才能落地到遥感目标检测轻量化场景。

Abstract: For $n$ unit vectors $x_1,\ldots,x_n \in \mathbb{R}^d$, we study the continuous ReLU derivative Gram matrix $H$, whose entries are obtained by averaging pairwise gated inner products over a standard Gaussian direction. Writing $ Δ_\pm := \min_{i \neq j} \min\{ \|x_i-x_j\|_2, \|x_i+x_j\|_2 \} $ for their projective separation, we prove the universal dimension-free lower bound $ λ_{\min}(H) = Ω( Δ_\pm/\sqrt{\log n} ) $. Conversely, we construct worst-case families satisfying the matching upper bound $ λ_{\min}(H) = O( Δ_\pm/\sqrt{\log n} ) $, showing that this rate is tight up to universal constants.

</details>


### [170] [Benign interpolation and Occam's razor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03386)
*Tom F. Sterkenburg,Daniel A. Herrmann,Jan-Willem Romeijn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 一篇关于深度学习中"良性插值"（benign interpolation）现象的哲学讨论论文，探讨插值模型的简单性偏好与泛化能力之间的解释性鸿沟。

Research relevance: 与本课题（遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化）基本无关。论文属于机器学习理论/科学哲学交叉领域，讨论的是深度学习泛化理论中的"良性插值"现象及其哲学解释，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或任何模型压缩/轻量化技术。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与本课题方向基本无关，属于机器学习理论/科学哲学领域，不涉及遥感、目标检测或模型轻量化，不建议投入时间阅读。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何实验数据集或评价指标，属于纯理论/哲学论述。

Experiments: 摘要未说明。论文没有实验部分，主要进行概念辨析和理论论证。

Limitations: 该论文与本课题方向完全无关。它讨论的是深度学习泛化理论中的哲学问题（良性插值、简单性偏好、Occam剃刀），不涉及遥感、目标检测或模型轻量化的任何具体技术内容。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值极低。唯一可能的间接启发是：论文讨论的"简单性偏好"与泛化关系在理论上与轻量化模型（更简单的模型）可能具有更好的泛化能力这一直觉有一定哲学层面的关联，但这属于非常间接的理论背景，对实际工程化的在轨目标检测模型轻量化工作几乎没有直接可借鉴的技术思路。

Abstract: Contemporary deep learning methods generalize well even when they fit their training data perfectly, a phenomenon known as benign interpolation. This phenomenon cannot be accounted for by classical statistical learning theory and has prompted a range of attempted new explanations in the statistics and machine learning literature. A common feature of these new proposals is an appeal to a simplicity preference among interpolating models, often presented as a form of Occam's razor. We clarify this debate for a philosophical audience and argue that this new appeal to simplicity creates an explanatory gap. The classical theory offers theorems which connect the simplicity of model classes to good generalization, thus underwriting methodological simplicity norms. The new accounts instead appeal to properties of individual models, which they interpret as a kind of simplicity. Lacking a provable connection to generalization, it is the name "simplicity" that does the work a theorem used to do, making a substantive and unargued assumption look like the application of a familiar methodological principle.

</details>


### [171] [TimeRLM: Recursive Language Models Enable Precise Anomaly Localization in Long-Context Time-Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03391)
*Nicolas Zumarraga,Lorenzo Steno,Ning Wang,Max Rosenblattl,Thomas Kaar,Maxwell A. Xu,Kevin O'Sullivan,Markus Kreft,Elgar Fleisch,Paul Schmiedmayer,Patrick Langer,Robert Jakob*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TimeRLM，一种基于递归语言模型（RLM）的时间序列异常定位方法，通过代码和视觉能力外部化上下文，并引入合成长上下文异常定位基准AnomalyXL，在长序列异常检索任务上显著超越现有TSLM基线。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文聚焦于时间序列（time series）异常定位（anomaly localization），属于泛机器学习/时序建模方向，与遥感、卫星、在轨目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。虽然异常检测在遥感场景（如变化检测、灾害监测）中有一定概念映射，但本文方法基于LLM+代码交互的递归检索范式，并非面向遥感图像或遥感信号设计，也未涉及任何轻量化/部署优化。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文聚焦时间序列异常定位与LLM递归检索，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，无直接可借鉴的轻量化方法或遥感场景适配。仅作为泛机器学习方法可略读，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：长上下文时间序列异常定位（long-context time series anomaly localization）。应用场景：临床监护（clinical care）、工业运维（industrial operations）、金融服务（financial services）、物流（logistics），以及ECG、睡眠、软件可观测性（software observability）数据。传感器类型：时间序列信号（非遥感图像）。目标类别：异常事件/异常片段（anomaly），非遥感目标（舰船/飞机/车辆等）。

Model architecture: TimeRLM基于递归语言模型（Recursive Language Model, RLM）架构，将上下文（context）外部化于LLM之外，通过代码（code）和视觉（vision）能力顺序操作时间序列信号。模型通过代码执行查询外部上下文，并利用视觉能力处理信号可视化。后训练阶段采用强化学习（reinforcement learning）进行优化。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS或轻量网络设计等模型压缩/加速方法。唯一与效率相关的信息是：后训练后的模型所需agent交互轮次约为未训练基座模型的三分之一（approximately one-third as many agent interaction turns），但这属于推理效率/交互效率优化，而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未报告参数量（parameters）、FLOPs、延迟（latency）、显存（memory）、能耗（energy consumption）等部署指标。且该方法依赖LLM+代码执行+视觉能力，计算开销大，与星上/边缘部署的轻量化约束（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT）方向相悖。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：AnomalyXL（自建合成长上下文异常定位基准），包含5种任务类别和两个变体：AnomalyXL-MCQ和AnomalyXL-Localize；另在真实ECG、睡眠和软件可观测性记录上进行泛化评估。评价指标：IoU（定位，0.682）、classify-with-evidence（0.745），对比基线最高分别为0.329和0.072。

Experiments: TimeRLM在AnomalyXL-Localize的5个任务中4个上优于所有TSLM和单遍（single-pass）基线；后训练（RL）后性能进一步提升，且交互轮次减少约三分之二。在未见过的真实ECG、睡眠和软件可观测性数据上，后训练模型保持或提升性能，尽管仅用合成数据训练。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关，方法不可直接迁移。2. 依赖LLM+代码执行+视觉推理，计算和存储开销大，不适合资源受限的星上部署。3. 仅在时间序列异常定位上验证，未涉及图像目标检测。4. 摘要未说明模型规模、推理延迟、能耗等部署关键指标。5. 合成数据训练在真实遥感场景的泛化性未知。

Ideas for my research: 1. 递归/外部化上下文（externalized context）的思想可借鉴：在遥感在轨目标检测中，可将大场景遥感图像分块处理，通过外部存储和递归查询机制避免一次性加载全图，缓解星上内存受限问题。2. 合成数据+程序化注入异常（programmatically injected anomalies）的基准构建思路，可用于构建遥感小目标/异常目标检测的合成训练与评测基准。3. 强化学习后训练减少交互轮次的思想，可类比为在轨推理中减少不必要的计算步骤，提升推理效率。4. 但整体而言，该论文对"遥感目标检测+轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Precise anomaly localization over long-context time series is a crucial task in monitoring applications across clinical care, industrial operations, financial services, and logistics, where brief evidence may hide inside long spans of high-frequency data. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) are able to ingest time series data and verbalize findings on anomalies in natural language; however, recent benchmarks report a decrease in retrieval performance at long contexts, mirroring failure modes in text, vision, and audio. In the text domain, Recursive Language Models (RLMs) can recover much of this lost performance by keeping context external to the large language model (LLM), allowing the model to query it through code. We present TimeRLM, an RLM formulation for time-series that sequentially manipulates the signal using code and vision capabilities. We further introduce AnomalyXL, a synthetic long-context anomaly localization benchmark with programmatically injected anomalies that require precise retrieval. We implement five different task categories and two variants: AnomalyXL-MCQ and AnomalyXL-Localize. TimeRLM outperforms every evaluated TSLM and single-pass baseline on four of the five AnomalyXL-Localize tasks, reaching 0.682 IoU on localization and 0.745 on classify-with-evidence, versus at most 0.329 and 0.072 across all baselines. We post-train TimeRLM using reinforcement learning. The resulting model further improves performance and requires approximately one-third as many agent interaction turns as its untrained base model to produce a final answer. On unseen real-world ECG, sleep and software observability recordings, the post-trained TimeRLM retains or improves performance, surpassing TSLMs despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data. Our findings suggest recursive interaction with time-series is an effective approach for long-horizon retrieval.

</details>


### [172] [Shorter Reasoning, Earlier Answers? An Evaluation of Reasoning Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03401)
*Francesca Carlon,Vincent Ginis,Andres Algaba*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究大语言模型在固定推理预算（token限制）下，通过简洁提示词或训练好的effort设置来缩短推理轨迹，并评估其对准确率的影响。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。本文研究对象是大语言模型（LLM）的推理长度压缩与延迟优化，属于泛机器学习/泛AI方法，与遥感、卫星、目标检测均无直接关联。虽然涉及"缩短推理、降低延迟"这一与轻量化/实时推理相关的主题，但对象是LLM而非遥感目标检测模型，方法（prompt token限制、effort设置）也不适用于CNN/Transformer检测器的剪枝、量化、蒸馏等轻量化手段。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM推理效率研究。仅"推理预算控制"和"deadline-aware评估"两个思想有间接借鉴价值，但整体参考意义有限，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：大语言模型推理效率评估（reasoning efficiency evaluation）。应用场景：通用问答（GPQA Diamond、MMLU-Pro基准）。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 涉及模型：Qwen3-14B、gpt-oss-20b、gpt-oss-120b。核心机制：通过numeric/concision prompt（声明token上限）和trained effort settings（低/中/高effort）控制推理长度。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 非传统模型压缩方法。本文的"轻量化"思路是运行时推理预算控制（inference-time budget control）：通过prompt限制token数或使用训练好的effort设置来缩短推理轨迹，从而降低计算成本和延迟。不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等离线模型压缩技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅涉及推理延迟（latency）和token成本（cost）的定性讨论，且针对的是云端大模型推理，与星上/边缘部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：GPQA Diamond（198题）、MMLU-Pro（500题）。评价指标：准确率（accuracy）、推理轨迹长度（reasoning trace length）、token限制下的匹配准确率、正确完成率（correct completion before deadline）、未完成运行间的差异、正确选项概率质量。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：1) Qwen3-14B的concision prompt使推理轨迹缩短12-17%，匹配token限制下准确率变化小且混合；2) concise/early-answer指令在512 token下使MMLU-Pro准确率提升3.8个百分点；3) gpt-oss低/中effort的候选logit答案比匹配horizon的高effort答案准确率高14.5-26.3点；4) 512-token优势主要来自低effort更早完成，未完成运行间差异较小且混合；5) 错误的早期答案往往在所选选项上集中概率，提前停止并不均匀改善概率质量。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，无法直接迁移；2) 研究对象是LLM推理，不涉及视觉目标检测模型；3) 摘要未说明模型压缩方法（剪枝/量化/蒸馏等）；4) 未提供任何部署相关硬指标（FLOPs、延迟数值、能耗）；5) 样本量较小（198+500题），结论泛化性有限；6) 未讨论该方法对视觉任务或嵌入式平台的适用性。

Ideas for my research: 1) 借鉴"推理预算控制"思想：在遥感在轨目标检测中，可类比设计"计算预算自适应"机制——根据输入场景复杂度动态调整检测器推理深度（如early-exit、动态通道裁剪），在简单场景用轻量路径、复杂场景用完整路径，平衡精度与星上算力；2) 借鉴"匹配horizon评估"方法：评估轻量化检测模型时，不应只看最终精度，还应报告"在给定延迟/FLOPs预算下能正确检测的目标数"，即deadline-aware评估；3) 借鉴"未完成运行差异"分析：在轨场景中推理可能被中断，可研究检测器在部分推理（如浅层特征）时的中间输出质量，评估early-exit的可靠性；4) 概率质量分析思想：可迁移到检测置信度校准，研究轻量化后模型在错误检测上的置信度分布。

Abstract: Large language models often reason at length before answering, increasing cost and latency. Prompts and trained settings can shorten this reasoning, but a shorter trace may only show that the model stopped sooner. Here, we evaluate paired runs of the same question at matched reasoning horizons across 198 GPQA Diamond and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. We test a numeric/concision prompt that announces a token limit for Qwen3-14B and the trained effort settings of gpt-oss-20b and -120b. The Qwen prompt shortens reasoning traces by 12-17%, while accuracy changes at matched token limits are small and mixed. A concise/early-answer instruction raises MMLU-Pro accuracy by 3.8 percentage points at 512 tokens, including +2.7 points when both runs are unfinished. Its gain at 2,048 tokens is uncertain. For gpt-oss, candidate-logit answers from completed low- and medium-effort reasoning are 14.5-26.3 points more accurate than matched-horizon high-effort answers. Most of the 512-token advantage comes from lower effort finishing earlier, while differences among unfinished runs are smaller and mixed. Wrong early answers often concentrate probability on the chosen option, so earlier stopping does not uniformly improve probability quality. In these tests, a tight deadline can favor lower effort or a concise instruction, whereas allowing high effort to finish can recover higher final accuracy. Evaluations should report correct completion before a deadline, the answer obtained when a run is stopped, differences among unfinished runs, and probability assigned to the correct answer separately.

</details>

### [173] [Light-Loco-Parkour: Versatile Perceptive Whole-Body Locomotion via Multi-Skill Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02653)
*Hongming Chen,Zhuoran Li,Hongxi Wang,Jiangpeng Hu,Ziliang Li,Peize Liu,QingRui Zhao,Xuhao Liu,Liang Pan,Ximin Lyu,Yuntao Ma,Tingxiang Fan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Light-Loco-Parkour (LLP)，一个端到端感知型人形机器人全身运动控制系统，通过单一可部署策略实现行走、平衡、攀爬、下台阶和跨越等动作，无需参考输入或手工编码状态机。

Research relevance: 1分，基本无关。该论文研究人形机器人全身运动控制（whole-body locomotion），涉及深度感知、强化学习、parkour技能学习，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测、轻量化部署完全无关。虽然提到"deployable policy"和"onboard sensing"，但这里的部署是指机器人本体部署，与星上部署/边缘部署的模型压缩加速含义完全不同。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于人形机器人运动控制领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：人形机器人全身运动控制（whole-body locomotion）与parkour技能学习；应用场景：室内外复杂地形穿越（cluttered terrain）；传感器类型：机载深度相机（onboard depth）；目标类别：不涉及目标检测，涉及行走、平衡、攀爬、下台阶、跨越等运动技能。

Model architecture: 端到端感知型全身运动控制策略（end-to-end perceptive whole-body locomotion policy），基于RL训练的velocity-tracking locomotion policy扩展parkour技能，结合object-interacting motions学习。策略仅以onboard depth和velocity command为输入，无参考输入、无技能标签、无手工编码门控、无运行时运动图。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩方法。虽然强调"single deployable policy"和"zero-shot transfer"，但这是指策略的泛化性和可部署性，而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提到"single deployable policy"可在仿真和真实硬件上零样本迁移到室内外实验，但未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等具体部署指标。这里的"部署"指机器人本体实时运行，与星上/边缘部署的轻量化约束（算力、功耗、内存）语境不同。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。实验包括仿真（simulation）和真实世界（real-world）实验，在基准地形和未见障碍变体上评估成功率（success rate），并进行了室内外硬件零样本迁移测试。

Experiments: 仿真和真实世界实验显示在基准地形和未见障碍变体上均取得高成功率，同一策略可零样本迁移到室内外硬件实验。摘要未提供与其他方法的定量对比数据。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于机器人运动控制领域；2. 摘要未提供模型规模、计算量、推理速度等量化指标；3. 未涉及任何目标检测任务；4. 未涉及任何模型压缩或加速技术。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能间接相关的点是：1) 其"从稀疏种子扩展单个运动为地形配对参考"的数据增强思路，在遥感小样本场景下或许有类比启发（如从少量标注样本扩展训练数据）；2) "单一策略处理多种技能并自主决策切换"的架构思想，与在轨多任务统一模型（如检测+分割+分类）有一定概念相似性。但整体上与本课题关联度极低。

Abstract: Existing humanoid whole-body control systems still fall short of the way humans move through cluttered terrain: they either track expressive whole-body references without terrain generalization, or react to terrain online while leaving the arms, torso, and knees largely unused. We present \texttt{Light-Loco-Parkour} (LLP), an end-to-end perceptive whole-body locomotion system that closes this gap with a single deployable policy. Conditioned only on onboard depth and a velocity command, the policy decides when to walk, balance, climb, step down, or vault, with no reference input, skill label, hand-coded gate, or runtime motion graph. Compared with prior humanoid systems, LLP makes three contributions. First, it introduces a whole-body perceptive-control pipeline that extends an RL-trained, velocity-tracking locomotion policy with parkour skills learned from object-interacting motions, so the same policy tracks velocity in open terrain, executes whole-body traversal at obstacles, and resumes locomotion afterward. Second, it acquires terrain-conditioned skills from sparse seeds by expanding a single motion into dynamically feasible, terrain-paired references across obstacle geometry, rather than relying on a large motion corpus. Third, it learns autonomous skill transitions from reward, letting the policy decide when and which whole-body skill to invoke from depth and command alone, with no one-hot skill label, hand-coded state machine, or runtime motion generator. Simulation and real-world experiments show high success across both benchmarked terrains and unseen obstacle variations, and the same policy transfers zero-shot to indoor and outdoor hardware experiments. These results demonstrate autonomous perceptive whole-body locomotion on a humanoid in outdoor settings, using only onboard sensing and a single deployable policy.

</details>


### [174] [Semantic Haptic Feedback Enhances Dexterous Robotic Teleoperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02780)
*Bingjian Huang,Sahar Aseeri,Jonas Schmidtler,Joseph Zhang,Sonny Chan,Andrew Doxon,Jom Preechayasomboon,Evan Pezent,Alberto Rigo,Amir Memar,Nicholas Colonnese,Chase Tymms*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"语义触觉"（semantic haptics）用于机器人遥操作，通过抽象触觉模式传递机器人状态信息，替代高保真感官触觉，简化硬件需求并提升双手任务表现。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文主题是机器人遥操作（robot teleoperation）中的触觉反馈（haptic feedback）设计，属于人机交互（HRI）领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或任何模型压缩/轻量化技术。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为机器人遥操作触觉反馈，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，不建议投入时间阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：机器人遥操作中的触觉反馈设计；应用场景：pick and place（抓取放置）遥操作任务；传感器类型：pneumatic and vibrotactile wristbands（气动和振动触觉腕带）；目标类别：不适用（非视觉目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。本文核心是模块化触觉渲染管线（modular haptic rendering pipeline），将机器人状态分为"Confirmations"和"Exceptions"两类，通过抽象触觉模式（abstract haptic patterns）实现一对多映射。不涉及神经网络或深度学习模型。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何模型轻量化方法（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等）。本文的"简化"体现在硬件层面——用抽象触觉模式替代高保真感官触觉，降低传感与反馈硬件需求，而非模型压缩或计算加速。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署指标。虽然提到"simplifies hardware requirements"，但这是针对触觉反馈硬件而非计算模型。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集。通过三项评估研究（three evaluation studies）验证方法，比较了semantic haptics与sensory haptics、visual feedback等遥操作反馈方式。评价指标包括：任务工作量（task workload）、情境感知（situational awareness）、用户偏好（overall preference）。

Experiments: 三项评估研究：1）识别最有效的语义触觉设计；2）在单臂（unimanual）任务中与sensory haptics和visual feedback对比；3）在双臂（bimanual）任务中对比。结果表明：单臂任务中语义触觉与其他反馈方式表现相近；双臂任务中语义触觉表现更优，降低任务工作量、提升情境感知和整体偏好。

Limitations: 1）与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关，无法直接借鉴；2）摘要未说明语义触觉模式的具体编码方案、硬件参数、用户数量等实验细节；3）未涉及任何计算模型或算法层面的优化。

Ideas for my research: 与本人课题（遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化）基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是：本文"用抽象信息替代高保真信息以降低硬件/资源需求"的思想，在哲学层面与轻量化（用更精简的模型表达核心信息）有相似之处，但技术路径完全不同，不构成可复现的方法论借鉴。

Abstract: In robot teleoperation, haptic feedback can be used to help human operators accomplish dexterous manipulation tasks. However, existing haptic feedback methods try to replicate high-fidelity sensory haptics that are felt in real world interactions, which are constrained by the sensing and feedback hardware capability and may lead to higher workload.
  To addresses these limitations, this work introduces semantic haptics for teleoperation, which uses abstract haptic patterns to convey critical information about robot states. We categorize robot states into "Confirmations" and "Exceptions", implement a modular haptic rendering pipeline in robot simulation, and deliver semantic haptic feedback to operators through pneumatic and vibrotactile wristbands. This simplifies hardware requirements and enables one-to-many mappings between haptic patterns and robot states.
  Through three evaluation studies, we identify the most effective semantic haptic design for a common pick and place teleoperation task and compare semantic haptics to other teleoperation feedback approaches including sensory haptics and visual feedback. Results suggest that while semantic haptics performs similarly as other feedback in unimanual tasks, it achieves superior performance in bimanual tasks, with reduced task workload, increased situational awareness, and overall preference.

</details>


### [175] [Toward Certified Functional Safety for Industrial Humanoid Robots: The Fail-Passive Gap and a Feasibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02809)
*Caiwu Ding,Tao Cui,Lingyun Wang,Chengtao Wen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文讨论工业人形机器人的功能安全认证问题，提出"fail-passive gap"概念，通过外部安全链定位不可认证的机器人侧反应链，并在Unitree G1机器人上验证。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于人形机器人功能安全认证（ISO 13849-1 / EN 60204-1），涉及fail-safe PLC、PROFIsafe、安全链等工业安全领域概念，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何一项。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为人形机器人工业安全认证，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：人形机器人工业场景功能安全认证（functional safety certification）。应用场景：Unitree G1 EDU pick-and-place单元，3m x 1.5m半封闭工作空间。传感器类型：light curtain（光幕）、emergency stop（急停）。目标类别：不适用（非检测任务）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及神经网络模型架构，核心是安全链架构（light curtain, emergency stop, fail-safe input, fail-safe PLC, wireless PROFIsafe）以及Siemens fail-safe S7-1500紧急停止参考系统。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。本文不讨论任何模型压缩或加速方法（无pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。虽然提到"onboard compute"（G1机载计算）不是安全认证硬件，但这是关于安全认证而非模型部署性能。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等任何部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：不适用（非机器学习任务）。评价指标：PFHD（probability of dangerous failure per hour）、DC（diagnostic coverage）、CCF（common cause failure）、PL/SILCL（performance level / safety integrity level claim limit）、ISO 13855分离距离。实验设置：Unitree G1 EDU pick-and-place单元，3m x 1.5m半封闭工作空间。

Experiments: 在Unitree G1 EDU上验证了外部安全链方法，贡献了人形机器人特有的主动安全状态分析（fall-as-hazard、单支撑停止边界、平衡策略残余风险、ISO 13855分离）以及带来源标注的时间预算。作者明确不声称端到端认证PL e / SIL 3。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关。局限性包括：作者明确承认无法实现端到端安全认证；G1机载计算非安全认证硬件，SDA-to-balancing-policy接口仍存在fail-passive gap；未涉及任何遥感、目标检测或模型轻量化内容。

Ideas for my research: 对本课题（遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化）基本无可借鉴之处。唯一可能的间接启发是：文中"安全链定位不可认证元素"的系统化分析方法论，在方法论层面可类比于"通过系统化分解定位模型部署瓶颈"，但这是非常间接且牵强的联系。

Abstract: Industrial humanoid robots are constrained less by locomotion or manipulation capability than by the immaturity of functional safety certification for legged platforms. The root difficulty is that the safe state of a legged robot is an actively-controlled state, which violates the fail-passive assumption underlying ISO~13849-1 / EN~60204-1: removing power from a walking biped causes an uncontrolled fall, so classical de-energization is itself a hazard. We term this the fail-passive gap and use a certified external safety chain (light curtain, emergency stop, fail-safe input, fail-safe PLC, and wireless PROFIsafe) as an instrument to locate it precisely: because the external chain is closed and quantifiable with established methods (PFHD, DC, CCF, PL/SILCL), the residual uncertifiable element is pinpointed to the robot-side reaction chain. Using a Siemens fail-safe S7-1500 emergency-stop reference, we show its certifiable Reaction subsystem is contactor-based power removal (Stop Category~0)---exactly the element a balancing humanoid cannot have. We deliberately do not claim end-to-end certified PL~e / SIL~3. We validate the approach on a Unitree G1 EDU pick-and-place cell in a 3m x 1.5m semi-enclosed workspace, and contribute a humanoid-specific analysis of the active safe state (fall-as-hazard, single-support stop bounds, balancing-policy residual risk, ISO~13855 separation) and a provenance-labeled timing budget. Hosting an industrial software-defined automation (SDA) controller on the robot, co-located with the balancing policy, moves robot-side PROFINET/PROFIsafe reception onto a standardized IEC~61131-3 interface; because the G1's onboard compute is not safety-rated hardware, this endpoint is not a certified safety runtime, which reinforces rather than resolves the fail-passive gap and localizes it to the SDA-to-balancing-policy interface.

</details>
