### [220] [ScoreField: Neural Inverse Scattering with Score-Based Generative Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02937)
*Wenhan Guo,Yuan Gao,Yu Sun*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出ScoreField，一种将耦合隐式神经表示（INR）与预训练score-based生成先验相结合的电磁逆散射求解框架，通过Lippmann-Schwinger方程联合优化对比度与感应电流场，提升强多重散射场景下的重建保真度。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关（1分）。该论文属于电磁逆散射（electromagnetic inverse scattering）物理反问题求解领域，涉及计算电磁学与神经隐式表示，既非遥感图像目标检测任务，也不涉及任何模型压缩或边缘部署技术。虽然电磁逆散射与遥感中的SAR成像在物理上有一定关联（都涉及电磁波与目标的相互作用），但本文聚焦于重建未知介电常数对比度，而非目标检测或识别，且未涉及任何在轨/星上部署考量。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于电磁逆散射物理反问题求解领域，不涉及目标检测任务，也不涉及任何模型压缩或部署技术。除非对物理引导的神经表示方法有跨领域兴趣，否则不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：电磁逆散射（electromagnetic inverse scattering）重建，即从散射场数据重建未知介电常数对比度（permittivity contrast）。应用场景：计算电磁学、微波成像、生物医学成像等。传感器类型：非遥感传感器，涉及Fresnel实验测量数据。目标类别：非目标检测任务，目标是重建连续物理场（介电常数分布）。

Model architecture: ScoreField框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 两个隐式神经表示（Implicit Neural Representations, INRs），分别参数化介电常数对比度（permittivity contrast）和感应电流场（induced current fields）；(2) 一个预训练的score-based生成先验模型（score-based generative prior），提供对比度上的学习先验梯度，通过链式法则（chain rule）传播到对比度INR。整体在Lippmann-Schwinger方程约束下联合优化。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（如pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等），也未讨论推理效率、参数量或FLOPs。INR架构本身参数规模较小，但论文未从轻量化角度进行讨论。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息，也未讨论任何星上/边缘部署可行性。该任务本质上是物理反问题求解，需要迭代优化INR，计算开销较大，与实时在轨推理场景不匹配。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：模拟的弱散射和强散射基准（simulated weak- and strong-scattering benchmarks）、经典Austria phantom、实验Fresnel测量数据。评价指标：PSNR（峰值信噪比），在真实Fresnel数据上相比最佳对比方法平均提升1.8 dB。

Experiments: 在模拟弱/强散射基准、Austria phantom和实验Fresnel数据上进行了评估。相比经典全波方法（classical full-wave methods）和深度学习基线（deep learning baselines），ScoreField显著提升了重建保真度并抑制了伪影，在真实Fresnel数据上平均PSNR提升1.8 dB。

Limitations: 摘要未说明。主要局限包括：(1) 未涉及目标检测任务，仅做物理场重建；(2) 未讨论计算效率与部署可行性；(3) 未提供模型规模、推理速度等关键工程指标；(4) 未涉及遥感/卫星场景；(5) 迭代优化INR的求解方式可能计算开销较大，实时性存疑。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与在轨目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但仍有少量可借鉴思路：(1) 隐式神经表示（INR）作为一种紧凑的参数化方式，其"用少量网络参数编码复杂物理场"的思想可类比于轻量化模型设计中对参数效率的追求；(2) score-based生成先验作为正则化约束的思路，可迁移到遥感目标检测中作为数据增强或域适应手段；(3) 物理方程约束（Lippmann-Schwinger）与网络联合优化的范式，对遥感中物理引导的模型设计（如SAR成像与检测联合优化）有一定启发。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Designing an effective electromagnetic inverse-scattering solver requires faithful enforcement of nonlinear full-wave physics together with an expressive prior on the unknown permittivity contrast. We propose ScoreField, a neural inverse scattering framework that integrates coupled implicit neural representations (INRs) with a pretrained score-based generative prior. ScoreField employs two INRs to parameterize the permittivity contrast and the induced current fields, and jointly optimize them under the Lippmann-Schwinger equations. In addition to the implicit regularization by the INR architecture, the score model provides a learned prior gradient on the contrast, which is propagated to the contrast INR through the chain rule. This formulation enables ScoreField to effectively handle strong multiple scattering, where nonlinear wave interactions require accurate modeling of the coupled full-wave physics. We evaluate ScoreField on simulated weak- and strong-scattering benchmarks, the canonical Austria phantom, and experimental Fresnel measurements. We note that ScoreField significantly improves reconstruction fidelity and suppresses artifacts relative to classical full-wave methods and deep learning baselines, achieving an average PSNR improvement of $1.8 \, \mathrm{dB}$ over the best competing method on real Fresnel data.

</details>


### [221] [Automatic Patient-Specific Microwave Ablation Planning Accelerated by a Physics-Guided Deep Learning Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03086)
*Seonaeng Cho,Minjee Seo,Minju Seol,Juil Park,Joon Ho Kwon,Kyungho Yoon*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于数字孪生的微波消融自动规划框架，将神经网络消融预测模型与遗传算法结合，实现比数值仿真快约420倍的个性化治疗规划。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于医学影像中的微波消融（MWA）治疗规划，属于医学图像处理与治疗优化领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、边缘部署等模型压缩或加速方法。虽然论文中提到了"fast forward model"和加速规划，但这属于医学仿真加速，与遥感在轨目标检测的轻量化部署完全是不同领域。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为医学微波消融治疗规划，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。仅当对"代理模型替代物理仿真"这一通用方法论感兴趣时可作泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：微波消融（MWA）治疗规划（automatic planning），属于医学图像处理与治疗优化。应用场景：肝脏肿瘤的个性化微创治疗规划。传感器类型：医学影像（multiphysics simulation data，基于患者肿瘤和血管结构）。目标类别：肝脏肿瘤及周围血管/器官结构。与遥感目标检测无关。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体网络结构。仅提及"neural ablation prediction model"作为快速前向模型（fast forward model），与遗传算法（genetic algorithm）结合构成数字孪生规划框架。模型基于多物理场仿真数据训练，输入包括患者特异性肿瘤和血管结构、天线配置和治疗条件。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩方法。论文的"加速"体现在用神经网络替代昂贵的数值仿真作为前向预测器，实现约420倍规划加速，但这属于"用代理模型替代物理仿真"的加速策略，并非面向边缘/星上部署的模型轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。论文的加速目标是临床治疗规划场景（约420倍加速），而非星上/边缘实时推理部署。与在轨遥感目标检测的部署约束（功耗、算力、存储受限）完全不同。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：基于患者特异性肿瘤和血管结构生成的多物理场仿真数据（multiphysics simulation data），以及13个未见过的规划案例（unseen planning cases）。评价指标：Dice score（预测模型达95.1%）、消融效率提升54.3%、器官损伤减少55.0%、插入路径长度缩短3.3%、规划速度提升约420倍。代码开源：https://github.com/SeonAengCho/MWA-Planning.git

Experiments: 主要实验：1）神经网络消融预测模型在仿真数据上达到Dice 95.1%；2）在13个未见规划案例中，与临床医生定义规划相比，消融效率提升54.3%，器官损伤减少55.0%，插入路径长度缩短3.3%；3）与基于数值仿真的规划相比，加速约420倍；4）多数生成方案被MWA专家判定为临床可用。

Limitations: 摘要未说明模型的具体网络架构、训练数据规模、泛化到不同患者群体的能力、临床实际部署的硬件要求等。此外，该研究完全不属于遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向，无法为在轨遥感目标检测提供直接借鉴。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但有一个方法论层面的间接启发：用轻量神经网络作为"快速代理模型"替代昂贵的物理仿真/前向计算，这一思路在遥感领域可类比为"用轻量网络替代复杂物理模型进行快速辐射校正或大气校正"，或在星上推理中用代理模型加速某些物理约束的后处理。但整体而言，该论文对本课题的可借鉴性非常有限。

Abstract: Microwave ablation (MWA) is a promising minimally invasive treatment for liver tumors, but its therapeutic outcome strongly depends on patient-specific planning of antenna insertion trajectory, power, and treatment duration. Accurate numerical simulation can provide physically reliable ablation predictions; however, its high computational cost limits its use in optimization-based planning, where repeated forward evaluations are required. To address this issue, we propose a digital twin-based automatic planning framework that combines a neural ablation prediction model with a genetic algorithm. The model was trained on multiphysics simulation data generated from patient-specific tumor and vessel structures, antenna configurations, and treatment conditions, and was used as a fast forward model during planning. The prediction model achieved a Dice score of 95.1%, enabling accurate deep learning-based optimization. In 13 unseen planning cases, the proposed method improved ablation efficiency by 54.3% and reduced organ damage by 55.0% compared with clinician-defined planning, while slightly shortening the insertion path length by 3.3%. Most generated plans were also judged clinically applicable by MWA specialists. Furthermore, the framework enabled approximately 420-fold faster planning than numerical-simulation-based planning, demonstrating its potential as a fast digital twin for quantitative and personalized MWA treatment planning. The code is available at: https://github.com/SeonAengCho/MWA-Planning.git

</details>


### [222] [Radiometric Thermal Imaging Dataset of Laboratory Rats with Anatomical Segmentation Masks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03481)
*Dima Bykhovsky,Evyatar Chaimoff,Pe'er Eden,Tom Simkin,Oshrit Hoffer,Shahar Cohen,Bar Eilat Yogev,Gal Levi,Noa Efroni,Doron Todder,Hagit Cohen*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个包含1,655张实验室大鼠辐射热成像帧的数据集，每帧配有四类解剖分割掩码（背景、头部、身体、尾部）和原始温度矩阵，并展示了U-Net分割管线的基准结果（mIoU 0.895）。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于红外热成像（infrared thermography）在实验室动物应激与药理学研究中的应用，涉及语义分割（semantic segmentation），但场景是实验室大鼠，并非遥感/卫星/航空影像；传感器是热成像相机而非遥感卫星载荷；任务为解剖区域分割而非目标检测。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，仅在"红外/热成像传感器"和"语义分割方法"层面有极弱的泛化借鉴意义。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于生物医学热成像分割领域，仅在"辐射数据直接用于像素级任务"和"小样本U-Net基准"上有极弱的间接启发，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：热红外图像的像素级解剖语义分割（semantic segmentation）。应用场景：实验室动物应激与药理学研究中的体温调节响应分析。传感器类型：辐射热成像相机（radiometric thermal camera），输出480×640原始温度矩阵（摄氏度）。目标类别：四类解剖区域——背景（background）、头部（head）、身体（body）、尾部（tail）。

Model architecture: 采用探索性的U-Net分割管线（exploratory U-Net segmentation pipeline），用于直接从辐射热成像通道进行像素级分割。摘要未说明U-Net的具体深度、编码器结构、损失函数等细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等），也未讨论轻量化网络设计。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理能力，也未涉及星上/边缘部署。输入为480×640热成像帧，属于小尺寸图像，但未讨论部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：自建数据集，包含1,655张质量控制后的辐射热成像帧，来自25只实验室大鼠，来自两个药理学队列（乙醇诱导外周血管扩张、氯胺酮影响中枢体温调节）。每帧配有四类解剖分割掩码和原始480×640温度矩阵。评价指标：subject-level交叉验证的平均intersection-over-union（mIoU），结果为0.895 ± 0.006。摘要未说明训练/验证/测试划分比例及具体交叉验证折数。

Experiments: 主要实验：U-Net分割管线在自建大鼠热成像数据集上达到subject-level交叉验证mIoU 0.895 ± 0.006。数据集层面还报告了各类温度排序（head > body > tail）。摘要未说明与其他分割方法的对比实验或消融实验。

Limitations: 1. 场景为实验室大鼠热成像，与遥感/卫星/航空影像完全无关；2. 任务为语义分割而非目标检测；3. 未涉及任何轻量化/部署方法；4. 未报告模型复杂度、推理速度等部署指标；5. 未与其他分割方法对比；6. 数据集规模较小（1,655帧），且为特定动物物种，泛化性有限。

Ideas for my research: 1. 该论文展示了"原始辐射温度矩阵直接用于像素级分割"的思路，可类比遥感中"原始辐射定标数据（如SAR原始回波、热红外DN值）直接用于检测/分割"的预处理策略，提示在轨处理中可减少color-mapped渲染环节以降低计算开销；2. U-Net在小型数据集上通过subject-level交叉验证获得稳定性能，可作为遥感小样本场景下分割/检测骨干的参考；3. 数据集构建中"标签与物理温度直接配准"的思想，可迁移到遥感标注中"标签与辐射定标值配准"的规范设计。总体而言，借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Infrared thermography provides a contact-free, restraint-free method to record surface temperatures. It serves as a valuable marker for thermoregulatory responses in laboratory animal stress and pharmacology research. However, the analysis of these images is currently bottlenecked by the manual delineation of anatomical regions. To date, no public dataset has provided paired radiometric thermal frames of rats with pixel-level body-part labels. We present a dataset of 1,655 quality-controlled radiometric thermal frames from 25 laboratory rats. Each frame is paired with a dense four-class anatomical segmentation mask (background, head, body, and tail) and the raw $480 \times 640$ temperature matrix (rows $\times$ columns) in degrees Celsius. This ensures every label is registered directly to the physical temperature it describes rather than a color-mapped rendering. The frames originate from two pharmacological cohorts where interventions alter thermoregulation in opposite directions: ethanol, which induces peripheral vasodilation, and ketamine, which affects central thermoregulation. This provides a wide and physiologically diverse range of surface temperature regimes. Aggregated across the dataset, the per-class temperatures follow a head~$>$~body~$>$~tail ordering in physical units. To demonstrate that the data support pixel-level segmentation directly from the radiometric channel, we present an exploratory U-Net segmentation pipeline that attains a subject-level cross-validated mean intersection-over-union of $0.895 \pm 0.006$. The dataset provides a reuse-ready benchmark for thermal semantic segmentation and for downstream physiological and stress-phenotyping analyses.

</details>


### [223] [Predictive Enhancement Calibration for Latent Breast MRI Virtual Contrast Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03612)
*Qin Lei,Hao Wu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出Predictive Enhancement Calibration (PEC)方法，用于从平扫乳腺MRI合成增强图像，通过共享自适应坐标系解决潜在生成器与MRI非标准强度尺度之间的冲突。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于医学影像（乳腺MRI）的对比增强合成，属于医学影像生成领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化部署。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于医学影像生成领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：医学影像对比增强合成（virtual contrast enhancement, VCE）；应用场景：乳腺MRI影像；传感器类型：MRI（磁共振成像）；目标类别：乳腺组织/病灶（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 基于预训练的FLUX latent flow transformer，通过parameter-efficient reference conditioning集成PEC校准模块。PEC在训练时将每对图像映射到共享的case-adaptive坐标系，推理时从平扫图像预测不可用的增强图像上端点。

Lightweight method: 摘要未明确说明轻量化方法。仅提到"parameter-efficient reference conditioning"暗示使用了参数高效的适配方式，但未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等典型轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。且FLUX latent flow transformer属于大规模生成模型，与星上/边缘部署场景不匹配。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：内部MAMA100开发队列（固定内部数据集）；评价指标：MSE、LPIPS（共8个point estimates）；实验设置：source-only VCE设置，包含target round trips隔离表示损失、near-matched conditional models对比PEC与fixed-wide和separate coordinates。

Experiments: 在MAMA100数据集上，PEC在source-only VCE设置下改进了全部8个point estimates，其中MSE和LPIPS指标的配对证据最强。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1) 仅使用单一内部数据集（MAMA100），缺乏外部验证；2) 未报告模型规模、推理速度等部署指标；3) 医学影像生成任务与遥感目标检测任务差异巨大；4) 依赖大规模预训练生成模型（FLUX），计算开销可能很大。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但有以下间接可借鉴点：1) "parameter-efficient reference conditioning"的参数高效适配思想可类比于遥感检测模型中的轻量适配模块设计；2) 坐标校准/归一化思想（case-adaptive coordinate）可类比于遥感影像中不同传感器、不同成像条件下的数据分布对齐问题；3) 训练时隔离表示损失与生成损失的消融策略，可借鉴到轻量化蒸馏实验中用于分离不同损失来源的贡献。但这些借鉴较为间接，整体参考价值有限。

Abstract: Virtual contrast enhancement (VCE) synthesizes enhanced breast MR images from pre-contrast acquisitions. Modern latent generators offer strong image priors, but their bounded natural-image autoencoders conflict with the non-canonical intensity scale of MRI. We show that the upper bound can alter radiomic fidelity before generation, while scaling source and target independently creates a coordinate inconsistency. We propose Predictive Enhancement Calibration (PEC), which represents each pair in a shared, case-adaptive coordinate during training and predicts its unavailable upper endpoint from the pre-contrast image at inference. We integrate PEC with a pretrained FLUX latent flow transformer via parameter-efficient reference conditioning. Target round trips first isolate representation loss before generation; near-matched conditional models then compare PEC with fixed-wide and separate coordinates under comparable training budgets and backbone settings. On the fixed internal MAMA100 development cohort, PEC improves all eight point estimates in this source-only VCE setting, with paired evidence strongest for MSE and LPIPS.\noindent\textbf{Code:} https://github.com/tanlei0/pec-breast-mri-vce

</details>


### [224] [Unsupervised Adversarial Domain Adaptation for Uterine layer Segmentation: From Labeled Cine to Unlabeled Dynamic EPI MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03762)
*Smiti Tripathy,Milauni Desai,Jordina Aviles Verdera,Jana Hutter*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种动态多回波梯度回波EPI框架，在0.55T磁场下同时表征子宫蠕动活动与时间分辨T2*变化，并利用无监督对抗域适应框架将标注的cine MRI分割知识迁移到未标注的动态EPI数据上，实现子宫肌层自动分割与T2*动态分析。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。该论文聚焦于医学影像（子宫MRI）中的生理现象分析，属于医学图像分割与域适应任务，与遥感、卫星、在轨部署、目标检测、轻量化均无直接关联。唯一可借鉴的是其Unet-LSTM架构与无监督域适应方法，但这些属于泛医学影像方法，对遥感目标检测轻量化课题借鉴价值有限。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文是医学影像（子宫MRI）领域的生理现象分析工作，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。虽然域适应和Unet-LSTM架构有一定泛化参考价值，但优先级极低，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：医学图像分割（子宫肌层/结合带/内膜分层）与动态T2*定量分析。应用场景：0.55T低场MRI下的子宫蠕动与组织氧合关联研究。传感器类型：MRI（动态多回波梯度回波EPI）。目标类别：子宫三层结构（myometrium, junctional zone, endometrium）。与遥感场景完全无关。

Model architecture: Unet-LSTM架构，结合多尺度域判别器（multi-scale domain discriminators），用于利用时间维度上的层动态信息进行分割。采用无监督对抗域适应（unsupervised adversarial domain adaptation）框架，将标注的cine MRI分割知识迁移到未标注的动态EPI数据。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。其域适应方法属于迁移学习范畴，与轻量化无直接关系。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。该工作面向医学影像分析，无星上或边缘部署考虑。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：标注的cine MRI与未标注的动态EPI数据（具体样本量摘要未说明，但提到39例病例用于相关性分析）。评价指标：Dice score（0.88）、Jaccard index（0.80）、T2*均值（myometrium 108ms, junctional zone 76ms, endometrium 124ms）。

Experiments: 主要结果：Dice score 0.88，Jaccard index 0.80；三层T2*均值分别为108ms/76ms/124ms；在39例中14例观察到结合带面积与T2*的负相关，首次揭示了结合带收缩与动态T2*变化之间的关联。未提供与基线方法的对比实验或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于医学影像领域。2. 摘要未说明模型复杂度、推理速度等部署指标。3. 未提供域适应方法的详细消融分析。4. 样本量较小（39例），统计显著性有待验证。5. 0.55T低场MRI本身分辨率受限，分割精度可能受限于图像质量。

Ideas for my research: 1. 无监督域适应思想可借鉴：在遥感目标检测中，仿真数据（标注）到真实卫星数据（未标注）的域迁移是一个重要问题，其对抗域适应框架思路可迁移。2. Unet-LSTM结合时间动态信息的架构，对遥感视频序列（如多帧卫星影像）中的运动目标检测有一定参考价值。3. 多尺度域判别器设计可用于遥感场景中不同分辨率/不同传感器间的特征对齐。但整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴点有限。

Abstract: Uterine peristalsis is a key physiological phenomenon responsible for various functions across the menstrual cycle, intimately linked to uterine wall microstructure. Alterations in uterine motion and tissue properties are implicated in the etiology of gynecological diseases, yet these processes have been studied in isolation. We introduce a dynamic multi-echo gradient echo EPI framework for simultaneous characterization and correlation of uterine peristaltic activity and time-resolved T2* changes at 0.55T. Inherent susceptibility artifacts, reduced resolution, and burden of manual uterine layer annotation are addressed by an unsupervised adversarial domain adaptation framework, transferring segmentation knowledge from labeled cine MRI to unlabeled dynamic EPI. We implemented Unet-LSTM with multi-scale domain discriminators that exploits temporal layer dynamics. A Dice score of 0.88 and Jaccard index of 0.80 was achieved. Mean T2* values were 108ms, 76ms, and 124ms for the myometrium, junctional zone, and endometrium. A negative correlation between junctional zone area and T2* was observed in 14/39 cases, providing first insights into oxygenation patterns associated with junctional zone contraction and motion, demonstrating feasibility of assessing the interplay between contractility and dynamic T2* changes.

</details>

### [225] [ISEE: Interactive Semantic Enrichment for Database Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02604)
*Yuan Tian,Yiru Chen,Rakesh R. Menon,Zifan Liu,Ting Cai,Fei Wu,Anudeep Chimakurthi,Prashanthi Ramamurthy,Sridevi Aishwariya Ganesan,Kun Qian,Yunyao Li*

Experiments: 摘要仅概述了实验方式（用户研究、自动化用户模拟、定量评估、案例研究），未给出具体实验结果数值或对比方法细节。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：ISEE中"通过评分系统衡量数据质量并协作增强语义"的思路，在遥感数据集标注质量评估或数据清洗场景中或许有概念性参考，但与本课题（在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化）的核心技术路线无实质关联。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly being deployed for data-related tasks, including data sense-making, exploration, and retrieval. However, their performance heavily depends on the clarity and completeness of data semantics. In practice, many field descriptions remain ambiguous or incomplete, as much of the essential context (e.g., the meaning of a customized field) originates from users' domain knowledge and is rarely documented publicly. This gap restricts the agents' task performance in downstream tasks, such as entity-linking. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel and comprehensive Interactive SEmantic Enrichment system (ISEE). Given a data field description, ISEE measures its quality through a scoring system, gathers domain knowledge, and collaboratively enriches the semantics with users. Through a user study, automated user simulation, quantitative evaluation, and case study, we demonstrate that ISEE significantly reduces cognitive load, improves description quality, and enhances downstream task performance.

### [226] [Self-Organising Digital Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02606)
*Marcello Barylli,Gabriel Béna,Alexander Mordvintsev,Eleni Nisioti,Sebastian Risi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种受生物自组织启发的自组织数字电路（Self-Organising Digital Circuits）方法，利用拓扑掩码Transformer配置布尔门查找表（LUT），将功能逻辑生成与维护建模为图上的元学习问题，实现电路从零自组装、故障快速重路由与软错误近完美恢复。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛机器学习/数字硬件容错领域，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化均无直接关联。其核心是生物自组织启发的数字电路容错与逻辑重配置，属于泛视觉/泛机器学习方法，对在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化方向仅可能有间接的方法论借鉴（如图结构上的元学习、容错重配置思想），但并非遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测或模型压缩。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于数字硬件容错与生物自组织计算领域。仅对星上硬件容错鲁棒性设计有极间接的方法论启发，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：数字电路的功能逻辑生成与故障容错（fault tolerance）；应用场景：经典计算硬件容错，非遥感/卫星场景；传感器类型：不适用（摘要未涉及）；目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 采用拓扑掩码Transformer（topology-masked Transformer）配置电路布尔门的查找表（Lookup Tables, LUT）；扩展了Neural Cellular Automata (NCA)的模式生成范式，将功能逻辑生成与维护建模为图上的元学习（meta-learning）问题。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等传统模型轻量化方法。其"轻量"相关思想体现在：通过自组织方式在退化布尔搜索空间中高效配置电路逻辑，避免静态硬件冗余，实现动态重配置以维持功能——这与模型压缩/加速无直接关系。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。论文面向的是数字硬件容错（digital hardware fault tolerance），而非星上/边缘部署的深度学习模型推理加速，因此不具备直接的星上部署可行性分析。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标包括：软错误恢复准确率（>99.99% accuracy）、跨电路规模泛化能力（accuracy improves on graphs substantially wider than training）。

Experiments: 实验验证了：1) 从零自组装功能电路（self-assemble functional circuits from scratch）；2) 对永久性、未见过的硬件故障进行快速逻辑重路由（rapidly re-route logic around permanent faults）；3) 软错误（soft errors）下近完美恢复（>99.99% accuracy），且损伤规模远超训练条件；4) 跨电路规模泛化，在比训练时更宽的图上精度提升。摘要未给出与基线方法的详细对比。

Limitations: 摘要未说明：1) 具体电路规模、布尔函数复杂度上限；2) 与经典容错方法（硬件冗余、纠错码）的定量对比；3) 实际硬件实现与能耗开销；4) 是否适用于大规模复杂电路；5) 与遥感/目标检测/模型轻量化完全无关，缺乏可迁移的部署指标。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与遥感目标检测轻量化无直接关联，但可借鉴以下方法论思想：1) 将功能维护建模为图上的元学习问题，可类比于在轨模型面对分布漂移/硬件退化时的自适应重配置；2) 拓扑掩码Transformer的"掩码-重配置"机制，可启发在轨模型针对特定硬件故障（如FPGA/NPU单元失效）的动态路由与容错设计；3) 自组织/自修复思想可迁移到星上推理系统的鲁棒性设计，使模型在部分计算单元损坏时仍能维持检测功能。但这些均为间接启发，非直接可复现方法。

Abstract: Fault tolerance in classical computing has traditionally relied on static strategies like hardware redundancy and error-correcting codes. Biological systems, in contrast, exhibit adaptive plasticity, maintaining function through dynamic re-organisation around damage. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Self-Organising Digital Circuits, framing functional logic generation and maintenance as a meta-learning problem on graphs. Our architecture employs a topology-masked Transformer that configures the Lookup Tables (LUT) of a circuit's Boolean gates. Extending the pattern-generation paradigm of Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), it navigates the degenerate Boolean search space to satisfy a computational task, rather than regenerating a fixed target state. We demonstrate that it can self-assemble functional circuits from scratch and rapidly re-route logic around permanent, previously unseen hardware faults. For soft errors, the policy achieves near-perfect recovery (>99.99\% accuracy) from damage sizes far exceeding training conditions. We further observe generalisation across circuit scales: accuracy improves on graphs substantially wider than those seen during training. This work bridges the principles of biological self-organisation with the practical domain of digital hardware.

</details>


### [227] [Beyond the Hivemind: Escaping LLM Homogeneity via Meta-Persona Anchoring and Sequential Temperature Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02618)
*Tairan Fu,Javier Conde,Carlos Arriaga,Gonzalo Martínez,Pedro Reviriego,Javier Coronado-Blázquez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Meta-Persona Anchoring与Filtered Temperature Scaling (FTS)框架，通过两阶段生成（自选个性化persona锚定 + Top-p过滤与极端温度缩放）来缓解大语言模型中的"Artificial Hivemind"语义坍缩问题，降低模型输出的语义收敛度。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的输出多样性/语义坍缩问题，属于自然语言处理与生成式AI范畴，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测等视觉任务，更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署等轻量化方法。唯一可能的弱关联是"模型压缩"概念（~20B参数模型），但论文并未讨论任何模型压缩或部署优化技术。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题（LLM输出多样性）与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及任何遥感、目标检测或模型压缩技术，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：大语言模型文本生成多样性增强（语义坍缩缓解）。应用场景：开放域对话/文本生成。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉任务）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 两阶段生成框架：(1) Meta-Persona Anchoring——提示模型自选一个独特persona作为生成锚点；(2) Filtered Temperature Scaling (FTS)——双阶段采样筛，先用Top-p过滤保持语法有效性，再对幸存候选施加极端温度缩放（T≥4.0）以探索拓宽的概率分布。评估对象为~20B参数的开源权重LLM。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。虽然提到~20B参数模型，但未讨论模型轻量化或部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量优化、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。其提出的采样策略（Top-p过滤 + 极端温度缩放）属于推理阶段的采样策略调整，不涉及模型本身的轻量化。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：INFINITY-CHAT。评价指标：平均pairwise cosine similarity（语义相似度，从~0.85降至~0.65）、低于0.7阈值的题目占比。实验对象：~20B参数的开源权重模型。

Experiments: 在INFINITY-CHAT数据集上对SOTA开源权重模型（~20B参数）进行评测。结果显示：平均pairwise cosine similarity从~0.85降至~0.65，多数问题低于0.7阈值，显著降低了语义收敛，缩小了人工模式坍缩与人类类型学多样性之间的差距。摘要未提供与基线方法的详细对比表格或消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于NLP生成多样性研究。2. 摘要未说明方法在视觉任务或嵌入式/边缘设备上的适用性。3. 摘要未说明计算开销、推理延迟等实际部署成本。4. 摘要未说明该方法对模型准确率、任务性能（如检测精度）的潜在影响。5. 摘要未提供消融实验和与现有多样性增强方法的系统对比。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限，但可提取两个泛化思路：1) "Persona Anchoring"思想——在遥感目标检测中可类比为"场景先验/上下文锚定"，即根据卫星轨道、传感器类型、成像条件等先验信息为检测模型提供条件化输入，提升特定场景下的检测鲁棒性；2) "Filtered Temperature Scaling"的"过滤-缩放"两阶段思想——在检测模型推理中可类比为"候选框过滤 + 置信度重标定"的两阶段后处理策略。但这些均为非常间接的类比，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Recent studies have identified an ``Artificial Hivemind'' effect in Large Language Models (LLMs) causing models to converge on a narrow, homogenized consensus even for open questions. This semantic collapse limits the diversity of AI, resulting in high inter-response similarity ($\approx 0.80-0.90$) even under high-temperature sampling. In this paper, we propose a novel mitigation framework to increase diversity: Meta-Persona Anchoring combined with Filtered Temperature Scaling (FTS). Our approach utilizes a two-stage generation process: first, the model is prompted to self-select a unique, idiosyncratic persona to anchor its starting point; second, we apply a dual-stage sampling sieve, utilizing Top-$p$ filtering to preserve grammatical validity followed by extreme temperature scaling ($T \ge 4.0$) on the surviving candidates to explore the broadened probability distribution. We evaluate our method using the INFINITY-CHAT dataset on state-of-the-art open weight models under $\sim$20B parameters. Our results demonstrate a significant reduction in semantic convergence, with average pairwise cosine similarity dropping from ($\approx 0.85$) to ($\approx 0.65$). Our scheme achieves a majority of questions below the 0.7 threshold, effectively reducing the gap between artificial mode collapse and human-level typological diversity. We provide our implementation as an open-source framework to enable more diverse and creative AI deployments.

</details>


### [228] [PULSE: An Executable Contract Language for Spatiotemporal Knowledge Graph Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02630)
*Dongxu Yang,Ziyi Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PULSE语言，一种基于Object-Process-Methodology的领域特定语言，用于将知识图谱工程中的状态、观测、约束、流程和假设场景的"执行契约"本地化到单一类型化运行时中，并通过Lean 4形式化验证和大量测试验证其安全性与轨迹一致性。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于知识图谱工程、领域特定语言设计、形式化验证（Lean 4）、时序事件推理与契约本地化，属于知识表示与软件工程/形式化方法领域。虽然文中提到GeoSPARQL、SOSA、SHACL等地理空间标准，以及NOAA IBTrACS（热带气旋轨迹数据集）和cold-chain trace（冷链追踪），但这些仅作为验证场景，并非遥感影像目标检测或星上部署相关。不涉及object detection、remote sensing imagery、pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、FLOPs等任何本方向核心概念。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于知识图谱工程与形式化方法领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测和模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及任何目标检测、遥感影像处理或模型压缩/部署技术，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：知识图谱工程中的领域特定语言设计与形式化验证；应用场景：冷链路追踪、热带气旋轨迹（NOAA IBTrACS）事件推理、标准组合（GeoSPARQL/SOSA/SHACL）；传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: PULSE语言基于Object-Process-Methodology（OPM）启发，在单一类型化运行时中本地化四种操作角色及其写效果。核心包括：evidence non-overwrite（证据不可覆盖）、branch isolation（分支隔离）、grounded multi-subject timers（多主体定时器）、guarded state change（守卫状态变更）、declaration-ranked event ordering（声明排序事件顺序）。外部runner决定证据是否成为权威动作。核心演算提供effect-confinement lemma和六个安全属性，Lean 4验证kernel类比。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量网络设计等任何轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 验证数据集：NOAA IBTrACS（自1980年以来的完整子集，1,476,290个transition-zone pairs，含4,800个采样和12,831个duration-qualified事件）；37,440条生成的时间轨迹；88个测试、3,534个有界检查、32个Lean/Python运行时-内核用例。评价指标：轨迹一致性（trace parity）、与GEOS和事件扫描的一致性、接口覆盖率（GeoSPARQL probes）、十种单字段突变体的区分能力。

Experiments: 主要实验：1) 在37,440条生成时间轨迹上与独立workflow匹配，并能区分十种单字段突变体；2) 在NOAA IBTrACS完整子集上与GEOS和事件扫描在1,476,290个transition-zone pairs上达成一致；3) 通过Lean 4形式化验证kernel类比（positions, evidence, clocks, monitors, atomicity, branch source retention）；4) 88个测试、3,534个有界检查、32个Lean/Python运行时-内核用例；5) 两个独立实现（标准组合和Sismic statechart）复现了测试的冷链路轨迹。

Limitations: 作者明确指出"语言优越性和可用性不在评估范围内"（language superiority and usability remain outside the evaluation）。此外，验证结果仅支持"测试片段"（tested fragment）的契约本地化、安全论证和轨迹一致性，不能推广到完整语言能力。与遥感目标检测和轻量化方向完全无关，无任何可迁移的模型压缩或部署技术。

Ideas for my research: 与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴点极少。可能的间接启发：1) 形式化验证思路（Lean 4）可用于验证轻量化模型在特定硬件上的数值一致性（如量化前后推理结果的一致性保证），但这是非常间接的类比；2) 事件时序推理与轨迹一致性验证方法，若未来涉及在轨多帧目标跟踪或时序检测结果的一致性校验，可能有参考价值。总体而言，不建议投入时间精读。

Abstract: Knowledge graph engineering often distributes accepted state, observations, constraints, processes, and hypothetical scenarios across artifacts whose combined execution contract remains external. We present PULSE, an Object-Process-Methodology-inspired language that localizes four operational roles and their write effects in one typed runtime. Here, modes denote operational roles rather than modal or deontic logic. The implemented contract fixes evidence non-overwrite, branch isolation, grounded multi-subject timers, guarded state change, and declaration-ranked event ordering over time and space; an external runner still decides whether evidence becomes an authoritative move. GeoSPARQL, SOSA, and SHACL remain generated views. A core calculus gives an effect-confinement lemma and six safety properties. Lean 4 checks kernel analogues for positions, evidence, clocks, monitors, atomicity, and branch source retention; 88 tests, 3,534 bounded checks, and 32 Lean/Python runtime-kernel cases bound the implementation claim to the checked cases. First-author implementations of a standards composition and a separate Sismic statechart reproduce the tested cold-chain trace. Across 37,440 generated temporal traces, PULSE matches a separate workflow and distinguishes ten single-field mutants. On the complete NOAA IBTrACS since1980 subset it agrees with GEOS and an event sweep on 1,476,290 transition-zone pairs, including 4,800 sampled and 12,831 duration-qualified events. Project-specific GeoSPARQL probes measure interface coverage. Overall, the results support contract localization, safety arguments, and trace parity for the tested fragment; language superiority and usability remain outside the evaluation.

</details>


### [229] [HyperAgent: Planning and Acting over Tool-Schema Hypergraphs for Tool-Use LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02650)
*Zian Zhai,Xingyu Tan,Gaowang Zou,Xiaoyang Wang,Wenjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HyperAgent，一种基于Tool-Schema超图引导的LLM智能体动态规划与执行框架，通过建模工具间schema级关系来提升复杂任务中的工具使用规划效率。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于LLM智能体工具使用规划方向，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、模型轻量化均无直接关联。既非遥感场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及任何模型压缩或部署优化。仅作为泛机器学习/泛AI方法，对遥感在轨目标检测课题几乎没有直接借鉴价值。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于LLM agent工具规划方向，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化课题基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM agent工具使用规划（tool-use planning）与动态执行。应用场景：通用复杂真实世界任务（AppWorld基准）。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 核心结构包括：(1) Tool-Schema Hypergraph——将工具建模为从输入schema节点到输出schema节点的超边；(2) 任务相关的工具上下文图（tool context graph）；(3) schema感知的任务DAG（Task DAG）；(4) 状态条件工具支持图（state-conditioned tool support graph），通过deficit-oriented expansion动态识别未解决需求并检索支持性生产者工具。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩方法。其优化目标是通过减少冗余API调用、LLM交互次数和token消耗来提升执行效率，属于系统层面的效率优化，而非模型层面的轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。其"效率"体现在减少API调用和token消耗，与硬件部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：AppWorld（LLM agent工具使用基准）。评价指标：任务完成性能（task completion performance）、冗余API调用次数、LLM交互次数、token消耗量。

Experiments: 在AppWorld上与现有agent基线对比，HyperAgent在提升任务完成性能的同时减少了冗余API调用、LLM交互次数和token消耗。摘要未提供具体数值和消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要未说明。但可推断：仅在一个基准（AppWorld）上验证，泛化性存疑；超图构建和动态扩展的计算开销未讨论；与遥感/视觉任务完全无关。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值有限，但有两个概念层面的启发：(1) "deficit-oriented expansion"（缺陷导向扩展）思想——在遥感目标检测中，可类比为针对小目标/难样本的注意力或特征增强机制，识别当前检测器"未解决的需求"并动态补充；(2) 图结构建模工具/模块间关系的思想，可类比于在轻量化检测网络中建模不同模块间的依赖关系以指导剪枝或结构搜索。但整体而言，该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化课题的直接关联性很弱。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external tools to complete complex real-world tasks. However, reliable tool-use planning remains challenging due to the limitations of implicit reasoning and the evolving nature of real-world execution environments. Existing tool-use agents typically rely on LLMs to infer tool compositions from textual descriptions, which can lead to inefficient exploration and unreliable execution in complex tasks. To address these challenges, we model tool relations at the schema level and construct a directed Tool--Schema Hypergraph, in which tools are represented as hyperedges from their required input-schema nodes to their output-schema nodes. Furthermore, we propose HyperAgent, a Tool--Schema Hypergraph-guided framework for dynamic planning and execution. Given a task, HyperAgent first extracts a task-relevant tool context graph and uses it to guide the construction of a schema-aware Task DAG. During execution, HyperAgent dynamically realizes each subtask by constructing a state-conditioned tool support graph through deficit-oriented expansion, which identifies unresolved requirements and retrieves supporting producer tools according to the current agent state. Experiments on AppWorld demonstrate that HyperAgent improves task completion performance while reducing redundant API calls, LLM interactions, and token consumption compared with existing agent baselines.

</details>


### [230] [Explainable AI for the EU Right to Explanation: A Systematic Review of the Law-XAI Translation Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02699)
*Benjamin Fresz,Elena Dubovitskaya,Marco F. Huber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于可解释人工智能（XAI）与欧盟"解释权"法律框架的系统性文献综述，聚焦GDPR第15(1)(h)条和AI法案第86条，提出Addressee/Purpose框架和四阶段操作化蓝图。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文主题是XAI（Explainable AI）与欧盟法律"Right to Explanation"的交叉研究，属于法律-技术交叉领域，不涉及remote sensing、object detection、模型压缩或边缘部署等任何相关技术内容。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议阅读。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明。本文是文献综述而非技术方法论文，未提出任何神经网络模型结构或算法架构。

Datasets and metrics: 数据来源为文献检索：从2643篇初始记录中筛选出57篇全文，其中19篇实质性整合了法律与技术视角。评价指标为文献综述的定性分析维度（法律基础识别、CJEU判例参与度、解释形式与内容区分等），非目标检测领域的mAP、FPS等指标。

Experiments: 作为综述论文，主要"实验"是文献筛选与分类分析：识别出三个问题模式（多数误认GDPR法律基础、少数涉及CJEU Dun & Bradstreet判决、解释形式与内容常被混淆），并提出Addressee/Purpose框架、四阶段操作化蓝图和六个开放研究问题。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关。摘要未涉及任何遥感、目标检测、模型轻量化或部署相关内容。作为综述，其局限性在于跨学科整合不足（仅19/57篇论文实现法律与技术视角的实质整合）。

Ideas for my research: 对本课题无可借鉴的技术想法。唯一可能的间接启发是：如果未来在轨目标检测系统涉及AI决策的可解释性合规问题（如军事或监管场景），可参考其"解释形式与内容区分"的框架思路，但这与本课题的轻量化核心方向无直接关联。

Abstract: When algorithms make or influence consequential decisions---about loan eligibility, hiring, or healthcare---EU law grants affected individuals a Right to Explanation. Yet whether (and how) Explainable AI (XAI) can satisfy this right in practice remains poorly understood, with direct implications for individuals' ability to contest automated decisions that affect their lives. This paper presents a systematic literature review of XAI in the context of the EU Right to Explanation, with particular focus on Art. 15(1)(h) GDPR, Art. 86 AI Act (AIA), and related instruments. We consider papers published from 2024 onwards, as the final version of the AIA was published in July 2024---with Art. 86 being added late. From 2643 initial records identified by a deliberately broad search, we review 57 full texts, of which only 19 papers demonstrate substantive integration of both legal and technical perspectives, showing gaps in the interdisciplinary synthesis of the current regulatory framework. We document three problematic patterns across the corpus: Most misidentify the GDPR legal basis; few engage with the CJEU's Dun & Bradstreet judgment (likely due to publication timing); and the distinction between explanation form (governed by addressee) and content (governed by legal purpose) is often conflated. We conceptualize this as the Addressee/Purpose Framework, propose a four-phase blueprint for operationalization, and identify six concrete open research questions. Without further progress, the Right to Explanation risks remaining a formal obligation without a technically realizable path to compliance.

</details>


### [231] [Predictive Set Theory: A Generative Framework for Cognitive Architecture with Operationalized Core Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02704)
*Yiyang Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Predictive Set Theory (PST)，一个从第一性原理重构认知架构的形式化生成框架，基于传感器恒等函数、集合论状态刷新和三种引用链来推导认知功能，属于认知科学与数学基础理论论文。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文属于认知科学/数学基础/理论神经科学范畴，讨论预测处理理论、贝叶斯认知科学、Russell悖论、Gödel不完备性等哲学与数学问题，不涉及任何计算机视觉、目标检测、遥感图像处理或模型压缩技术。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化研究方向完全无关，属于认知科学/数学基础理论论文，无任何技术借鉴价值。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：认知架构的形式化理论构建；应用场景：认知科学、数学基础、理论神经科学；传感器类型：不涉及（文中"传感器"为抽象认知概念，非遥感传感器）；目标类别：不涉及。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何部署场景，无参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及实验数据集或评价指标，属于纯理论性论文。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题无可借鉴点。该论文属于认知科学与数学基础领域，与遥感图像处理、目标检测、模型压缩完全无关。不建议投入时间阅读。

Abstract: Predictive processing theories portray the brain as a hierarchical prediction engine that minimizes prediction error, yet they lack operational definitions for the structure of a "prediction," the standardized response to a prediction error, and the mechanism that maintains consistency across successive updates. Bayesian cognitive science attempts to subsume all uncertainty under probabilistic belief updating, but it presupposes a closed hypothesis space and provides no generative account of how the objects over which probabilities are distributed become discrete, identifiable referents in the first place. This paper introduces Predictive Set Theory (PST), a formal generative framework that reconstructs cognitive architecture from first principles. PST anchors cognition in a minimal set of operations---a sensor formalized as an identity function, set-theoretic state refresh, and three fundamental forms of reference chains (reference, counter-reference, and semi-reference)---and rigorously derives core cognitive functions including state sequences, demand, comparison, efficiency, and finite-horizon probabilistic planning. Rather than modeling neural mechanisms, PST constitutes a design specification for any system that must maintain internal consistency while acting under incomplete information and irreversible risk. The framework offers novel resolutions to classical problems such as Russell's paradox, the cognitive status of Gödelian incompleteness, the grounding of negative feedback, and the comprehension of film editing. The primary purpose of this paper is to establish, through the public academic record, the originality and completeness of the Predictive Set Theory framework.

</details>


### [232] [Towards a new paradigm of scientific discovery with socialized artificial intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02775)
*Xinjie Yao,Xingxin Xu,Xiyuan Gao,Zhoupeng Guo,Kunlong Yang,Dengyu Zhao,Siqi Zhao,Zhihe Fan,Yichen Dong,Xin Li,Jiekang Feng,Jiahe Wu,Sen Wang,Beiming Yu,Kejia Zhao,Ruipu Zhao,Jiaqi Zhou,Heyang Li,Jianjun Chen,Anbo Dai,Xin Liu,Zhengtao Yu,Qinghua Hu,Pengfei Zhu*

TL;DR: 提出BLAZE（Bridging Literature, Agents, and Zero-gap Experimentation）范式，将AI视为组织化科学发现的基础设施，通过连接知识、推理、实验与人类判断构建"社会化科学智能"。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文讨论的是科学发现的组织范式与AI基础设施，属于科学哲学/科学方法论与AI Agent的交叉领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于科学方法论/科学智能范式层面的论述，不涉及任何目标检测、遥感或模型压缩技术，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：科学发现的组织范式构建（socialized scientific intelligence）。应用场景：科学研究流程管理、知识组织、实验验证。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构。BLAZE是一个概念性范式框架，涉及persistent knowledge、collective reasoning、empirical validation、human judgment等组件，但未给出任何网络架构或算法实现细节。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关信息。

Experiments: 摘要未说明。未提供任何实验设置、对比方法或消融实验结果。

Limitations: 该论文为概念性/范式性论述，摘要中缺乏具体技术实现、实验验证和量化评估。与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化方向无任何直接关联，无法提供可复现的技术细节。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：论文强调将AI嵌入持续的研究生命周期中，这或许可以类比为在轨模型的自适应持续学习/增量更新思路——即遥感卫星在轨检测模型不应是一次性部署的静态系统，而应具备持续学习、知识积累和在线验证的能力。但这一启发非常间接，且论文本身未涉及任何相关技术细节。

Abstract: Scientific discovery has advanced through successive transformations in the organization of knowledge. Observation and experimentation established the empirical foundations of science. Theory made it possible to derive general principles from particular phenomena. Computation extended inquiry into systems beyond direct observation, while data-intensive methods opened new spaces of pattern and prediction. Science now confronts a different frontier. The central challenge is no longer simply to produce more information, but to organize expanding knowledge, reasoning, and evidence into a coherent process of discovery. Here, we introduce Bridging Literature, Agents, and Zero-gap Experimentation (BLAZE), a paradigm of socialized scientific intelligence. BLAZE conceives AI not as an assistant for isolated research tasks, but as an organizational infrastructure for scientific discovery. It connects persistent knowledge, collective reasoning, empirical validation, and human judgment within a continuous research lifecycle, transforming fragmented activities into a cumulative process of inquiry, criticism, and revision. The central premise of BLAZE is that scientific intelligence does not arise from computation alone. It emerges from the sustained interaction among knowledge, hypotheses, experiments, and collective verification. By organizing humans and machines within a shared scientific process, BLAZE makes discovery more traceable, reproducible, and cumulative while preserving human creativity, judgment, and responsibility. Socialized scientific intelligence may provide a foundation for the next era of science. Its purpose is not to replace human discovery, but to extend the scale, depth, and continuity of collective scientific inquiry.

</details>


### [233] [BAP-SQL: Budget-Aware Observation Planning for Agentic Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02876)
*Chong Peng,Pin Qian,Su Wang,Yihang Chen,Varun Sah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出BAP-SQL，将观测形成视为预算控制阶段，通过查询风险评估、SQL重写和独立运行时防护来优化agentic text-to-SQL在紧预算下的成功率。

Research relevance: 1分，基本无关。论文聚焦agentic text-to-SQL（文本到SQL查询生成），属于自然语言处理与数据库交互领域，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。虽然涉及"budget control"和"token效率"等概念，但这是指上下文预算和数据库查询开销，并非模型参数量、FLOPs或推理延迟等部署层面的轻量化。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测与轻量化方向基本无关，属于NLP/数据库领域。除非对"budget-aware推理"的抽象思想感兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：agentic text-to-SQL（智能体文本转SQL查询）。应用场景：数据库查询、自然语言接口。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用（处理的是SQL查询与数据库行数据）。

Model architecture: BAP-SQL框架包含三个组件：查询风险评估（query risk estimation）、SQL重写（SQL rewriting）、独立运行时防护（independent runtime shield）。在4B通用模型、FINER-SQL 4B专用模型和7B模型三个骨干上验证。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明传统模型压缩方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。论文的"budget control"指上下文token预算和数据库查询开销控制，通过SQL重写减少token消耗（节省4.5-5.0% token），但这不是模型轻量化，而是推理时的输入/查询优化策略。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。模型规模为4B和7B参数级别，远超出星上部署的典型约束范围。token节省（4.5-5.0%）属于上下文效率优化，与边缘/星上推理加速无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：BIRD（衍生设置，BIRD-derived setting）作为主要评测基准。指标：tight-budget success（紧预算成功率）、token使用量（减少4.5/5.0%）、SFT匹配重训练（matched retraining）、任务级迁移（task-level transfer）。

Experiments: 在4B通用、FINER-SQL 4B、7B三个骨干上验证BAP-SQL。在BIRD衍生设置中，相比matched SFT提升3.4/3.6个百分点，同时减少4.5/5.0% token。消融/分析表明增益来自policy-visible planning和budget-sensitive rescue。随着模型能力和预算增加，收益衰减，在最宽松设置下出现反转，且不减少数据库工作量。

Limitations: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关。摘要未涉及任何视觉任务、遥感数据、目标检测或模型压缩技术。收益在宽松预算下反转，说明方法适用场景有限。4B/7B模型规模也不适合星上部署。

Ideas for my research: 弱借鉴点有限，但可抽象出两个思路：(1) "budget-aware"思想——在推理时根据输入复杂度动态调整计算路径/特征提取范围，类似地可在遥感目标检测中根据图像复杂度动态选择轻量/重量分支；(2) "runtime shield"独立防护机制——类似地可在轻量化检测模型中设置独立的异常检测/兜底模块，防止轻量模型在困难样本上失效。但这些均为间接启发，需自行转化到视觉检测场景。

Abstract: Tool-using agents do not merely consume observations: their actions determine what arrives next. In agentic text-to-SQL, a broad query can spend context and database work before useful evidence appears, while post-hoc compression cannot recover omitted rows or expended work. We present BAP-SQL, which treats observation formation as a budget-control stage: it estimates query risk, rewrites SQL when useful, and delegates hard limits to an independent runtime shield. Across general 4B, specialized FINER-SQL 4B, and 7B backbones, BAP-SQL improves tight-budget success. On the primary BIRD-derived setting, it gains 3.4/3.6 percentage points over matched SFT while using 4.5/5.0% fewer tokens. Matched retraining and task-level transfer associate the gain with policy-visible planning and budget-sensitive rescue. The benefit attenuates as model capability and budget increase, reverses at the loosest setting, and does not reduce database work.

</details>

*Yu-Tung Liu,Cunxi Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VeriTrace多智能体系统，通过扩展调试动作空间（Agentic Temporal Exploration）实现Verilog RTL自动生成100% Pass@1，解决LLM在硬件代码生成基准上的精度瓶颈。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于LLM驱动的Verilog RTL硬件代码自动生成与调试，属于电子设计自动化（EDA）与AI for Hardware领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化中的任何核心要素。相关性评分为1分。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务：基于LLM的Verilog RTL代码自动生成与多智能体调试。场景：硬件电路设计自动化（EDA）。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用（对象为Verilog代码/电路行为）。

Model architecture: VeriTrace多智能体系统，包含Inspector agent，其核心能力是Agentic Temporal Exploration——对信号选择（signal selection）、时间窗口边界（time-window bounds）和迭代深度（iteration depth）进行独立控制，形成假设-查询波形-迭代精化的调试循环。基于Claude Sonnet 4.0 backbone。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。虽然涉及硬件（Verilog RTL），但方向是代码生成而非模型部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署指标。该论文面向的是LLM推理生成硬件代码，而非在轨/边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：VerilogEval-V2基准。指标：Pass@1（功能正确率）。对比基线：最强复现基线（Claude Sonnet 4.0 backbone上的多智能体系统），VeriTrace相对提升+5.1%，达到100% Pass@1。

Experiments: VeriTrace在VerilogEval-V2上达到100% Pass@1，是首个在该基准上实现完美功能正确率的系统；在共享Claude Sonnet 4.0 backbone下，比最强复现基线提升+5.1%。摘要未提供消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要未说明。潜在局限：仅验证于单一基准（VerilogEval-V2）；依赖特定LLM backbone（Claude Sonnet 4.0）；多智能体系统的推理成本与延迟未讨论；未涉及真实硬件综合验证。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感目标检测轻量化无直接关系，但其"Agentic Temporal Exploration"思想有一定间接启发：1）多智能体协作与迭代精化机制可类比于检测模型的多阶段refinement策略；2）"扩展动作空间而非模式匹配"的思想可类比于在目标检测中引入更丰富的上下文探索而非固定感受野；3）若未来在轨智能需LLM辅助决策，其多智能体架构可参考。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Large language models have shown promise for automated Verilog RTL generation, yet state-of-the-art multi-agent systems plateau at ~95% accuracy on standard benchmarks. We trace this ceiling to an incomplete debugging action space: existing systems restrict which signals the agent can inspect, which time windows it can query, or both, reducing debugging to pattern matching on a narrow, predetermined view of circuit behavior rather than hypothesis-driven root-cause analysis. We present VeriTrace, a multi-agent system whose Inspector agent operates over a complete debugging action space, with independent control over signal selection, time-window bounds, and iteration depth. This capability, which we term Agentic Temporal Exploration, enables the agent to form hypotheses about failure causes, query the waveform for evidence, and refine its understanding iteratively, mirroring the exploratory process of human verification engineers. VeriTrace achieves 100\% Pass@1 on VerilogEval-V2, the first system to attain perfect functional correctness on this benchmark. On a shared Claude Sonnet 4.0 backbone, VeriTrace outperforms the strongest reproduced baseline by +5.1%, demonstrating that debugging agency closes the final accuracy gap.

</details>

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于LLM可解释性/NLP领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测任务或面向部署的轻量化方法，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM可解释性/归因分析（sentence-level attribution interpretation）。应用场景：闭源大语言模型API的负责任部署与可解释性。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉任务）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 核心框架包含两部分：(1) Energy-Based Model (EBM)作为代理模型，用于捕捉LLM在prompt与response之间的内部概念一致性；(2) 轻量级interpreter网络，基于EBM的能量景观进行训练，用于量化prompt句子对目标输出的影响。解释器是独立工具，训练完成后无需再查询LLM API。

Lightweight method: 文中提到"lightweight interpreter network"，但摘要未说明具体轻量化技术手段（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。这里的"lightweight"更多指解释器网络本身规模较小，而非面向部署的模型压缩方法。摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟等部署指标。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。该论文不涉及星上部署、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等任何硬件部署相关内容。虽然解释器训练完成后可独立运行（无需API查询），但这是针对LLM解释场景的推理效率优化，与遥感在轨部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。仅提及"Experiments demonstrate that our EBM accurately simulates the target LLM"，但未给出具体实验数据集、评估协议或量化指标。

Experiments: 摘要仅概述实验结论：EBM能准确模拟目标LLM，解释器能有效识别对特定目标输出最具影响力的prompt句子。未提供具体对比方法、消融实验或定量结果。

Limitations: (1) 摘要未说明解释器在长文本、多轮对话等复杂场景下的泛化能力；(2) 未讨论EBM代理模型与真实LLM之间的保真度误差对解释质量的影响；(3) 未提供计算开销、训练成本等效率指标；(4) 与遥感目标检测和轻量化部署方向完全无关。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测无关，但存在一些可迁移的间接思路：(1) "代理模型(surrogate model) + 轻量解释器"的框架思想，可类比于在遥感目标检测中训练一个轻量代理模型来模拟大模型的行为，但这一思路更接近知识蒸馏(Knowledge Distillation)的范畴，而蒸馏本身已是成熟方法；(2) "训练完成后无需额外推理开销"的独立工具设计理念，与在轨部署中"训练离线、推理在轨"的范式有概念上的相似性。总体而言，借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: The widespread adoption of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) accessed strictly through closed APIs has created a critical challenge for responsible deployment: a fundamental lack of interpretability. To address this, we propose a model-agnostic, post-hoc attribution interpreter operating at the sentence level. Our approach trains an Energy-Based Model (EBM) as a surrogate to capture the LLM's internal conceptual consistency between prompts and responses. This energy landscape guides the training of a lightweight interpreter network. Uniquely, our interpreter operates as a standalone tool; once trained, it quantifies the influence of prompt sentences on a user-specified target output without requiring further API queries to the LLM. By globally training a local interpreter across diverse inputs, our framework captures broader generation patterns and mitigates instance-specific biases. Experiments demonstrate that our EBM accurately simulates the target LLM, allowing the interpreter to effectively identify the prompt sentences most influential in generating specific target outputs.

</details>

Experiments: 摘要未说明实验设置。论文包含二元情形（binary case）的完整推导、三元超立方体（ternary hypercube）的显式处理，以及约简机制（reduction machinery）的展开说明，但这些都是理论分析而非实验验证。

Limitations: 论文属于纯理论/逻辑学研究，与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化完全无关。摘要未说明任何与工程应用、部署或视觉任务相关的信息。即使从泛机器学习角度，其贡献也偏向概念学习理论而非可迁移的检测或压缩方法。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值极低。唯一可能的间接启发是"复杂度局部化"（complexity is localized）这一思想——即概念/特征空间的复杂度并非均匀分布，这或许在直觉上提示：在遥感目标检测中，不同目标类别或不同场景区域的检测难度可能高度不均匀，轻量化时可以针对"高复杂度区域"保留更多容量、对"低复杂度区域"激进压缩。但这仅是一种非常间接的哲学类比，不具备直接可操作性。

Abstract: We revisit higher-arity atomic concept learning through the geometry of hypercubes and hyperplanes of ground instances. Our starting point is the observation that the ambient r-dimensional hypercube of ground atoms is not structurally uniform. Its logical complexity is organized by hyperplanes: every hyperplane other than the full diagonal collapses into finitely many elementary-equivalence classes, with a bound independent of the term depth, while the full diagonal is exceptional and its class count grows without bound. This asymmetry is not merely geometric. It reflects the reduction-theoretic structure of the concepts themselves. Building on a higher-dimensional framework developed in the author's earlier work, we reinterpret these results through canonical simple concepts, minimal orderings, and representative reductions. This yields a taxonomy of hyperplane behavior in higher dimensions and shows that complexity is localized rather than spread uniformly through the instance space. The paper includes a fully worked binary case, an explicit treatment of the ternary hypercube, and an unpacked account of the reduction machinery that drives the collapse. The three-dimensional case already exhibits the essential phenomenon of orthogonal families, partial diagonals, and the exceptional full diagonal. This geometric-logical perspective clarifies where complexity is concentrated in atomic concept learning and suggests a modern interpretation in terms of constrained hypothesis spaces and structured classification.

</details>


### [237] [When Compression Scores Cannot Decide: Information Boundaries for Group-Robust LLM Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02940)
*Andrew Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究的是密集剪枝（dense pruning）中压缩统计量（compression statistic）选择候选端点的问题，提出通过信息接口（information interfaces）建模统计量选择与真实损伤之间的差距，并给出群组级（group-level）剪枝分配与端点选择的改进方法。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的密集剪枝统计量选择与群组分配问题，属于泛机器学习/模型压缩方法研究，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务。虽然涉及pruning（剪枝）这一轻量化手段，但研究对象是LLM而非遥感目标检测模型，且未涉及在轨部署、边缘部署或实时推理。

Reading priority: 2分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向弱相关，主要价值在于剪枝方法论层面的启发（如统计量可靠性、群组级分配），但研究对象是LLM而非遥感检测模型，且缺乏部署相关指标，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：密集剪枝（dense pruning）中的候选端点选择与群组级分配优化。应用场景：大语言模型（LLM）压缩，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 研究对象为多个密集LLM（three dense LLMs）以及OLMoE（混合专家模型）。核心概念包括：压缩统计量（compression statistic）、信息接口（information interfaces）、群组局部矩（group-local moments）、参考路径曲率（reference-path curvature）、完整掩码端点（complete-mask endpoint）、路由器轨迹（router traces）。

Lightweight method: 涉及dense pruning（密集剪枝）方法，具体包括：压缩统计量的可复现性（split-half reliability）评估、群组级深度分配（coarse depth allocation）、完整掩码端点选择（complete-mask endpoint selection）、群组分辨对角恢复（group-resolved diagonal recovery）。但未涉及量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS或边缘/星上部署。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。研究对象为LLM，与星上/边缘部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标包括：split-half reliability（0.906）、Spearman相关系数（0.9239）、worst-group perplexity inflation（最差群组困惑度膨胀）、worst-group KL reduction（13.7%和7.2%）、增益百分比（16.1%、6.0%、7.7%、2.7–8.0%、12.6–20.9%）。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：1）可复现的压缩统计量（split-half reliability 0.906）预测16.1%增益，但其选出的端点比两个对照组差6.0%和7.7%；2）群组分辨对角恢复可恢复大致损伤顺序（Spearman 0.9239）但精细顺序仍弱；3）粗粒度深度分配相比均衡均匀分配，在三个密集LLM上将最差群组困惑度膨胀降低12.6–20.9%；4）模型特定的完整掩码端点选择比参考方法提升2.7–8.0%；5）在OLMoE中，路由器轨迹预测单方向（114/192对比81/192）；6）单层有限菜单决策带来held-out最差群组KL降低13.7%和7.2%。

Limitations: 1）与遥感、卫星、目标检测完全无关，属于LLM压缩领域；2）摘要未说明具体数据集、模型规模、计算开销等关键信息；3）方法针对LLM的群组级剪枝设计，其"群组"概念（如层、专家）与遥感目标检测中的通道/层剪枝场景差异较大；4）未涉及任何部署硬件（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT）或实时性验证。

Ideas for my research: 1）"可复现的压缩统计量仍可能选出错误候选"这一发现对遥感目标检测模型的剪枝有警示意义——不能仅依赖单一统计量（如L1范数、BN缩放因子）选择剪枝通道，应结合完整端点评估或群组级验证；2）"信息接口"建模统计量与真实损伤之间差距的思路，可迁移到遥感检测模型剪枝中，用于解释为何某些重要性评分在特定层/通道上失效；3）群组级（group-level）分配策略（如按层或按检测头分组）可借鉴到遥感目标检测模型的非均匀剪枝中，避免均匀剪枝导致小目标检测性能骤降；4）"完整候选端点选择"思想提示在遥感检测模型轻量化时，应评估剪枝后完整模型的端到端mAP而非仅看中间统计量。

Abstract: A reproducible compression statistic can still select the wrong candidate. A dense pruning score with 0.906 split-half reliability predicted a 16.1% gain. Its selected endpoint was 6.0% and 7.7% worse than two controls. We model the gap through information interfaces that delimit which distinctions each statistic supports. For equal-weight groups, a conic law gives the exact pooling price for positive linear fixed-candidate damage, including diagonal and full PSD second moments. Three two-world constructions and an exact observation-fiber radius characterize what pooled moments, group-local moments, and reference-path curvature leave unresolved. A group-resolved diagonal recovers broad damage order (Spearman 0.9239) while fine order remains weak. Relative to balanced uniform allocation, a coarse depth allocation cuts worst-group perplexity inflation by 12.6--20.9% across three dense LLMs. Model-specific complete-mask endpoint selection improves over those references by 2.7--8.0%. In OLMoE, router traces predict singleton direction (114/192 versus 81/192 under the strongest relabeling). Finite-menu decisions on one layer yield held-out worst-group KL reductions of 13.7% and 7.2%. Local measurements construct candidates. Selection is licensed by complete candidate endpoints or a validated uniform guarantee, with uncertainty calibrated to every comparison.

</details>


### [238] [When Many Answers Are Valid, Voting Fails: Symbolic Verification for Best-of-K Causal Reasoning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03506)
*Omatharv Bharat Vaidya,Connor Thomas Jerzak,Zayne Rea Sprague,Fangcong Yin,Nhat Ho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CALVER 是一个无需训练的符号验证器，利用 Pearl 因果准则（d-separation、backdoor adjustment、intervention）对结构化推理轨迹打分，从而在因果推理中选择最可靠的答案，替代传统的 plurality voting 或 reward model。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于因果推理/大语言模型推理验证方向，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能均无直接关系；也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测、舰船/飞机/车辆检测等遥感任务；更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、星上部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT 等轻量化与部署技术。唯一可借鉴的点在于其"training-free"（无需训练）的符号验证思路以及"在 CPU 上毫秒级打分"的轻量计算特性，但这与遥感目标检测轻量化方向关联很弱。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文聚焦因果推理验证与 LLM 推理轨迹选择，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感数据、目标检测任务或任何模型压缩/部署技术，仅"training-free + 毫秒级 CPU 打分"的轻量计算特性有极弱的间接借鉴意义，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：因果推理中的答案选择/验证（self-consistency 的改进）。应用场景：大语言模型（LLM）推理轨迹验证、因果结构推理、平均处理效应（ATE）决策。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: CALVER（Causal Axiom-Level VERification）：一个 training-free 的符号验证器，对结构化推理轨迹基于 Pearl 因果准则打分，包括 d-separation、backdoor adjustment、intervention。选择得分最高的候选答案，无需参考标准答案。可扩展为从文本构建因果图（graph from text）的模式，并支持 truth-table checker 下的逻辑泛化。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS 等传统模型压缩方法。但 CALVER 本身是 training-free（无需训练）的符号验证器，且"在 CPU 上毫秒级（milliseconds）对每个候选打分"，具有轻量计算、低资源开销的特性。这属于推理阶段的计算效率优化，而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提到"在 CPU 上毫秒级打分"，说明其计算开销低、可在无 GPU 环境下运行。但该特性面向的是 LLM 推理验证场景，与星上/边缘部署遥感目标检测模型无直接关系。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：CLEAR find-one-valid queries（允许多个图有效答案的查询）、十种已发表的 Bayesian networks、一个第二模型家族、从文本构建图的设置、thresholded average-treatment-effect（ATE）决策任务、truth-table checker 逻辑任务。评价指标：准确率（CALVER 达 42.1%，而 plurality、reward model、LLM judge、model confidence 均约 30%）；audited clean-core 子集中 11/21 个图有效选择与基准答案不同但仍满足谓词。

Experiments: 主要结果：在 CLEAR find-one-valid 查询上 CALVER 达到 42.1%，优于 plurality、reward model、LLM judge、model confidence（均约 30%）；将 judge 扩展到 72B 仍无法缩小差距。audited clean-core 子集中 11/21 个选择与基准答案不同但仍满足谓词。采样预算增大时优势扩大；在十种 Bayesian networks、第二模型家族、从文本构建图等设置中可复现。CALVER 还改进了 thresholded ATE 决策，并泛化到 truth-table checker 下的逻辑任务。

Limitations: 摘要未说明：模型参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标；未涉及任何遥感/卫星/目标检测场景；未涉及模型压缩或加速方法。核心局限：CALVER 需要因果结构（causal structure），要么直接提供要么从文本构建，这限制了其在缺乏因果结构信息场景下的适用性。与遥感在轨目标检测方向基本无交集。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感目标检测轻量化方向弱相关，但仍有两点可借鉴：1) "training-free" 的验证/选择思路——在遥感目标检测中，可借鉴无需训练的后处理验证机制（如对检测框进行符号化/规则化校验）来提升检测可靠性，避免额外训练开销；2) "在 CPU 上毫秒级打分"的低开销推理思想——可类比于在星上 CPU/低算力环境下追求毫秒级推理的轻量化目标，提示在模型设计时关注计算效率与实时性。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Self-consistency assumes the most frequent answer among sampled reasoning traces is the most reliable, but this can fail in causal reasoning: samples often repeat the same confounding error, and votes fragment across multiple valid answers, letting an invalid answer win despite a valid minority trace. We introduce CALVER (Causal Axiom-Level VERification), a training-free symbolic verifier that scores structured traces against Pearl's causal criteria, including -separation, backdoor adjustment, and intervention, and selects the highest-scoring candidate without consulting a reference answer. On CLEAR find-one-valid queries that admit multiple graph-valid answers, CALVER reaches 42.1% where plurality, a reward model, an LLM judge, and model confidence remain near 30% on identical frozen pools. Scaling the judge to 72B does not close the gap. In an audited clean-core subset, 11 of 21 graph-valid CALVER selections differ from the benchmark's listed answer while still satisfying the requested predicate. The advantage widens with the sampling budget and reproduces across ten published Bayesian networks, a second model family, and settings where the model must build the graph from text. CALVER also improves thresholded average-treatment-effect decisions against exact ground truth, generalizes to logic under a truth-table checker, and scores each candidate in milliseconds on CPU. CALVER needs only a causal structure, supplied outright or built from the text; wherever that holds, selection can aggregate via causal validity.

</details>

Abstract: Latin America is missing two foundational layers of AI infrastructure: the dataset layer and the benchmark layer. This paper targets the dataset layer. The dataset layer faces two compounding problems: discovery and supply. Latin American AI datasets exist but are scattered across platforms with no shared index. Even with perfect indexing, the total volume would remain far below what frontier AI development requires. We propose DataHub: a task-first data infrastructure organized through the ontology /<task?>/<domain?>/<language?>, with mechanisms for dataset discovery, metadata, contribution, licensing, and reuse.

</details>


### [240] [Neurosymbolic Reasoning with Incremental Knowledge for Sample Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02993)
*Subrat Prasad Panda,Blaise Genest,Arvind Easwaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种神经符号分层强化学习框架InK，通过可更新的增量知识表示进行符号规划（如D*），结合低层目标条件神经模块学习运动原语，以提升稀疏奖励长程推理环境下的样本效率。
