Experiments: 在导航任务上进行了实验，结果表明引入InK（增量知识）能显著提升样本效率。摘要未给出具体对比方法、消融实验细节或量化结果。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。主要缺口包括：未涉及遥感/卫星场景；未涉及目标检测任务；未涉及模型压缩或部署优化；实验仅限导航任务，泛化性未知。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴价值有限，但可考虑以下间接启发：(1) 神经符号混合架构的思想——在遥感目标检测中，可将领域先验知识（如目标几何约束、场景语义）以符号形式注入轻量检测网络，减少对大规模数据依赖；(2) 增量知识更新的思路——在轨场景中模型可随新观测数据增量更新知识，而非固定不变；(3) 分层设计思想——高层做全局规划/场景理解、低层做局部检测的层次化结构，可能有助于在轨计算资源受限时的任务分解。但这些均为间接启发，需自行迁移到检测与轻量化语境。

Abstract: (Flat) Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents face significant challenges in environments with sparse rewards that require long-horizon reasoning. A compelling approach to improve sample efficiency is to incorporate knowledge into learning and decision-making. In standard Hierarchical RL (HRL), knowledge is encoded in a fixed, non-updatable form, such as architectural choices, and remains unchanged throughout learning. With fixed HRL, reasoning with incremental knowledge learned during exploration is impractical before sufficient environmental knowledge is acquired, leading to poor sample efficiency. In this work, we propose neurosymbolic HRL with {\em Incremental Knowledge (InK)}: symbolic high-level components perform {\em symbolic planning} (e.g. using $D^*$) on an updatable representation of current InK, while low-level goal-conditioned neural modules learn motion primitives through experience using reward shaping. Experiments on navigation tasks demonstrate that incorporating InK substantially improves sample efficiency. Additionally, to perform {\em optimal} symbolic planning given {\em prior} knowledge about the world, we develop Belief World Tree Search. The code is available at https://github.com/CPS-research-group/ink_bwts.

</details>


### [241] [On the missing benchmarks layer and a potential solution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02996)
*Francis F Daniel,Mauro Ibañez,Francis Perelman,Marian Basti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出面向拉丁美洲的AI基准测试基础设施EvalsHub/LatamBoard，用于审计和优化AI系统，与遥感目标检测和轻量化完全无关。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文讨论的是拉丁美洲AI基准测试基础设施（benchmark infrastructure），属于AI治理、评估与区域化优化领域，不涉及remote sensing、object detection、卫星、在轨部署或模型压缩等任何相关主题。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为区域AI基准测试基础设施，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化研究方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：AI基准测试与评估基础设施构建；应用场景：拉丁美洲区域AI治理与产业优化；传感器类型：不涉及；目标类别：不涉及。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构。论文提出的是EvalsHub/LatamBoard基准测试平台架构，而非神经网络模型架构。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要未提及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络或任何模型压缩/加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 不涉及。摘要未提及星上部署、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存或能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要提出构建基准测试（benchmark）基础设施，但未说明具体数据集名称、评价指标或实验设置。属于平台/框架层面的概念性提案。

Experiments: 摘要未说明实验设置、对比方法或消融实验。论文处于概念提案阶段，未报告任何实验结果。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但明显缺乏与遥感、目标检测、轻量化相关的任何技术细节，且未提供实验验证。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义极为有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：论文强调"benchmark layer"对AI系统评估与优化的价值，这提示在遥感在轨目标检测轻量化研究中，建立标准化的评估基准（如统一的轻量化指标对比框架）可能有助于系统化衡量pruning/quantization等方法的收益。但整体上对本课题无直接可复现的技术借鉴。

Abstract: Latin America is missing a foundational layer for native AI development: the benchmark layer. The benchmark layer does two things no other layer can - it audits AI systems against regional social requirements and it directs AI optimization in economically relevant environments. Without it, public institutions cannot independently evaluate foreign AI systems, and companies cannot optimize AI systems to solve local problems with SOTA performance. The cost of the missing layer is dual: a loss of auditability and a loss of optimization direction over a technology that is increasingly critical infrastructure. We propose an EvalsHub, with LatamBoard as its first regional instance - an open, task-first benchmark infrastructure where universities, public institutions, professional communities, and companies can publish, execute, compare, and maintain evaluations across models, workflows, and agents. Built once, measured forever - re-run by institutions as new AI systems ship and by industry teams after every system change. Open by design and incentive-driven by construction.

</details>


### [242] [ProPRL: Property-Aware Prerequisite Relation Learning in Educational Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03006)
*Xinghe Cheng,Jiapu Wang,Chaobo He,Ruihai Dong,Quanlong Guan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ProPRL框架，通过概念-资源超图与有向学习行为图的双视图表示学习、Pair-conditioned Gate自适应融合以及Irreversibility Constraint反对称正则化，提升教育领域先修关系学习的性能。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文属于教育数据挖掘/知识图谱领域的先修关系学习（prerequisite relation learning），不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或任何模型压缩/加速技术。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于教育数据挖掘领域，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：先修关系学习（prerequisite relation learning），属于教育数据挖掘/知识图谱链接预测任务。应用场景：自适应教学（adaptive instruction）。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感数据）。目标类别：概念对（concept pairs）之间的先修关系。

Model architecture: ProPRL框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 从概念-资源超图（concept-resource hypergraph）和有向学习行为图（directed learning-behavior graph）学习互补的概念表示，其中采用方向保持的个性化传播（direction-preserving personalized propagation）聚合多跳行为证据；(2) Pair-conditioned Gate用于对每个候选有序概念对自适应加权融合两个视图；(3) Irreversibility Constraint引入反对称正则化（anti-symmetry regularizer），惩罚同一概念对两个方向同时高置信度的情况。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（如剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息，且该任务本身与星上/边缘部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 在多个真实世界教育数据集（multiple real-world educational datasets）上进行实验，具体数据集名称摘要未说明。评价指标摘要未说明，但先修关系学习领域通常使用AUC、Accuracy、F1等链接预测指标。

Experiments: 实验表明ProPRL在先修关系学习任务上达到state-of-the-art性能。具体对比方法、消融实验细节摘要未说明。

Limitations: 摘要未说明。但可推断：该工作聚焦教育领域，未涉及遥感图像处理、目标检测或模型轻量化；其图神经网络方法在遥感场景下的可迁移性存疑。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可能间接相关的点是：Pair-conditioned Gate的自适应特征融合思想，在遥感多传感器（如光学+SAR）特征融合或轻量化检测模型的多尺度特征融合中或有启发，但需要大幅改造。Irreversibility Constraint的反对称正则化思想在旋转框检测的角度回归中可能有类比意义，但关联较弱。

Abstract: Prerequisite relation learning is central to adaptive instruction, yet existing methods often formulate it as conventional link prediction, limiting their ability to adaptively integrate complementary educational evidence for individual candidate pairs and to discourage contradictory reverse predictions. We propose ProPRL, a Property-aware Prerequisite Relation Learning framework. ProPRL first learns complementary concept representations from a concept-resource hypergraph and a directed learning-behavior graph, where direction-preserving personalized propagation aggregates multi-hop behavioral evidence. It then employs a Pair-conditioned Gate to adaptively weight and fuse the two views for each candidate ordered concept pair. Finally, an \textit{Irreversibility Constraint} introduces an anti-symmetry regularizer that penalizes simultaneously high confidence in both directions of the same concept pair. Experiments on multiple real-world educational datasets show that ProPRL achieves state-of-the-art performance on prerequisite relation learning.

</details>


### [243] [UrbanAgent: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Cross-System Urban Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03018)
*Jiayu Cao,Xingyuan Zeng,feiyu Li,Zhijing Huang,Xujie Yuan,Rongxiang Chen,Shimin Di,Libin Zheng,Jian Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Urban-Agent，一个面向跨系统城市任务的工具增强型智能体框架，结合大语言模型与代码执行、API调用和MCP工具集，并引入Urban-Eval基准来评估任务结果与执行质量。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于城市数字服务、大语言模型智能体（LLM agent）、跨系统工作流执行，属于自然语言处理与智能体领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测或任何视觉检测任务。更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署等轻量化方法。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于LLM智能体与城市服务领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：跨系统城市任务（cross-system urban tasks）的智能体执行，即把自然语言请求转化为可执行的跨系统工作流。应用场景：城市数字服务、城市基础设施管理。传感器类型：不涉及（无遥感/视觉传感器）。目标类别：不涉及目标检测。

Model architecture: Urban-Agent框架：将大语言模型（LLM）的认知与推理能力与工具集（tool-set）耦合，工具集支持代码执行（code execution）、API调用和Model Context Protocol（MCP）。通过一个自适应闭环（adaptive closed loop），在执行前澄清缺失信息、将工具使用锚定在实时观测上、并将最终响应与观测证据和任务约束对齐。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。其核心是LLM智能体框架，与在轨部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 提出Urban-Eval基准，专门用于评估跨系统城市请求。与以往只评估通用工具使用或城市知识与推理的基准不同，Urban-Eval同时评估任务结果（task results）和执行质量（execution quality），包括所需工具覆盖率（tool coverage）、依赖有效性（dependency validity）和证据可追溯性（evidence traceability）。主要指标为任务成功率（task success rate）。

Experiments: 实验结果表明Urban-Agent达到71%的任务成功率，比最强基线高出10个百分点。该优势在GPT-5-mini、Gemini-2.5-flash、DeepSeek-V4-flash和Qwen3-235B-A22B等多个LLM后端上保持一致。

Limitations: 摘要未说明具体局限性。但可推断：该工作聚焦于LLM智能体与工具调用，与遥感目标检测、模型轻量化、在轨部署完全无关；其评估基准Urban-Eval针对城市任务而非遥感场景；未涉及任何视觉感知或目标检测能力。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的可借鉴点非常有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：其"工具增强型智能体"和"自适应闭环"思想若迁移到遥感在轨智能场景，可考虑将轻量化检测模型作为工具集的一部分，由LLM调度执行星上推理任务——但这属于非常间接的跨领域联想，且需要大量额外设计。总体而言，该论文对本课题的直接借鉴价值很低。

Abstract: Modern cities rely on an increasing number of digital services to operate, but residents' daily needs are still difficult to meet. Services are fragmented and have little interoperability, placing a heavy operational burden on users. Existing digital platforms, urban foundation models, and intelligent assistants each address only isolated aspects of an urban task. But they struggle to reliably convert complex natural-language requests into executable cross-system workflows. We propose Urban-Agent, a tool-augmented agent framework for cross-system urban tasks. It couples the cognitive and reasoning capabilities of a large language model with a tool-set supporting code execution, API calls, and Model Context Protocol. Through one adaptive closed loop, it clarifies missing information before acting, grounds tool use in live observations, and aligns the final response with observed evidence and task constraints. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce Urban-Eval, a benchmark specifically designed for cross-system urban request. Unlike prior benchmarks that assess either general tool use or urban knowledge and reasoning, Urban-Eval evaluates both task results and execution quality, including required tool coverage, dependency validity, and evidence traceability. Experimental results indicate that Urban-Agent reaches a 71% task success rate, 10 points above the strongest baseline. This lead holds across GPT-5-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash, DeepSeek-V4-flash, and Qwen3-235B-A22B.

</details>


### [244] [LoCA: Forward-Only LLM Tuning after One-Shot Calibration with Local Credit Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03020)
*Linhan Xia,Rui Liu,Zhaofeng Zhang,Yihao Wang,Binrui Shen,Shengxin Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Local Credit Assignment (LoCA)，一种两阶段参数高效微调方法，通过一次性校准（one-time calibration）将低秩映射从最终预测误差映射到各transformer块的局部隐状态修正，从而避免重复的端到端反向传播，实现仅前向的后续微调。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛机器学习/大语言模型（LLM）参数高效微调（PEFT）方向，与遥感、卫星、目标检测均无直接关联。但其"避免重复反向传播、仅需一次性校准、降低GPU峰值显存和CPU稳态内存"的思想，对星上/边缘部署中计算资源受限场景下的模型适配有一定方法学借鉴意义，属于泛机器学习方法。

Reading priority: 2分。论文与遥感/卫星/目标检测无直接关联，属于LLM微调方向。但其"一次性校准替代重复反向传播、仅前向适配"的思想对星上模型在线适配有方法学借鉴价值，可作为边缘/星上部署中模型适配的参考方法，但优先级较低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：参数高效微调（Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning, PEFT）/小偏移适配（small-shift adaptation）。应用场景：大语言模型（LLM）下游任务适配，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。评估基准为五个判别式（discriminative）基准任务。

Model architecture: 基于Transformer架构。核心模块：在每个transformer block上拟合低秩映射（low-rank map），将最终预测误差映射到局部隐状态修正；利用这些映射从前向激活构造分块回归目标（blockwise regression targets），并通过闭式岭回归（closed-form ridge solves）拟合低秩适配器（low-rank adapters）。模型规模覆盖Qwen2.5 0.5B到14B，以及SmolLM2-1.7B。

Lightweight method: 属于参数高效微调（PEFT）范畴，采用低秩适配器（low-rank adapters）和低秩映射（low-rank map）。核心轻量化思想是：将重复的端到端反向传播（repeated end-to-end backpropagation）替换为一次性校准（one-time calibration），校准后仅需前向传播（forward-only tuning），无需backward-capable硬件，也无需存储或重算activations。这与知识蒸馏/剪枝/量化等传统压缩方法不同，属于"训练/适配阶段的计算开销压缩"。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提供了部署相关指标：1) 全运行GPU峰值显存（full-run GPU peak）比LoRA低26-29%（含校准阶段）；2) 校准后CPU稳态内存（CPU steady-state memory）比LoRA低36-52%；3) 校准后单次前向pass时间比LoRA低43-48%。这些指标表明LoCA在推理/适配阶段显著降低内存和延迟开销，对资源受限的边缘/星上场景有潜在价值。但摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、能耗等具体数值。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：五个判别式基准任务（具体名称摘要未说明）。模型：Qwen2.5（0.5B至14B）、SmolLM2-1.7B。评价指标：评估交叉熵（evaluation cross-entropy）、GPU峰值显存、CPU稳态内存、单次pass时间。在25个任务-规模组合中，16个组合LoCA的交叉熵低于对应LoRA。

Experiments: 在5个判别式基准、Qwen2.5 0.5B-14B规模上评估。25个任务-规模组合中16个LoCA交叉熵优于LoRA。GPU峰值显存降低26-29%，CPU稳态内存降低36-52%，单次pass时间降低43-48%。共享的scale-normalized候选集可跨所有Qwen2.5规模和SmolLM2-1.7B复用。代码已开源（github.com/Xia12121/LoCA）。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于LLM微调方向；2) 摘要未说明具体数据集名称、任务类型细节；3) 未报告参数量、FLOPs、能耗等部署关键指标；4) 仅在判别式基准上评估，未涉及生成式任务或视觉任务；5) 未说明在视觉/遥感模型（如CNN、ViT检测头）上的可迁移性；6) 交叉熵指标在16/25组合中优于LoRA，但仍有9个组合不如LoRA，性能稳定性存疑。

Ideas for my research: 1) 核心思想"一次性校准替代重复反向传播"可迁移到遥感目标检测模型的域适配/微调场景：在轨卫星上对预训练检测模型做小偏移适配（如传感器差异、光照变化）时，可借鉴LoCA的blockwise低秩回归思路，避免星上重复反向传播；2) 低秩映射+闭式岭回归的适配方式计算开销低，适合星上有限算力；3) 其"校准后仅前向"的范式与星上推理硬件（FPGA/NPU）天然契合——这些硬件通常不支持反向传播；4) 可探索将LoCA思想用于遥感检测头（如轻量检测头）的在线适配，或用于域自适应（domain adaptation）场景；5) 其降低GPU峰值显存和CPU稳态内存的思路对星上内存受限的部署有参考价值。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient post-training reduces the number of trainable parameters, but still requires repeated end-to-end backpropagation through the frozen backbone. Every adaptation step therefore needs backward-capable hardware and must store or recompute activations. We ask whether this repeated backward chain can be replaced by a one-time calibration. We introduce Local Credit Assignment (LoCA), a two-stage method for small-shift adaptation. One probe backward pass fits a low-rank map at each transformer block from the final prediction error to a local hidden-state correction. LoCA then reuses these maps to form blockwise regression targets from forward activations and fits low-rank adapters with closed-form ridge solves. No further backbone backward pass is required. We evaluate LoCA on five discriminative benchmarks with Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 14B. In 16 of 25 reported task--scale comparisons, LoCA yields lower evaluation cross-entropy than the corresponding LoRA run. Its measured full-run GPU peak, including calibration, is 26--29\% lower than LoRA's. After calibration, its CPU steady-state memory is 36--52\% lower and its per-pass time is 43--48\% lower. A shared scale-normalized candidate set is reused across all tested Qwen2.5 sizes and on SmolLM2-1.7B. LoCA thus amortizes global credit assignment into one calibration and enables later forward-only tuning when repeated backpropagation is impractical. The code associated with this paper is available \href{https://github.com/Xia12121/LoCA}{here}.

</details>


### [245] [DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03025)
*Feng Zhang,Feiyu Han,Rongxin Yang,Yang Liu,Yancheng Chen,Rui Wang,Yingguang Yang,Tian Xueyun,Chongyang Zhang,Hao Zheng,Xu Kefu,Congjing Ran,Fuhai Chen,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DiffImaginE，将多模态命名实体识别（MNER）的类型验证建模为条件潜在扩散推理，用去噪误差作为类型条件负对数似然的代理来对候选实体类型进行排序。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于多模态自然语言处理（MNER）领域，处理的是文本与视觉证据联合的命名实体识别任务，与遥感、卫星、在轨部署、目标检测、轻量化均无直接关联。唯一可借鉴的是其扩散模型用于判别式验证的思路，但这属于泛机器学习方法，与本课题方向弱相关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于多模态NLP领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，仅扩散模型判别式验证的思路有极有限的间接借鉴价值，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多模态命名实体识别（Multimodal Named Entity Recognition, MNER），即判断每个候选span和实体类型假设是否被联合的文本与视觉证据支持。应用场景：社交媒体文本（Twitter）中的实体识别。传感器类型：文本+自然图像（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：命名实体类型（如人物、地点、组织等），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: 保留标准多模态编码器栈（standard multimodal encoder stack），将原有的确定性验证器（deterministic verifier）替换为基于classifier-free guidance的扩散评分器（diffusion scorer）。核心组件包括：类型条件去噪器（type-conditioned denoiser）、潜在扩散推理（conditional latent diffusion inference）、Min-SNR加权训练、跨噪声水平的聚合学习、antithetic sampling降低蒙特卡洛比较方差。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法，也未讨论推理效率、参数量或FLOPs等部署相关指标。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。且扩散模型通常推理成本较高，与本课题的星上轻量化部署需求相悖。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Twitter-2015和Twitter-2017（多模态命名实体识别基准数据集）。评价指标：摘要未明确列出具体指标名称（推测为F1等NER标准指标），但提到使用paired significance tests进行显著性检验，并进行了消融实验（ablations）。

Experiments: 在Twitter-2015和Twitter-2017上与匹配的确定性ImaginE基线对比，在相同编码器、辅助目标和评估协议下取得一致提升。通过消融实验和paired significance tests验证了classifier-free guidance对类型后验的锐化作用，以及antithetic pairing在相同去噪器成本下降低方差的效果。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关，属于NLP+多模态领域。2. 扩散模型推理开销大，与在轨实时检测的轻量化需求背道而驰。3. 摘要未说明模型参数量、推理速度等部署指标。4. 仅在Twitter数据集上验证，未涉及遥感场景泛化。

Ideas for my research: 1. 扩散模型用于判别式验证的思路可借鉴：将"去噪误差作为负对数似然代理"的思想，理论上可迁移到遥感目标检测中的候选框/候选区域验证，但需注意扩散模型推理成本高，需配合蒸馏或加速策略。2. classifier-free guidance对后验锐化的分析思路可用于理解检测置信度校准问题。3. antithetic sampling降低蒙特卡洛方差的思想可用于遥感检测中不确定性估计。总体而言，借鉴价值有限，且需额外考虑轻量化约束。

Abstract: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier-free-guided diffusion scorer trained using Min-SNR weighting. We directly supervise per-type diffusion scores as classification logits, learn aggregation across noise levels, and use antithetic sampling to reduce Monte Carlo comparison variance. Our analysis shows that classifier-free guidance sharpens the induced type posterior and characterises when antithetic pairing reduces variance at equal denoiser cost. Experiments on Twitter-2015 and Twitter-2017 show consistent gains over a matched deterministic ImaginE control under the same encoder, auxiliary objectives, and evaluation protocol, supported by ablations and paired significance tests.

</details>


### [246] [Evaluating Counterfactual Sensitivity to Patient Information in Medication-Safety Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03028)
*Zhitian Hou,Yuhang Liu,Pengkai Wang,Zeyu Liu,Guanghao Zhu,Zheng Liu,Shuo Cai,Congkai Xie,Zhijie Sang,Kun Zeng,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MedPIC-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型在患者个体化用药安全推理中是否真正依据患者信息应用条件性安全规则，而非仅凭药物-风险关联记忆作答。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文属于医疗AI/大语言模型(LLM)评测领域，聚焦患者个体化用药安全推理(counterfactual reasoning)，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、目标检测或任何模型压缩/加速技术。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于医疗LLM评测领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：医疗安全规则推理评测（patient-specific medication-safety reasoning）；应用场景：临床用药决策支持；传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）；目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。评测对象为28个医疗专用、通用及专有LLM（medical-specific, general, proprietary LLMs），但未给出具体模型名称或网络结构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝(pruning)、量化(quantization)、知识蒸馏(knowledge distillation)、NAS、轻量网络设计或任何模型压缩/加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时推理等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：MedPIC-Bench（自建基准），包含467个问题，按六个临床与推理维度标注，结合guideline-following问题与配对的反事实(counterfactual)问题。评价指标：准确率(accuracy)，具体报告了平均准确率从63.6%降至45.1%（反事实问题上的表现）。

Experiments: 在28个医疗专用、通用及专有LLM上评测。主要发现：所有模型在反事实问题上表现更差（平均准确率从63.6%降至45.1%）；当显式患者属性直接提示已知禁忌症时模型表现良好，但当患者信息需要收窄或撤销安全警告时表现挣扎；模型rationale常承认患者信息变化，但最终答案仍保留原安全判断；医疗专用LLM的反事实表现平均低于通用LLM。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关。摘要未涉及遥感、目标检测、轻量化或部署相关内容。该论文的局限性在于其评测基准仅覆盖医疗领域，且未讨论模型效率、推理速度或资源约束问题。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感目标检测轻量化方向无关，但其"反事实(counterfactual)评测"思想有一定方法论借鉴潜力：在遥感目标检测中，可考虑设计反事实场景（如改变目标尺度、遮挡、背景干扰）来评测模型是否真正学习到目标本质特征而非依赖上下文捷径（shortcut learning），这对评估轻量化模型在压缩后是否仍保持鲁棒性有参考价值。但整体借鉴意义有限。

Abstract: Applying a valid medication-safety rule when its patient-specific conditions are not met can produce an incorrect decision. Existing medical evaluations largely use isolated and fixed scenarios. A model may therefore answer correctly by recalling a drug-risk association without showing that it used patient information to decide whether the rule applies. To address this gap, we introduce MedPIC-Bench, a benchmark of source-verifiable recommendations and expert-validated questions for patient-specific medication-safety reasoning. It combines guideline-following questions with paired counterfactual questions in which a controlled change in patient information changes whether a rule applies. The benchmark contains 467 questions annotated along six clinical and reasoning dimensions. Across 28 medical-specific, general, and proprietary LLMs, every model performs worse on counterfactual questions, with mean accuracy falling from 63.6\% to 45.1\%. Models perform well when an explicit patient attribute directly signals a familiar contraindication, but struggle when patient information must narrow or withdraw a safety warning. Model rationales often acknowledge the changed patient information, yet the final answers retain the previous safety judgment. This vulnerability persists among medical-specific LLMs, whose average CF performance trails that of general LLMs. MedPIC-Bench therefore makes conditional rule application measurable and highlights the limitations of static medication-safety accuracy for assessing patient-specific reliability.

</details>


### [247] [CastFSR: A Fast--Slow--Reflect Agentic Reasoning Framework for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03031)
*Xiaoyu Tao,Mingyue Cheng,Bokai Pan,Chuang Jiang,Huanjian Zhang,Tian Gao,Yaguo Liu,Qi Liu,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CastFSR，一个基于LLM的agentic框架，将时间序列预测建模为Fast-Slow-Reflect工作流，通过上下文感知推理提升预测性能，并支持通过SFT和强化学习将编排能力迁移到紧凑LLM上实现高效部署。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于时间序列预测（time series forecasting）领域，基于大语言模型（LLM）的上下文感知推理，与遥感、卫星、在轨目标检测、轻量化模型压缩等方向基本无关。唯一可借鉴的点在于其"将能力从大模型迁移到紧凑模型"的两阶段SFT+强化学习策略，与知识蒸馏/模型压缩思想有间接关联，但并非针对遥感目标检测场景。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM时间序列预测领域，仅"大模型到紧凑模型能力迁移"的思想有间接借鉴意义，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：时间序列预测（time series forecasting）；应用场景：复杂系统中的决策支持；传感器类型：不涉及遥感传感器；目标类别：不涉及目标检测。摘要未说明具体数据集类型。

Model architecture: CastFSR框架包含三个模块：Fast thinking（快速画像观测数据并选择轻量预测器构建数据驱动先验）、Slow deliberation（检索上下文证据、自适应确定look-back窗口、推理上下文如何重塑未来动态）、Reflection（迭代精炼预测以满足时间、上下文和领域一致性约束）。整体基于LLM构建agentic workflow。

Lightweight method: 涉及轻量化部署：支持training-free inference（使用现成LLM）以及通过两阶段SFT（supervised fine-tuning）+ 强化学习（reinforcement learning）策略将编排能力迁移到紧凑LLM（compact LLMs）上实现高效部署。这本质上是一种模型压缩/蒸馏思路，但并非针对遥感目标检测模型的剪枝、量化或知识蒸馏。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提到"efficient deployment through a two-stage SFT and reinforcement learning strategy that transfers its orchestration capability to compact LLMs"，即通过将能力迁移到紧凑LLM实现高效部署。但摘要未说明具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要提到"Extensive experiments on public datasets"，但未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。摘要未说明。

Experiments: 摘要提到"CastFSR consistently outperforms representative baselines"，但未给出具体对比方法、消融实验和量化结果。摘要未说明。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于时间序列预测领域；2. 摘要未提供具体实验数据、数据集名称、指标数值；3. 未说明紧凑LLM的具体规模、压缩比、推理延迟等部署细节；4. 未涉及遥感图像、SAR、高光谱等传感器数据。

Ideas for my research: 1. "Fast-Slow-Reflect"工作流思想可借鉴：在遥感在轨目标检测中，可设计"快速粗检测 + 慢速精修"的两阶段推理策略，在资源受限的星上平台先用轻量模型快速筛选候选区域，再对关键区域进行精细检测；2. "将大模型能力迁移到紧凑模型"的两阶段SFT+RL策略，与知识蒸馏思想类似，可借鉴到将大检测模型的知识蒸馏到轻量检测模型；3. 上下文感知推理（context-aware reasoning）思想可用于遥感场景中结合地理上下文信息辅助目标检测。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Time series forecasting is fundamental to decision-making in complex systems, where future dynamics are influenced not only by historical observations but also by evolving contextual features. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have extended forecasting beyond numerical extrapolation toward context-aware reasoning. However, existing approaches often lack explicit mechanisms to identify relevant contexts, reason about their impacts, and validate forecasts against temporal and domain constraints. In this work, we propose CastFSR, an agentic framework that formulates context-aware forecasting as a Fast--Slow--Reflect workflow. In fast thinking, CastFSR profiles observations and selects lightweight forecasters to construct a data-driven forecast prior. In slow deliberation, it retrieves contextual evidence, adaptively determines informative look-back windows, and reasons about how contexts reshape future dynamics. In reflection, it iteratively refines forecasts to ensure temporal, contextual, and domain consistency. CastFSR supports both training-free inference with off-the-shelf LLMs and efficient deployment through a two-stage SFT and reinforcement learning strategy that transfers its orchestration capability to compact LLMs. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate that CastFSR consistently outperforms representative baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/CastFSR.

</details>


### [248] [TraceCAD: Trace-Guided Repair for Agentic CAD Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03062)
*Fengxiao Fan,Jingzhe Ni,Fan Sang,Xiaolong Yin,Yu Liu,Ruofeng Tong,Min Tang,Peng Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TraceCAD，一个为LLM驱动的CAD智能体设计的恢复层，通过持久化状态、局部化搜索和可复用技能记忆来提升参数化程序修复的可靠性与几何质量。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于CAD（计算机辅助设计）领域的LLM智能体程序修复问题，属于生成式AI/程序合成方向，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于CAD程序合成领域。除非对LLM智能体修复机制或增量学习策略有跨领域兴趣，否则不建议深入阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM-based CAD agent的参数化程序生成与修复；应用场景：计算机辅助设计（CAD）建模；传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）；目标类别：CAD建模操作序列，非视觉目标。

Model architecture: TraceCAD恢复层架构，包含：持久化状态（persistent state）链接需求特征、建模步骤、失败证据和候选结果；故障操作诊断模块；依赖区域内的有界编辑搜索；执行与保持性校验；可复用技能记忆（skill memory）存储成功与失败修复结果。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。其"轻量"体现在通过持久化状态和局部化搜索减少代码智能体调用次数、token成本和延迟，但这属于推理效率优化而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及减少retries、token cost和latency，但这些是针对CAD代码生成场景，与在轨遥感部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：DeepCAD-derived benchmarks（200-model消融实验和1K-model对比实验）；评价指标：IoU、Chamfer distance、Hausdorff distance（几何质量指标）、recovery score、geometric regression、code-agent invocations、retries、token cost、latency。

Experiments: 主要结果：TraceCAD在IoU、Chamfer distance和Hausdorff distance上达到有竞争力的几何质量；移除持久化状态使recovery score几乎减半；移除局部化搜索使几何回归翻倍以上且代码智能体调用次数翻倍；在不相交训练模型上初始化技能库进一步减少重试、token成本和延迟。

Limitations: 摘要未说明具体局限性。与本研究方向的缺口：完全未涉及遥感图像、目标检测、模型压缩或边缘部署；其"效率优化"思路（持久化状态、局部化搜索、技能复用）虽在减少推理开销上有一定方法论参考价值，但应用场景差异极大。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景不同，TraceCAD的"持久化状态+局部化搜索+可复用记忆"思想可类比借鉴到在轨目标检测的增量学习或持续学习场景：例如在轨模型更新时，可保留历史检测结果作为持久化状态，对误检/漏检区域进行局部化重训练，并将成功的修复策略存入可复用记忆以减少星上计算开销。此外，其"减少token成本和延迟"的优化目标与星上推理的低延迟需求在方法论上有一定相通性，但需自行迁移到视觉检测任务。

Abstract: LLM-based CAD agents produce executable parametric programs, but their correction loops may lose evidence about satisfied requirements, faulty operations, and prior repairs. We introduce TraceCAD, a recovery layer that links requested features, modeling steps, failure evidence, and candidate outcomes as persistent state. TraceCAD diagnoses likely faulty operations, searches bounded edits in their dependency regions, validates candidates through execution and preservation checks, and retains successful and failed repair outcomes in reusable skill memory. On DeepCAD-derived benchmarks with 200-model ablations and a 1K-model comparison, TraceCAD achieves competitive geometric quality in terms of IoU, Chamfer distance, and Hausdorff distance. Removing persistent state nearly halves recovery score; removing localized search more than doubles geometric regression and doubles code-agent invocations. Initializing the skill store on disjoint training models further reduces retries, token cost, and latency. These results demonstrate that persistent, localized, and reusable recovery improves final CAD quality and repair reliability.

</details>


### [249] [Getting the Parameters Right: A Difficulty-Graded Benchmark and Probe-Guided Training for LLM Tool Calls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03071)
*Guoyao Yu,Xiaoqing Sun,Ziqi Huang,Shaojing Fan,Zhongyi Zhang,Xiaomeng Hu,Xiaobo Xue,Yangyang Shi,Xiong Xiao,Yang Song,Biao Lyu,Rong Wen,Xing Li,Qinming He,Shunming Zhu,Zhenguang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM隐藏状态正确性信号的探针引导框架（PBT+PGR），用于提升大语言模型工具调用中参数生成的准确性，并发布ParamBench基准。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的工具调用参数生成问题，属于自然语言处理/LLM agent领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化/部署的任何内容。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM agent工具调用领域，不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM tool use中的参数生成（parameter generation）与参数填充。应用场景：cloud networking（云网络）API调用。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 基于LLM hidden state的线性探针（linear probe）用于预测参数值是否正确；提出两个互补框架：probe-filtered bootstrapped training (PBT) 用于过滤可靠自生成样本进行微调，probe-guided reranking (PGR) 用于推理时选择更优候选。具体底层LLM架构摘要未说明。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或任何模型压缩/加速方法。探针本身是轻量线性层，但并非针对模型轻量化设计。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 发布ParamBench基准（基于真实云网络API构建，按参数嵌套深度、跨参数依赖、推理需求分为5个难度等级）。在5个开源模型上评估ParamBench，并在6个外部基准上验证。主要指标：exact match（精确匹配率），从19.7%提升到59.6%。

Experiments: 在5个开源LLM上于ParamBench及6个外部基准进行实验，PBT+PGR框架将平均exact match从19.7%提升至59.6%。具体对比方法和消融实验细节摘要未说明。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关。摘要未说明任何遥感、目标检测或轻量化相关内容。此外，该方法依赖LLM hidden state，计算开销和可迁移性在非LLM场景（如CNN目标检测器）中未知。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可能的概念性启发是"利用模型内部表征（hidden state/feature map）中的正确性信号来指导训练数据筛选或推理时选择"，这一思路在目标检测中可类比为利用中间特征图置信度来辅助轻量化模型训练或推理，但关联非常间接，不建议作为主要参考。

Abstract: Large language model agents derive much of their capability from tool use. Existing research on tool use has largely focused on selecting the right tool and orchestrating the order of calls. However, correctly filling the parameters of a tool call is equally critical for successful execution and has received far less attention. In domains such as cloud networking, even frontier models correctly complete fewer than half of tool calls. Inspired by recent analyses showing that LLM hidden states encode rich information about model predictions, we discover that while the model generates a parameter value, its hidden state contains a strong correctness signal: a simple linear probe can accurately predict whether the value will be correct. Based on this observation, we propose a unified probe-guided framework with two complementary approaches: probe-filtered bootstrapped training (PBT), which uses the probe to filter reliable self-generated calls for fine-tuning, and probe-guided reranking (PGR), which uses the probe to select better candidates during inference. To support systematic evaluation, we release ParamBench, a benchmark built from real cloud-network APIs that categorizes every instance into five difficulty levels according to parameter nesting depth, cross-parameter dependencies, and the reasoning required to derive values from earlier calls. Extensive experiments across 5 open models on ParamBench and 6 external benchmarks demonstrate that our method substantially improves parameter generation, raising the average exact match from 19.7% to 59.6%.

</details>


### [250] [AI Agent Economics: Can Autonomous Economic Behavior Emerge among AI Agents under Minimal External Conditions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03076)
*Lingyun Zhang,Shang Shang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体系统中经济组织是否内生涌现，提出"AI Agent Economics"框架，通过两阶段实验（无生产边界测试 + 24个六智能体世界）验证可执行机制而非角色标签驱动经济行为涌现。

Research relevance: 弱相关（1-2分）。该论文属于多智能体系统（Multi-agent systems）与AI经济学交叉领域，研究智能体间的经济组织、资源分配、选举与转移机制。完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及object detection、目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测等视觉任务，更不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等轻量化或部署方法。与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于多智能体经济学方向，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化课题基本无关，无阅读价值。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多智能体经济行为涌现研究（AI Agent Economics）。应用场景：模拟经济系统，涉及work（工作）、transfer（转移）、elections（选举）、allocation（分配）等机制。传感器类型：不适用（非视觉/遥感任务）。目标类别：不适用（无目标检测对象）。

Model architecture: 两阶段框架：①无生产边界测试（no-production boundary test）；②24个独立六智能体世界（six-agent worlds）。底层模型使用GPT和DeepSeek大语言模型作为智能体。摘要未说明具体网络结构或模型架构细节。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。摘要中未提及任何模型压缩、加速或轻量化方法（无pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、剪枝、量化、蒸馏等）。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。该研究不涉及星上/边缘部署，未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：非视觉数据集，使用24个六智能体模拟世界，基于GPT和DeepSeek两个LLM平台。评价指标：摘要未明确列出量化指标，主要观察指标包括inter-agent transfer activity（智能体间转移活动）、failed allocation（分配失败）、prolonged exclusion（长期排斥）、differentiation（分化程度）、continuation support（延续支持）等行为学指标。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：①无生产任务时，智能体仅进行沟通和资源供给治理，无实质性转移活动；②有验证工作和稀缺任务访问时，涌现出转移、借贷、访问承诺、投票换访问、分配策略等经济行为；③固定选举接口时，可执行分配权增加分化同时减少分配失败和长期排斥；④能量符号化后延续支持消失，但任务访问竞争持续。摘要未说明与基线方法的定量对比或消融实验细节。

Limitations: ①与遥感目标检测和轻量化方向完全无关，无法提供任何视觉任务或部署层面的借鉴；②摘要未说明实验的统计显著性检验、可复现性细节；③仅基于GPT和DeepSeek两个LLM，泛化性有限；④摘要未说明计算资源消耗、训练成本等工程细节。

Ideas for my research: ①该论文与本人课题无直接可借鉴点，不涉及遥感、目标检测或轻量化技术；②若强行关联，其"可执行机制驱动行为涌现"的思想或可类比为"网络结构/剪枝策略驱动模型行为"，但关联非常牵强；③不建议在本课题中参考此论文的方法或结论。

Abstract: Multi-agent studies commonly place AI agents in predefined games, markets, or roles, making it difficult to distinguish endogenous economic organization from behavior inherited from the scenario. We ask whether economic relations emerge when agents receive executable mechanisms for work, transfer, elections, and allocation but no prescribed social or economic strategy. We define AI Agent Economics as systems of production, allocation, consumption, exchange, and institutions that alter agents' future feasible actions. We develop a two-stage framework comprising a no-production boundary test and 24 independent six-agent worlds across GPT and DeepSeek. Without productive tasks, agents communicate and govern resource provision but show no substantive inter-agent transfer activity. With verified work and scarce task access, transfers, loans, access promises, vote-for-access exchanges, and allocation strategies emerge. Holding the election interface fixed, executable allocation authority increases differentiation while reducing failed allocation and prolonged exclusion. When energy becomes symbolic, continuation support disappears, yet competition over task access persists. These findings show that organization follows executable rights and resource consequences rather than role labels or prompt language, and motivate governance audits of the mechanisms that actually constrain agents' future actions.

</details>


### [251] [Don't Peek at the Answer: Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization for Label-Free RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03119)
*Yongshi Ye,Liang Zhang,Yidong Chen,Xiaodong Shi,Biao Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出OM-GRPO，一种无标签的RLVR框架，通过解耦奖励估计与策略优化（在答案片段上屏蔽梯度）并引入对比增强奖励，提升LLM推理能力，在Test-Time Training设置下超越多数投票4.24分。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的强化学习推理优化（RLVR），属于自然语言处理/推理领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测等视觉任务，更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署等轻量化方法。唯一可能的弱关联是"Test-Time Training"概念与在轨自适应推理有一定思想上的相似性，但整体关联度极低。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM强化学习推理优化领域。除非对RLVR或Test-Time Training的通用方法论感兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM推理能力强化学习优化（reasoning via reinforcement learning）。应用场景：通用推理基准测试与Test-Time Training（测试时训练）。传感器类型：不适用（纯文本/推理任务）。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: OM-GRPO框架：基于GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）的变体。核心设计包括：(1) 在answer span上屏蔽梯度（mask gradients on the answer span），将优化压力从答案token转移开；(2) 通过soft consensus signal保留answer-level奖励；(3) Contrast-Augmented Reward，利用已有轨迹的低成本成对比较来细化奖励估计，无需额外rollout。使用三个LLM backbone进行实验。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩方法。其"低开销"体现在Contrast-Augmented Reward无需额外rollout（不增加采样成本），但这属于训练效率优化而非模型轻量化/部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。且该方法面向LLM推理训练，与星上/边缘部署场景无直接关联。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：多个diverse reasoning benchmarks（摘要未具体列出名称）。评价指标：推理准确率（具体指标名称摘要未说明），以及Test-Time Training设置下的性能对比（超越majority voting 4.24 points）。实验设置：三个LLM backbone上对比现有label-free RLVR方法，并与supervised GT-reward训练对比。

Experiments: 主要结果：OM-GRPO在多个推理基准和三个LLM backbone上一致优于现有label-free RLVR方法，并匹配supervised GT-reward训练的性能，且优化过程稳定。在Test-Time Training设置下，OM-GRPO超越majority voting 4.24 points。摘要未提供具体数值表格或消融实验细节。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关，属于NLP/LLM推理领域；(2) 摘要未说明具体推理基准名称、backbone名称、计算开销、训练成本等关键细节；(3) 方法依赖LLM的token级策略优化，难以直接迁移到CNN/Transformer视觉检测模型；(4) 未讨论任何部署或边缘/星上推理场景。

Ideas for my research: 尽管整体弱相关，但有两个思想层面的借鉴点：(1) "解耦奖励估计与策略优化"的思想——在遥感目标检测的轻量化蒸馏/剪枝中，可类比思考"评估指标"与"优化目标"的解耦，避免优化目标被单一信号主导导致次优解；(2) "Test-Time Training"概念——在轨场景下卫星数据分布漂移时，可借鉴测试时自适应/微调的思想，让轻量模型在轨根据新数据分布做低成本自适应。但需注意这些仅是方法论层面的类比，直接可复现性很低。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves LLM reasoning but typically relies on ground-truth (GT) answers, limiting scalability. Voting-based label-free RLVR replace gold supervision with answer-level consensus from model samples. However, collapse arises when the same answer-level signal is used both to estimate rewards and to drive token-level policy optimization, encouraging the model to directly reinforce answer tokens rather than improve reasoning. We propose OM-GRPO, a label-free RLVR framework that decouples reward estimation from policy optimization. OM-GRPO masks gradients on the answer span while retaining answer-level rewards through a soft consensus signal, shifting optimization pressure away from answer tokens. We further introduce Contrast-Augmented Reward, which refines reward estimation via low-cost pairwise comparisons over existing trajectories without additional rollouts. Across diverse reasoning benchmarks and three LLM backbones, OM-GRPO consistently outperforms existing label-free RLVR methods and matches supervised GT-reward training with stable optimization. This stability is particularly beneficial in the Test-Time Training setting, where OM-GRPO surpasses majority voting by 4.24 points.

</details>


### [252] [Beyond Average Performance: Dynamic Instance Clustering and Specialized Algorithm Design in LLM-Assisted Evolutionary Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03129)
*Qinglong Hu,Qingfu Zhang,Fei Liu,Xialiang Tong,Kun Mao,Mingxuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DyCA框架，通过动态实例聚类与专用算法设计，改进大语言模型辅助进化搜索（LES）在异构实例分布下的尾部鲁棒性。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于泛机器学习/自动算法设计领域，核心是Large Language Model-assisted Evolutionary Search (LES) 和实例聚类，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化均无直接关联。既非遥感场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及模型压缩或部署优化。唯一可能的间接关联是：LES作为一种自动化算法设计范式，理论上可迁移到轻量化网络结构搜索（NAS）或剪枝策略搜索中，但摘要中完全没有涉及这些方向。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于自动算法设计领域。除非对LLM辅助进化搜索在NAS中的应用感兴趣，否则无需优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：自动算法设计（Automated Algorithm Design），具体为Large Language Model-assisted Evolutionary Search (LES) 的改进。应用场景：异构实例分布下的算法组合构建（algorithm portfolios）。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: DyCA框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 动态实例聚类（Dynamic Instance Clustering）——作为搜索过程中的共进化组件，复用累积的评估数据作为无特征信号，逐步划分具有相似算法响应模式的实例；(2) 专用算法设计（Specialized Algorithm Design）——将混合目标分解为结构感知的子目标，为每个聚类设计专用算法。整体采用LLM辅助的进化搜索范式。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量网络设计等模型压缩/加速方法。其"轻量"含义是算法设计层面的搜索效率优化，而非模型部署层面的轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等任何部署相关指标，也未涉及星上或边缘部署场景。

Datasets and metrics: 实验覆盖四个异构实例分布的算法设计任务（具体任务名称摘要未说明）。评价指标包括：尾部鲁棒性（tail robustness，平均提升15.2%）、整体性能（overall performance，平均提升7.1%）、头部性能（head performance，保持竞争力）。对比基线为SOTA LES方法。

Experiments: 在四个异构实例分布的算法设计任务上，DyCA相比SOTA LES基线：尾部鲁棒性平均提升15.2%，整体性能平均提升7.1%，头部性能保持竞争力。消融实验和具体任务细节摘要未说明。

Limitations: 摘要未说明具体局限性。可推断的缺口包括：(1) 未涉及遥感或目标检测场景；(2) 未讨论计算开销和搜索效率的实际成本；(3) 未说明聚类数如何自动确定；(4) 未讨论在资源受限环境（如星上）的可行性；(5) 四个任务的具体领域和规模未披露。

Ideas for my research: 尽管弱相关，但有以下潜在借鉴点：(1) LES范式可迁移到轻量化NAS中——用LLM辅助进化搜索来探索轻量目标检测网络结构，DyCA的"实例聚类+专用设计"思想可用于为不同遥感场景（如不同分辨率、不同目标尺度分布）自动搜索专用轻量检测头；(2) "复用累积评估数据作为无特征信号"的思路可用于NAS或剪枝搜索中减少重复评估开销，提升搜索效率；(3) 尾部鲁棒性优化思想可类比到遥感小目标检测——小目标往往在数据集中占比低、贡献的loss小，类似"尾部实例"，可借鉴其聚类思路对小目标样本进行专门优化。但整体借鉴价值有限，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Large Language Model-assisted Evolutionary Search (LES) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for automated algorithm design. However, existing LES methods primarily optimize for average performance, inherently directing search effort toward instances that contribute most to this metric while leaving others poorly served, resulting in weak tail robustness and limited real-world reliability. To address this limitation, we propose Dynamic Instance Clustering and Specialized Algorithm Design (DyCA), an LES framework with a feature-free, structure-aware mechanism for constructing reliable algorithm portfolios under heterogeneous instance distributions. DyCA treats instance clustering as a co-evolving component within the search process, reusing accumulated evaluation data as feature-free signals to progressively partition instances with similar algorithmic response patterns. The uncovered clusters decompose the mixed objective into a set of structure-aware sub-objectives, thereby enabling finer-grained and more adaptive guidance for specialized algorithm design. Experimental results across four algorithm design tasks with heterogeneous instances demonstrate that DyCA outperforms state-of-the-art LES baselines, improving tail robustness by an average of 15.2\% and overall performance by 7.1\% while maintaining competitive head performance.

</details>


### [253] [Verifiable Memory: Learning Unified Memory Management with Local and Global Verifiers for Large Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03137)
*Xiaolong Sun,Qichao Wang,Hangyu Li,Liang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VerMem 是一个面向大语言模型（LLM）智能体的可验证记忆管理框架，通过统一策略控制长期记忆、活动上下文和情景历史，并利用分层强化学习与验证器进行训练。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于 LLM agent 的记忆管理（memory management），属于自然语言处理/大语言模型智能体领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。虽然论文涉及"efficiency"和"token budget"等效率优化概念，但这是针对 LLM 上下文窗口的 token 效率，与目标检测模型的轻量化（pruning/quantization/distillation/FLOPs）完全不同。

Reading priority: 1 分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于 LLM 智能体记忆管理领域，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM agent 的长时程交互记忆管理（long-horizon interaction memory management）。应用场景：多轮交互、任务执行中的记忆检索与上下文控制。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: VerMem 框架将长期记忆（LTM）、活动上下文（active context）和情景历史（episodic history）表示为不同状态，由一个统一的 memory operation policy 控制。定义了七种原子操作：添加/修改/软删除 LTM 条目、将 LTM 检索到活动上下文、过滤或摘要活动上下文、恢复选定的情景片段。训练采用监督微调初始化 + 三阶段强化学习课程（three-stage RL curriculum），包含本地验证器（local verifier）和全局验证器（global verifier）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及模型压缩或加速方法（无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计）。其"efficiency"概念是指 LLM 交互中的 token 预算控制（online-token budgets），属于推理时的上下文管理优化，而非模型本身的轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。其效率评估基于"online-token budgets"（在线 token 预算），衡量的是记忆管理策略在有限 token 下的表现，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 在五个 benchmark 和两个 LLM backbone 上进行评估，具体数据集名称摘要未说明。评价指标包括任务完成度、证据召回（evidence-recall）、效率（efficiency）和约束信号（constraint signals）等，具体指标名称摘要未说明。在三个交互式 benchmark 上进行了受控在线 token 预算下的效率-性能前沿（efficiency-performance frontier）对比。

Experiments: VerMem 在五个 benchmark 和两个 LLM backbone 上，在绝大多数报告指标上取得最佳结果，并一致优于强记忆基线（strong memory baselines）。在三个交互式 benchmark 的受控在线 token 预算下，取得了最强的效率-性能前沿。具体对比方法和消融实验细节摘要未说明。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1）论文完全面向 LLM 智能体记忆管理，与遥感目标检测无任何交集；2）验证器仅在训练时使用，推理时依赖策略本身，其泛化性未知；3）未报告计算开销、部署资源等工程指标；4）未涉及任何视觉/遥感数据。

Ideas for my research: 与"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能间接相关的概念是：论文中"分层信用分配"（hierarchical credit assignment）和"验证器辅助训练"的思想，若未来在遥感检测模型的 knowledge distillation 或 NAS 搜索中引入类似"验证器"来评估中间状态，或许有方法论上的启发，但关联非常间接且牵强。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain reusable information, control a bounded active context, and recover earlier evidence during long-horizon interaction. Existing methods commonly optimize long-term memory (LTM) and short-term memory (STM) separately, while unified policies are often trained primarily with trajectory-level feedback, which provides weak credit for individual memory decisions. We present Verifiable Memory (VerMem), a framework that represents LTM, active context, and episodic history as distinct states and controls them with one memory operation policy. Seven atomic operations let the policy add, revise, or soft-delete LTM entries; retrieve LTM into the active context; filter or summarize the active context; and restore selected episodic fragments. VerMem is initialized by supervised fine-tuning and trained with a three-stage reinforcement-learning curriculum. The local verifier scores executable memory transitions, and a global verifier assesses evidence coherence and terminal-memory consistency after task completion. These scores are combined with programmatically computed task, evidence-recall, efficiency, and constraint signals through hierarchical credit assignment. The verifiers are used only during training. Across five benchmarks and two LLM backbones, VerMem achieves the best result on the vast majority of reported metrics and consistently outperforms strong memory baselines. Under controlled online-token budgets on three interactive benchmarks, it also achieves the strongest efficiency--performance frontier among the compared methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Sun-SYSU-24/VerMem.

</details>


### [254] [Spatial proteomics guided by H&E-based AI reveals recurrence-risk niches in triple-negative breast cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03145)
*Yesung Cho,Ji Hwan Park,Chanil Kim,Hyewon Kim,Honglan Li,Yumin Lee,Geongyu Lee,Sujeong Hong,Seong Min Park,Yoonyoung Lee,Hee Sool Rho,Sumin Lee,Amos Chungwon Lee,Changhwan Lee,Hwanyoung Shim,Hyunwook Kim,Hyeji Shin,Sanha Park,Jihoon Yu,Yoon Hee Shin,Sooheon Kim,Hyunjin Park,Seung Min Park,Sangwan Kim,Yujung Kim,Sung-Im Do,Eun-Young Kim,Dongmyung Shin,Jongbae Park,In-Gu Do*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于AI生成复发风险热图与质谱空间蛋白质组学整合的TNBC（三阴性乳腺癌）预后框架，利用H&E染色切片预测癌症复发并揭示局部分子状态。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文属于医学病理学/肿瘤学领域，研究对象是H&E染色组织切片和空间蛋白质组学，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能等完全无关。虽然涉及深度学习模型和heatmap生成，但既非遥感场景，也非目标检测任务，更不涉及任何轻量化或部署技术。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于医学病理学领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：癌症复发风险预测与空间蛋白质组学分析；应用场景：三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）病理诊断与生物标志物发现；传感器类型：H&E染色组织切片（数字病理图像）与质谱（mass spectrometry）空间蛋白质组学；目标类别：肿瘤高风险/低风险区域。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体网络结构。仅提及"outcome informed spatial pathology framework"和"AI generated recurrence risk heatmaps"，即基于深度学习生成复发风险热图，但未给出具体模型架构（如CNN、Transformer等）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：156例TNBC患者队列（含独立测试队列）；METABRIC TNBC队列（独立验证）。评价指标：AUC（0.77）、C-index（0.77）、out of bag C-index（0.679提升至0.739）、3年和5年时间依赖判别能力、recurrence-free survival（无复发生存）。

Experiments: 主要结果：distribution based aggregation of high scoring patches在独立测试队列达到AUC 0.77和C-index 0.77；bulk proteomics关联高风险与细胞周期/基因组维持程序、低风险与免疫激活；从2例复发患者中物理分离并分析46个AI定义肿瘤区域，发现高风险区域富集有丝分裂程序、低风险区域富集免疫和抗原呈递程序；13蛋白复合物与转录复合物均能分层无复发生存；蛋白复合物与H&E风险评分整合将out of bag C-index从0.679提升至0.739。

Limitations: 摘要未说明模型架构细节、计算资源需求、推理速度等。该研究完全面向医学病理学，与遥感目标检测和轻量化部署无任何交集。摘要未说明AI模型的训练细节、泛化能力评估、以及heatmap生成的计算开销。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义非常有限。唯一可能的概念性启发是：该论文将AI生成的热图作为"空间显式实验指南"（spatially explicit experimental guides），将预测结果与局部区域特征关联——这种"预测结果反哺区域级分析"的思路，在遥感领域可类比为将检测模型输出的目标位置作为引导，对目标区域进行更细粒度的特征分析（如多光谱/高光谱波段级分析）。但整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的参考价值极低。

Abstract: Deep learning models can predict cancer recurrence from H&E stained slides, but the localized molecular states underlying these predictions remain largely obscured. Here, we developed an outcome informed spatial pathology framework in TNBC that integrates AI generated recurrence risk heatmaps with mass spectrometry based spatial proteomics. In a cohort of 156 patients, distribution based aggregation of high scoring patches achieved an AUC of 0.77 and a C-index of 0.77 in an independent test cohort. Bulk proteomics associated high image derived risk with cell cycle and genome maintenance programs and low risk with immune activation. High and low risk patches coexisted within the same tumor compartment and displayed distinct nuclear and architectural features, revealing intratumoral heterogeneity beyond tissue compartment identity. We then used the heatmaps as coordinate level guides to physically isolate and profile 46 AI defined tumor regions from two recurrence patients. Spatial proteomic profiling revealed a concordant molecular contrast across both patients: mitotic programs were enriched in high risk regions and immune and antigen presentation programs in low risk regions. A 13 protein composite derived from these spatial contrasts showed a trend toward poorer recurrence-free survival with increasing scores in an expanded cohort, while the corresponding transcript based composite stratified recurrence free survival in the independent METABRIC TNBC cohort. Integrating the protein composite with the H&E derived risk score improved the out of bag C-index from 0.679 to 0.739 and enhanced time dependent discrimination at 3 and 5 years. Together, these findings define a new role for outcome trained AI models as spatially explicit experimental guides that connect prognostic morphology with localized molecular states and advance biologically grounded, multiscale biomarker discovery in TNBC.

</details>


### [255] [UniGD: A Unified Generative-Discriminative Framework for Industrial Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03150)
*Shujie Ji,Yawei Kong,Yilin Zhao,Li Wang,Xialong Liu,Peng Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出UniGD统一生成-判别框架，将生成式检索与相关性评分集成到单一模型，通过CAGE梯度增强、CAM码本锚定表示和HAM异构广告建模，在快手搜索广告平台上提升收入5.78%并降低33%推理延迟。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于工业搜索广告领域的生成式检索（Generative Retrieval）方法，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱等遥感场景完全无关，也不涉及目标检测任务。虽然论文涉及推理延迟优化（inference latency reduction）和模型效率，但其优化目标是广告检索系统而非遥感目标检测，且未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏等轻量化技术。属于泛机器学习/泛检索方法，对遥感在轨目标检测方向借鉴价值有限。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文聚焦工业搜索广告的生成式检索，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。虽然涉及推理延迟优化和知识蒸馏思想，但场景差异过大，对课题的直接参考价值很低，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：生成式检索（Generative Retrieval）与相关性评分（relevance scoring）联合建模，用于工业搜索广告系统。应用场景：快手（Kuaishou）搜索广告平台，覆盖短视频、商品、直播三类异构广告。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感传感器）。目标类别：广告（advertisement），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: UniGD框架包含三个核心模块：(1) Conflict-Aware Gradient Enhancement (CAGE)——用于协调生成式检索目标与判别式相关性评分目标之间的梯度冲突；(2) Codebook-Anchored Representation Module (CAM)——将物品表示锚定到从多模态预训练模型蒸馏得到的冻结分层码本上，赋予语义先验；(3) Heterogeneous Ad-material Modeling (HAM)——在共享骨干网络上捕获跨类型语义共性，同时保留类型特定的建模能力。

Lightweight method: 摘要未明确使用剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等传统轻量化方法。但论文通过将生成式检索与相关性判别模型合并为单一模型（UniGD），减少了级联（cascade）架构中独立相关性模型带来的额外serving成本，从而降低了推理延迟（inference latency降低33%）。CAM模块使用从多模态预训练模型蒸馏（distilled）的冻结码本，属于一种知识蒸馏思想，但目的是增强语义表示而非模型压缩。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅报告了在线AB测试中推理延迟降低33%（inference latency reduction），以及广告收入提升5.78%。该延迟优化来自架构合并（消除级联中的独立相关性模型），而非模型压缩或硬件加速。未涉及FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等边缘或星上部署方案，与在轨部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 离线数据集：NQ320K和MS300K，评价指标为Recall@10。在线实验：快手搜索广告平台AB测试，指标包括广告收入提升（5.78%）、推理延迟降低（33%）和判别式相关性估计改善。摘要未说明遥感相关数据集。

Experiments: 在线AB测试显示UniGD在快手搜索广告平台上广告收入提升5.78%，推理延迟降低33%，判别式相关性估计得到改善。离线实验中，在NQ320K上Recall@10较最强复现GR基线提升8.44%，在MS300K上提升3.19%。摘要未提供消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存等部署细节；未提供消融实验验证各模块（CAGE、CAM、HAM）的独立贡献；未讨论模型在资源受限设备上的表现；未涉及遥感场景或目标检测任务。该工作聚焦广告检索场景，其"轻量化"仅体现在架构合并减少级联开销，而非真正的模型压缩。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测方向弱相关，但仍有少量可借鉴思路：(1) CAGE的梯度冲突协调机制——在多任务联合优化（如检测+轻量化蒸馏）中，可用于缓解不同损失目标之间的梯度干扰；(2) CAM的码本锚定表示——将特征表示锚定到预训练码本的思想，可类比用于遥感目标检测中利用预训练视觉模型增强小目标特征表达；(3) 架构合并降低serving成本的思想——在星上部署中，将多个级联模块合并为单一模型以减少推理开销的思路有参考价值。但整体而言，该论文对遥感在轨目标检测轻量化的直接借鉴意义有限。

Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) is a promising paradigm for industrial search advertising, yet its deployment is constrained by strict relevance and latency requirements. Existing systems cascade GR with an independent relevance model, decoupling the generative likelihood objective from query-ad relevance discrimination, which compromises effectiveness and increases serving costs. We propose a Unified Generative-Discriminative framework (UniGD) that integrates retrieval and relevance scoring within a single model. To mitigate gradient interference in joint optimization, UniGD introduces Conflict-Aware Gradient Enhancement (CAGE) to adaptively coordinate the two objectives. UniGD further designs a Codebook-Anchored Representation Module (CAM) that anchors item representations to frozen hierarchical codebooks distilled from a multimodal pretrained model, thereby endowing them with rich and generalizable semantic priors. For heterogeneous short-video, product, and live-stream ads, UniGD proposes Heterogeneous Ad-material Modeling (HAM), which captures cross-type semantic commonality over a shared backbone while preserving type-specific modeling capacity. Online AB tests on Kuaishou search advertising platform show that UniGD raises ad revenue by 5.78%, reduces inference latency by 33%, and improves discriminative relevance estimation. On NQ320K and MS300K, UniGD improves Recall@10 over the strongest reproduced GR baseline by 8.44% and 3.19%, respectively.

</details>


### [256] [Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Knowledge Graph Construction for Multi-Lecture Educational Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03161)
*Sahil Al Farib,Momota Ahsana Meem,Sheikh Redwanul Islam,Md. Tanvir Raihan*

Main category: cs.AI

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多模态知识图谱构建（从讲座视频中提取概念和关系）。应用场景：教育视频理解与检索。传感器类型：不适用（输入为讲座视频的语音、幻灯片文本、OCR和视觉帧）。目标类别：概念（concept）和关系（relationship）提及，非视觉目标检测。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。流水线包含：transcription（语音转写）、semantic anchor selection（语义锚点选择）、OCR、vision-language model（视觉-语言模型）用于概念与关系提取、mention validation与canonicalization（提及验证与规范化）构建知识图谱。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或任何模型压缩/加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：三个神经网络讲座视频，包含3,118帧、756个转写片段、559个锚点。评价指标：endpoint coverage（端点覆盖率90.38%）、top-1/top-3 accuracy（100%）、mean top-5 recall（100%）。

Experiments: 在三个讲座视频上处理了3,118帧、756个转写片段和559个锚点，保留1,022个概念提及和312个关系提及，最终得到172个规范化概念和282个关系，端点覆盖率达90.38%。初步三项问题检索测试达到100% top-1和top-3准确率及100% mean top-5 recall。作者明确表示贡献在于可审计的构建方法而非SOTA性能。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：实验规模极小（仅三个讲座、三项检索测试），缺乏大规模验证；不涉及任何视觉目标检测或遥感场景；无部署相关指标；性能声明较弱（作者自述非SOTA）。

Ideas for my research: 与本人课题（遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化）基本无可借鉴点。唯一可能的间接启发是"evidence-grounded"（证据驱动）的思想——即在遥感目标检测中，可以借鉴"多模态证据交叉验证"的思路（如光学+SAR多源遥感数据融合验证检测结果），但这与本论文的实际技术内容关联很弱。

Abstract: Lecture videos distribute knowledge across speech, slide text, diagrams, equations, and presentation order, which transcript-only retrieval does not fully preserve. This paper presents an evidence-grounded multimodal pipeline that transcribes lectures, selects semantic anchors, applies optical character recognition (OCR), and uses a vision-language model to extract only concepts and typed relationships supported by transcript, OCR, or visual evidence. Mentions are validated and canonicalized into a provenance-rich knowledge graph. On three neural-network lectures, the pipeline processed 3,118 frames, 756 transcript segments, and 559 anchors. It retained 1,022 concept and 312 relationship mentions, yielding 172 canonical concepts and 282 relationships with 90.38% endpoint coverage. A preliminary three question retrieval test achieved 100% top-1 and top-3 accuracy and 100% mean top-5 recall. The contribution is an auditable construction method rather than a state-of-the-art performance claim.

</details>


### [257] [Adversarial Stress Testing of Role-Playing Language Agents using Multi-Agent Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03166)
*Saqib Shouqi,Abdullah Nazly,Januki Wanniarachchi,Ravisha De Alwis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个模块化多智能体平台，通过结构化多轮对话对角色扮演语言代理（RPLA）进行对抗性压力测试，协调审讯者、目标与评判三个智能体，揭示单策略测试无法发现的累积行为失败模式。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于自然语言处理/大语言模型安全评估领域，研究对象是角色扮演语言代理（RPLA），完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。论文既没有遥感目标检测任务，也没有任何模型轻量化或边缘/星上部署相关内容。它属于泛机器学习/泛AI方法，与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"方向基本无关，仅在"多智能体协同评估"这一方法论层面可能有极弱的间接借鉴意义。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于LLM安全评估领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。既无遥感场景、无目标检测任务，也无任何轻量化或部署技术。除非对多智能体评估框架有跨领域兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：角色扮演语言代理（RPLA）的对抗性压力测试与鲁棒性评估。应用场景：医疗辅助、客户支持、教育等高风险对话应用。传感器类型：不适用（纯文本对话）。目标类别：不适用。摘要未涉及任何视觉或遥感数据。

Model architecture: 模块化多智能体平台，包含三个协调智能体：(1) 策略驱动的审讯者智能体（Interrogator Agent），应用六种渐进式对抗策略；(2) 目标智能体（Target Agent），代表被评估的RPLA；(3) 自动评判智能体（Judging Agent），从角色保真度、漂移、伦理偏差和一致性四个维度评分。测试对象为Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3.5-Haiku三个LLM家族。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法，包括剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计等均未提及。也没有实时推理、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等部署相关内容。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署，未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等任何部署相关指标。测试对象为70B级别的大模型，与在轨部署的轻量化需求方向相反。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：三个persona（角色设定）和三个LLM家族（Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3.5-Haiku）上进行实验。评价指标：鲁棒性评分（robustness scores，降低0.17-0.20点）、自动评判与人类对齐度（r=0.82，Fleiss' κ=0.71）、角色保真度、漂移、伦理偏差、一致性四个维度。摘要未说明具体数据集名称。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：(1) 多策略对抗性评估能揭示单策略测试无法发现的失败模式，平均降低鲁棒性评分0.17-0.20点；(2) 跨模型验证显示Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3.5-Haiku存在一致的退化模式；(3) Authority Challenge（权威挑战）和Emotional Manipulation（情感操纵）是最有效的攻击策略；(4) 自动评判与人类评判高度对齐（r=0.82，Fleiss' κ=0.71）。摘要未说明消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要明确承认对抗性测试方法论本身存在潜在伦理风险，强调需负责任地使用以提升AI安全性。此外，摘要未说明：单策略与多策略对比的具体实验设置、六种对抗策略的具体定义、评判维度的量化标准、平台的计算开销与可扩展性。从本研究方向看，该论文完全不涉及遥感场景、目标检测或模型轻量化，缺乏任何可迁移的视觉或部署技术。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但以下方法论层面可能有极弱的间接借鉴：(1) "多策略协同评估"的思想可类比为在轨检测模型的多场景/多退化条件联合压力测试（如不同光照、云遮挡、传感器噪声下的鲁棒性评估）；(2) "自动评判智能体"的概念可类比为自动化评估轻量化模型在边缘设备上的性能退化程度；(3) "渐进式对抗策略"可类比为对轻量化检测模型的渐进式对抗攻击测试（如FGSM/PGD等）。但这些借鉴非常间接，整体阅读价值有限。

Abstract: Role-Playing Language Agents (RPLAs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications such as healthcare assistance, customer support, and education, where maintaining consistent personas, ethical constraints, and behavioral coherence under adversarial pressure is critical. Existing evaluation approaches rely on static benchmarks or isolated single-turn prompts that fail to capture cumulative behavioral failures emerging over extended interactions.
  We present a modular multi-agent platform for adversarially stress-testing RPLAs through structured, multi-turn dialogue. The system coordinates three agents: a strategy-driven Interrogator Agent that applies six progressive adversarial strategies, a Target Agent representing the RPLA under evaluation, and an automated Judging Agent that scores behavior across role fidelity, drift, ethical deviation, and consistency dimensions.
  Through experiments across three personas and three LLM families, we demonstrate that multi-strategy adversarial evaluation reveals failure modes invisible to single-strategy testing, reducing overall robustness scores by 0.17--0.20 points on average. Cross-model validation confirms consistent degradation patterns across Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, and Claude-3.5-Haiku, with Authority Challenge and Emotional Manipulation emerging as the most effective attack strategies. Automated judging achieves strong human alignment ($r = 0.82$, Fleiss' $κ= 0.71$). This work is released as an open-source platform to support AI safety and reproducible RPLA benchmarking. While the framework enables systematic discovery of failure modes, we acknowledge potential ethical risks associated with adversarial testing methodologies and emphasize responsible usage for improving AI safety.

</details>


### [258] [Surrogate Substitution Preserves PHI Detectability: A Multi-Detector Equivalence Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03172)
*Qiming Bao,Sherry J. H. Feng,Kim Chester Eugenio,Meng Fon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构保持的去标识化（de-identification）评估协议，用于检验下游PHI检测器在掩码片段上能否仍识别出替代性数据（surrogate），并采用等价性检验（TOST）而非显著性检验来评估11个检测器在7个基准、7种语言上的性能变化。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于医疗文本（clinical text）中的受保护健康信息（PHI）去标识化与下游检测器评估，属于自然语言处理（NLP）与隐私保护领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、地球观测、目标检测或模型轻量化。既无遥感图像/传感器数据，也无目标检测任务，更无剪枝/量化/蒸馏等轻量化方法。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为医疗文本去标识化与NLP隐私评估，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。仅当对"等价性检验用于模型压缩评估"这一方法论感兴趣时可作泛读参考。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：结构保持的去标识化（structure-preserving de-identification）评估；应用场景：医疗临床文本隐私保护；数据类型：临床文本（clinical text），非遥感图像；目标类别：PHI（受保护健康信息），如人名、机构名等，非遥感目标。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。涉及11个下游PHI检测器（detectors）作为评估对象，但未给出其网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。本文无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络等模型压缩或加速方法。核心贡献是评估协议（evaluation protocol）而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。本文与星上/边缘部署无关，未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：7个基准（benchmarks）、7种语言、1,750篇文档、57k配对片段（paired spans）；评价指标：掩码片段上的召回率（recall on masked spans），从76.1%降至74.9%；采用等价性检验（TOST, two one-sided tests）而非零假设显著性检验，等价边界为±2个百分点（p ~ 3e-9）。

Experiments: 在11个检测器、7个基准、7种语言上评估，掩码片段召回率从76.1%变为74.9%，等价性检验表明该变化在±2点边界内统计等价于零，检测器排名保持。残余损失集中在畸形（malformed）和分布外（out-of-distribution）替代数据上（如截断 Chicago->Illino、显著性丢失 Cedars-Sinai->Vidant）。消融/对照包括redaction floor和开源surrogate baseline。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关，无法提供遥感目标检测或轻量化方面的任何信息。摘要未说明模型结构、计算开销、部署约束等。其评估协议（等价性检验、掩码片段解耦评估）虽在方法论上有一定通用性，但属于NLP隐私领域，对遥感在轨检测课题借鉴价值极低。

Ideas for my research: 尽管整体弱相关，但方法论层面有一个可借鉴点：其"仅在掩码片段上评估、将coverage与utility解耦"的评估思路，以及用等价性检验（TOST）而非显著性检验来判断模型压缩前后性能差异是否"统计等价"，可迁移到轻量化评估中——即判断剪枝/量化后的检测模型与原始模型在精度上是否统计等价，而非仅看均值差异。此外，其"surrogate-failure typology"（区分可修复缺陷与固有局限）的分类思想，可用于区分轻量化引入的精度损失是可修复的（如量化误差）还是模型固有局限。

Abstract: Structure-preserving de-identification replaces protected health information (PHI) with realistic same-type surrogates -- "Anna S." becomes "Maria S.", not [NAME] -- so that clinical text stays fluent and downstream tools keep working. But this only helps if the substitution does not itself corrupt the signal those tools rely on. We ask a narrow, testable question: on the spans a de-identifier actually masks, can downstream PHI detectors still find the surrogate? We introduce a paired, multi-detector evaluation protocol that (i) scores utility only on masked spans, decoupling coverage from utility; (ii) uses equivalence testing (TOST) rather than null-hypothesis significance testing, which is uninformative at our sample size (57k paired spans); and (iii) builds a surrogate-failure typology separating fixable generator defects from intrinsic detector limits. Across 11 detectors, 7 benchmarks, and 7 languages (1,750 documents), recall on masked spans moves from 76.1% to 74.9% -- a change our equivalence test shows is statistically equivalent to zero within a +/-2-point margin (p ~ 3e-9), with detector ranking preserved. The residual loss does not reflect detectors getting worse at PHI: it concentrates in malformed and out-of-distribution surrogates (truncation Chicago -> Illino, salience loss Cedars-Sinai -> Vidant). A redaction floor and an open-source surrogate baseline indicate the effect is a property of well-formed substitution, not of one tool. We release the evaluation subsets, scoring code, and an interactive dashboard at https://custodianai.pages.dev so the protocol can audit any structure-preserving transform.

</details>


### [259] [Diversity is Not Ambiguity: Toward Accurate and Efficient Ambiguity Detection for Open-Domain QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03177)
*Jiwon Lee,Yong-chan Park,Jungin Hong,U Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ARCHIVE框架，通过逻辑冲突检测来识别开放域问答中的歧义查询，结合轻量级early-exit编码器和冲突推理模块，在QuireQA基准上提升F1分数并实现16倍加速。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。该论文聚焦于开放域问答（open-domain QA）中的歧义检测（ambiguity detection），属于自然语言处理（NLP）领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。虽然论文中提到了"lightweight early-exit encoder"和"16× faster"等与效率相关的表述，但这是针对NLP问答系统的计算效率优化，与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化没有任何直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于NLP问答领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。虽然early-exit动态推理思想有一定概念上的启发，但不值得作为核心文献精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：开放域问答（open-domain QA）中的歧义检测（ambiguity detection）。应用场景：文本问答系统，判断查询是否存在歧义。传感器类型：不适用（纯文本/NLP任务）。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: ARCHIVE框架包含两个核心模块：(1) 轻量级early-exit编码器（lightweight early-exit encoder），用于处理表面可检测的歧义情况；(2) 冲突推理模块（conflict reasoning module），建模答案之间的逻辑关系。此外引入不变性目标（invariance objective）以增强对噪声答案集的鲁棒性。

Lightweight method: 采用了early-exit机制（early-exit encoder）作为轻量化手段，即对简单/表面可检测的查询提前退出，避免不必要的深层计算。这与模型剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏等经典模型压缩方法不同，属于动态推理/自适应计算路径的范畴。但该轻量化是针对NLP问答模型，而非遥感目标检测模型。

Onboard deployability: 摘要提到ARCHIVE比最佳竞争者快16×（16× faster），但未说明具体参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存或能耗等部署指标。且该加速是针对NLP问答任务，与星上/边缘部署遥感目标检测模型无关。摘要未说明具体硬件平台或部署环境。

Datasets and metrics: 提出了QuireQA基准，包含4,703个查询，涵盖factoid、non-factoid和ill-formed三类查询。评价指标为F1-amb（歧义检测F1）和F1-unamb（非歧义检测F1）。

Experiments: 实验表明ARCHIVE在F1-amb上最高提升10.4%，在F1-unamb上最高提升21.6%，且运行速度比最佳竞争者快16×。摘要未说明具体对比方法名称和消融实验细节。

Limitations: 摘要未说明：具体参数量、FLOPs、推理延迟等部署指标；模型在真实硬件上的部署验证；与遥感/视觉任务的任何关联。该工作完全面向NLP问答场景，与遥感目标检测和轻量化方向无直接可迁移性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感目标检测无关，但有两个概念层面的思路可借鉴：(1) early-exit / 动态推理思想——在遥感目标检测中，可以对简单场景（如均匀背景、无目标区域）提前退出浅层网络，对复杂场景（密集小目标、遮挡）才进入深层网络，从而在保证精度的同时降低平均推理成本，这对星上计算资源受限的场景有启发意义；(2) 逻辑冲突/一致性校验思想——在遥感目标检测中，可以利用多视角或多时相观测之间的逻辑一致性来校验检测结果，减少误检。但需注意，这些只是方法论层面的类比借鉴，论文本身与遥感无关。

Abstract: How can question answering (QA) systems determine whether a query is ambiguous? Ambiguity detection is essential in open-domain QA, as misclassification leads to answering the wrong interpretation or unnecessary clarification. However, existing methods conflate answer diversity with ambiguity, leading to inaccurate predictions. They also process queries uniformly, resulting in wasteful computation. We propose ARCHIVE (Ambiguity Recognition via Cascaded Hypothesis Inspection and Conflict Verification), an accurate and efficient framework that detects ambiguity via logical conflict: a query is ambiguous when its valid answers cannot all be true under a single interpretation. ARCHIVE combines a lightweight early-exit encoder for surface-detectable cases with a conflict reasoning module that models logical relations among answers, reinforced by an invariance objective for robustness to noisy answer sets. We present QuireQA, a 4,703-query benchmark spanning factoid, non-factoid, and ill-formed queries. Experiments show ARCHIVE outperforms competitors, improving F1-amb by up to 10.4% and F1-unamb by up to 21.6%, while operating 16$\times$ faster than the best competitor.

</details>


### [260] [TumorBoard: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Decision Support for Longitudinal Neuro-Oncology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03190)
*Yantong Liu,Zheyu Zhang,Runpeng Liu,Mu Xitang,Seong-Yoon Shin,Hyun-Ae Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TumorBoard 是一个面向神经肿瘤学临床决策的多智能体决策支持系统，通过共享纵向病例状态和可审计的声明-证据账本，协调放射学、神经病理学、分子诊断、指南和治疗规划等专家智能体，并引入对抗性批评者和安全治理器来保证推荐的安全性与证据充分性。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，属于医疗AI多智能体决策系统，不涉及遥感、目标检测或模型压缩/部署优化，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：神经肿瘤学临床决策支持（multi-agent decision-support system）。应用场景：医疗影像（serial MRI）与多模态临床数据综合判读。传感器类型：MRI（磁共振成像），非遥感传感器。目标类别：肿瘤诊疗决策，非目标检测任务。

Model architecture: 多智能体系统架构：共享纵向病例状态（shared longitudinal case state）+ 可审计声明-证据账本（auditable claim-evidence ledger）。包含五类专家智能体：放射学（radiology）、神经病理学（neuropathology）、分子诊断（molecular diagnosis）、指南（guidelines）、治疗规划（therapy planning）。另有对抗性批评者（adversarial critic）和安全性治理器（safety governor）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标，且其应用场景为医疗决策支持，与星上/边缘部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：360例隐藏基准测试集（360-case hidden benchmark），匹配token预算（matched token budget）。评价指标：action F1（0.772）、evidence entailment（0.914）、recommendation-to-evidence coverage（0.927）、unsafe case deferral rate（84.2%）、harmful recommendation rate（5.8%）、harmful release reduction（7.8个百分点）、false-deferral cost（4.3个百分点）。

Experiments: 主要结果：TumorBoard在action F1上超过最强typed-council基线3.1个百分点（95% CI: 1.6-4.7，adjusted p=0.0012）。在证据删除场景下，系统推迟了84.2%的不安全病例，将有害推荐限制在5.8%。安全性治理器将有害发布降低了7.8个百分点，代价是4.3个百分点的误推迟。消融实验验证了账本（ledger）、批评者（critic）和治理器（governor）各自的作用，确认结构化协同是性能提升的来源。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但明显可见：该研究完全面向医疗临床决策场景，与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化无任何交集；未涉及任何视觉目标检测任务、遥感数据或部署优化；其多智能体协同框架的token预算优化与模型轻量化（参数量/FLOPs/延迟）属于不同层面的问题。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与本课题方向基本无关，但可借鉴的点有限且间接：(1) 多智能体协同与"声明-证据账本"（claim-evidence ledger）的思想，若未来在轨遥感目标检测中引入多模型协同推理（如检测模型+验证模型），可参考其可审计的证据链设计来提升检测结果的可信度；(2) 安全性治理器（safety governor）的"延迟/限定/发布"三级决策机制，可类比于在轨场景中低置信度检测结果的"延迟上报/降级处理"策略。但这些均为架构层面的间接启发，对模型轻量化本身无直接贡献。

Abstract: Neuro-oncology decisions require coordinated interpretation of serial MRI, pathology, molecular markers, treatment history, performance status, and evolving guidelines. We present TumorBoard, a multi-agent decision-support system built around a shared longitudinal case state and an auditable claim-evidence ledger. Specialist agents for radiology, neuropathology, molecular diagnosis, guidelines, and therapy planning produce atomic claims with provenance. An adversarial critic exposes contradictions, and a safety governor releases, qualifies, or defers recommendations according to evidence sufficiency and temporal validity. On a 360-case hidden benchmark at a matched token budget, TumorBoard achieved an action F1 of 0.772 and evidence entailment of 0.914. It exceeded the strongest typed-council baseline by 3.1 percentage points (95% CI: 1.6 to 4.7, adjusted p = 0.0012), while recommendation-to-evidence coverage reached 0.927. Under evidence deletion, the system deferred 84.2% of unsafe cases and limited harmful recommendations to 5.8%. The safety governor reduced harmful release by 7.8 percentage points at a false-deferral cost of 4.3 percentage points. Ablation studies of the ledger, critic, and governor produced the predicted failure patterns, establishing structured coordination as the source of the measured multi-agent advantage.

</details>


### [261] [When Refusal Looks Safe: The Refusal-Cue Shortcut in Safety Guard Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03201)
*Yu Feng,Chunting Zang,Chen Shen,Rui Miao,Ge Teng,Weidong Cai,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究安全护栏（safety guard）模型中的"拒绝提示捷径"（refusal-cue shortcut）问题，并提出一种轻量级后处理干预方法（sparse complementary masking）来抑制该捷径，无需重新训练即可大幅降低由拒绝提示导致的检测失败。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的安全护栏（safety guard）内容过滤任务，属于自然语言处理/安全对齐领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。虽然文中提到"lightweight post-hoc intervention"（轻量级后处理干预），但这里的"轻量"指的是无需重训练的参数级干预，与模型压缩/轻量化部署（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS）完全无关。目标检测、遥感目标、星上部署等概念均未出现。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为LLM安全护栏的捷径问题与后处理干预，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。仅"sparse masking干预无需重训练"这一方法论思路在极端情况下可类比参考，但整体阅读优先级极低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM安全护栏（safety guard）的有害内容检测/过滤（harmful content detection）。应用场景：大语言模型安全对齐与内容审核。传感器类型：不适用（纯文本NLP任务）。目标类别：有害/无害提示-响应对（harmful/unharmful prompt-response pairs）。

Model architecture: 研究对象为安全护栏模型，包括基于WildGuardMix和GR-Train数据集训练的护栏，以及官方发布的LlamaGuard3和Qwen3Guard。干预方法为sparse complementary masking，识别并抑制与捷径相关的少量attention heads和MLP neurons。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 文中"lightweight"指sparse complementary masking作为一种post-hoc干预手段，无需重新训练（without retraining），仅通过识别并抑制少量与捷径关联的attention heads和MLP neurons来实现。这属于模型内部机制干预，而非传统意义上的模型压缩/加速方法（如pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS, TensorRT等）。与遥感在轨部署所需的轻量化（参数量、FLOPs、延迟、能耗优化）无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署指标。且该任务为NLP安全对齐，与星上/边缘部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：WildGuardMix、GR-Train（训练/审计数据）；LlamaGuard3、Qwen3Guard（官方发布模型，训练数据未公开）。评价指标：标准检测性能（standard detection performance）、响应初始位置检测失败率（response-initial detection failures），干预后相对降低约79%。摘要未说明具体指标名称（如F1、AUC等）。

Experiments: 主要实验：1) 审计WildGuardMix和GR-Train发现refusal expressions与unharmful labels几乎共现，形成refusal-cue shortcut；2) 验证该捷径影响官方模型LlamaGuard3和Qwen3Guard；3) 提出sparse complementary masking干预，在两个基准上实现约79%的响应初始位置检测失败相对降低，同时保持标准检测性能；4) 验证抑制效果可迁移到未见位置和数据集；5) 分析表明捷径依赖与合法拒绝识别在功能上部分可分离。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，属于NLP安全对齐领域；2) 干预方法虽无需重训练，但未报告计算开销、推理延迟等部署指标；3) 干预仅在单一响应位置优化，虽验证了迁移性，但跨位置/跨数据集的泛化机制仍需进一步研究；4) 摘要未说明干预对模型整体能力（除安全检测外）的影响。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测无关，但以下方法论层面有潜在借鉴价值：1) "sparse complementary masking"识别并抑制少量关键attention heads/neurons的思路，可类比于在遥感检测模型中定位并剪除对特定任务（如小目标检测）贡献冗余的通道/神经元，实现无需重训练或轻量微调的模型压缩；2) 论文揭示"捷径依赖与合法功能部分可分离"的结论，提示在遥感模型轻量化时，可通过分析哪些内部组件对特定目标类别（如小目标、旋转目标）起关键作用，从而进行更有针对性的结构化剪枝。但整体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Safety guards are widely used to filter harmful content and are typically trained via supervised fine-tuning on labeled prompt-response pairs. We audit two widely used safety-guard training datasets, WildGuardMix and GR-Train, and find that among responses to harmful prompts, refusal expressions co-occur almost exclusively with unharmful labels. This imbalance motivates what we term the refusal-cue shortcut: inserting a refusal cue into a harmful response could flip the guard's verdict from harmful to unharmful. The shortcut affects not only guards trained on these datasets but also officially released models such as LlamaGuard3 and Qwen3Guard whose training data is undisclosed. It persists across response positions and is generally stronger in smaller variants within a family. To mitigate it, we adapt sparse complementary masking as a lightweight post-hoc intervention that identifies and suppresses a small set of shortcut-associated attention heads and MLP neurons without retraining. On two primary benchmarks, the intervention achieves an approximately 79% relative reduction in response-initial detection failures induced by refusal cues, while preserving standard detection performance. Although optimized using cues at a single response position, the suppression effect transfers to unseen positions and datasets, suggesting that shortcut manifestations across positions are partly mediated by shared internal components. Further analysis provides evidence that shortcut reliance and legitimate refusal recognition are partially functionally separable, as suppressing the shortcut broadly preserves the guard's ability to recognize genuine refusals.

</details>


### [262] [The Agent Operating System (AOS): A Reference Operating Architecture for Distributed Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03214)
*Ankur Sharma,Deep Shah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Agent Operating System (AOS)，一个面向分布式智能体系统的厂商中立参考操作系统架构，包含控制治理平面和运行时协调平面，用于治理意图、选择能力、维护授权、控制不确定性并协调运行时行为。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于大语言模型驱动的分布式智能体系统（agentic systems）的操作系统架构设计，属于AI系统软件/基础设施层面，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩。相关性评分为1分。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于AI系统软件架构领域，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：分布式智能体系统（agentic systems）的操作系统架构设计。应用场景：大语言模型驱动的长期运行分布式系统，涉及工具调用、外部状态检索、任务委派等。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: AOS包含两个内部平面：(1) Control & Governance Plane——负责意图、策略、信任、授权、置信度、可审计性、可观测性和人类监督；(2) Runtime & Coordination Plane——负责智能体生命周期、工作流协调、模型与工具路由、上下文与记忆协调、调度、流量管理和运行时保障。平台服务、Linux/Windows、容器运行时和物理基础设施位于AOS边界之外，通过显式接口集成。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量网络设计等模型压缩/加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明。论文未提及任何数据集或评价指标，属于架构概念性论文。

Experiments: 摘要未说明。论文提出AOS的概念、不变量、接口对象、优化目标、部署配置文件和可靠性职责，并识别了权衡和未解决的研究问题，但未给出实验验证。

Limitations: 论文为纯概念性/架构性工作，缺乏实验验证和实证评估。摘要明确承认AOS并非替代现有框架或基础设施，而是作为组合异构组件的操作系统架构提出，并指出存在权衡和未解决的研究问题。与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化方向无任何关联。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值很低。唯一可能的间接启发是：如果未来在轨智能系统需要多模型协同（如检测+分类+决策的级联推理），AOS中关于"模型与工具路由"、"上下文与记忆协调"、"调度"的思想可能对星上多任务推理的资源调度设计有参考意义，但这属于非常间接的类比，且星上资源约束与通用分布式系统差异巨大。

Abstract: Large language models have transformed artificial intelligence from isolated prediction services into components of long-running, distributed systems that reason, invoke tools, retrieve external state, delegate tasks, and act on behalf of users and organizations. The surrounding ecosystem has responded with agent frameworks, workflow engines, model-serving platforms, memory systems, communication protocols, and observability tools. These technologies improve execution, but they do not provide a stable, implementation-independent operating architecture for governing intent, selecting capabilities, preserving authority across delegation, controlling uncertainty, coordinating runtime behavior, and reconstructing why consequential actions occurred. This paper proposes the Agent Operating System (AOS), a vendor-neutral reference operating architecture for distributed agentic systems. AOS contains two internal planes: a Control & Governance Plane responsible for intent, policy, trust, authority, confidence, auditability, observability, and human oversight; and a Runtime & Coordination Plane responsible for agent lifecycle, workflow coordination, model and tool routing, context and memory coordination, scheduling, traffic management, and runtime assurance. Platform services, Linux or Windows, container runtimes, and physical infrastructure remain outside the AOS boundary and are integrated through explicit interfaces. The paper specifies AOS concepts, invariants, interface objects, optimization objectives, deployment profiles, and reliability responsibilities. It also identifies tradeoffs and unresolved research questions. AOS is not presented as a replacement for existing frameworks or infrastructure; it is proposed as the operating architecture through which heterogeneous components can be composed into governable, reliable, observable, and interoperable agentic systems.

</details>


### [263] [Reachability Is Not Realization: Tracing the Sources of LLM Benchmark Gains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03219)
*Yanchao Li,Wanhao Liu,Jiaqing Xie,Ben Gao,Yanbo Wang,Tianfan Fu,Yuqiang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种问题级审计框架，区分LLM的"已实现能力"(realization)与"可达能力"(reachability)，发现推理时层路由和训练扩展对两者影响不一致，主张能力评估应同时报告两者。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦大语言模型(LLM)的能力评估方法论，讨论realization与reachability的区分，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型轻量化。虽然涉及"推理时层路由"(inference-time layer routing)和"MLP block silencing"等模型内部机制分析，但这些是针对LLM推理行为的分析，与遥感在轨目标检测的轻量化部署无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM能力评估方法论研究。仅"realization vs reachability"评估框架和层路由概念有极弱的间接借鉴价值，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM能力评估与审计（question-level audit）。应用场景：大语言模型部署与能力分析。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测）。

Model architecture: 研究对象为LLM（规模0.5B到31B），涉及推理时层路由(inference-time layer routing)、MLP block silencing等机制分析。摘要未说明具体模型架构细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明传统轻量化方法（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS等）。涉及"推理时层路由"和"silencing MLP block"可视为一种推理时的动态模块选择/跳过机制，与动态推理(dynamic inference)或层跳过(layer skipping)有一定概念关联，但目的不是压缩模型或加速部署，而是分析能力可达性。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 涉及43个model和task设置、6个case（0.5B到31B规模）、DAPO训练方法。评价指标为realized performance（部署性能）和reachable ceiling（可达上限）。摘要未说明具体数据集名称。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：(1) 在匹配预算下，随机层路由在43个设置中匹配或超过结构化搜索；(2) 答案盲(Answer-blind)过程几乎不保留增益，需要访问正确答案；(3) silencing一个MLP block可修复68%-92%的预定义失败集；(4) 训练在5/6匹配评估中提升部署性能但可达上限持平或下降，DAPO部署分数上升14.7点而可达上限下降13.3点。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可指出：论文聚焦LLM能力评估，与遥感目标检测和轻量化完全无关；其"realization vs reachability"框架虽具方法论价值，但需大幅迁移才能用于遥感模型评估。

Ideas for my research: 尽管弱相关，但"realization vs reachability"的评估框架对遥感在轨目标检测有潜在启发：(1) 在评估轻量化模型时，可区分"模型在标准推理流程下实际达到的精度"与"在特定搜索/推理策略下可达的精度上限"，避免仅用benchmark分数掩盖行为差异；(2) 层路由/模块跳过的概念与动态推理(dynamic inference)相关，可借鉴到遥感模型的推理时自适应计算分配（如简单场景跳过深层模块），但需注意本文结论是随机路由即可匹配结构化搜索，且需要访问正确答案，这对无监督的轻量化部署参考价值有限；(3) 训练后部署性能上升但可达上限下降的现象，提示在遥感模型轻量化训练中需同时监控"可达精度"而非仅看最终精度。

Abstract: Benchmark gains are often treated as evidence of greater LLM capability. Yet the same gain can reflect different changes in model behavior. A model may reach new answers, or produce answers that were already within reach. Aggregate scores do not distinguish these changes question by question. We establish a question-level audit under fixed budgets, temperatures, and answer formats. A question is realized when the default deployment procedure produces the correct answer. A question is reachable when a specified probe finds that answer within a fixed budget. We first test whether inference-time layer routing can expand reachability.
