Under a matched budget, random routes match or exceed structured search in all 43 model and task settings. Answer-blind procedures retain almost none of this gain, which instead requires access to the correct answer. We then ask why reachable answers sometimes fail to appear. Across six cases spanning 0.5B to 31B, silencing one identified MLP block repairs 68 to 92 percent of a predefined failure set. We next test whether training closes the gap by expanding reachability. In five of six matched evaluations, deployed performance rises while the reachable ceiling remains flat or falls. For DAPO, the deployed score rises by 14.7 points while the reachable ceiling falls by 13.3 points. Across the settings we audit, realization and reachability therefore do not always change together. Claims of capability expansion should report both realized performance and reachability under matched evaluation conditions. Code is available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/reachability-not-realization

</details>


### [264] [UniNav: A Unified World-Action Diffusion Model for Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03244)
*Changqing Zhou,Yueru Luo,Zeyu Jiang,Changhao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UniNav 提出一个统一的 world-action 扩散模型，通过单一 diffusion process 同时生成未来视觉观测和连续航点轨迹，用于 embodied agent 的 image-goal 视觉导航任务。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文属于 embodied AI / 视觉导航领域，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景完全无关；也不涉及目标检测任务。虽然涉及"efficient trajectory prediction"和"latency 0.1s"等效率优化，但这是针对导航策略的推理加速，并非面向遥感目标检测的模型轻量化（pruning/quantization/distillation/NAS），借鉴意义有限。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于 embodied visual navigation 领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测或传统模型压缩技术，借鉴价值有限。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：image-goal visual navigation（图像目标视觉导航），属于 embodied agent 导航任务。应用场景：室内/室外机器人导航。传感器类型：视觉相机（RGB frames + goal image）。目标类别：导航目标位置/航点，不涉及遥感目标检测中的舰船、飞机、车辆等类别。

Model architecture: UniNav 采用 unified world-action model：单一 diffusion process 联合去噪 visual tokens 和 waypoint tokens，基于 single transformer 框架。包含 geometry-aware camera tokens 以增强空间 grounding。两个变体：UniNav-Full（联合预测未来观测+轨迹）和 UniNav-Fast（推理时移除 future-image tokens 以加速轨迹预测）。

Lightweight method: 摘要中未涉及传统模型压缩方法（pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS）。唯一的效率优化手段是 UniNav-Fast 在推理阶段移除 future-image tokens（即减少输出 token 数量）以实现 one-step inference，达到 0.1s 延迟。这是一种"推理时裁剪输出分支"的策略，而非对模型权重或结构的轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅报告 UniNav-Fast 在 one-step inference 下延迟为 0.1s，且精度无明显下降。但该延迟是在导航 benchmark 上的推理延迟，并非星上/边缘部署场景，也未提及硬件平台（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT 等）。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：navigation benchmarks（摘要未给出具体数据集名称，如 Habitat、Gibson 等未说明）。评价指标：ATE（Absolute Trajectory Error，绝对轨迹误差）。训练数据包括 trajectory-labeled navigation data 和 video-only data（无航点标注的视频数据）。

Experiments: UniNav 在所有数据集上的 ATE 指标均优于最强 baseline。UniNav-Fast 通过 one-step inference 实现 0.1s 延迟且精度无明显下降。摘要未给出具体数值对比、消融实验细节或与其他导航方法的详细对比表。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于 embodied navigation 领域；2. 摘要未说明模型参数量、FLOPs 等轻量化关键指标；3. 未涉及任何传统模型压缩技术；4. 0.1s 延迟的硬件平台和部署环境未说明；5. 未讨论在低算力/边缘设备上的可行性。

Ideas for my research: 1. "推理时移除部分 token/分支"的思路可借鉴——在遥感目标检测中，可在推理阶段根据场景复杂度动态裁剪部分计算路径（类似 dynamic inference）；2. "video-only 数据训练"的多模态数据利用思想，可类比遥感中利用无标注影像进行自监督预训练；3. diffusion 统一框架的 idea 对遥感多任务（检测+分割）联合建模有一定启发，但整体相关性较弱。

Abstract: Image-goal visual navigation is a fundamental capability for embodied agents. Existing navigation policies efficiently predict waypoint trajectories but lack visual foresight, while navigation world models can anticipate future observations but often require costly planning rollouts. We present UniNav, a unified world-action model that generates future visual observations and continuous waypoint trajectories through a single diffusion process. Given history frames and a goal image, UniNav jointly denoises visual and waypoint tokens within a single transformer, unifying future prediction and action generation in a shared framework. To improve spatial grounding, we incorporate geometry-aware camera tokens. We also train on both trajectory-labeled navigation data and video-only data, enabling the model to benefit from diverse videos without waypoint annotations. Based on this unified framework, we introduce two variants: UniNav-Full jointly predicts interpretable future observations and their corresponding trajectories, while UniNav-Fast removes future-image tokens at inference for efficient trajectory prediction. Experiments on navigation benchmarks show that UniNav outperforms the strongest baseline in ATE across all datasets. With one-step inference, UniNav-Fast achieves a latency of 0.1s without a substantial accuracy drop. Code will be released.

</details>


### [265] [One Knob to Rule Them All: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Cold-Start Active Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03249)
*Ning Zhu,Xiaochuan Ma,Juntao Xu,Jingze Liang,Mengfei Zhao,An Chen,Liang-Jian Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于最优传输（optimal transport）的冷启动主动学习（Cold-Start Active Learning）框架，通过熵正则化的数据自适应规则（ε-Adaptive Selection, ε-AS）自动适应数据与任务，在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于泛机器学习/主动学习（active learning）领域，核心是冷启动样本选择问题，与遥感、卫星、在轨目标检测、轻量化均无直接关联。虽然主动学习可用于减少遥感标注成本，但摘要中未涉及任何遥感场景、目标检测或模型压缩/加速内容，属于泛视觉/泛机器学习方法。

Reading priority: 2分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向弱相关，属于通用主动学习研究。除非课题涉及遥感标注数据稀缺下的主动学习样本选择，否则优先级较低。可作为方法论参考，但不构成核心阅读材料。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：冷启动主动学习（Cold-Start Active Learning, CSAL），即无先验知识、无人工辅助地从无标注池中选择有价值的子集。应用场景：通用图像分类/标注任务，非遥感场景。传感器类型：摘要未说明（使用ImageNet-1k等通用数据集）。目标类别：摘要未说明。

Model architecture: 提出ε-Adaptive Selection (ε-AS)算法，基于Sinkhorn算法求解最优传输问题。核心组件包括：(1) 广义传输选择框架（generalized transport selection framework），统一了现有方法的共享分配结构；(2) 熵正则化（entropic regularization）控制选择权衡；(3) 数据自适应正则化规则（data-adaptive regularization rule）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等模型压缩或加速方法。唯一与效率相关的是选择时间（selection time）的降低（较ActiveFT减少56.2%），但这属于主动学习样本选择的计算效率，而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署信息。该工作面向通用主动学习场景，未涉及星上/边缘部署可行性。仅报告了选择时间减少56.2%，但这与在轨推理部署无关。

Datasets and metrics: 在六个公开数据集上进行了实验，涵盖多个标注预算（annotation budgets）。具体数据集名称摘要仅提及ImageNet-1k（用于对比ActiveFT，平均准确率提升1.29%，选择时间减少56.2%），其余五个数据集名称摘要未说明。评价指标为平均准确率（average accuracy）和选择时间（selection time）。

Experiments: 在六个公开数据集和多个标注预算下，ε-AS一致达到state-of-the-art性能。在ImageNet-1k上，相比ActiveFT平均准确率提升1.29%，选择时间减少56.2%。摘要未提供与其他方法的详细对比表、消融实验细节或具体数值。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测/轻量化方向基本无关，属于通用主动学习研究；(2) 摘要未说明在遥感数据（如SAR、高光谱、多光谱）上的表现；(3) 未涉及目标检测任务，仅针对图像分类/标注场景；(4) 未提供模型部署相关的参数量、FLOPs、延迟等关键信息；(5) 未讨论在标注预算极低或数据分布极端（如遥感小目标密集场景）下的鲁棒性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管与在轨目标检测轻量化直接关联较弱，但有以下间接借鉴点：(1) 遥感在轨场景中标注数据稀缺，冷启动主动学习可用于地面端减少遥感图像标注成本，辅助构建训练集；(2) 最优传输框架的熵正则化自适应思想可迁移到遥感小目标检测的样本选择或类别不平衡处理；(3) Sinkhorn算法的计算效率优化思路对星上资源受限环境下的算法设计有一定启发；(4) 若未来将主动学习与轻量化检测模型结合，可探索"用更少标注训练更轻模型"的联合优化路径。

Abstract: Cold-Start Active Learning (CSAL) aims to select a valuable subset from an unlabeled pool without any prior knowledge or human assistance. Existing methods take diverse routes based on typicality, coverage, or diversity. Each rests on its own inductive bias and therefore performs well on some tasks yet poorly on others. We argue that the real challenge is not to design yet another selection heuristic, but to make CSAL adapt automatically to the data and task at hand. To this end, we revisit CSAL through the lens of optimal transport. First, we propose a generalized transport selection framework that reveals the shared allocation structure of existing methods and exactly subsumes representative formulations. Second, we introduce a theoretical analysis that characterizes the trade-off controlled by entropic regularization and establishes a task-agnostic minimax bound for cold-start selection. These results provide a principled foundation for adapting the regularization strength to the unlabeled data. Third, we derive a data-adaptive regularization rule and present a novel Sinkhorn-based CSAL algorithm, termed $ε$-Adaptive Selection ($ε$-AS). Extensive experiments on six public datasets and multiple annotation budgets show that $ε$-AS consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. On ImageNet-1k, it improves the average accuracy over ActiveFT by 1.29% while reducing selection time by 56.2%. Code will be released at https://github.com/Z-yiwei/OT-CSAL

</details>


### [266] [TaskPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression via Task-Guided Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03276)
*Wonpyo Park,Seung-won Hwang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TaskPress 提出一种面向大语言模型长上下文推理的任务引导、查询无关的 KV cache 淘汰框架，利用任务级引导作为 meta-query 在 prefill 阶段过滤无关 token，并借助量化 scale factor 作为零成本信号检测重要表征离群点，从而构建跨查询可复用的紧凑缓存。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于大语言模型（LLM）长上下文推理中的 KV cache 压缩/淘汰问题，属于泛机器学习/泛视觉方法范畴。虽然其核心思想涉及"pruning"（剪枝/淘汰）和"quantization"（量化），但这些概念应用于 LLM 的 KV cache 管理，而非遥感图像目标检测模型的轻量化。论文不涉及 remote sensing、satellite、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及 object detection 任务。其借鉴价值仅在于"任务引导的查询无关缓存淘汰"和"量化 scale factor 作为重要性信号"这两个方法论层面的思路，与在轨遥感目标检测轻量化方向关联较弱。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文聚焦 LLM KV cache 压缩，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关。虽然"任务引导的查询无关淘汰"和"量化 scale factor 作为重要性信号"在方法论上有一定启发，但迁移成本高、关联度低，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：大语言模型长上下文推理中的 KV cache 内存管理/淘汰（KV cache eviction）。应用场景：LLM 长序列推理，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用（处理对象是 token 序列而非图像目标）。

Model architecture: TaskPress 框架包含两个关键组件：(1) 任务引导（task guide）作为 meta-query，在 prefill 阶段过滤与任务无关的 token；(2) 利用 quantization scale factors 作为零成本信号（zero-cost signal）检测表征中的 influential outliers，作为 token 重要性的高效代理。整体架构围绕 LLM 的 KV cache 构建可复用的紧凑记忆表示。

Lightweight method: 涉及两类轻量化/压缩技术：(1) KV cache pruning/eviction——通过任务引导的查询无关淘汰策略压缩缓存；(2) quantization——利用量化 scale factor 作为检测重要 token 的零成本信号。但注意：这里的 pruning 和 quantization 是服务于 LLM KV cache 压缩的，并非遥感目标检测模型的剪枝/量化压缩。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。虽然 KV cache 压缩本质上是为了降低推理内存开销，但摘要未给出具体数值或硬件部署信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。仅提到"various tasks with long context input"（多种长上下文输入任务），未给出评价指标（如困惑度、准确率、缓存压缩率等）的具体数值。

Experiments: 摘要仅说明在多种长上下文任务上进行了实验，证明 TaskPress 能高效构建跨多样查询的紧凑可复用缓存。未给出具体对比方法、消融实验或量化结果。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于 LLM 推理优化领域；(2) 摘要未提供实验细节、数据集、指标和部署数据；(3) 查询无关的 token 重要性估计可能牺牲特定查询的精度，摘要未讨论这种 trade-off；(4) 量化 scale factor 作为重要性信号的有效性缺乏理论分析和消融验证；(5) 未说明该方法在视觉/遥感任务上的可迁移性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管弱相关，仍有两点方法论可借鉴：(1) "任务引导的查询无关重要性估计"思想——在遥感目标检测中，可类比为"任务级（如舰船检测）引导的通道/层重要性评估"，构建跨图像可复用的剪枝掩码，避免逐样本重新计算重要性；(2) "量化 scale factor 作为零成本重要性信号"——在遥感检测模型轻量化中，可探索利用量化误差/scale factor 作为通道或层重要性代理，实现剪枝与量化联合优化，降低重要性评估的计算开销。但需注意这些只是方法论层面的启发，需重新设计以适配 CNN/Transformer 检测器。

Abstract: Long-context inference with large language models is constrained by the linear growth of the key-value cache to sequence length. While pruning offers mitigation, prevailing methods determine query-specific token importance that cannot be reused across unseen queries. In contrast, we introduce TaskPress, a framework for task-guided, query-agnostic KV cache eviction. Instead of optimizing the cache for a single query, TaskPress constructs a reusable memory representation conditioned on a high-level task guide. The guide functions as a meta-query during prefill to filter irrelevant tokens before downstream queries are issued. In addition, TaskPress leverages quantization scale factors as a zero-cost signal for detecting influential representation outliers, providing an efficient proxy for token importance. Experiments on conducted on various tasks with long context input demonstrate that TaskPress efficiently creates a compact, reusable cache across diverse queries.

</details>


### [267] [AgentPanel: Toward a New Paradigm for Human--AI Collaboration in Exploring Scientific Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03283)
*Zhiyao Cui,Qianyi Wang,Haoyang Yan,Yiqun Zhang,Siyue Ren,Hangfan Zhang,Zelin Tan,Hao Li,Chunjiang Mu,Dexian Cai,Shao Zhang,Chen Zhang,Meng Li,Jianan Chai,Yuting Fan,Zichao Ye,Xiaolei Yang,Xinyao Lu,Yuyang Yu,Wenjie Lou,Xiaosong Wang,Fenghua Ling,Shiyang Feng,Mao Su,Qiaosheng Zhang,Bo Zhang,Yang Chen,Lei Bai,Shuyue Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AgentPanel，一个用于人类与AI协作进行科学探索的多智能体论坛平台，通过异构智能体异步讨论科学问题来帮助研究者发现和筛选科研想法。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于科学探索中的人机协作平台（multi-agent forum for scientific exploration），属于AI辅助科研工具/人机交互方向，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩部署等任何相关技术。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于AI辅助科研工具/人机交互方向，无技术借鉴价值，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：科学想法发现与筛选（scientific idea exploration）；应用场景：科研探索中的人机协作；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: AgentPanel平台架构：异构智能体（heterogeneous agents）在论坛式环境中异步讨论科学问题；研究者可提交问题、浏览和组织候选想法、与智能体进行后续交互、生成事后总结报告。属于多智能体系统（multi-agent system）设计，非视觉/检测模型架构。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未讨论任何模型压缩、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS或轻量化网络设计方法。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 评估方式：离线实验（offline experiments）对比集中式多智能体辩论基线（centralized multi-agent debate baseline）；人类研究（human study）涉及20名参与者；指标包括idea quality、exploration breadth、interaction effectiveness、candidate-selection efficiency、practical utility；65%参与者偏好AgentPanel。未使用遥感或视觉数据集。

Experiments: 离线实验显示AgentPanel优于集中式多智能体辩论基线；20人人类研究显示用户认可其视角多样性和探索支持；与常用LLM工具的经验性对比中，65%参与者偏好AgentPanel在探索广度和早期探索适用性上的表现。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但与本课题方向完全无关：不涉及遥感图像处理、目标检测、模型压缩或边缘部署；属于AI辅助科研工具方向，对遥感在轨检测轻量化课题无直接技术借鉴价值。

Ideas for my research: 弱相关借鉴点有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：AgentPanel的多智能体协作思想或可类比用于"多专家模型协同"的轻量化设计思路（如多个轻量子模型协同推理），但这是非常间接的联想，且论文本身未涉及任何视觉或部署技术，不建议作为主要参考。

Abstract: Identifying promising scientific ideas remains an important challenge in research practice. Researchers commonly rely on small-group discussions or one-to-one interactions with a single large language model, yet these approaches often expose them to only a limited range of perspectives and directions. We present AgentPanel, a multi-agent forum for human--AI collaboration in scientific exploration. Heterogeneous agents asynchronously discuss scientific questions in a forum-style environment, while researchers can submit questions, browse and organize candidate ideas, engage agents in follow-up interactions, and optionally generate post-hoc summary reports. We evaluate AgentPanel in terms of idea quality, exploration breadth, interaction effectiveness, candidate-selection efficiency, and practical utility. Offline experiments show that AgentPanel outperforms a centralized multi-agent debate baseline. A human study with 20 participants further shows that users value AgentPanel for perspective diversity and exploration support. In experience-based comparisons with commonly used LLM tools, 65\% of participants favored AgentPanel for both breadth of research directions and overall suitability for early-stage exploration. The platform is publicly available at https://agentpanel.cc/.

</details>


### [268] [DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03292)
*Le Xiang,Zhicheng Guan,Hong Chen,Xiaocong Lin,Zhenghua Lei,Teng Hu,Bolei He,Long Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DocTrace提出一种层次化框架，将长文档视觉问答(LongDocVQA)建模为显式证据图推理问题，通过两阶段训练（联合SFT + 任务特定GRPO）实现证据定位、结构化文档解析和证据图推理，在三个长文档基准上显著超越开源和闭源MLLM。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于多模态大语言模型(MLLM)在长文档视觉问答领域的应用，与遥感、卫星、在轨目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。它既不是遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测，更不涉及模型压缩或边缘部署。唯一可能的借鉴点是其两阶段训练框架（SFT + GRPO强化学习）和显式证据图推理机制，这些方法学思路或可迁移到遥感目标检测的推理可解释性研究中，但整体相关性很弱。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文聚焦长文档VQA与MLLM推理，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及遥感场景、目标检测或任何模型压缩/部署技术。除非对MLLM训练策略（SFT+GRPO）或可解释推理机制有跨领域兴趣，否则无需优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：长文档视觉问答(LongDocVQA)，即多页文档中跨页定位、整合和推理异构文档元素。应用场景：文档理解、多模态问答。传感器类型：非遥感传感器，输入为文档图像/页面。目标类别：文档元素（文本、表格、图表等），非遥感目标。

Model architecture: DocTrace层次化框架，包含三个核心阶段：(1) 证据定位(evidence localization)；(2) 结构化文档解析(structured document parsing)；(3) 证据图推理(evidence graph reasoning)。以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct作为骨干模型(backbone)。训练采用两阶段框架：第一阶段联合SFT初始化证据定位和图推理能力，第二阶段使用任务特定的GRPO(Group Relative Policy Optimization)强化学习进一步优化。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文未涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等任何模型压缩或轻量化方法。骨干模型为Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct（8B参数规模），属于大模型范畴，未讨论部署优化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。8B参数的MLLM本身对星上部署而言规模过大，且论文未讨论任何边缘或星上部署可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL、SlideVQA三个长文档VQA基准。评价指标：摘要未明确列出具体指标名称（推测为VQA准确率/匹配分数），但报告了绝对提升点数：相比Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct骨干，三个基准分别提升14.4、11.3、11.7个百分点。

Experiments: 在MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL、SlideVQA三个基准上与现有开源baselines和闭源MLLM对比，DocTrace一致优于所有对比方法。相比Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone，绝对提升分别为14.4、11.3、11.7点。此外，DocTrace构建了带显式节点级溯源的可追踪证据图，支持透明可验证的推理。摘要未提供消融实验细节。

Limitations: (1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化方向完全无关；(2) 摘要未说明推理效率、模型规模压缩策略或部署可行性；(3) 8B参数MLLM的推理成本较高，未讨论实时性；(4) 未提供消融实验、计算开销等关键实验细节；(5) 证据图推理的复杂度随文档长度增长的可扩展性未讨论。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感目标检测无直接关联，但以下方法学思路或可借鉴：(1) 两阶段训练范式（SFT初始化 + GRPO强化学习优化）可迁移到遥感小目标检测模型的训练策略中，用于提升检测头的定位精度；(2) 显式证据图推理/可解释推理机制，可类比用于遥感检测中的"证据链"构建，增强在轨检测结果的可信度和可追溯性；(3) 层次化"定位-解析-推理"框架思想，可类比为遥感检测中的"候选区域定位-特征解析-目标判定"流水线。但整体借鉴价值有限，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Long Document Visual Question Answering (LongDocVQA) requires Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to locate, integrate, and reason over heterogeneous document elements distributed across multiple pages. Existing approaches, including end-to-end MLLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and document agents, often lack explicit mechanisms to represent and verify how grounded evidence is progressively composed during reasoning, limiting both answer accuracy and traceability. In this paper, we cast LongDocVQA as an explicit evidence graph reasoning problem rather than implicit answer prediction. To this end, we propose DocTrace, a hierarchical framework that progressively performs evidence localization, structured document parsing, and evidence graph reasoning to enable explicit evidence provenance. To effectively learn these capabilities, we develop a two-stage training framework: joint Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) first initializes evidence localization and graph reasoning abilities, followed by task-specific Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with dedicated rewards to further optimize these capabilities. Extensive experiments on MMLongBench-Doc, LongDocURL, and SlideVQA demonstrate that DocTrace consistently outperforms both existing open-source baselines and proprietary MLLMs. Compared with the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone, DocTrace achieves absolute improvements of 14.4, 11.3, and 11.7 points on the three benchmarks, respectively. Beyond competitive performance, DocTrace constructs traceable evidence graphs with explicit node-level provenance, enabling transparent and verifiable reasoning for long document understanding.

</details>


### [269] [Distractor-Aware Truncation: Disentangling Context-Length Effects from Signal Loss in Long-Context LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03297)
*Mohsen Arjmandi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究检索增强和记忆增强语言模型中上下文截断策略对性能的影响，对比了朴素截断（删除中间内容）与干扰物感知截断（仅删除无关内容）两种协议，发现性能下降主要源于截断方式误删了答案承载内容，而非上下文长度本身。

Research relevance: 1分。该论文属于自然语言处理/大语言模型（LLM）领域，研究上下文窗口截断策略对长上下文基准测试的影响，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署完全无关。既非遥感场景，也非视觉任务，更不涉及模型压缩或边缘部署。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文属于NLP/LLM上下文窗口研究，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：长上下文语言模型基准测试（long-context benchmark evaluation）；应用场景：检索增强生成（RAG）与记忆增强语言模型；传感器类型：不适用（文本数据）；目标类别：不适用（文本推理任务）。

Model architecture: 评估对象为Claude系列（Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7）以及GPT-5.5，属于通用大语言模型（LLM），非视觉或遥感专用模型。摘要未说明具体网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS或轻量网络设计等模型压缩方法。其核心关注点是上下文截断（context truncation）策略，属于数据/提示词层面的处理，而非模型轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。本文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署指标。研究对象为云端大模型推理，与在轨部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：BABILong、GraphWalks (BFS)、MRCR v2、Oolong（均为长上下文NLP基准）；评价指标：得分（score），使用配对Wilcoxon检验（paired Wilcoxon）和Holm校正（Holm-corrected p_adj < 0.05）进行统计显著性检验；实验设置：四种上下文保留比例（100%、75%、50%、25%）× 两种截断协议（朴素截断 vs 干扰物感知截断）。

Experiments: 主要结果：(1) 朴素截断下得分单调下降，8个BABILong和GraphWalks实验单元均统计显著（p_adj < 0.05）；(2) 干扰物感知截断下性能保持或提升，两个较小Claude模型在BABILong上有显著增益，较大模型（Opus 4.7和GPT-5.5）达到全上下文上限；(3) 朴素截断在25%保留率下答案承载内容存活率不足1%，而干扰物感知协议按构造保留信号；(4) 结论在GPT-5.5上复现，排除单一供应商伪影。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关，无法提供遥感目标检测或轻量化方面的局限性分析。就论文本身而言，摘要未说明：跨模型架构（如开源模型）的泛化性、真实RAG场景中的可操作性（干扰物感知需要预先知道答案位置）、计算开销等。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但有一个方法论层面的间接启发：论文强调"评估协议本身可能引入系统性偏差"——类比到遥感目标检测，在评估轻量化模型时，需警惕评测协议（如裁剪/缩放输入图像、截断检测范围）可能掩盖或夸大模型真实性能。此外，"干扰物感知"的思想可类比为：在遥感场景中，若只保留目标区域而丢弃背景，检测精度可能虚高，需在完整场景下评估轻量化模型的真实泛化能力。但总体借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: A standard claim in the literature on retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented language models is that shorter context is better when the relevant information is preserved. We test this claim by running every sample of two long-context benchmarks -- BABILong and GraphWalks (BFS) -- at four context-retention fractions (100%, 75%, 50%, 25%) under two truncation protocols. The first is the naive protocol implicitly used in much prior work: drop content from the middle of the prompt. The second is distractor-aware: identify the task-relevant content for each sample and drop only the rest. We evaluate three sizes of the Claude family (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7) and, to test cross-provider generality, GPT-5.5 from a different provider; we apply the same protocol to two further benchmarks (MRCR v2, Oolong). Under naive truncation, score collapses monotonically (paired Wilcoxon, Holm-corrected p_adj < 0.05 in all eight BABILong and GraphWalks cells). Under the distractor-aware protocol -- which preserves the signal by construction -- performance is preserved or improves: the two smaller Claude models show statistically significant gains on BABILong, while the larger models (Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5) sit at their full-context ceiling. The naive collapse and its distractor-aware recovery replicate on GPT-5.5, ruling out a single-provider artifact. The mechanism is direct: under the naive protocol the answer-bearing content survives in fewer than 1% of samples at 25% retention; under the distractor-aware protocol it is preserved by construction. The naive protocol is therefore not a measurement of context-window effects; it is a measurement of how often middle-removal happens to spare the answer. We conclude that future studies of context-length effects must specify how they distinguish signal from distractor, or they are at best ambiguous between two opposite hypotheses.

</details>


### [270] [SeaSlides: Semantic Abstraction Layer for Agentic Slide Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03298)
*Shengjun Fang,Chenyang Wu,Zongzhang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SeaSlides 是一个基于语义抽象层的智能幻灯片生成框架，通过模板与能力模块分离内容创作与渲染，在 HTML 和 Typst 两个后端上实现更可读、内容导向的演示文稿生成。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文聚焦于智能演示文稿（slide）生成，属于自然语言处理/多模态生成/文档自动化领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等任何遥感相关任务，也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测等视觉检测任务，更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署等轻量化或部署技术。相关性评分为 1 分。

Reading priority: 1 分。论文主题为智能演示文稿生成，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化研究方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：agentic slide generation（智能演示文稿生成）。应用场景：长技术演示文稿（含公式、代码、数据图表）的自动生成。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉传感器）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: SeaSlides 框架围绕语义抽象层（semantic abstraction layer）构建，包含两个后端实现：SeaSlides-HTML 使用模板定义的 DOM components，SeaSlides-Typst 使用 template functions 和 package-backed modules。能力模块（capability modules）将公式、代码、图表路由到专用渲染器，三个反馈阶段（three feedback stages）在导出前定位构建错误、项目约束违规和视觉缺陷。模型通过可复用组件和模板编写结构化幻灯片内容，而非直接编写坐标、内联样式或原始 SVG 几何。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法（无剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、轻量网络设计等）。其"语义抽象"概念属于生成框架设计层面的抽象，与模型轻量化无关。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。其关注点是生成内容的可读性和质量，而非推理效率。

Datasets and metrics: 评估使用两个基准：128-task UltraPresent validation setting 和新增的 SeaSlidesBench-Rich（32-task 基准，强调数学、代码、伪代码、表格、图表和示意图）。评价指标为 rich-content macro-average 和整体定性质量（readability、content-oriented source）。在四个生成模型上评估两个 SeaSlides 后端。

Experiments: 主要实验结果显示：在四个生成模型下，两个 SeaSlides 后端相比 SVG-heavy generation 产生更可读、内容导向的源代码；SeaSlides 后端在四个模型中的三个上取得最高的 rich-content macro-average，同时保持有竞争力的整体定性表现。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：论文仅针对演示文稿生成任务，与遥感目标检测、模型轻量化、在轨部署完全无关；评估指标（macro-average、可读性）与检测精度（mAP）、推理速度（FPS）、模型复杂度（FLOPs/Params）等指标无任何交集。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的可借鉴点非常有限。唯一可能间接相关的概念是"语义抽象层"（semantic abstraction layer）——即通过抽象接口将高层语义与底层实现解耦，这一设计思想在软件架构层面或许可类比于将检测模型的高层任务逻辑与底层硬件加速（FPGA/NPU）实现解耦，但这是非常间接的类比，实际借鉴价值很低。

Abstract: Agentic presentation generation must preserve source content, maintain coherent visual design, render specialized objects, and produce usable artifacts. Existing systems meet only part of this requirement: templates preserve regularity but restrict adaptation, whereas free-form HTML or SVG gives models flexibility at the cost of low-level rendering decisions. This mismatch makes long technical decks brittle, especially when slides contain formulas, code, or data graphics. We present SeaSlides, an agentic slide-generation framework built around a semantic abstraction layer. Rather than authoring coordinates, inline styles, or raw SVG geometry, the model writes structured slide content through reusable components and capability modules, while templates own layout, style, and rendering. We instantiate this principle separately in HTML and Typst: SeaSlides-HTML uses template-defined DOM components, whereas SeaSlides-Typst uses template functions and package-backed modules. Capability modules route equations, code, and charts to dedicated renderers, and three feedback stages localize build errors, project-constraint violations, and visual defects before export. The two systems retain backend-specific syntax and contracts while sharing the same authoring boundary. For evaluation, we combine the 128-task UltraPresent validation setting with SeaSlidesBench-Rich, a new 32-task benchmark stressing mathematics, code, pseudocode, tables, charts, and diagrams. Across four generation models, both SeaSlides backends produce more readable, content-oriented source than SVG-heavy generation. A SeaSlides backend attains the highest rich-content macro-average under three of the four models while maintaining competitive overall qualitative performance. These results support semantic abstraction as a practical authoring principle across presentation backends.

</details>


### [271] [Screenshots or Tools? Eliciting Tool Use and Managing Multimodal Context in Hybrid GUI-MCP Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03327)
*Siqi Fan,Minghao Li,Xiaoqian Ma,Wenhui Tan,Xiusheng Huang,Juntong Wu,Liujie Zhang,Shuo Shang,Weihang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究混合计算机使用智能体（hybrid computer-use agents）在GUI-MCP框架下工具调用行为对性能的影响，提出"adoption gap"概念，并通过多轮RL和上下文压缩来改善工具采用率与输入成本。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文研究的是GUI计算机使用智能体（computer-use agents）在OSWorld-MCP基准上的工具调用行为，属于泛机器学习/多模态智能体方向，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。唯一可借鉴的是其"输入token压缩"（halving image history, cutting input tokens by ~1/3）的思路，与轻量化中的输入/特征压缩有概念上的类比，但并非遥感场景。

Reading priority: 1分。论文属于GUI智能体行为学研究，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，仅输入压缩思想有极弱的类比借鉴价值，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：混合计算机使用智能体（hybrid computer-use agents）的工具调用决策与行为分析；应用场景：GUI自动化操作（如电子表格操作）；传感器类型：屏幕截图（screenshot）+ 文本工具调用；目标类别：非遥感目标，涉及工具调用行为（tool-decision behavior）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。涉及两类策略：reasoning model（推理模型）与non-reasoning model（非推理模型），在统一的GUI-MCP harness下运行。涉及多轮RL（multi-turn RL）训练、dense tool bonus奖励设计、上下文压缩（dropping redundant screenshots, halving image history）。

Lightweight method: 核心轻量化手段是上下文/输入压缩：当一次成功的工具调用使下一张截图变得冗余时，丢弃该截图并将图像历史减半，使输入token减少约三分之一（cut input tokens by about a third），在微小精度代价下实现。在相同观测规则下重训练可消除该精度代价，压缩后的智能体达到37.8% vs 未压缩的33.0%，输入成本仅为53%。这属于输入侧压缩/上下文裁剪，而非传统模型压缩（剪枝/量化/蒸馏/NAS）。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及输入token成本降低约1/3（压缩后为未压缩的53%），属于输入侧计算成本优化，与星上/边缘部署的硬件约束（FPGA/NPU/TensorRT）无直接关联。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：OSWorld-MCP benchmark（309个任务）；评价指标：准确率（accuracy，如37.8% vs 33.0%）、工具采用率（tool adoption，如0.03 -> 0.33）、输入token成本（input cost，53%）、标准误（SE）与预注册退化子集（pre-registered degraded subset）上的rich-lean gap。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：(1) 相同MCP工具对推理模型提升+4.0pp，对非推理模型降低-5.9pp（各5次运行，均超过2 SE）；(2) 推理模型仅在55/309任务中调用工具，占工具可达任务的23.9%，即"adoption gap"；(3) 多轮RL中dense tool bonus将电子表格工具采用率从0.03提升到0.33并保持到greedy decoding，但held-out精度未随之提升——行为可引导但能力不可引导；(4) 上下文压缩（丢弃冗余截图+减半图像历史）将输入token减少约1/3，重训练后压缩智能体达到37.8% vs 33.0%，输入成本53%，rich-lean gap归零。

Limitations: 摘要未说明模型架构细节、参数量、FLOPs等部署指标；未涉及遥感/卫星场景；held-out精度未随工具采用率提升而提升，说明工具调用行为优化与能力提升之间存在脱节；压缩带来的精度提升依赖重训练，直接压缩会有精度代价；整体研究聚焦GUI智能体行为学，与遥感目标检测轻量化方向关联薄弱。

Ideas for my research: 尽管场景不同，以下思路可迁移到遥感在轨目标检测轻量化：(1) "输入侧压缩"思想——在遥感场景中，可类比为对多光谱/高光谱波段或图像块进行冗余裁剪，减少输入token/计算量，类似"丢弃冗余信息"；(2) "行为可引导但能力不可引导"的教训——在轻量化蒸馏/剪枝中，单纯优化某一指标（如FLOPs）未必带来精度收益，需在相同观测/训练规则下重训练（类似retraining under the same observation rule）才能消除精度代价；(3) "adoption gap"概念可类比为轻量化模型在部署时对某些硬件加速路径（如NPU算子）的利用率不足；(4) 压缩后重训练消除精度代价的结论，与剪枝/量化后fine-tuning的必要性一致。

Abstract: Hybrid computer-use agents can act through screenshots or call text tools. We find that having a tool available does not settle which way the effect goes. Under one identical GUI-MCP harness on the OSWorld-MCP benchmark (309 tasks), the same MCP tools improve a reasoning model by +4.0pp and degrade a non-reasoning model by -5.9pp (5 runs each, both beyond 2 SE). What separates the two is tool-decision behavior. The non-reasoning policy ignores, misnames, or falsely terminates around tools. The reasoning model avoids these failures, yet still calls a tool on only 55/309 tasks, 23.9% of the tool-reachable ones. We call this shortfall the adoption gap. Both levels of the problem share one cause: the model already has a cheaper route and is never trained to take it. Multi-turn RL probes that cause. At the action level, a dense tool bonus raises spreadsheet adoption 0.03 -> 0.33 and carries into greedy decoding, but held-out accuracy does not follow. Behavior is steerable; competence is not. The bottleneck lies in tool-call semantics. At the context level, a successful tool call often makes the next screenshot redundant. Dropping it and halving image history cuts input tokens by about a third, at a small accuracy cost. Retraining under the same observation rule removes that cost. The compressed agent then reaches 37.8% against 33.0% for the uncompressed operating point, at 53% of the input cost, and closes the rich-lean gap on a pre-registered degraded subset to zero. Tools help when the model chooses and integrates them, and current hybrid agents leave many such choices unused.

</details>


### [272] [Long-term Traffic Scene Prediction via Polynomial Representations in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03330)
*Yue Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本论文提出基于多项式表示的轨迹预测模型，用于自动驾驶交通场景预测，强调计算效率、泛化能力和预测合理性。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。论文聚焦自动驾驶交通场景预测（traffic scene prediction），与遥感卫星在轨目标检测无直接关系。虽然涉及"computationally efficient"和"computational cost"等效率概念，但这是针对轨迹预测的表示效率，并非模型压缩/轻量化技术（pruning, quantization, distillation等）。属于泛机器学习/泛视觉方法，对遥感目标检测的借鉴价值有限。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为自动驾驶轨迹预测，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，仅在"计算效率表示"和"跨域泛化评估"理念上有间接启发，不建议优先精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：自动驾驶中的交通场景预测（traffic scene prediction），包括轨迹预测（trajectory prediction）和多智能体场景生成（multi-agent scene generation）。应用场景：自动驾驶（autonomous driving）。传感器类型：摘要未说明（推测为车载传感器，但未明确）。目标类别：车辆轨迹、地图几何（map geometry）。

Model architecture: 基于多项式表示（polynomial representations）的预测模型，同时用多项式表示轨迹和地图几何；扩展为基于扩散（diffusion-based）的生成框架用于多智能体场景生成。摘要未给出具体网络结构细节。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及传统模型压缩方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等）。论文的"computational efficiency"来源于多项式表示本身的计算优势，而非模型轻量化技术。不涉及边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等部署相关内容。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。仅提及多项式表示"reduce computational cost"，但未给出量化数据。不涉及星上部署或边缘部署。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：Argoverse 2 和 Waymo Open Dataset。评价指标：摘要未明确列出具体指标名称，但提到"regression-based metrics"和"standard benchmarks"，并指出标准in-distribution评估和回归指标可能无法反映真实泛化能力和预测合理性。

Experiments: 在Argoverse 2和Waymo Open上验证：多项式表示相比序列表示在计算效率、泛化能力和预测合理性上更优；中等阶次多项式能高保真捕捉真实运动动态；扩散生成框架生成的交通延续比传统基线更合理且运动学一致；跨数据集泛化能力显著提升。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/在轨目标检测完全无关，属于自动驾驶轨迹预测领域。2. 摘要未提供任何模型压缩或轻量化技术细节。3. 摘要未给出计算效率的量化指标（FLOPs、延迟等）。4. 未涉及遥感图像、SAR、高光谱等传感器数据。5. 摘要未说明模型在真实车载/嵌入式平台上的部署验证。

Ideas for my research: 1. 多项式表示（polynomial representations）的思想可借鉴：在遥感目标检测中，可用多项式/参数化方式表示旋转框（oriented bounding box）或目标轨迹，减少参数冗余。2. 论文指出"标准in-distribution评估可能无法反映真实泛化能力"，这对遥感在轨场景有启示——在轨模型面临分布偏移（不同光照、季节、传感器），评估时应关注跨域泛化。3. 扩散生成框架用于多智能体场景生成的思想，可类比用于遥感数据增强或场景合成。4. 整体而言，该论文对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值有限，仅在某些表示效率和泛化评估理念上有间接启发。

Abstract: This thesis addresses fundamental challenges in traffic scene prediction for autonomous driving by introducing robust and computationally efficient models based on polynomial representations. While conventional sequence-based representations often struggle with noise and generalization, this work demonstrates that polynomial representations offer significant advantages in computational efficiency, generalization, and prediction plausibility. Through theoretical analysis and empirical validation, this thesis demonstrates that moderate-degree polynomials capture real-world motion dynamics with high fidelity without constraining predictive performance. Building on this foundation, a prediction model representing both trajectories and map geometry with polynomial representations achieves near state-of-the-art accuracy on standard benchmarks while substantially improving generalization under distribution shift. Extending this concept, a diffusion- based generative framework enables multi-agent scene generation, producing traffic continuations that are more plausible and kinematically consistent than those generated by conventional baselines. Evaluations on the Argoverse 2 and Waymo Open datasets confirm that polynomial representations reduce computational cost, enhance cross-dataset generalization, and yield smoother trajectories and higher behavioral plausibility. The findings reveal that standard in-distribution evaluation and regression-based metrics may fail to reflect true model generalization and prediction plausibility. By providing theoretical justification and empirical validation, this dissertation estab- lishes polynomial trajectory representations as an efficient, expressive, and generalizable foundation for traffic scene prediction in safety critical autonomous driving.

</details>


### [273] [Traceable Multi-Agent System for Knowledge-Based Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03339)
*Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Hyeokjun Choe,Soonyoung Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TraceMAS是一个面向企业预测的多智能体可追溯交互演示系统，通过两种因果循环图（Ideal CLD和Data-Grounded CLD）组织智能体输出，使自主预测流程的证据到预测过程可检查，并在原油价格预测上进行了演示。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。该论文聚焦于企业预测（enterprise forecasting）中的多智能体系统（multi-agent forecasting）和可追溯性（traceability），属于自然语言处理、智能体系统与预测分析的交叉领域。完全不涉及遥感（remote sensing）、卫星（satellite）、地球观测（Earth observation）、目标检测（object detection）或模型轻量化（model lightweighting）。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于多智能体预测与可追溯性系统领域，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：多智能体预测系统（multi-agent forecasting）的可追溯性展示。应用场景：企业预测、原油价格预测（crude oil price forecasting）。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感/视觉任务）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构细节。系统围绕两种因果循环图组织：Ideal CLD（从领域文档提取关键因素及其因果关系的理想因果循环图）和Data-Grounded CLD（将因素与内部变量、外部数据或文档代理相连接的数据落地因果循环图）。涉及多智能体（multi-agent）协作，包括文档解读、数据搜索、代码生成和模型修订等智能体角色。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。不涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS或任何模型压缩/加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及星上部署（onboard deployment）、边缘部署（edge deployment）、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存或能耗等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集和评价指标。仅在原油价格预测（crude oil price forecasting）场景上进行了演示（demonstration），未提及定量评价指标。

Experiments: 摘要未说明定量实验结果。仅描述了演示系统的功能：用户可比较预测迭代、检查智能体级修订、探索因果图、审查特征-数据映射和模型架构、将情景预测与市场叙事连接。属于交互式演示（interactive demo），未提供对比实验或消融实验。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1）仅针对原油价格预测单一场景演示，泛化性未验证；2）未提供定量评估指标；3）因果循环图的构建质量和可扩展性未讨论；4）与遥感/视觉/目标检测领域完全无关。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的借鉴点非常有限。唯一可能间接相关的思路是：该论文强调"可追溯性"（traceability）和"证据到预测的可检查性"，这提示在遥感在轨检测系统中，若引入可解释性/可追溯机制（如记录检测决策依据、模型修订历史），可能有助于地面运维人员审查星上模型行为。但这一借鉴属于方法论层面的泛化启发，与轻量化技术本身无直接关联。

Abstract: Enterprise forecasting increasingly relies on autonomous agents that interpret documents, search for data, generate code, and revise models. While this autonomy helps build adaptive forecasting pipelines, it also makes it difficult for practitioners to inspect why a forecast changed, which evidence supported the change, and how data and modeling choices were revised. We present TraceMAS, an interactive demo system for traceable multi-agent forecasting. TraceMAS organizes agent outputs around two causal-loop representations: an Ideal Causal Loop Diagram (Ideal CLD), which captures key factors and their causal relations extracted from domain documents, and a Data-Grounded Causal Loop Diagram (Data-Grounded CLD), which links those factors to internal variables, external data, or documented proxies. The Data-Grounded CLD guides feature construction and model design while preserving the connection between textual evidence, data choices, and model revisions. We demonstrate TraceMAS on crude oil price forecasting. The demo interface allows users to compare forecasting iterations, inspect agent-level revisions, explore causal maps, review feature-data mappings and model architecture, and connect scenario forecasts to market narratives. This demonstration shows how autonomous forecasting agents can retain flexibility while making the evidence-to-forecast process inspectable.

</details>


### [274] [MMLongBench-Doc-V2: A Corrected-Annotation, Semantics-Aware Revision of MMLongBench-Doc](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03397)
*Mingtian Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MMLongBench-Doc-V2 是对长文档问答基准 MMLongBench-Doc 的修正版本，修正了106条标注错误、替换了字符串匹配指标为LLM裁判、移除了11个有问题的题目，并提供了可复用的空集键扩展决策流程。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。该论文属于自然语言处理/长文档问答（long-document QA）基准评测领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能，也不涉及目标检测或任何模型压缩/轻量化方法。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与"遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化"研究方向基本无关，属于NLP长文档问答基准评测领域，不涉及遥感、目标检测或模型压缩/部署。除非对评测方法论（如LLM裁判替代硬指标）有泛化兴趣，否则无需阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：长文档问答（long-document QA）基准构建与修正；应用场景：文档理解与问答评测；传感器类型：不适用（纯文本PDF文档）；目标类别：不适用（问答问题与文档）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型结构。核心贡献是评测基准的修正与评估流程设计，包括：将字符串匹配指标替换为固定的LLM裁判（pinned LLM judge）来判断回答是否与参考答案语义等价；提出空集键（empty set key）扩展的决策流程。

Lightweight method: 不涉及任何轻量化方法。摘要中未提及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT等任何模型压缩或加速技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。该论文不涉及星上/边缘部署，无参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：MMLongBench-Doc（V1）及其修正版 MMLongBench-Doc-V2，包含135个PDF文档、1082个问题（V1），修正后为134个文档、1071个问题。评价指标：V1使用参考字符串匹配（reference metric）比较提取答案；V2改用固定的LLM裁判判断回答是否与参考答案语义等价。修正了106条标注，移除了10个文件名错误的题目和1个重复题目。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验对比结果。主要工作是对基准的修正：修正106条标注（每条附有页码和算术依据）、替换指标为LLM裁判、移除11个问题、对208行应用空集键扩展决策流程并扩展了14个。作者明确指出V2分数与已发布的V1分数不可直接比较。

Limitations: 该论文与遥感在轨目标检测及轻量化方向完全无关，属于NLP评测基准领域。摘要未涉及任何视觉任务、模型部署或效率优化内容。其核心关注点是评测指标的公平性与标注质量，而非模型性能或部署可行性。

Ideas for my research: 虽然该论文与遥感目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但有一个方法论层面的间接借鉴点：其"用LLM裁判替代字符串匹配指标"的思路，提示在遥感目标检测评测中，如果使用严格的IoU阈值或字符串式匹配可能对某些边界情况不公平，可考虑更鲁棒的评测协议。此外，其"修正标注并公开修正记录"的做法，对遥感数据集（如DOTA、HRSC2016等）的标注质量审计有一定参考价值。但这些均为间接、泛化的借鉴，不构成实质性研究方向关联。

Abstract: MMLongBench-Doc is a long-document QA benchmark of 1,082 questions over 135 PDFs. Two properties of it push measured scores away from the quantity they are meant to capture: the reference metric compares extracted answers, so 1,358,000 loses to 1358000; and a non-trivial share of ground-truth annotations are wrong, ambiguous, or incomplete --- concentrated, because of how they were found, in exactly the questions capable systems answer correctly. MMLongBench-Doc-V2 corrects 106 annotations, each published with the page and arithmetic that settle it, and replaces the string metric with a pinned LLM judge asked whether a response means the reference. Ten questions whose document ships under the wrong filename are removed rather than counted wrong, along with one duplicated question, leaving 1,071 questions over 134 documents. The most reusable contribution is a decision procedure for when an empty set key may be widened and when widening would destroy a deliberate negative sample; applied to all 208 rows, it widened 14. V2 scores are not comparable with published V1 numbers. The corrected corpus, the per-entry correction record and the evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/VectifyAI/MMLongBench-Doc-V2.

</details>


### [275] [Towards Robust Tool Use in Agents via Experience-Driven Adaptive Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03403)
*Can Wang,Haoran Chen,Li Yu,Ding Hao,Bohai Zhao,Zhaoyang Liu,Zhiying Tu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ExpG机制，通过经验获取、经验蒸馏和经验复用三个阶段构建并优化工具使用指导，提升智能体在不同运行环境下工具调用的鲁棒性。

Research relevance: 与本研究方向基本无关（1分）。论文聚焦于LLM/智能体（agent）的工具使用鲁棒性问题，属于自然语言处理与智能体领域，完全不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测任务，更不涉及任何模型轻量化或边缘/星上部署技术。虽然摘要中出现"distillation"一词，但指的是"experience distillation"（经验蒸馏），即对历史执行轨迹中经验池的筛选与总结，与模型压缩中的knowledge distillation（知识蒸馏）完全无关。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为LLM agent工具使用鲁棒性，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向完全无关，无直接借鉴价值。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：智能体（agent）工具使用（tool use）的鲁棒性增强，涵盖tool selection、tool calling、response generation三个子任务。应用场景：LLM-based agent与外部工具交互的运行时环境。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: ExpG机制包含三个阶段：(1) experience acquisition——从历史执行轨迹中分析工具调用质量，通过多维度归因产生结构化可学习经验；(2) experience distillation——通过等价类方法筛选代表性经验，过滤无用经验并总结为可泛化指导；(3) experience reuse——在后续任务求解中自适应应用指导。整体架构围绕agent的工具使用流程设计，不涉及任何视觉/检测网络结构。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明任何模型压缩或加速方法。虽然提及"distillation"，但这是经验池的筛选与总结机制，并非模型层面的knowledge distillation。不涉及pruning、quantization、NAS、轻量网络设计等任何轻量化技术。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署，不报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署指标。唯一相关的性能表述是"smaller agents outperform larger ones"，但这指的是更小规模的LLM在引入ExpG后性能超过更大规模模型，属于模型能力层面的对比，与计算资源/部署效率无关。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称和评价指标。仅提及在tool selection、tool calling、response generation三个任务上进行了实验，并报告了"consistent improvements"和"particularly strong gains in challenging settings"，但未给出具体数值或基准名称。

Experiments: 摘要仅概述了实验结果：ExpG在三个任务上带来一致改进，使较小agent超越未使用ExpG的较大agent，且在具有挑战性的设置下增益尤为显著。未提供具体对比方法、消融实验细节或量化结果。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可指出：论文完全面向LLM agent的工具使用场景，与遥感目标检测和模型轻量化无任何交集；"distillation"一词易造成与知识蒸馏的混淆，需注意区分；摘要未提供任何部署相关指标，无法评估其计算开销。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感在轨目标检测轻量化方向基本无关，但"experience distillation"中"用等价类方法筛选代表性样本"的思想，在概念层面可类比于数据集蒸馏（dataset distillation）或样本选择策略，或许对遥感小样本目标检测中的数据增强或难例挖掘有间接启发。此外，"smaller model + guidance outperforms larger model"的结论在哲学层面与轻量化目标一致，但方法论上无可直接借鉴之处。总体而言，不建议投入时间深入阅读。

Abstract: The performance bottleneck of agents is increasingly shifting from model capability to the robustness of their execution processes. Tools play a central role as the primary interface through which agents interact with external environments, yet existing methods rarely focus on ensuring robust tool use across diverse runtime conditions. To address this problem, we propose ExpG, a mechanism that builds and refines adaptive guidance capturing each tool's capability boundaries and best practices, thereby enabling agents to use tools more robustly and effectively. ExpG consists of three phases: (1) experience acquisition, which analyzes tool invocation quality from historical execution trajectories, producing structured learnable experiences through multi-aspect attribution; (2) experience distillation, which keeps the experience pool effective by filtering unhelpful experiences, selecting representative ones with an equivalence-class-based method, and summarizing them into generalizable guidance; and (3) experience reuse, which applies the guidance adaptively during future task solving. Extensive experiments show that ExpG brings consistent improvements across the tool selection, tool calling, and response generation tasks, enabling smaller agents to outperform larger ones that do not use ExpG. Moreover, ExpG achieves particularly strong gains in challenging settings, suggesting a promising path toward more robust tool use. Our code, experiments, and results are available.

</details>


### [276] [Enactive Artificial Intelligence: A Decision-Centric Architecture for Complex Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03413)
*Zuojun Max Shen,Yuan Qu,Pujun Zhang,Anbang Liu,Yunhao Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Enactive AI概念框架，用于企业级和工业复杂系统中的决策智能、站点级决策支持与执行反馈，强调AI从模型能力向系统感知行动的扩展。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文讨论的是企业/工业复杂系统中的AI决策框架（Enactive AI），不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能等任何遥感相关主题，也不涉及目标检测或模型压缩/轻量化。属于泛AI/企业决策智能方向的弱相关论文。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于企业决策智能概念框架研究，不涉及任何遥感、目标检测或模型压缩技术内容，不建议阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：企业级与工业复杂系统中的决策智能框架设计。应用场景：企业运营管理、工业站点级优化与执行、决策支持与反馈。传感器类型：不适用（摘要未涉及）。目标类别：不适用（摘要未涉及）。

Model architecture: 提出Enactive AI概念框架，包含四个互补角色：Organizational World（组织世界，定义企业战略-制度层面的运营管理逻辑和组织行为世界模型）、Site World（站点世界，定义运营-实现层面的物理边界工业优化与执行世界模型）、Schema Intelligence（模式智能，提供两个世界模型之间的耦合机制）、Enactive Decision Cycle（能动决策循环，触发框架的自演化动态更新与审计过程）。

Lightweight method: 摘要未涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法。不涉及pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、轻量网络设计等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未涉及星上/边缘部署相关内容。不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署指标。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集和评价指标。论文为概念性/框架性研究，未提及实验数据集、benchmark或定量评估指标。

Experiments: 摘要未说明具体实验结果。论文属于概念框架综述/综合研究（synthesizes adjacent research），未提及对比方法、消融实验或定量结果。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：该论文为概念性框架研究，缺乏定量实验验证；与遥感、目标检测、模型轻量化完全无关；其讨论的"reliability, feasibility, resilience, responsibility"等可靠性要求虽与部署有一定概念关联，但属于企业决策层面而非计算资源/硬件部署层面。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的直接借鉴价值很低。唯一可能的概念性启发在于：论文强调AI系统在真实复杂系统中的"reliability, feasibility, resilience, responsibility"要求，这与在轨部署中需要考虑的鲁棒性、可靠性、资源受限下的可行性有一定哲学层面的类比，但缺乏任何技术层面的可操作性。不建议作为技术参考。

Abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) continues to evolve and mature, recent AI practices have moved beyond large language models (LLMs) and text or image generation tasks, increasingly integrating tools, agents, and harnesses to solve real business and industrial problems. However, the power of AI is not verified under these real-world complex systems for various reasons, considering reliability, feasibility, resilience, and responsibility requirements in real commercial and industrial operations. This study synthesizes adjacent research and introduces Enactive AI as a conceptual framework for enterprise and industry reasoning, site-level decision support, and execution feedback. Four complementary roles organize the framework: an Organizational World defines operations management logic and an organizational behavior world model behind an enterprise from a strategic-institutional horizon; a Site World defines a physically bounded industrial optimization and execution world model from an operational-realization horizon; Schema Intelligence provides the coupling mechanism between two world models to weave various AI applications via two models; and Enactive Decision Cycle triggers the self-evolving dynamic process to update and audit the entire framework. By foregrounding decision intelligence in complex systems, Enactive AI expands the frontier of AI from model capability to system-aware action, opening new possibilities for scalable, governable, and socially valuable AI deployment. Enactive AI points toward a future in which AI progress is measured not only by what models can generate or automate, but by how reliably intelligent systems can support consequential action, responsible governance, and durable social value in the complex systems that shape modern life, which we believe will define the next frontier of AI research for enterprise-level and industrial complex systems.

</details>


### [277] [AI World Cup 2026: Benchmarking Large Language Models for End-to-End Football Tournament Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03416)
*Jonaid Shianifar,Iias Faiud*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为 AI World Cup 的基准测试，评估十个 LLM 助手对 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯全部 104 场比赛的赛前预测表现，发现淘汰赛表现主导最终排名，而逐场准确率与总排名不一致。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文主题是大型语言模型（LLM）对体育赛事（足球世界杯）的预测基准测试，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能等任何遥感相关领域，也不涉及 object detection、小目标检测、旋转框检测等目标检测任务，更不涉及 pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS、实时推理、边缘部署等轻量化或部署技术。属于泛机器学习/LLM 应用评估方向，与本课题弱相关（仅可能在"模型评估方法论"层面有极弱的借鉴意义）。

Reading priority: 1 分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于 LLM 体育赛事预测评估研究，无可直接迁移的技术内容，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM 赛事预测基准测试（AI World Cup）。应用场景：体育赛事（2026 FIFA 世界杯）赛前预测。传感器类型：不适用（无遥感传感器）。目标类别：不适用（预测对象为足球比赛结果、小组排名、淘汰赛对阵等）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构细节。涉及十个 LLM-based assistants，包括 GPT-5.5 Thinking、GPT-5.5、Gemini、Qwen 3.7、Claude Sonnet 4.6 等，但未给出这些模型的内部结构、参数量或网络设计。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法，如剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计等。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：2026 FIFA 世界杯全部 104 场比赛的真实赛果，所有参赛模型使用相同的 tournament snapshot、prompt、JSON schema 和 scoring procedure。评价指标：总分（total score）、淘汰赛积分（knockout points）、小组赛比分预测积分（group-stage match points）、小组排名积分（group-standing points）、赛前积分（pre-knockout score）、逐场准确率（match-level accuracy）、自报置信度（self-reported confidence），以及相关系数 r 值。

Experiments: 主要结果：GPT-5.5 Thinking 以 744 分夺冠，其后依次为 GPT-5.5（717）、Gemini（699）、Qwen 3.7（687）。GPT-5.5 Thinking 是唯一预测西班牙夺冠的模型（西班牙决赛 1-0 击败阿根廷）。最终排名主要由淘汰赛表现驱动：总分与淘汰赛积分强相关（r=0.986），但与小组赛比分积分（r=0.055）、小组排名积分（r=-0.103）及赛前综合积分（r=-0.054）几乎无关。逐场准确率排序不同：Claude Sonnet 4.6 正确预测最多小组赛结果（63.89%）但总排名第六。自报置信度与准确率（r=-0.060）和总分（r=-0.067）均无相关性。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：1) 该基准仅针对单一赛事（足球世界杯），泛化性有限；2) 评分规则设计对排名影响显著（bracket-based leaderboard 依赖 scoring design），可能掩盖模型真实预测能力；3) 与遥感目标检测、模型轻量化、在轨部署等方向完全无关，无可直接迁移的技术内容。

Ideas for my research: 与本课题（遥感卫星在轨目标检测模型轻量化）基本无可借鉴的技术点。唯一可能的间接启发是：1) 论文强调"评估基准的设计会显著影响模型排名结论"，这提示在遥感目标检测轻量化研究中，评价指标（如 mAP vs. 延迟 vs. 能耗）的选择会显著影响对轻量化方法优劣的判断，应综合多维度指标评估；2) 论文指出"整体任务表现与逐项任务表现可能不一致"，类比到遥感检测中，整体 mAP 提升与单类小目标检测性能提升可能不一致，轻量化评估时应关注小目标/难例类别的单独指标。但这些均为方法论层面的泛化启发，非技术性借鉴。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now regularly asked to forecast real-world events, but comparisons are often difficult because models receive different information, use different tools, and are evaluated under different rules. This paper reports the completed \emph{AI World Cup} benchmark, in which ten LLM-based assistants made a single pre-tournament forecast of the entire 2026 FIFA World Cup. Every submission used the same tournament snapshot, prompt, JSON schema, and scoring procedure. The forecasts covered group-stage scores, group rankings, the knockout bracket, final placings, confidence values, and short explanations. After all 104 matches had been played, GPT-5.5 Thinking finished first with 744 points, followed by GPT-5.5 with 717, Gemini with 699, and Qwen 3.7 with 687. GPT-5.5 Thinking was also the only model to select Spain, which defeated Argentina 1--0 in the final, as champion. The final ranking was driven mainly by knockout performance: total score was strongly correlated with knockout points ($r=0.986$), but showed little relationship with group-stage match points ($r=0.055$), group-standing points ($r=-0.103$), or their combined pre-knockout score ($r=-0.054$). Match-level accuracy produced a different ordering. Claude Sonnet 4.6 correctly predicted the largest number of group-stage outcomes (63.89\%) but placed sixth overall. Average self-reported confidence was also unrelated to either outcome accuracy ($r=-0.060$) or total score ($r=-0.067$). The results suggest that forecasting a complete tournament tests something different from predicting matches one at a time, while also showing how strongly a bracket-based leaderboard can depend on scoring design. The benchmark materials, raw responses, and scoring code are released to support replication and future extensions.

</details>


### [278] [Towards Improving Sequential Decision-Making in LLM Agents via Experience Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03420)
*Jakub Rada,Viliam Lisý*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究大语言模型在完全可观测双人零和博弈中的序贯决策能力，并提出带经验记忆的agentic框架来改善LLM在井字棋等简单游戏中的次优表现。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文研究的是LLM在序贯决策（sequential decision-making）和博弈游戏中的推理能力，不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或任何模型压缩/加速技术。属于泛机器学习/LLM推理方向，与本课题弱相关。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为LLM序贯决策推理，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，不涉及任何遥感、目标检测或模型压缩/加速技术，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM序贯决策推理（sequential decision-making）；应用场景：完全可观测双人零和博弈（tic-tac-toe, Connect Four）；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 提出一个agentic framework，包含experience memory（经验记忆），用于序贯决策场景，解决credit assignment（信用分配）问题。采用post-game reflection（赛后反思）和rule extraction（规则提取）机制，不修改模型权重。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等任何模型压缩或轻量化方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 使用tic-tac-toe和Connect Four两个完全可观测双人零和博弈作为评估环境；以MCTS（Monte Carlo Tree Search）作为对手和基准；评估指标为LLM在博弈中的胜率/表现（outcomes determined by rules）。

Experiments: 实验发现：不同规模的LLM在简单博弈（tic-tac-toe, Connect Four）中表现次优，输给MCTS对手；对游戏树进行表面改写（obfuscations）后性能基本不变，说明性能差距不能完全归因于记忆策略的回忆；提出的agentic framework通过post-game reflection和rule extraction在tic-tac-toe上取得可测量的性能提升。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感目标检测和轻量化完全无关，无任何可迁移的部署或压缩技术；2. 实验仅覆盖简单博弈，未涉及复杂序贯决策场景；3. 摘要未说明框架的计算开销、推理延迟等效率指标；4. 未报告在更复杂博弈（如Connect Four）上框架是否同样有效。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可能的间接启发是：论文中"post-game reflection"和"rule extraction"的思想，在概念上类似于知识蒸馏中从教师模型提取规则/知识到学生模型的过程，但技术路线完全不同。如果未来考虑将LLM用于遥感在轨场景的语义理解或决策辅助，该框架的memory设计思路或可参考，但与本课题核心的轻量化目标检测无直接关联。

Abstract: Large language models have improved substantially on single-shot reasoning tasks, but their performance in sequential decision-making is less well understood. We study this on fully-observable two-player zero-sum games, which provide ground-truth evaluation: outcomes are determined by the rules, and optimality of individual moves can be computed or approximated, without relying on a judge model. Across model tiers, LLMs play suboptimally in simple games such as tic-tac-toe or Connect Four, and lose to MCTS opponents. Obfuscations that preserve the game tree but rewrite its surface form leave performance largely unchanged, indicating the gap is not fully explained by recall of memorized strategies. Motivated by this performance gap, we introduce an agentic framework enhanced with an experience memory designed for the sequential setting and addressing common challenges of sequential decision-making such as credit assignment. We show that post-game reflection and rule extraction yield measurable improvements on tic-tac-toe without modifying the model weights.

</details>


### [279] [State Propagation Also Satisfies: A Complex-Valued State-Space Model for Deterministic State Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03425)
*Xiaohe Li,Yang Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Complex State Propagator (CSP)，一种极简的循环架构，仅通过复数域状态传播即可在确定性状态跟踪任务（如奇偶校验、模计数、括号匹配）上达到100%准确率。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文是泛机器学习/序列建模方法，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。它属于泛视觉/泛机器学习方法，仅在"轻量级架构设计"这一抽象层面可能对轻量化网络设计有间接借鉴意义。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，属于序列建模/状态跟踪的纯机器学习研究。仅在"极简架构设计"哲学层面有极有限的间接启发，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：确定性状态跟踪（deterministic state tracking），包括 parity checking（奇偶校验）、modular counting（模计数）、parenthesis matching（括号匹配）。应用场景为序列建模，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: CSP (Complex State Propagator)：极简循环架构，仅在层间传播隐藏状态，中间步骤无输出投影（output projections）。状态表示为复数向量（complex-valued vector），通过输入依赖的复数域旋转（input-dependent rotations）进行更新。引入 block-level skip connection（块级跳跃连接）、element-wise complex normalization（逐元素复数归一化）和 SiLU activation 来避免深层传播中的梯度消失与退化。

Lightweight method: 该论文本身并非轻量化方法论文，但架构设计体现"极简主义"思想——去除中间步骤的输出投影，仅保留状态传播，属于架构层面的参数精简。未涉及剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS 等经典轻量化手段。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。未提供参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署相关信息。由于是循环架构且状态为复数向量，理论上参数量可能较少，但摘要未给出任何量化数据。

Datasets and metrics: 使用 canonical tasks（规范任务集）：parity checking、modular counting、parenthesis matching。评价指标：accuracy 和 F1 score，均达到100%（perfect）。使用 Focal Loss 训练。未说明具体数据集规模与划分方式。

Experiments: CSP 在三个规范任务上均达到100%准确率和完美F1分数。摘要未说明与哪些基线方法对比，也未提供消融实验细节。

Limitations: 1. 任务范围狭窄，仅覆盖确定性状态跟踪类任务，未验证在视觉/遥感任务上的泛化能力。2. 摘要未提供参数量、计算量等效率指标，无法判断其实际轻量化程度。3. 未与 Transformer、LSTM 等主流序列模型进行系统对比。4. 复数运算在硬件部署（如 FPGA/NPU）上的支持度可能受限，摘要未讨论。

Ideas for my research: 1. "极简架构"思想可借鉴：去除冗余投影层、仅保留必要计算路径，这一设计哲学可用于遥感目标检测骨干网络的轻量化改造。2. 复数域状态表示与旋转更新机制，可启发设计轻量的时序特征融合模块（如用于视频/多帧遥感目标检测中的帧间状态传播）。3. block-level skip connection 与 complex normalization 的组合，可作为深层轻量网络训练稳定性的参考方案。4. 但整体而言，该论文与遥感在轨目标检测的直接关联很弱，借鉴价值有限。

Abstract: Transformer-based architectures have dominated sequence modeling, largely due to the expressive power of attention mechanisms. However, for a class of deterministic state tracking tasks---such as parity checking, modular counting, and parenthesis matching---attention may be overkill. In this paper, we show that \textbf{state propagation alone is sufficient}.
  We propose the \textbf{Complex State Propagator (CSP)}, a minimalistic recurrent architecture that \textbf{only propagates hidden states} across layers without output projections at intermediate steps. The state is represented as a complex-valued vector, updated via input-dependent rotations in the complex domain. To enable deep propagation without gradient vanishing or degradation, we introduce a \textbf{block-level skip connection} alongside element-wise complex normalization and SiLU activation at sequence boundaries. Applied with Focal Loss, CSP achieves \textbf{100\% accuracy} with perfect F1 scores across canonical tasks.

</details>


### [280] [DataSpace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Verifiable Analytics over Heterogeneous Workspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03451)
*Boyan Li,Zhuowen Liang,Yupeng Xie,Xiaotian Lin,Tianqi Luo,Xinyu Liu,Yizhang Zhu,Zhangyang Peng,Yuan Li,Zhengxuan Zhang,Jiayi Zhang,Nan Tang,Guoliang Li,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了DataSpace基准，用于评估数据代理（data agents）在异构工作空间中生成可验证表格结果的能力，包含410个跨语言任务和7439个工件，并作为KDD Cup 2026官方评测基准。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于自然语言数据代理（data agents）在组织工作空间中的表格分析任务，属于自然语言处理、数据库检索与多模态理解领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱或空间在轨智能。也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测、旋转框检测或任何视觉检测任务，更不涉及轻量化、剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS、实时推理或边缘/星上部署。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测与模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于数据代理与多模态表格分析领域。除非对数据基准构建方法论或确定性评测器设计有特殊兴趣，否则不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：数据代理（data agents）的自然语言表格分析任务，要求代理根据问题在异构工作空间（CSV、JSON、SQLite、Markdown、PDF、视频）中检索证据并生成完整的表格结果。应用场景：组织工作空间的企业级数据分析，非遥感场景。传感器类型：不适用（涉及文本、表格、PDF、视频等多模态数据）。目标类别：不适用（无视觉目标检测目标）。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构。论文主要贡献是基准构建框架DataSpace-Builder，包含跨语言转换、约束感知的关系采样、模态路由与工件渲染、人工审查与任务修复等模块。评测对象为六个前沿多模态模型（frontier multimodal models）和五个代理框架（agent harnesses），但未给出具体模型名称和结构细节。

Lightweight method: 不涉及。论文未提及任何模型压缩或加速方法，包括剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）、知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）、NAS、轻量网络设计等。摘要未说明。

Onboard deployability: 不适用。论文未涉及星上/边缘部署、参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息。摘要未说明。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：DataSpace基准，包含410个跨语言任务和7,439个工件，总数据量15.01 GB，涵盖CSV、JSON、SQLite、Markdown、PDF和视频六种模态。评价指标：确定性评估器（deterministic evaluator），包含header不变的列对齐（header-invariant column alignment）、类型与精度感知的归一化（type- and precision-aware normalization）、顺序感知的行比较（order-aware row comparison）。最佳准确率66.34%。

Experiments: 在六个前沿多模态模型和五个代理框架上进行评测。最佳准确率66.34%；在骨干网络固定的情况下，代理框架的选择造成15.36个百分点的性能差异；多模态证据整合与连接（joins）在所有六个骨干网络上均降低准确率。结果显示DataSpace尚未饱和（unsaturated），并指出了提升数据代理可靠性的关键挑战。

Limitations: 与本研究方向完全无关，无法提供遥感目标检测或轻量化方面的任何借鉴。摘要未说明模型架构细节、推理效率、部署约束等。此外，论文本身也指出多模态证据整合会降低性能，说明该基准对多模态融合的鲁棒性仍有挑战。

Ideas for my research: 虽然整体方向无关，但以下方法论层面可能有间接借鉴价值：(1) 确定性评估器设计（header-invariant column alignment、type-aware normalization、order-aware row comparison）的思路可用于遥感目标检测中检测结果的严格对齐与公平评测；(2) 基准构建中的"人工审查与任务修复"流程可类比于遥感数据集的标注质量控制；(3) 多模态证据整合降低性能的发现提示在遥感多传感器（光学+SAR）融合中需谨慎设计融合策略。但这些均为间接启发，不构成实质性借鉴。

Abstract: Data agents enable natural-language analytics over organizational workspaces, where relevant evidence may be scattered across databases, structured files, long documents, and multimedia. Existing benchmarks largely isolate structured querying, retrieval, or open-ended analysis, leaving heterogeneous evidence discovery, complete tabular outputs, and deterministic evaluation insufficiently unified. We introduce DataSpace, a benchmark in which data agents produce verifiable tabular results from task-local heterogeneous workspaces. It contains 410 cross-language tasks and 7,439 artifacts totaling 15.01 GB across CSV, JSON, SQLite, Markdown, PDF, and video. DataSpace also served as the official evaluation benchmark for the KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents for Complex Data Analysis competition. Each agent receives only a question and workspace and returns the complete requested tabular result. We construct DataSpace with DataSpace-Builder, an execution-grounded framework comprising cross-language transformation, constraint-aware relational sampling, modality routing and artifact rendering, and human review and task repair by 11 domain experts. A deterministic evaluator performs header-invariant column alignment, type- and precision-aware normalization, and order-aware row comparison. Across six recently released frontier multimodal models and five widely used agent harnesses, the best accuracy reaches 66.34%, while harness choice creates a 15.36-point spread with the backbone fixed. Multimodal evidence integration and joins consistently reduce accuracy across all six backbones. These results show that DataSpace remains unsaturated and identify key challenges for improving data-agent reliability.

</details>


### [281] [LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03457)
*Fengqi Zhu,Shaoxuan Xu,Jingyang Ou,Zebin You,Yipeng Xing,Huabin Liu,Xiaolu Zhang,Jun Zhou,Zhenzhong Lan,Yankai Lin,Wayne Xin Zhao,Jianguo Li,Chongxuan Li,Ji-Rong Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 系统研究扩散语言模型（dLLM）中MoE架构的扩展规律，并据此训练了30B-A3B的LLaDA MoE v2模型。

Research relevance: 1分，基本无关。论文聚焦于扩散语言模型（diffusion language models）的MoE扩展规律与训练，属于自然语言处理/大语言模型领域，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、轻量化部署均无直接关联。

Reading priority: 1分。论文主题为扩散语言模型的MoE扩展规律，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关，不建议投入阅读时间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：扩散语言模型（dLLM）的scaling law研究与大模型预训练。应用场景：通用NLP（知识、推理、编码benchmark）。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: MoE（Mixture-of-Experts）架构的扩散语言模型，具体为LLaDA MoE v2，30B总参数量、3B激活参数（30B-A3B）。涉及expert pool规模、expert granularity、shared expert激活比例等架构设计。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文讨论的是MoE架构的scaling规律（如expert pool大小、activated capacity分配），并非针对模型压缩/加速的轻量化方法（如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS）。MoE本身可视为一种参数效率设计，但论文未从部署/推理加速角度讨论。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未提供参数量之外的部署信息（FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等均未提及）。30B-A3B的模型规模对于星上/边缘部署而言过大，不具备在轨可行性。

Datasets and metrics: 预训练数据：23.5T tokens。评测benchmark：知识、推理、编码类基准（具体名称摘要未说明），对比模型包括Qwen3和SDAR Chat。评价指标：benchmark得分（具体指标名称摘要未说明）。

Experiments: 主要实验：IsoFLOP分析揭示数据侧略倾斜（最优token预算增长快于激活侧计算）；优化超参数方面，最优名义batch size增长更快、最优学习率随计算量衰减更快；架构方面，更大规模更偏好更大的expert pool，中等expert granularity持续有效，shared expert激活比例跨规模稳定。LLaDA MoE v2用约Qwen3的65%预训练token，在多个知识/推理/编码benchmark上接近Qwen3；仅经SFT后，在8个推理/编码benchmark中的7个上超过SDAR Chat。

Limitations: 与本研究方向（遥感卫星在轨目标检测与轻量化）完全无关。摘要未涉及任何视觉任务、遥感场景、目标检测、模型压缩或边缘/星上部署内容。此外，论文聚焦scaling law的理论规律，未讨论实际推理效率与部署约束。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限，但可提取两点间接启发：(1) MoE架构中"固定激活容量下增大expert pool"的scaling规律，若未来在遥感检测模型中引入MoE式条件计算，可参考其expert分配策略；(2) IsoFLOP分析方法论可迁移到遥感检测模型的"精度-计算量"权衡分析中，用于指导轻量化方案的选择。但整体上该论文对在轨目标检测轻量化课题的直接借鉴价值很低。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language modeling, yet the scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs remains poorly understood. We systematically characterize how optimization hyperparameters, compute allocation, and architecture scale for MoE dLLMs, identifying quantitative differences from scaling trends previously reported for AR models. Specifically, for optimization, the optimal nominal batch size grows faster, while the optimal learning rate decays more rapidly with compute. For model--data allocation, IsoFLOP analysis reveals a slight data-side tilt: the optimal token budget grows faster than activated model-side computation. For MoE architecture, larger scales increasingly favor larger expert pools at fixed activated capacity, while moderate expert granularity remains consistently effective and the preferred fraction of activated capacity assigned to shared experts remains stable across scales. Guided by these findings, we train LLaDA MoE v2, a 30B-A3B dLLM, from scratch on 23.5T tokens. With approximately 65\% as many pretraining tokens as Qwen3, LLaDA MoE v2 approaches Qwen3 on several knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks. After supervised fine-tuning alone, it outperforms SDAR Chat on seven of eight reasoning and coding benchmarks and remains close to Qwen3 on several tasks. These results establish practical scaling laws and design principles for MoE dLLMs.

</details>


### [282] [Solver-Aware Decompositions for Programming-by-Example: When Dividing Requires Knowing how to Conquer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03461)
*Janis Zenkner,Tobias Sesterhenn,Tim Grams,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD) 训练框架，通过冻结的合成器直接反馈来优化分解器，使分解器生成的子目标更符合求解器的搜索动态，而非盲目模仿人工标注的 ground-truth 分解。

Research relevance: 1 分。该论文属于 Programming-by-example (PBE) 程序合成领域，研究的是分解器（decomposer）与合成器（synthesizer）之间的训练对齐问题，与遥感、卫星、目标检测、模型轻量化均无任何关联。属于程序合成/机器学习方法论的泛化研究，与本课题方向基本无关。

Reading priority: 1 分。论文属于程序合成领域，与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，仅方法论层面有极间接的启发，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：Programming-by-example (PBE) 程序合成中的任务分解与程序生成。应用场景：程序合成（两个 PBE 领域）。传感器类型：不适用。目标类别：不适用。

Model architecture: 包含两个组件：decomposer（分解器，预测中间子目标）和 synthesizer（合成器，基于子目标生成程序）。SAD 框架中合成器被冻结（frozen synthesizer），作为分解器的直接反馈信号来源。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS 等任何模型压缩或加速方法。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。不涉及参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗、实时性等部署相关信息。

Datasets and metrics: 摘要未说明具体数据集名称。评价指标包括 synthesis accuracy 和 end-to-end task accuracy，在两个 PBE 领域上进行实验。

Experiments: 实验发现一个"accuracy paradox"：分解器与 GT 分解的一致性越高，并不提升合成成功率。SAD 通过牺牲 GT 对齐换取求解器可解性（solver tractability），在两个 PBE 领域上取得一致的合成精度和端到端任务精度提升。此外，SAD 能解决 GT 分解 oracle 都无法解决的任务。

Limitations: 1. 论文完全面向程序合成领域，与遥感/目标检测/轻量化无任何交集。2. 摘要未说明模型规模、计算开销、推理效率等部署相关信息。3. 摘要未说明 SAD 方法在视觉任务上的可迁移性。

Ideas for my research: 尽管论文与遥感目标检测无关，但其核心思想——"分解质量是求解器相对的，而非内在的"——在方法论层面有一定启发：在知识蒸馏或模型压缩中，student 模型不应盲目模仿 teacher 的输出（类似 GT 分解），而应基于 student 自身的能力边界来设计蒸馏目标或剪枝策略。即"teacher-aware 的压缩/蒸馏"可能比"GT 对齐"更有效。但这属于间接的方法论借鉴，与本课题的直接相关性很低。

Abstract: Decomposition-based Programming-by-example (PBE) scales performance by splitting tasks into subtasks that a learned synthesizer solves: a decomposer predicts intermediate subgoals, and a synthesizer generates programs conditioned on them. Current approaches train the decomposer to imitate ground-truth ( GT) subgoals, implicitly treating decomposition quality as intrinsic to the task. We challenge this assumption: for bounded solvers with fixed inductive biases, GT decompositions reflect the annotator's factorization choices - not the solver's search dynamics. A decomposer trained to match GT decompositions may therefore propose subgoals that are logically valid yet intractable for the solver. We propose Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD), a training framework that retains supervised training on GT subgoals as a structural scaffold, while additionally optimizing the decomposer via direct feedback from a frozen synthesizer. Subgoals are rewarded based on the synthesizer's loss on the target program - a signal of subtask difficulty that encourages decompositions the solver can act on. Our experiments reveal an accuracy paradox: higher agreement with GT decompositions does not improve synthesis success - even though the synthesizer was trained on the very same GT data the decomposer is optimized to mimic. SAD instead learns decompositions that trade GT alignment for solver tractability, yielding consistent gains in synthesis and end-to-end task accuracy across two PBE domains. Moreover, SAD solves tasks that a GT decomposition oracle fails - empirical evidence that GT decompositions are not universally optimal for bounded solvers, and that decomposition quality is solver-relative, not intrinsic.

</details>


### [283] [LeanMem: Simple and Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03463)
*Yuxin Liao,Le Wu,Min Hou,Hao Liu,Han Wu,Zishu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LeanMem是一个面向LLM智能体的轻量级长期记忆框架，根据对话内容的可压缩性、时间动态性和保真度需求，将历史信息分类存储为profile/event/record三种记忆类型，并在推理时按需动态选择记忆类型和分配检索预算，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上以最低或接近最低的构建成本、推理token和延迟提升准确率最高15.1个点。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2分）。该论文属于LLM智能体长期记忆管理方向，与遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱、多光谱、空间在轨智能完全无关。虽然标题和摘要中出现"lightweight"一词，但这里的"轻量"指的是LLM记忆框架的token/延迟开销优化，并非模型压缩（pruning/quantization/distillation）意义上的轻量化，也不涉及目标检测。因此属于泛机器学习/泛AI方法，与本课题弱相关。

Reading priority: 1分。该论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM智能体记忆管理领域。虽然"lightweight"一词出现在标题中，但含义完全不同，不涉及模型压缩、目标检测或遥感场景。除非对LLM记忆系统有独立兴趣，否则不建议投入时间精读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：LLM-based agent的长期记忆管理与检索。应用场景：多轮对话、长程交互、智能体记忆系统。传感器类型：不适用（非遥感场景）。目标类别：不适用（非目标检测任务）。

Model architecture: LeanMem框架包含三个核心组件：1) 低价值内容过滤模块（filter out low-value content）；2) 三类记忆存储结构——profile memory（紧凑画像记忆）、event memory（时间结构化事件记忆）、record memory（源锚定记录记忆）；3) 推理阶段的动态记忆类型选择与检索预算分配机制。底层依赖GPT-4.1-mini和Qwen3-8B等LLM作为记忆构建与推理的骨干。

Lightweight method: 摘要中的"lightweight"并非指模型压缩（pruning/quantization/knowledge distillation/NAS），而是指记忆框架在token消耗、构建成本和延迟上的轻量化设计。具体手段包括：1) 过滤低价值内容以减少存储冗余；2) 按信息性质分类存储，避免统一summarization导致的token浪费；3) 维护阶段仅选择性更新动态演化的event memory，跳过稳定的profile和不可变的record；4) 推理时按查询需求动态分配检索预算。这些属于系统级资源优化，而非神经网络模型层面的轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及星上/边缘部署、FPGA/NPU/TensorRT、参数量、FLOPs、显存或能耗等部署指标。仅报告了构建成本（construction cost）、推理token数和延迟（latency）作为效率指标，但这些是针对LLM推理场景的，与在轨遥感目标检测的部署约束完全不同。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S。骨干模型：GPT-4.1-mini和Qwen3-8B。评价指标：准确率（accuracy），以及构建成本（construction cost）、推理token数（inference tokens）、延迟（latency）。对比基线：最强的memory-based baseline。结果：在全部设置下准确率提升最高15.1个点，同时保持最低或接近最低的构建成本、推理token和延迟。

Experiments: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S两个基准上，使用GPT-4.1-mini和Qwen3-8B两种骨干模型，LeanMem在所有设置下均优于最强memory-based baseline，准确率最高提升15.1个百分点，且构建成本、推理token和延迟处于最低或接近最低水平。摘要未提供消融实验、具体数值表格或与更多基线的详细对比。

Limitations: 1) 与遥感/卫星/目标检测完全无关，属于LLM智能体记忆管理领域；2) 摘要未说明记忆分类的阈值设定、过滤策略的具体实现细节；3) 未报告在更长对话、更多记忆类型或不同语言场景下的泛化能力；4) 依赖GPT-4.1-mini和Qwen3-8B等大模型，计算开销仍较大，与星上资源约束差距明显；5) 摘要未提供消融实验验证各模块的独立贡献。

Ideas for my research: 尽管该论文与遥感在轨目标检测无直接关系，但其"按信息性质分类处理、按需动态分配资源"的思想有一定借鉴价值：1) 在遥感目标检测中，可借鉴"按内容性质分类存储/处理"的思路，例如对不同尺度、不同类别、不同重要性（如舰船/飞机等关键目标 vs 背景区域）的目标采用差异化处理策略，避免对低价值区域浪费计算资源；2) "动态分配检索预算"的思想可类比为在轨推理时的动态计算分配——根据输入图像的复杂度或目标密度动态调整网络深度或推理精度；3) "选择性更新"思想可类比为增量学习/持续学习场景，在轨模型可只对动态变化的目标类别进行更新，避免全量重训练。但整体而言，该论文对课题的直接借鉴价值有限，建议仅作为方法论层面的启发。

Abstract: Long-term memory is essential for LLM-based agents to sustain interactions and reliably leverage distant history. However, existing memory systems typically process heterogeneous dialogue content through a uniform summarization and retrieval pipeline, leading to either excessive token consumption or irreversible loss of fine-grained evidence. We argue that historical dialogue content should be handled differently according to its compressibility, temporal dynamics, and fidelity requirements. Based on this insight, we propose LeanMem, a lightweight long-term memory framework. LeanMem first filters out low-value content, then stores informative segments as compact profile memory, temporally structured event memory, or source-grounded record memory, depending on the nature of the information. During maintenance, only dynamically evolving event memories are selectively updated, avoiding redundant consolidation of stable profiles and immutable records. During inference, LeanMem dynamically selects memory types and allocates retrieval budgets according to query-specific evidence demands, assembling relevant evidence on demand. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S with GPT-4.1-mini and Qwen3-8B, LeanMem improves accuracy over the strongest memory-based baseline in every setting, by up to 15.1 points, at the lowest or near-lowest construction cost, inference tokens, and latency. The code and datasets are included in the supplementary materials.

</details>


### [284] [ChartAnno: Evaluating MLLMs for Chart Annotation Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03464)
*Zhenghan Chen,Zekai Shao,Lidan Tan,Xin Lin,Xingchen Zeng,Yi Shan,Ziyue Lin,Xiaoliang Fu,Xinyuan Liu,Yuetong Guo,Fen Wang,Bongshin Lee,Siming Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ChartAnno基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图表标注生成任务上的能力，包含1,200个真实图表及三种指令粒度，评测了10个代表性MLLM。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在图表（chart）理解与标注生成任务上的能力评测，属于自然语言处理与视觉-语言交叉领域，不涉及遥感、卫星、Earth observation、aerial image、SAR、高光谱或多光谱等遥感场景，也不涉及目标检测、小目标检测或旋转框检测，更不涉及剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、NAS等轻量化或部署方法。相关性评分：1分。

Reading priority: 1分。论文与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及模型轻量化方向基本无关，属于图表理解与MLLM评测领域。除非未来研究方向涉及遥感大语言模型（remote sensing MLLM）或视觉-语言理解，否则无需阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：图表标注生成（chart annotation generation），即让MLLM根据图表推断意图并生成合适的文本或图形标注。应用场景：数据可视化、图表理解与编辑。传感器类型：不适用（输入为图表代码和图表图像）。目标类别：图表元素与标注，非遥感目标。

Model architecture: 摘要未说明具体模型架构细节。评测对象为10个代表性多模态大语言模型（MLLMs），包括专有模型（proprietary models）和开源模型（open-source models），但未列出具体模型名称。输入设置包括：(1) 仅图表代码（chart code alone）；(2) 图表代码+图表图像（chart code + chart image）；以及图表图像单独输入的消融实验。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明。论文不涉及任何模型压缩或加速方法，如pruning、quantization、knowledge distillation、NAS等均未提及。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明。论文未报告参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗或实时性等部署相关信息，且该任务（图表标注生成）与星上部署场景无关。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：ChartAnno基准，包含1,200个真实世界图表（real-world charts），配有配对代码（code）和标注指令（annotation instructions），覆盖三种指令具体性级别（three levels of instruction specificity）。评测对象：10个代表性MLLM。评价指标：摘要未明确列出具体指标名称，但提到"design-related metrics"（设计相关指标）在加入图表图像后有所提升。

Experiments: 主要实验发现：(1) 专有模型（proprietary models）整体表现更强，但大规模开源模型正在缩小差距；(2) 更具体的指令（more specific instructions）能提升标注质量；(3) 推断抽象意图（inferring abstract intent）对当前MLLM仍是最困难的；(4) 提供图表图像带来的整体增益有限，改进主要体现在设计相关指标上。

Limitations: 摘要未说明局限性。但可推断：(1) 该任务与遥感目标检测在数据模态、任务目标、评估体系上均无交集；(2) 未涉及任何部署或轻量化考量；(3) 评测的MLLM规模较大，与星上资源受限环境不匹配；(4) 图表标注任务本身与遥感场景理解差异显著。

Ideas for my research: 对"在轨遥感目标检测模型轻量化"课题的可借鉴点非常有限。可能的间接启发：(1) 论文展示了MLLM在视觉-语言任务上的能力边界，若未来考虑将大语言模型引入遥感在轨智能（如遥感图像描述、场景理解），可参考其评测框架设计思路；(2) 其"指令具体性影响任务质量"的发现，对设计遥感目标检测的prompt或任务描述有一定参考价值；(3) 但整体而言，该论文不涉及目标检测、遥感或轻量化，不建议作为核心参考。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in chart understanding, generation, and editing, but their ability to annotate existing charts remains underexplored. Annotating charts is a common yet challenging communicative task, requiring models to infer intended messages, interpret chart semantics, and place appropriate textual or graphical elements. To address this gap, we introduce ChartAnno, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on chart annotation generation. It contains 1,200 real-world charts with paired code and annotation instructions across three levels of instruction specificity. We evaluate 10 representative MLLMs under two primary input settings: (1) chart code alone and (2) both chart code and chart image, and further include a chart image-only ablation study. Results show that proprietary models remain stronger overall, although large-scale open-source models narrow the gap. More specific instructions improve annotation quality, while inferring abstract intent remains most difficult for current MLLMs. Providing chart images brings limited overall gains, with improvements mainly appearing in design-related metrics. These findings highlight chart annotation generation as a challenging task requiring semantic grounding and effective annotation design. Code and data will be released in a future version.

</details>


### [285] [When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03467)
*Zhe Cao,Miaowen Wen,Fangjiong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Cue-GRPO，一种基于策略线索的稀有性感知信用再分配方法，用于解决GRPO强化学习中正确解重复采样导致的结构级信用集中问题，提升数学推理性能。

Research relevance: 与遥感卫星在轨目标检测及轻量化方向基本无关。论文聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的强化学习训练（RLVR/GRPO），应用于竞赛数学推理（AIME），不涉及遥感、卫星、目标检测或模型压缩部署。属于泛机器学习/强化学习训练方法，相关性评分1分。

Reading priority: 1分。与遥感卫星在轨目标检测与轻量化方向基本无关，属于LLM强化学习训练方法，不建议优先阅读。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Task and scene: 任务类型：强化学习训练策略优化（RLVR, GRPO）；应用场景：竞赛数学推理（competition mathematics, AIME）；传感器类型：不适用；目标类别：不适用。摘要未说明。

Model architecture: 基于GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）框架，引入Cue-GRPO模块，使用确定性Strategy Cues构建rollout-local partitions，对verified-correct traces进行稀有性感知的信用再分配。基座模型为Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。

Lightweight method: 摘要未说明传统模型压缩方法（pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, NAS等）。仅提到Cue-GRPO相比GRPO仅增加6%的wall-clock训练开销，属于训练效率优化而非推理侧轻量化。

Onboard deployability: 摘要未说明参数量、FLOPs、延迟、显存、能耗等部署信息。仅提及训练开销增加6%，且模型为7B/8B规模的大语言模型，与星上部署场景不匹配。

Datasets and metrics: 数据集：AIME（American Invitational Mathematics Examination）竞赛数学数据集；评价指标：AIME repeated-sampling performance（重复采样性能）；基座模型：Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。

Experiments: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上验证Cue-GRPO，相比GRPO在AIME重复采样性能上有提升，且在高采样预算下增益最大。还验证了Judge Partitions（JP）下的Credit Redistribution（CR）机制。训练开销仅增加6%。

Limitations: 1. 与遥感/卫星/目标检测/轻量化完全无关；2. 仅针对数学推理任务验证，泛化性未说明；3. 摘要未说明方法在其他任务（如视觉任务）上的适用性；4. 未涉及任何部署侧指标。

Ideas for my research: 借鉴意义有限。唯一可参考的抽象思想是"稀有性感知的信用分配"——在训练目标检测模型时，如果某些困难样本（如小目标、旋转目标）被反复正确预测而简单样本被过度采样，可考虑对稀有困难样本给予更高训练权重。但这属于训练策略层面的启发，与轻量化部署无直接关系。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) com- monly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal. In GRPO, this completion-level uniformity creates structure-level skew: recurring correct solution forms accumulate positive coefficient mass in proportion to how often they are sampled, while rare forms receive limited credit. We formalize this behavior as multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration and introduce a partition- conditioned rule that redistributes positive advantages accord- ing to cluster rarity. Cue-GRPO instantiates this rule with- out auxiliary-model inference by using deterministic Strategy Cues to construct rollout-local partitions of verified-correct traces. Across Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Cue-GRPO improves AIME repeated-sampling performance, with the largest gains at high sampling budgets. Credit Re- distribution (CR) under Judge Partitions (JP) further indi- cates that the proposed redistribution mechanism can oper- ate with judge-derived partitions. Cue-GRPO adds only 6% wall-clock training overhead over GRPO. These results sup- port structure-level credit redistribution as a practical design axis for RLVR, with Strategy Cues providing a low-overhead implementation for competition mathematics. Code is avail- able at https://github.com/CzZ12/When-Correct-Solutions- Repeat-Rarity-Aware-Credit-Redistribution-for-GRPO.

</details>


### [286] [PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03682)
*Chenghua Wang,Daliang Xu,Dongqi Cai,Duojin Sun,Hao Zhang,Haoze Qian,Huaiyuan Zhang,Jinshuo Cui,Kezhao Zhao,Longxi Gao,Mengwei Xu,Rongjie Yi,Tianyue Zhang,Weikai Xie,Xiyuan Tan,Xuanzhe Liu,Yingying Qin,Yiwen Lu,Yuan Yao,Yuezhi Zu,Yunhan Guo,Ziqi Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhyAI 是一个面向 Physical AI（具身智能/机器人）的统一推理引擎，通过单一 runtime 和 model adapter 机制，在星上、边缘、云端统一运行 VLA 和 world-action 模型，相比官方实现获得 1.40x-4.65x 加速。

Research relevance: 弱相关（2 分）。论文涉及 onboard/edge/cloud 部署和推理加速，与"在轨部署"有一定概念交集，但核心对象是 Physical AI（具身智能、机器人 VLA 模型），并非遥感卫星目标检测。论文不涉及 remote sensing、object detection、遥感图像、SAR、高光谱等任何遥感内容，也不涉及目标检测模型。其轻量化/加速手段是推理引擎层面的 kernel 优化、内存管理、并行服务，而非模型压缩（pruning/quantization/distillation/NAS）。因此属于泛机器学习/系统优化方法，与本方向弱相关。
